reports.text: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/28/ukraine-war-briefing-zelenskyy-criticises-trump-for-calling-putin-his-friend-kyiv-deploys-new-laser-weapon) reported that Kyiv deployed a new laser weapon that intercepts Russian drones.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/zelenskyy-urges-us-to-pressure-russia-and-questions-trump-referring-putin-as-friend/article71753434.ece) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged the U.S. to apply more pressure on Russia.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91344) reported that US President Donald Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin could attend next month's G20 summit in Florida if he wished.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1127/1600845-trump-putin-ukraine/), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/zelensky-cuestiono-a-trump-por-llamar-amigo-a-putin-y-comparo-al-lider-ruso-con-hitler-nid27112026/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that US President Donald Trump calling Vladimir Putin "my friend" was strange and akin to making the same comment about Adolf Hitler.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91409) reported that Donald Trump stated he refers to Putin as a friend to keep negotiations open and secure a deal to end Russia's war against Ukraine.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/trump-putin-europe-ukraine-russia-aggression/33906739.html) reported that US President Donald Trump called on Russian President Vladimir Putin to halt all military aggression in Europe to pave the way for a Ukraine peace deal.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261127-live-trump-calls-on-putin-to-end-all-military-aggression-against-europe) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he had urged Russian President Vladimir Putin to pull back all military aggression against territories.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/zelensky-trump-putin-hitler-ukraine-russia-war-b3092578.html), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/27/zelenskyy-putin-trump-comments-russia-ukraine-latest-news-updates), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/27/zelenskiy-criticises-trumps-description-of-putin-as-a-friend/), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3376046/zelensky-says-trump-calling-putin-my-friend-being-buddies-hitler-wwii) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy compared US President Donald Trump calling Vladimir Putin a friend to being friends with Hitler during the Second World War.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8064921/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated at Mar-a-Lago on Thanksgiving that he calls Vladimir Putin his friend to help reach a peace deal and end the war.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8064888/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91349) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy criticized US President Donald Trump's warm reception of Vladimir Putin in China.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/26/trump-says-he-asked-putin-to-pull-back-military-aggression-throughout-europe/) reported that US president Donald Trump cited the possibility of a peace breakthrough as the White House pursues direct engagement with Moscow.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/trump-tells-putin-to-pull-back-all-military-aggression-across-europe/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he urged Russian President Vladimir Putin during conversations in China to pull back all military aggression across Europe.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064838/) reported that Donald Trump said he asked Vladimir Putin to reach a peace agreement with Ukraine quickly.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2224875) reported that Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergey Ryabkov stated that Russia outlined its framework for peace in Ukraine at the Abu Dhabi talks.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064509/), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/25/lukashenko-offers-to-fly-zelensky-to-moscow-for-peace-talks-with-putin-what-am-i-his-suitcase-zelensky-responds) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy dismissed Belarusian leader Alexander Lukashenko's proposal to fly together to Moscow for peace talks with Vladimir Putin.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91100) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky ridiculed Alexander Lukashenko's proposal to personally escort him to Moscow for negotiations with Vladimir Putin.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/peskov-european-countries-seek-four-party-talks-in-abu-dhabi/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated European countries want the Abu Dhabi talks held in a four-party format, though Russia does not yet agree.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/trump-names-jay-clayton-acting-national-cyber-director-report-3725930) reported that Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton will hold the post of acting national cyber director until the Senate confirms Kirsten Davies, according to the Washington Post.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90373427) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky responded to Donald Trump's remarks calling Vladimir Putin a friend by stating that Putin is a criminal to them.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/23/he-is-not-america-s-friend-in-ukraine-not-at-all-u-s-intelligence-chief-responds-to-trump-calling-putin-his-friend), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/not-americas-friend-us-intelligence-chief-defends-trump-calling-putin-his-friend/) reported that U.S. Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton defended President Donald Trump's remarks calling Vladimir Putin his friend.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90392843) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump sparked criticism after posting a photo with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/us-intelligence-chief-defends-trumps-comments-calling-putin-his?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton defended President Trump's comments calling Vladimir Putin his friend as appropriate in the context of a summit.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/us-sen-shaheen-slams-trump-for-calling-putin-friend-3725849) reported that US Senator Jeanne Shaheen wrote that Vladimir Putin is anything but a friend to the United States after Donald Trump used the word ahead of talks at the APEC forum in China.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/22/president-sheikh-mohamed-holds-talks-with-us-homeland-security-chief-in-abu-dhabi/) reported that President Sheikh Mohamed held talks with the US Homeland Security Chief in Abu Dhabi.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063867/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90773) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy responded to US President Donald Trump calling Vladimir Putin a friend by stating that for Ukraine, Putin is an enemy and a killer.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/putin-a-killer-zelenskyy-says-after-trump-calls-russian-leader-his-friend) reported that Russian forces launched a major wave of strikes against Ukraine from Thursday night into Friday morning, killing at least seven people in Kyiv.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187030-to-us-he-is-enemy-and-murderer-zelensky-on-putin-whom-trump-called-friend.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he considers Russian dictator Vladimir Putin a murderer and an enemy of Ukraine.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cqevrddp91z8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting called Vladimir Putin a cold-blooded killer during a meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Kyiv.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/ckvg2nxgjjdgo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky called Vladimir Putin a killer after Donald Trump called the Russian leader a friend.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/trump-defends-ties-with-xi-putin-after-summit-backlash/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/trump-defends-fantastic-ties-xi-putin-after-backlash), [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/trump-defends-fantastic-ties-with-xi-putin-after-summit-backlash/HL5T2OOGENAYPFU2IWYOSA5X6U/) reported that Trump defended his summit with Xi Jinping and Putin despite backlash from critics.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/estonia-to-close-road-borders-with-russia-in-response-to-sustained-aggression-against-europe/) reported that Estonia plans to close road borders with Russia in response to sustained aggression against Europe.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2222601) reported that Maria Zakharova emphasized that Russia would take all necessary political and diplomatic response measures to secure its national interests.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2222361), a Russian state outlet, reported that a Russian diplomat stated the Ukrainian army is intensifying terrorist activities and striking civilian infrastructure with drones.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/trump-plans-to-meet-separately-with-putin-on-his-china-trip-in-addition-to-their-3-way-talks-with-xi) reported that Donald Trump plans to meet separately with Putin on his China trip in addition to their three-way talks with Xi.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220795), a state-media outlet, reported that Belarusian Foreign Minister Maxim Ryzhenkov stated Belarus's relations with Russia are not a bargaining chip in talks with the West.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/xi-trump-putin-to-discuss-issues-concerning-global-peace-china-says-3725740) reported that China's Foreign Ministry stated the American, Russian, and Chinese presidents will discuss issues concerning global peace at a trilateral summit.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/trump-putin-xi-meet-in-china-to-discuss-global-issues/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping discussed ending Russia's war against Ukraine during talks in Shenzhen.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219937), a state-run outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova stated Europe is ready to talk about peace only while ignoring Russia's interests.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/politics/ukraine-russia-europe-trump.html) reported that President Trump's envoys are attempting to craft a postwar security agreement in Europe to end the war.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/us-scold-ukraine-strikes-russia-peace-talks-elbridge-colby/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius criticized U.S. remarks regarding deep strikes as stupid.

reports.text: [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/candidats/le-deuxieme-parti-de-france-derriere-le-rn-dans-les-coulisses-du-qg-de-campagne-de-david-lisnard-20261128) reported on the activities inside the Parisian campaign headquarters of liberal candidate David Lisnard.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/27/journalistes-et-secret-de-l-instruction-comprendre-ce-que-dit-le-droit-apres-les-declarations-de-marine-le-pen_6815927_3224.html) reported that National Rally presidential candidate Marine Le Pen wants to increase existing penalties when a journalist is convicted of receiving stolen goods.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/vox/politique/mathieu-bock-cote-le-troisieme-homme-de-jean-pierre-chevenement-a-david-lisnard-20261127) reported that columnist Mathieu Bock-Côté discussed the historical role of the third candidate in French presidential elections ranging from Jean-Pierre Chevènement to David Lisnard.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-le-debut-de-campagne-de-teddy-riner-deja-marque-par-les-polemiques-20261127) reported that presidential candidate Teddy Riner drew criticism after stating the war in Ukraine was not our war.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261127-france-david-lisnard-shakes-up-presidential-race) reported that Cannes mayor and 2027 presidential candidate David Lisnard climbed to third place in several opinion polls.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/ralliements-lr-a-lisnard-wauquiez-s-inquiete-d-un-risque-de-division-a-droite-apres-une-tribune-20261127) reported that eight Republican Right deputies in the National Assembly officialized their support for Nouvelle Energie candidate David Lisnard, prompting concerns of division from Laurent Wauquiez.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-si-elle-est-elue-marine-le-pen-affirme-vouloir-obliger-les-journalistes-a-respecter-le-secret-de-l-instruction-20261127) reported that National Rally presidential candidate Marine Le Pen announced she wants to oblige journalists to respect the secrecy of judicial investigations.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/27/presidentielle-2027-marine-le-pen-veut-contraindre-les-journalistes-a-respecter-le-secret-de-l-instruction_6815863_823448.html) reported that Marine Le Pen stated during a press briefing that media should be constrained regarding elements from judicial procedures.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-david-lisnard-n-est-plus-dans-mon-espace-politique-declare-gerald-darmanin-20261127) reported that Justice Minister Gerald Darmanin reiterated criticism against Nouvelle Energie candidate David Lisnard regarding his stance on Edgar.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-il-pourrait-meme-embarquer-avec-nous-la-main-tendue-de-sebastien-chenu-a-destination-de-david-lisnard-20261127) reported that Marine Le Pen lieutenant Sebastien Chenu invited David Lisnard to clarify his program.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-francois-hollande-met-la-campagne-de-raphael-glucksmann-sous-pression-20261126) reported that former president Francois Hollande is increasing pressure on the campaign of Raphael Glucksmann.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-largement-battu-par-marine-le-pen-dans-les-sondages-de-second-tour-jean-luc-melenchon-a-t-il-vraiment-perdu-d-avance-20261126) reported that polls show Jean-Luc Melenchon qualified for the presidential runoff but clearly outpaced by National Rally candidate Marine Le Pen.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/26/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-passe-a-l-offensive-face-a-david-lisnard_6815527_823448.html) reported that candidate Edouard Philippe denounced the rise of Cannes mayor David Lisnard ahead of the 2027 presidential election.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/presidentielle-2027-david-lisnard-meilleur-candidat-qu-edouard-philippe-pour-les-sympathisants-de-la-droite-et-du-centre-20261126) reported that an Odoxa-Backbone poll for Le Figaro showed David Lisnard taking the ascendancy over Edouard Philippe among right and centre sympathisers.

[Le Figaro](https://tvmag.lefigaro.fr/programme-tv/actu-tele/la-mise-au-point-de-france-televisions-sur-les-fonctions-de-la-journaliste-jacqueline-pozzi-epouse-de-david-lisnard-20261126) reported that France Télévisions issued a statement regarding the functions of journalist Jacqueline Pozzi, a presenter on France 3 Côte d'Azur and wife of Cannes mayor and presidential candidate David Lisnard.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-la-guerre-en-ukraine-est-notre-guerre-repond-raphael-glucksmann-a-teddy-riner-20261126) reported that presidential candidate Raphael Glucksmann stated that the war in Ukraine is France's war and defended continued support for Kyiv.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq772vedgepro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that France's political mainstream risks a presidential vote debacle as hard-right and hard-left candidates dominate polls ahead of next year's election.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/presidential-candidate-raphael-glucksmann-frances-vote-will-shape-europes-destiny) reported that French presidential candidate Raphaël Glucksmann stated to Euronews that France's vote will shape Europe's destiny, with future relations to Europe emerging as a central campaign issue.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/comment-on-peut-dire-ca-a-la-veille-de-la-visite-de-riner-a-beziers-menard-se-dit-outre-et-choque-par-les-propos-du-candidat-sur-l-ukraine-20261126) reported that Beziers mayor Robert Ménard expressed outrage over remarks on Ukraine by presidential candidate Teddy Riner regarding cutting off aid to Ukraine.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/il-gene-le-systeme-comme-coluche-segolene-royal-defend-teddy-riner-sur-l-ukraine-et-lui-conseille-de-ne-pas-aller-a-beziers-chez-robert-menard-20261126) reported that Ségolène Royal defended Teddy Riner on his stance on Ukraine and advised him against visiting Robert Ménard in Beziers.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/jean-luc-melenchon-peut-il-gagner-la-presidentielle-comme-l-affirme-gerald-darmanin-20261126) reported on whether Jean-Luc Mélenchon can win the presidential election as affirmed by Gérald Darmanin.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-reelu-sans-appel-a-la-tete-des-maires-de-france-david-lisnard-poursuit-sa-campagne-20261125) reported that Cannes mayor David Lisnard was reelected as head of France's mayors with 72.06 percent of the vote and is pursuing his presidential campaign.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-un-debat-plutot-qu-une-primaire-la-nouvelle-piste-a-droite-et-au-centre-20261125) reported that Edouard Philippe invited David Lisnard to a televised debate instead of a primary for the right and center.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261125-french-milei-presidential-candidate-david-lisnard-aims-reshape-france-right-wing) reported that Cannes Mayor David Lisnard was reelected leader of France's mayors and is building on his presidential bid.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/25/comment-le-candidat-david-lisnard-seduit-les-decus-d-une-partie-de-la-droite-avec-retailleau-et-philippe-on-continue-sans-rien-changer_6815170_823448.html) reported that voters dissatisfied with traditional party figures are joining David Lisnard's Nouvelle énergie party.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/francia-david-lisnard-alcalde-cannes-crece-encuestas-preocupa-marine-pen_0_SOxGK5es1S.html) reported that Cannes Mayor David Lisnard is growing in opinion polls and attracting support from business leaders and traditional right-wing figures.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261125-french-mayors-conference-2027-elys%C3%A9e-hopeful-lisnard-reelected-association-president) reported that the Mayor of Cannes, David Lisnard, was re-elected president of the Association of Mayors of France.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/l-ukraine-n-est-pas-notre-guerre-avance-teddy-riner-au-congres-des-maires-de-france-20261125) reported that French presidential candidate Teddy Riner attended the Congress of Mayors and the Salon des Maires to gather endorsements and remarked that Ukraine is not France's war.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/french-presidential-hopeful-teddy-riner-says-ukraine-is-not-our-war/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that French presidential hopeful Teddy Riner stated that Ukraine is not our war.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/25/french-judo-legend-and-olympic-medalist-teddy-riner-says-ukraine-is-not-frances-war) reported that French judo legend Teddy Riner remarked that Ukraine is not France's war, five months ahead of the presidential elections.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-doit-montrer-ses-tripes-conseille-gerald-darmanin-20261125) reported that Gérald Darmanin criticized David Lisnard's political positioning, which he considers close to the National Rally.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/pour-l-instant-on-ne-bouge-pas-bruno-retailleau-et-david-lisnard-rivaux-d-un-jour-allies-demain-20261124) reported that Cannes mayor David Lisnard's rise in the polls shakes up the presidential campaign of Bruno Retailleau while weakening Édouard Philippe's campaign.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/article/2026/11/24/edouard-philippe-a-vote-pour-david-lisnard-a-la-presidence-de-l-amf-mais-fustige-sa-posture-dans-la-course-a-l-elysee_6814832_6205049.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-le-camp-d-edouard-philippe-pointe-le-flou-de-david-lisnard-face-a-l-extreme-droite-20261124) reported that Horizons candidate Edouard Philippe criticized Cannes mayor David Lisnard's posture and approach toward the right and the extreme right in the 2027 presidential race.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-une-enquete-ouverte-pour-detournement-de-fonds-publics-a-l-agglomeration-du-havre-presidee-par-edouard-philippe-20261124) reported that an investigation for public funds embezzlement was opened regarding the agglomeration of Le Havre presided over by Edouard Philippe.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/24/le-congres-des-maires-de-france-s-ouvre-sur-fond-de-course-a-la-presidentielle-et-de-protestations-autour-de-la-double-candidature-de-david-lisnard_6814718_823448.html) reported that the congress of French mayors opened with a focus on the presidential race and protests surrounding David Lisnard's double candidacy.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261123-is-cannes-mayor-david-lisnard-a-dark-horse-for-french-presidential-elections) reported that Cannes mayor David Lisnard surpassed former prime ministers Edouard Philippe and Gabriel Attal in a recent voter intention poll.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/le-nouvel-artiste-qui-monte-sur-les-planches-jordan-bardella-epingle-david-lisnard-en-contrebandier-du-macronisme-20261123) reported that National Rally president Jordan Bardella described David Lisnard as a smuggler of the presidential camp while minimizing his political momentum.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/lisnard-double-philippe-dans-un-sondage-le-pen-perd-jusqu-a-5-points-20261123) reported that a poll showed David Lisnard surpassed Édouard Philippe while Marine Le Pen lost up to 5 points.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261123-france-s-far-right-leader-le-pen-denies-receiving-secrets-from-civil-servant) reported that French far-right leader Marine Le Pen denied receiving confidential information from a civil servant suspected of leaking details of investigations to her party.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/22/french-interior-ministry-rocked-by-probe-into-prefects-leaks-to-national-rally) reported that a top French interior ministry official asked to be relieved of his post after being suspected of informing the National Rally about probes into the party.

reports.text: [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916321) reported that senior Haredi rabbis are expected to decide on Sunday whether to authorize United Torah Judaism to enter formal coalition talks with Gadi Eisenkot.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/netanyahu-weighs-rotating-premiership-with-eisenkot-to-break-israel-s-political-deadlock-report-101795823657826.html) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is weighing a rotating premiership with Gadi Eisenkot to break Israel's political deadlock.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916326) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is considering serving as second in a rotation with Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot to form a unity government.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916318) reported that Naftali Bennett reiterated his push for a Likud unity government amid disputes over defense and finance portfolios, while Avigdor Liberman warned against Netanyahu's political maneuvers.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261127-israel-s-eisenkot-and-left-wing-party-agree-coalition-deal) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's centrist Yashar party and a left-wing faction agreed on a preliminary coalition deal.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-lieberman-says-change-government-taking-shape-warns-of-netanyahu-maneuver/), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/lieberman-warns-netanyahu-could-use-rotation-offer-to-derail-eisenkot-3726048) reported that Yisrael Beiteinu leader Avigdor Lieberman stated that efforts by Gadi Eisenkot to form a new Israeli government were beginning to take shape and warned that caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu could use a rotation offer to derail it.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/israels-eisenkot-and-golan-agree-to-sign-coalition-deal-3726051) reported that Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot and Democrats party leader Yair Golan agreed to sign a coalition agreement.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261127-israel-s-eisenkot-agrees-to-coalition-deal-with-left-wing-democrats) reported that former Israeli military chief Gadi Eisenkot struck a coalition deal with Yair Golan's left-leaning Democrats.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/anti-netanyahu-gadi-eisenkot-construiu-imagem-de-centrista-austero-no-exercito-de-israel.shtml) reported that Gadi Eisenkot built an image of an austere centrist in the Israeli army.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916298) reported that Eisenkot's bloc is rushing to repeal four laws passed by Netanyahu's coalition before they change anything.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/medio-oriente/partido-de-gadi-eisenkot-anuncia-acuerdo-de-coalicion-con-formacion-de-izquierda-en-israel-para-formar-gobierno-pero-aun-no-logran-mayorias-3604617) reported that The Democrats reached a coalition agreement with Yashar, though they do not yet hold a majority.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-netanyahu-tells-aides-miracle-needed-to-prevent-eisenkot-from-forming-government/), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916196) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told aides that a miracle is needed to prevent Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot from forming a government, while Likud officials expect Eisenkot to form a government without Netanyahu's party.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86332990/Israel-seeks-to-drag-US-into-another-war-with-chemical-weapons) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi condemned Israeli allegations that Iran is pursuing chemical weapons as an attempt to drag the US into another war.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/haaretz-today/2026-11-26/ty-article/.highlight/will-this-man-de-ben-gvirize-israel/000001a2-17d8-d22a-a1bb-17fb613f0000) reported that Yair Golan's coalition deal with Eisenkot brings Netanyahu's ouster closer.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/report-libermans-party-would-take-defense-justice-immigration-posts-3726016) reported that Israel's Channel 13 stated the party of former Israeli Defense Minister Avigdor Liberman would take three ministries under a coalition deal with the Yashar party.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israels-eisenkot-strikes-coalition-deal-with-left-wing-ally) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's centrist party reached a coalition agreement with a left-wing ally.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/26/israel-gadi-eisenkot-et-le-parti-de-gauche-les-democrates-nouent-un-accord-de-coalition-premier-pas-vers-la-formation-d-un-gouvernement_6815576_3210.html) reported that discussions between the two parties had previously been halted due to a lack of agreement on ministerial portfolio distribution.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/israels-gadi-eisenkot-reaches-deal-with-left-wing-parties/article71747775.ece) reported that the left-leaning Democrats agreed to a coalition deal with Yashar.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/israels-eisenkot-resumes-meetings-left-wing-faction-coalition-talks-gain-steam) reported that ex-military chief Gadi Eisenkot stated he resolved a dispute with a left-wing faction that had posed a challenge to coalition talks.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-26/eisenkot-vows-to-form-israeli-government-by-end-of-week/107429976) reported that opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot stated he hopes to form a government within a week following an inconclusive Israeli election.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/kushner-warns-israel-becoming-global-pariah-over-gaza) reported that Jared Kushner warned that Israel risks becoming a global pariah as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu obstructs Gaza's reconstruction.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916082) reported that Likud and Yashar teams resumed unity government negotiations.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/d654b69da553) reported that Israel's opposition stated that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defence Minister Israel Katz had a lust for power that drove them out of their minds.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1125/1600662-iran-israel/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Israel was trying to drag the United States into another war after an Iranian minister alleged Tehran's involvement.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/iran-says-israel-trying-to-deceive-us-into-war-with-chemical-weapons-claim-3014026) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi accused Israel of attempting to mislead the United States into a conflict by falsely claiming that Iran is developing chemical weapons.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/podcasts/2026-11-24/ty-article-podcast/amos-harel-on-the-israeli-pms-politically-motivated-push-for-war/000001a2-0e5f-d089-a1fe-2f7f2e3b0000) reported that Amos Harel stated there is no urgent need to strike Iran now regarding Netanyahu's push for war.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israels-eisenkot-set-to-announce-new-government-next-week) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot is expected to notify President Isaac Herzog next week that he has formed a government.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-israels-eisenkot-plans-to-nominate-golan-for-public-security-post-report/) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot plans to nominate Yair Golan for the public security portfolio.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/25/world/middleeast/israel-opposition-netanyahu-new-government.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot set December 6 as the deadline to form a new Israeli government, with ally Avigdor Liberman stating he was on track.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-25/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-aims-to-hold-vote-to-swear-in-minority-government-next-week/000001a2-1324-d52d-afe2-db2432840000) reported that Gadi Eisenkot aims to hold a vote to swear in a minority government next week with ultra-Orthodox lawmakers expected to join and Mansour Abbas abstaining.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249727/Iran-Army-Navy-will-deliver-a-decisive-deterrent-response), a state-media outlet, reported that the Chief of Staff of Iran's Armed Forces and Commander of the Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters stressed that the Iran Army Navy will deliver a decisive and deterrent response.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249726/Two-Iranian-oil-tankers-recovered-from-US-naval-forces), a state-media outlet, reported that the commander of the Iranian Army's Navy stated two Iranian vessels were released from US naval troops.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86333992/Oil-tanker-hits-mine-in-south-of-Strait-of-Hormuz), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249728/Oil-tanker-strikes-mine-in-south-of-Strait-of-Hormuz), state-media outlets, reported that an oil tanker struck a naval mine and exploded north of Jazirat Umm al Ghanam in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-iran-claims-it-recovered-2-oil-tankers-seized-by-us-military/) reported that Iran’s Navy announced its forces had recovered two Iranian oil tankers that it said were stolen by the US military.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-oil-prices-rise-after-tankers-hit-mines-in-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that oil prices rose by about $1 after Yemen's Houthi group stated it targeted Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery and tankers were hit by mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86333899/Iranian-Navy-ready-to-deliver-decisive-response-to-any-threat) reported that Chief of Staff of the Iranian Armed Forces Major General Ali Abdollahi stated that the Army's Navy is fully prepared to deliver a decisive response to any threat.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2225829) reported that Shahram Irani claimed that US forces collected fees from shipowners for escorting vessels through the Strait of Hormuz.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86333900/Iranian-navy-commander-says-maritime-conflict-has-extended-to) reported that Iranian Navy Commander Rear Admiral Shahram Irani stated that the conflict at sea has expanded into the oceans.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/tehran-strait-of-hormuz-is-fully-under-irans-control/) reported that Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy commander Ali Azmaei claimed the Strait of Hormuz is fully under Iran's control.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iran-Says-LNG-Carrier-Exploded-After-Hitting-a-Mine-in-Hormuz.html) reported that an LNG vessel caught fire and exploded after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86333327/Two-more-offending-oil-tankers-hit-naval-mines-in-Strait-of-Hormuz), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-iran-says-2-oil-tankers-hit-naval-mines-catch-fire-near-omans-khasab-port/) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy stated that two oil tankers hit naval mines and caught fire while traveling near Oman's Khasab port.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86333233/Iran-can-sustain-Hormuz-blockade-expand-missile-capabilities), an Iranian state-run outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps stated Iran has sufficient firepower to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed and is improving its missile capabilities.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Rallies-as-Hormuz-Mine-Strikes-Rattle-Global-Markets.html) reported that crude oil prices rose following fresh reports of oil tankers hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-oil-tanker-catches-fire-after-hitting-naval-mine-in-strait-of-hormuz-iranian-navy/) reported that the Iranian Navy stated an oil tanker caught fire and was left immobilized after striking a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iran-Reports-Fresh-Tanker-Explosions-as-Hormuz-Attacks-Intensify.html) reported that two oil tankers exploded after hitting naval mines while attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz on unauthorized routes.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224855), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249700/LNG-carrier-strikes-sea-mine-explodes-in-Hormuz-IRGC) reported that an LNG carrier struck a sea mine and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after using a route not authorized by Iran.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532558/Iran-reports-naval-mine-strikes-on-two-tankers-downs-US-drones) reported that Iran's military and maritime authorities stated they downed US drones and reported naval mine strikes on two tankers.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86332270/Iran-tightens-security-measures-in-Strait-of-Hormuz-Army), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army spokesperson said the military stepped up surveillance and control of the Strait of Hormuz.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249692/Iran-Army-to-impose-stricter-control-over-Hormuz-Strait-Spox), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army spokesman stated the military enhanced its readiness and tightened control over the Strait of Hormuz.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224405), a Russian state outlet, reported that two oil tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz and fire broke out in their engine rooms.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642226/irgc-navy-says-two-oil-tankers-hit-mines-caught-fire-in-strait-of-hormuz-state-media), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249679/Two-more-oil-tankers-explode-in-Strait-of-Hormuz-unsafe-route), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86331897/Two-violating-oil-tankers-explode-on-unauthorized-route-in-Strait) reported that the IRGC Navy said two violating oil tankers struck naval mines and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261124-iran-blacklists-26-tugboats-operating-in-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that Iran blacklisted 26 tugboats operating in the Strait of Hormuz for providing services to vessels using an alternative southern route.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532514/Strait-of-Hormuz-to-become-increasingly-closed-army-chief), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army chief warned the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed and come under increasingly tighter Iranian control until the country's seven conditions are met.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/oil-prices-hit-three-month-lows-as-rising-global-supply-and-surplus-fears-outweigh-strait-of-hormuz-risks-101795523176752.html) reported that oil prices hit three-month lows as rising crude supply, Russian oil imports, and surplus fears outweighed shipping risks in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249668/Fourth-oil-tanker-explodes-east-of-Hormuz-Tues-IRGC) reported that the IRGC Navy reported an explosion and fire aboard an oil tanker east of the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iran-insists-7-demands-hormuz-crisis-deepens-irgc-targets-tankers) reported that Iranian officials insist the US meet seven conditions, including lifting sanctions, before Tehran agrees to terms.

[UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/us-pulls-more-tankers-out-of-europe-and-the-middle-east/) reported that 17 US KC-135 and KC-46 tankers left Europe and the Middle East with only four replacements sent according to flight tracking.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/us-and-qatar-stress-ensuring-freedom-of-navigation-in-the-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stressed the need to ensure freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261124-qatar-urges-restoration-of-hormuz-navigation-return-to-us-iran-talks/) reported that Qatar called for restoring freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz and a return to negotiations between the US and Iran.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249667/2-violating-oil-tankers-catch-fire-in-east-of-Hormuz-Strait), an Iranian state outlet, reported that the Iranian Army Force announced that two non-compliant oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines on an unauthorized route in the Hormuz Strait.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223805), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86331202/Strait-of-Hormuz-will-remain-closed-until-Iran-s-conditions-are) reported that Iranian Army Chief Commander Major General Amir Hatami stated the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until Iran's conditions are fulfilled.

reports.text: [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/saudi-arabia-houthis-trade-attacks-on-rival-capitals/article71753601.ece) reported that a Saudi-led coalition backing Yemen's internationally recognized government regularly bombed areas controlled by the Houthi group.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1588189/makkah-pact-members-renew-collective-defence-commitment-at-islamabad-talks/) reported that a meeting of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement's top decision-making body reviewed regional security and condemned persistent attacks.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1588280/pakistan-saudi-arabia-and-turkiye-vow-stronger-security-cooperation-under-makkah-defence-pact/) reported that Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening collective defense under the Makkah Defence Pact.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2226263), a state-media outlet, reported that Pakistani Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar stated that Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey reaffirmed their commitment to joint technological development, training, and capacity-building.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNY3QyVmpKWUFZNTlPMEdHMHptZE1pXzFZQjF3V2RsbTVGQThXN1B4dXRMc0xaT2FsRXVsa1cxM0ZCakh1MkxpdGZWVjh0czF6VFlNVFZESXQ2bXNnOEFzQWlmTC1NbmluZm5DZUI4OXJXZHRncnFVeUY1elBubnQweWlBazdmN04wbE5aSUMxMGo3c2VJOTkzb3dGcjZWNDVIRGxBREhkVzAyX3BK?oc=5), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-saudi-arabia-and-turkiye-pledge-collective-defence-against-houthi-threats-to-kingdom/) reported that Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye reaffirmed their collective defence pledge against Houthi threats.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOdXlvclpqeVdNZ2lZYWFsbzdid2N2MVdPeXVMeXZlLVByYThqQlVpekNfN2ZVblNhbWU3TzRmN01vanE0M0c5akJnY1M2VTg1VU4wQXVCSU5SR3FONmQ2ODdHUS1MR05xaDhEU19MSWV0QXc5bXBTM1FYQlhoZllWOTZYYlIxQ2RYZzJuYnV1VGdQR0xUU2lmRUE3RWV2eS1SWW42enNCNUZRdw?oc=5) reported that Dar and Fidan pledged closer defence coordination under the Makkah Pact.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/130ea632c410) reported that the Turkish top diplomat stated the committee approved most decisions on civilian and military headquarters and discussed Houthi militia threats and US-Iran talks.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2225731) reported that the document envisages mutual military assistance in the event of an external armed attack on any of the parties.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1587778/turkish-president-erdogan-completes-ratification-of-makkah-joint-defence-agreement-with-pakistan-and-saudi-arabia/) reported that Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan formally approved the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, published in the Official Gazette.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPVmJEdmR5Wl9uZTZKS1R2ckJXekhkX1AwSVZpSHhkODcweDNmTVRva2JDdjRWcjNvYk4yeXNkQWw3ZTVnMUpWUTBjYXNWOTVCY2Y1emVTdGFjazhoR1ltaXF6WTNvMEVqSUdaNTI3VzU4U3dMNkROYVlDMTR5NHhpdGhuZjl4VnZGTzFTNHRXMDdnSXVmdXhpODl6YjVabXVoa0NlMVFsOW94OUw1clJ2UUpR?oc=5), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/turkeys-erdogan-ratifies-mecca-defence-pact-with-saudi-arabia-pakistan-101795757446184.html), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047450/erdogan-completes-turkiyes-ratification-of-makkah-defence-pact) reported that Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan completed Turkey's ratification of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pakistan-to-host-two-day-meeting-of-trilateral-makkah-defence-alliance-101795788743192.html) reported that Pakistani Defence Minister Khawaja Asif stated that continuous turmoil south of Saudi Arabia will be on the agenda for the trilateral meeting.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/turkish-foreign-minister-to-attend-2nd-mecca-pact-committee-meeting-in-islamabad-3726070) reported that Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan, National Defense Minister Yasar Guler, and Chief of General Staff Gen. Selcuk Bayraktaroglu are set to attend the second Mecca pact committee meeting in Islamabad.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-saudi-arabia-and-turkiye-hold-defence-talks-in-islamabad/), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/diplomacy/turkiye-pakistan-saudi-arabia-hold-strategic-defense-talks) reported that senior political and military leaders from Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Türkiye met in Islamabad on Friday under the Makkah Joint / strategic political and defense committee to advance trilateral security cooperation.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-turkiye-pakistan-saudi-arabia-to-hold-2nd-meeting-of-mecca-pact-committee/) reported that Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan attended the second meeting of the strategic political and defense committee established under the Mecca pact.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642657/pakistan-reaffirms-commitment-to-global-nuclear-security-cooperation) reported that Islamabad hosted the IAEA's 15th NSSC Network meeting, bringing together participants from 49 member states.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047472/pakistan-seeks-deeper-cooperation-with-iaea-on-nuclear-security) reported that Pakistan looks forward to further deepening cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency and international partners in support of sustainable nuclear security.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642643/islamabad-set-to-host-high-level-trilateral-security-meeting-today) reported that Islamabad police announced the temporary closure of key Red Zone access points and advised citizens to use Margalla Road.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047415/makkah-defence-alliance-meeting-in-islamabad-begins-with-yemen-conflict-also-on-agenda) reported that a meeting of the tripartite Makkah Defence Alliance's top decision-making body began in Islamabad with discussions expected to feature the conflict between Yemen.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/f98008c4f1f0), a Turkish state outlet, reported that the Turkish top diplomat is expected to condemn Houthi militia attacks, call for a unified response to Israeli actions, and review the alliance's institutionalisation.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/uns-structural-flaws-leave-israel-unchecked-turkish-parliament-speaker/news) reported that Turkish Parliament Speaker Numan Kurtulmus called for the establishment of a fairer global order and criticized UN structural flaws.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/turkiye-saudi-arabia-sign-mou-to-boost-defense-cooperation-3726049) reported that Turkey and Saudi Arabia signed a memorandum of understanding to boost defense cooperation.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNRE9Gd0gzcGFKWTIxZVNnYWxpamRMRy1YVDM3TVBHMFYwQjM1QkhUQ3ptRTR3OWFNUGlYMldTY3BlV3lIUnhRVS1tekdna3NpbWI3QXVEeTlpcGl1VGIxcFA5amthT2pBSEhxc1J3V3FRcmpESUNiWTg3cHZjd3pQR2FNaXY3YXRyUXF6MWxZQXZVTnVpdW9qYmJWbUVhSlFWQUdhQkFuUQ?oc=5) reported that Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Türkiye are scheduled to hold a two-day defense meeting in Islamabad.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/pakistan-set-to-host-talks-with-saudi-arabia-turkey-under-trilateral-defence-pact/article71750047.ece) reported that talks in Islamabad will focus on West Asia and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, according to two security officials.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1587647/saudi-houthi-conflict-on-agenda-as-makkah-pact-nations-convene-in-islamabad-today/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047415/islamabad-set-to-host-2-day-makkah-defence-alliance-meeting-yemen-conflict-also-on-agenda), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/two-day-makkah-defence-alliance-meeting-set-to-being-in-islamabad-today/) reported that Pakistan is hosting a two-day meeting of the Makkah Defence Alliance's top decision-making body in Islamabad, with the Yemen conflict on the agenda.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2226271) reported that Pakistan and Turkey reiterated their strong condemnation of Houthi attacks targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure during talks in Islamabad.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1587903/saudi-refinery-attack-kills-one-operations-suspended/) reported that an attack on Saudi Aramco's Jizan refinery killed one worker, injured several others, and forced the temporary suspension of some refinery operations.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/mecca-pact-allies-condemn-heinous-houthi-attacks-on-saudi-arabia?traffic_source=rss) reported that officials from Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye pledged to protect the kingdom's security during talks in Islamabad.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/27/saudi-arabia-shoots-down-90-per-cent-of-houthi-missiles-in-five-month-barrage/) reported that Saudi Arabia shot down 90 percent of Houthi missiles during a five-month barrage.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047415/makkah-pact-nations-review-regional-security-condemn-houthi-attacks-on-saudi-arabia) reported that a meeting of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement's top decision-making body reviewed regional security and condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642615/saudi-led-coalition-says-it-destroyed-50-houthi-military-targets-across-yemen) reported that the Saudi-led coalition stated it destroyed 50 Houthi military targets across Sanaa, Al Hudaydah, and Saada provinces in Yemen.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6ly7jgv7jzdo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that markets and restaurants in Riyadh remain busy as residents express trust in the government to protect them despite Houthi attacks.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2225595), a Russian state outlet, reported that one person was killed and several injured in a Houthi attack on a Saudi refinery that partially halted operations.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxQRU9OOWkxZGpWR0JVeFhNTzM4bkVsSGFpQ043RGgzSnFGcm5xNk1URy1CblAzcXB4cUxGallXNlRPcGUzcE9WSTRQZnRVZWEtVGdLNk1PcDVwSUkxYzFzbHhfbDVubjhkMmJoWUk5cEhQVUxZTU5NVzB5UGN4aWNxcElBNkw2bU5Nbks0RVl4MmpmOGRFbjFWbmhzX0VJLXRlY0RmNmMzNTcyQmRPLXhVNVhGd2s4d0JUVjhmQ25wWDNhZw?oc=5) reported that Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye are scheduled to discuss the Yemen conflict at an Islamabad meeting.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642507/turkiye-saudi-arabia-sign-defence-cooperation-mou) reported that Türkiye's SSB and Saudi Arabia's GADD signed a defence development agreement.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-turkiye-saudi-arabia-sign-defense-cooperation-mou/) reported that Turkiye and Saudi Arabia signed a memorandum of understanding to strengthen defense industry cooperation.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-turkiye-saudi-to-discuss-yemen-conflict-as-ksa-seeks-stronger-regional-security-cooperation/) reported that Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Türkiye are set to discuss growing regional security threats, including escalating tensions involving Saudi Arabia.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/turkish-parliament-speaker-kurtulmus-visits-new-south-wales-parliament-3726022) reported that Turkish parliament speaker Numan Kurtulmus held delegation-level talks with New South Wales Legislative Assembly Speaker Greg Piper during a visit to the state.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642495/makkah-pact-nations-to-discuss-yemen-in-islamabad-meeting-khawaja-asif) reported that Khawaja Asif stated continuous turmoil south of Saudi Arabia will be an agenda point in the Islamabad meeting of Makkah pact nations.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1587264/bangladesh-parliament-speaker-claims-india-weakened-pakistan-in-1971-and-urges-stronger-ties-with-islamabad/) reported that Bangladesh Parliament Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed stated that India weakened Pakistan during the 1971 war.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/pakistan-saudi-turkey-hold-mecca-alliance-meeting-islamabad-nov-27-28-sources-say), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1587272/pakistan-saudi-arabia-turkiye-to-meet-in-islamabad/) reported that Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey will hold a meeting on their mutual defense agreement in Islamabad on November 27 and 28.

reports.text: [Somali Guardian](https://www.somaliguardian.com/news/somalia-news/somali-supreme-court-judges-refuse-return-work-president-term-expired/) reported that five Somali Supreme Court judges refused an order to resume their duties, stating they cannot work independently.
[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611230319.html) reported that Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud is expected to travel to Kampala, Uganda, amid political tensions.

[Somali Guardian](https://www.somaliguardian.com/news/somalia-news/eacj-steps-into-somalia-constitutional-crisis-president-term-extension/) reported that Somalia's constitutional crisis reached the East African Court of Justice after six Supreme Court judges filed a case.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-21/AU-Somalia-plan-phased-security-handover-to-Somali-forces-1SfTJB5yWtO/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that the African Union and Somalia agreed to develop an integrated security transition plan.

[Somali Guardian](https://www.somaliguardian.com/news/somalia-news/somalia-opposition-rejects-talks-president-hassan-sheikh-mohamud/) reported that Somalia's opposition leaders rejected talks with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud.

reports.text: [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/trump-inaugurara-una-planta-que-provee-chips-a-nvidia-a-dias-del-escandalo-de-jensen-huang-nid28112026/) reported that a White House official confirmed that US President Donald Trump will inaugurate a plant that supplies chips to Nvidia on December 4.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/trump-says-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-poses-no-national-security-risk/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he reviewed extensive information indicating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang poses no national security risk.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/mitt-romney-questions-trump-s-support-for-jensen-huang-says-nvidia-controversy-smells-of-profit-corruption-101795823234790.html) reported that Mitt Romney questioned Donald Trump's support for Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO and raised concerns about US chip sales to China.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10952102) reported that Samsung Electronics and SK hynix are facing new challenges to their high-bandwidth memory dominance from China's Huawei and Japan's Kioxia.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/tecnologia-consumo/jensen-huang-nvidia-trump-codigo-conducta-empleados_202611276b09ace450b7057c6d181bc3.html) reported that Jensen Huang returned to direct Nvidia following Donald Trump's intervention and demanded employees comply with rules he himself breached.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/2c21320fa1d9), a state-media outlet, reported that Jensen Huang's company is the world's leading supplier of chips crucial for AI data centers.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1127/1600850-nvidia-ceo-huang-not-a-security-threat-trump/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/trump-insists-nvidia-ceo-not-a-security-threat/), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/affaire-nvidia-donald-trump-assure-que-le-pdg-jensen-huang-n-est-pas-une-menace-pour-la-securite-nationale-20261127), [Punch](https://punchng.com/trump-insists-nvidia-ceo-poses-no-security-threat/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he had seen sufficient information that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is not a security threat.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/2ffa3b4b7ef0) reported that Donald Trump stated he and his officials worked behind the scenes to secure Jensen Huang's return, while the Nvidia CEO denied that the president intervened.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/women-decry-jensen-huangs-return-as-nvidia-ceo/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that women criticised Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO after his resignation over alleged affairs, saying it shows double standards for powerful men in tech.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-tsmc-arizona-chip-foundry-b3092143.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-to-attend-groundbreaking-of-arizona-chip-facility-supplying-nvidia-and-other-companies-jensen-huang-row-101795743869809.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump plans to visit Arizona to attend the groundbreaking of a new chip facility supplying Nvidia and others.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/president-donald-trump-insists-nvidia-ceo-not-a-security-threat/article71749200.ece) reported that President Donald Trump insisted that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is not a security threat.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/nate-silver-trump-impeachment-nvidia-chips-b3092456.html) reported that analyst Nate Silver predicted Donald Trump could be impeached over Nvidia's China chip sales.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/justice-department-never-saw-marco-rubios-memo-on-jensen-huang-that-led-to-brief-nvidia-ouster-report-101795733070534.html) reported that the U.S. Department of Justice reportedly never saw Marco Rubio's memo alleging Nvidia boss Jensen Huang had Chinese spy links.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/tech-and-start-ups/article-916299) reported that following Jensen Huang's affair, NVIDIA's former sales head Puri was found to have married a Super Micro executive.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/i-think-he-s-absolutely-fine-donald-trump-once-again-defends-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-amid-spy-concerns-101795738082579.html) reported that Donald Trump defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding spy concerns and stated he would probably speak to him soon.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/26/images-show-kim-jong-un-inspecting-north-korean-nuclear-facilities) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspected nuclear material production facilities and a weapons research institute.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/north-koreas-kim-jong-un-urges-wider-tactical-nuclear-deployment-during-inspection-of-weapons-facilities/) reported that Kim Jong Un urged the wider deployment of tactical nuclear weapons across multiple domains.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/kim-jong-un-ordena-diversificar-armas-nucleares-tacticas-corea-del-norte-acelera-modernizacion-militar/) reported that Kim Jong-un ordered the diversification of tactical nuclear weapons while supervising nuclear materials and armament facilities.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86332961/Baqaei-slams-US-senator-for-misrepresenting-North-Korea-s-nuclear) reported that Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei criticized US Senator John Cornyn for remarks regarding North Korea's nuclear program.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/kim-jong-un-says-north-korea-should-widen-deployment-of-tactical-nukes?traffic_source=rss) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un warned that attempts to deny the country's nuclear status will be seen as an open declaration of war.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/kim-jong-un-tours-nuclear-material-sites-urges-wider-use-of-tactical-nuclear-weapons/a-80055887?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that North Korea's Kim Jong Un visited sites that produce nuclear material and told his military to focus on tactical weapons.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/alice-huang-may-have-been-under-chinese-surveillance-amid-affair-with-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-us-agencies-told-congress-101795657212810.html) reported that U.S. agencies told Congress that Alice Huang may have been under Chinese surveillance amid her affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/kim-jong-un-najavio-sjeverna-koreja-povecava-nuklearne-kapacitete/) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un announced that North Korea will increase its nuclear capacities.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/novi-potez-kim-dzong-una-izaziva-zabrinutost-severna-koreja-siri-proizvodnju/f8n0wsf) reported that Kim Jong Un inspected nuclear material production facilities and research capacities, stating that North Korea is inviolable.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/how-pentagon-considered-using-cold-war-law-to-bring-jensen-huang-back/articleshow/136197861.cms) reported that the Pentagon considered using Cold War law to bring Jensen Huang back.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/marco-rubio-jensen-huang-nvidia-b3092316.html) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio expressed private concerns about Jensen Huang's return to the chipmaker.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/dennys-jensen-huang-nvidia-plaque-b3092157.html) reported that restaurant chain Denny's was mocked for its defense of scandal-fit tech boss Jensen Huang, who began his career as a dishwasher in one of its diners.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/pete-hegseth-jensen-huang-nvidia-b3092097.html) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth considered using the Defense Production Act of 1950 to compel chipmaker Nvidia to reinstate its scandal-hit CEO on national security grounds.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/we-were-told-he-was-under-no-investigation-jd-vance-on-nvidia-ceo-huang-amid-china-spy-claims/articleshow/136186283.cms) reported that JD Vance stated that Nvidia CEO Huang was told he was under no investigation amid China spy claims.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/fbi-alice-huang-jensen-huang-nvidia-spy-b3092061.html) reported that secret memos and clashing spy agencies deepen mystery around the woman linked to Nvidia chief Jensen Huang.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/nvidia-executive-relationship-jay-puri-cenly-chen-super-micro-linked-to-china-ai-chips-jensen-huang-row-101795684107490.html) reported that Jay Puri, another Nvidia executive, was in a long-term relationship with Cenly Chen, a top executive at Super Micro, before marrying her in March.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/26/world/politics/us-officials-chinese-spying-huang/) reported that US officials remain divided over whether a woman Jensen Huang had an affair with was a Chinese spy.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-26/jd-vance-shrugs-off-ceo-pardon-after-trump-comment/107429070) reported that US Vice-President JD Vance played down the possibility that Jensen Huang would need to receive a pardon after asking Nvidia's board to reinstate the chief executive.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/pete-hegseth-pentagon-officials-weighed-using-cold-war-era-law-to-put-jensen-huang-back-as-nvidia-ceo-report-101795661315105.html) reported that the Pentagon denied that Pete Hegseth and other officials weighed using a Cold War-era law to restore Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-916168) reported that a Trump administration official stated an emergency law could be used, though the law does not allow the president to make personnel changes at a private company.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxPWXpxVzdFTDlLUzR0Q1I5dzFrMDFIS0VJSUlBMk9qYllCSWNENGFiX2p6N3RzOC1aTjFNT21WdVBnNXFxRUhpMlVYMlZ4alZocS1mVXRHV2lOMTlZMzlHc1BwQ0FxcDAxZnpNdVpHb1pzQlF5MUYwT3VRT0lwb2oxZGpxMkJSS2NVVFgteTlaOFUzcWQ0OENlUFFTWXg3YjJtNVE?oc=5), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/vance-todd-blanche-jensen-huang-nvidia-b3091829.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/jd-vance-defends-jensen-huang-as-nvidia-ceo-faces-congressional-questioning-i-dont-think-he-needs-a-pardon-101795646079181.html) reported that JD Vance stated that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang does not need a presidential pardon and is under no investigation.

[The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/when-will-trump-meet-kim-jong-un-again/) reported that a Kim-Trump summit did not come to fruition despite speculation that the two would meet in Shenzhen.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/north-koreas-kim-calls-for-wider-tactical-nuclear-deployment) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for expanding the deployment of tactical nuclear weapons during a nuclear facility inspection.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010678/ph-envoy-presents-credentials-to-north-korean-leader-kim-jong-un/story/) reported that the Philippine ambassador to North Korea presented his credentials to leader Kim Jong Un, marking the first time in more than 30 years that the country's leader received new credentials.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-jensen-huang-todd-blanche-doj-b3091652.html) reported that Attorney General Todd Blanche responded 'I don't know what you're talking about' after Donald Trump marshaled government resources.

reports.text: [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188638-ukraine-hungary-planning-first-meeting-of-commission-on-national-minorities-for-early-2027.html) reported that Ukrainian Deputy Prime Minister Vsevolod Chentsov and Hungarian Foreign Minister Anita Orbán agreed to hold the first meeting of the Ukrainian-Hungarian Intergovernmental Commission on National Minorities in early 2027.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261125-ukraine-seeks-%E2%82%AC115-billion-in-foreign-aid-for-2027-zelensky-says), [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91075840) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine will need €115 billion ($125 billion) in external financial support in 2027 to sustain its economy and war effort.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064609/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188544-ukraine-ready-to-accelerate-implementation-of-agreements-on-rights-of-hungarian-minority-sybiha.html) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha stated that Ukraine can implement some agreements on Hungarian minority rights ahead of schedule.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064655/) reported that Hungarian PM Anita Orbán stated that Ukraine and Hungary will hold the first meeting of a minority rights commission in early 2027.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188156-magyar-reports-significant-progress-in-talks-with-ukraine-on-rights-of-hungarian-minority.html) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar stated significant progress was made in talks with Ukraine on ten issues concerning the rights of the Hungarian minority.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4187282-charity-auction-in-lviv-region-raises-uah-60-mln-to-support-ukrainian-defenders.html) reported that a charity auction held in the Lviv region raised 60 million Ukrainian hryvnias to support defenders.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/4186713-government-directs-additional-uah-814-bln-to-urgent-defense-ministry-needs.html) reported that the Cabinet of Ministers allocated an additional 81.4 billion Ukrainian hryvnias for the urgent needs of the Ministry of Defense.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1088950/eu-sprema-novu-finansijsku-injekciju-ukrajini-planirano-dodatnih-45-milijardi-eura-za-2027-godinu) reported that the European Union is preparing an additional financial injection of 45 billion euros for Ukraine for 2027, split into a 20 billion euro loan and another portion.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/4185879-finance-ministry-raises-uah-1105-bln-at-bond-auction.html) reported that Ukraine's Finance Ministry raised the equivalent of UAH 11.05 billion at a domestic government bond auction.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/4185863-16-bln-at-stake-finance-ministry-reports-significant-progress-in-talks-with-imf-mission.html) reported that the Finance Ministry announced significant progress in talks with the IMF mission.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90303) reported that the IMF made major progress in talks with Ukraine on the second and third reviews of its $8.1 billion loan program, bringing $1.6 billion in aid closer.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Ukrajini-prijeti-najteza-zima-EU-razmatra-novu-pomoc/992265) reported that European Union foreign ministers will discuss strengthening air defense with Ukrainian counterpart Andrii Sybiha in Brussels.
