Death-sentenced Sheikh Hasina's planned return puts Bangladesh on edge - and India in a bind

reports.text: [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/hasina-has-become-a-thorn-in-bangladesh-india-ties-minister-humaiun-kobir/article71750164.ece) reported that State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir said New Delhi is beginning to realize the strain caused by the former prime minister's presence in India.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bangladesh-considers-moving-icj-for-sheikh-hasina-extradition-from-india-report-dhaka-parliament-speaker-hafiz-uddin-ahmed-pakistan-visit-101795749599883.html) reported that Bangladesh's parliament speaker stated in Pakistan that if Sheikh Hasina returns to Dhaka, she will be arrested and sent to jail, and that Bangladesh considers moving the ICJ for her extradition from India.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/only-winter-will-come-bangladesh-minister-doubts-hasina-will-return-in-december/articleshow/136208427.cms) reported that Bangladesh's state minister for foreign affairs Humaiun Kobir expressed doubt over Sheikh Hasina's reported December return.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx30g71rev23o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the ousted prime minister's December homecoming plan deepens Dhaka-Delhi tensions and risks fresh unrest.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/sheikh-hasina-s-ex-deputy-press-secretary-two-others-arrested-in-bangladesh-101795687488932.html) reported that former deputy press secretary KM Shakhawat Moon and two others were arrested in Dhaka.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxNQ3l2N19iQWhBMUdzUWZZbkFhb0VoWEpNS2xSOTE3bVJSLUVYbjF4RXdyYzJGZnlET3pmMnlCaWpROWd5dHZRa3d6b2Q1cndBWkZVUFAzaEVMQ1BDdGh5OGRlYkZ2V2tjSWo3SjMyeHZmTFk2S29oODVhcUkxY3NFTWhnVHVqVmdFSmNWalF6Q05SR242SmlPWGFQNkJVZUhXRUVxUlpnc3B3NVF5YUk1U0RYQ0VTMU1ZcmxJeDVKZkZUZjQ?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/mea-separates-sheikh-hasinas-plans-to-return-to-bangladesh-from-issue-of-extradition/article71743712.ece) reported that India's Ministry of External Affairs stated that Sheikh Hasina's plan to return voluntarily to Bangladesh is separate from the extradition request.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-tightens-border-security-ahead-of-hasinas-planned-return-deploys-108-bgb-platoons/article71742554.ece) reported that Bangladesh deployed 108 BGB platoons and tightened border security ahead of the planned return.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/25/asia-pacific/politics/sheikh-hasina-return-bangladesh/) reported that ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return home on Dec. 16 from self-imposed exile in India.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/she-can-return-only-in-handcuffs-says-dhaka-as-sheikh-hasina-eyes-december-16-homecoming-bangladesh-news-101795508841134.html) reported that Dhaka stated ousted former prime minister Sheikh Hasina can return to Bangladesh only in handcuffs as she eyes a December 16 homecoming.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/hasina-could-only-be-brought-back-to-bangladesh-in-handcuffs-humaiun-kobir-101795505351544.html), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/sheikh-hasina-could-only-be-brought-back-to-bangladesh-in-handcuffs-humaiun-kobir/article71737801.ece) reported that Bangladesh State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir stated that ousted former prime minister Sheikh Hasina could only be brought back to Bangladesh in handcuffs or under strict surveillance.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPUUxMLWY1amxiVVpwSlZwU2N1LXVEdVVMMU5uZXdRMXlLc2dRQ1ItendWLVVqOTVLdzExV1N4RE1ELWNFUG9QU2pLLXJPaUltcmRxbG5qWkVLRGJmSDBCQ0dmNXhjUWtHWEM2RTlacU5SbGZMblJKVWpyZllvanhkci00S0d5eTZGb21Oc013SVBSQjBNVWE5UHdORWQ?oc=5) reported that ousted leader Hasina plans to return to Bangladesh from exile on December 16, according to her spokesperson.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxQQTZ3QXNQYmJqMENPRDZLVFAyS3JkUmhjaWxHLUF6TkwzejRmTTZHaERqdmd5NkZmMVVOMEZCaW1MWnlIS3hMVE5BUjJiRTNoMy1RdXUtUVpibnhicDgxZ0JHOUNuYmRDVTNrLVpTVUFaUVM5UDVaZExqR3hTSkxrNU9nSG5aMG9sc2hsMmFvTkstR2g4Qk1UZDMzM2JSaE1yTHVtSV9qaTRPbzN1U2F3UWM4S0hyT2FpaWc?oc=5), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/sheikh-hasina-seeks-return-to-bangladesh-on-december-16-asks-for-state-carrier-report-101795489979839.html), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/sheikh-hasina-requests-december-16-return-picks-bangladesh-victory-day-for-comeback/articleshow/136118389.cms) reported that ousted former prime minister Sheikh Hasina requested to return to Bangladesh on December 16 on a state carrier.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-vows-to-arrest-ex-pm-hasina-if-she-returns-from-india/article71734092.ece), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/bangladesh-vows-arrest-hasina-if-returns-india-6574441) reported that Bangladesh State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaed Islam stated that former prime minister Sheikh Hasina will be arrested if she returns from India.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/awami-league-leaders-houses-set-on-fire-clashes-with-bnp-sheikh-hasina-likely-return-bangladesh-dhaka-violence-tensions-101795313367961.html) reported that nearly 30 houses of Awami League party leaders were set ablaze in Bangladesh amid tensions over the likely return of Sheikh Hasina.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/21/world/asia/bangladesh-protests-sheikh-hasina-what-to-know.html) reported that supporters of deposed prime minister Sheikh Hasina, who was sentenced to death in absentia, have waged a small-scale insurgency.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/bangladesh-minister-vows-action-against-those-behind-arson-blames-awami-league-linked-groups-reports-101795247826142.html) reported that a Bangladesh minister vowed action against those behind arson and blamed Awami League-linked groups.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-minister-vows-action-against-those-behind-arson-blames-awami-league-linked-groups-says-reports/article71727826.ece) reported that Humaiun Kobir stated law enforcement agencies were working to bring those responsible to justice.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-hit-by-fresh-arson-attacks-in-political-unrest/article71725621.ece) reported that police stated 124 people linked to the Awami League had been arrested in Dhaka over the previous 24 hours.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/3-killed-as-violence-grips-bangladesh-amid-hasinas-return-buzz-120-linked-to-her-party-arrested-101795182684277.html) reported that three people were killed in violence as hundreds of paramilitary troops were deployed amid unrest and over 120 people linked to Hasina's party were arrested.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261119-bangladesh-hasina-supporters-vandalise-ruling-party-office) reported that hundreds of supporters of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina staged street protests and engaged in arson attacks.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/south-asia/article/3375123/violence-rises-bangladesh-ex-pm-hasinas-supporters-escalate-protests) reported that fresh violence erupted in Bangladesh as supporters of former prime minister Sheikh Hasina tried to bring businesses and public transport to a halt.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/19/bangladesh-violent-protest-sheikh-hasina-planned-return) reported that the Awami League party called for nationwide protests and parts of Bangladesh were shut down following the government's rejection of Hasina's passport request.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/bangladesh-tightens-security-amid-tensions-over-sheikh-hasinas-possible-return/) reported that Bangladesh stepped up security measures amid tensions surrounding former prime minister Sheikh Hasina's possible return.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/muhammad-yunus-ancestral-home-set-on-fire-chattogram-bangladesh-lockdown-call-awami-league-sheikh-hasina-return-101795067374137.html) reported that the ancestral home of former interim government chief Muhammad Yunus was set on fire in Bangladesh amid protests.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045579/paramilitary-units-deployed-in-bangladesh-amid-hasina-unrest) reported that Bangladesh stepped up security, deployed paramilitary units, and reported a petrol bomb killing an activist in the former prime minister's hometown alongside arson attacks targeting Grameen Bank branches.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583366/hasinas-planned-return-sparks-violence-across-bangladesh/) reported that Bangladesh deployed hundreds of paramilitary troops as violence and tensions spread over the planned return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-deploys-paramilitary-as-unrest-grows-overhasinas-return/article71717353.ece) reported that police recorded dozens of crude bomb blasts and torched vehicles across at least 28 districts over 10 days.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/police-in-bangladesh-clash-with-garment-workers-demanding-higher-minimum-wages) reported that police in Bangladesh clashed with garment workers demanding a minimum monthly wage increase to 30,000 takas.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/india-cannot-dictate-terms-on-hasinas-return-to-bangladesh-pms-adviser/article71712874.ece) reported that an adviser to the Prime Minister of Bangladesh stated that India cannot dictate terms regarding Sheikh Hasina's return.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/bangladesh-garment-workers-clash-with-police-in-fresh-protests-over-wages?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bangladeshi police clashed with garment workers who hurled bricks, torched vehicles, and blocked the highway between Dhaka and Mymensingh.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/fresh-protests-erupt-in-bangladesh-amid-garment-workers-wage-strike-tensions-over-sheikh-hasinas-possible-return-101794908401544.html) reported that workers demanded a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 taka, representing a 140 per cent increase over their current wage of 12,500 taka.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/south-asia/article/3374768/bangladesh-garment-workers-clash-police-fresh-wage-protest) reported that police fired tear gas and stun grenades during clashes with thousands of garment workers protesting after a key wage board meeting.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/fresh-unrest-in-bangladesh-as-garment-workers-protest-block-highway-for-higher-wages-101794900759373.html), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045168/bangladesh-garment-workers-police-clash-in-fresh-wage-protest) reported that Bangladeshi police used tear gas and stun grenades against garment workers protesting on highways for higher wages.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bangladesh-dismisses-reports-of-india-setting-conditions-for-sheikh-hasinas-return-she-ll-return-under-extradition-treaty-101794840686924.html) reported that Bangladesh minister Shama Obaed Islam stated Bangladesh will consider any formal conditions India may put forward regarding Hasina's return.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/ex-bangladesh-pm-hasina-return-home-despite-death-threat-6554771) reported that former Bangladesh prime minister Sheikh Hasina stated no threat of death will keep her away from her country as she plans a December return.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/ex-primeira-ministra-de-bangladesh-sheikh-hasina-diz-que-pretende-voltar-ao-pais-em-dezembro-apesar-de-condenacao-a-morte.ghtml) reported that 79-year-old former prime minister Sheikh Hasina stated she intends to return to Bangladesh in December despite her death sentence.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/sheikh-hasina-to-return-through-legal-means-what-india-does-is-up-to-them-bangladesh-minister-101794715954956.html) reported that a Bangladesh minister stated Sheikh Hasina will return through legal means and that Dhaka has completed its part of the legal process.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/sheikh-hasinas-return-to-bangladesh-india-wants-dhaka-to-fulfil-two-conditions-says-report/articleshow/135824475.cms) reported that India is seeking Sheikh Hasina's return to Bangladesh after more than two years in exile and has set two conditions for Tarique Rahman’s government.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/uk-parliamentarians-appeal-to-foreign-secretary-for-sheikh-hasina-death-penalty-safeguards-101794387141548.html) reported that UK parliamentarians appealed to the Foreign Secretary for safeguards regarding Sheikh Hasina and the death penalty.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/10/bangladesh-prosecutor-warns-hasina-faces-execution-if-she-returns?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal said ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will be executed if she returns home.

reports.text: [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/bayelsa-boat-mishap-exposes-gaps-between-safety-interventions-enforcement/) reported that a wooden passenger boat carrying mourners from Ayama to Ukubie capsized near the river junction between Oweikorogha and O.
[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tears-as-victims-of-bayelsa-boat-mishap-get-mass-burial/) reported that victims of the Bayelsa boat mishap received a mass burial.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fubara-commiserates-with-bayelsa-govt-over-boat-mishap/) reported that Rivers State Governor Siminalayi Fubara commiserated with Bayelsa State Governor Douye Diri over a boat accident that claimed lives.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fubara-mourns-victims-of-bayelsa-boat-accident/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Rivers Governor Siminalayi Fubara commiserated with Bayelsa over the Southern Ijaw boat accident which killed 29 people.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-death-toll-rises-to-32-police-warn-operators/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Bayelsa boat tragedy death toll rose to 32 as police warned operators and passengers against overloading and ignoring life-jacket rules.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/lokpobiri-commiserates-with-bayelsa-state-over-tragic-boat-mishap/) reported that Minister of State for Petroleum Resources Heineken Lokpobiri expressed sorrow over the boat mishap at Ukubie.
[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bayelsa-boat-mishap-death-toll-rises-to-32-aig-visits-scene/) reported that the Bayelsa boat mishap death toll rose to 32.
[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bayelsa-boat-mishap-govt-deploys-crane-to-scene/) reported that the state government deployed a crane to the scene of the mishap.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/927360-bayelsa-boat-tragedy-exposes-questions-over-n844m-budgeted-for-boat-purchases.html) reported that questions are mounting over Bayelsa's spending on marine vessels following a boat accident resulting in 29 deaths.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-orders-probe-into-deadly-bayelsa-boat-accident/) reported that the Federal Government ordered an immediate investigation into the boat accident that claimed several lives in Bayelsa State.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fg-orders-probe-into-bayelsa-boat-mishap-demands-niwa-report/) reported that the Federal Government ordered an investigation into the Bayelsa boat mishap and demanded a NIWA report.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/oyetola-orders-probe-into-bayelsa-boat-accident/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Minister Adegboyega Oyetola directed NIWA to investigate the fatal Bayelsa boat accident in Southern Ijaw, citing missing life jackets and a manifest.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-atiku-demands-probe-overhaul-of-water-transport-safety/) reported that presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar called for an investigation and an overhaul of water transport safety following the Bayelsa boat tragedy.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/dickson-mourns-victims-of-bayelsa-boat-mishap-seeks-safety-measures/) reported that former Governor of Bayelsa State Henry Seriake Dickson commiserated with the families and friends of victims of the boat mishap along the Ayama/Ow.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/nema-recovers-24-bodies-from-bayelsa-boat-mishap/) reported that the National Emergency Management Agency recovered 24 bodies from the Bayelsa boat mishap.
[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-death-toll-rises-to-26/) reported that the death toll from the boat accident in Bayelsa State climbed to 26.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bayelsa-boat-mishap-more-bodies-recovered-on-river/) reported that joint search and rescue efforts by the Bayelsa State government and security agencies recovered more bodies and rescued more survivors following a boat mishap.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/makinde-mourns-bayelsa-boat-tragedy-condoles-with-victims-families/) reported that Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde commiserated with the Bayelsa State Government over the boat mishap.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/oborevwori-mourns-bayelsa-boat-mishap-victims-commiserates-with-diri-bereaved-families/) reported that Delta State Governor Sheriff Oborevwori expressed deep sorrow over the boat mishap in the Southern Ijaw Local Government Area.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/many-feared-killed-as-funeral-bound-barge-capsizes-in-bayelsa/) reported that a crowded barge carrying passengers to a funeral capsized near Ukubie in the Southern Ijaw area of Bayelsa State.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-govt-warns-operators-against-overloading/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Bayelsa Government warned boat operators against overloading and reckless navigation following a boat mishap in Southern Ijaw.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/four-die-24-rescued-as-bayelsa-burial-boat-capsizes/) reported that four persons, including two children, died after a boat carrying passengers to a burial ceremony capsized in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/four-mourners-die-in-bayelsa-boat-accident/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that four mourners, including two children, died when a boat capsized in Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa State, with police stating 24 passengers were rescued.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/breaking-over-50-feared-dead-as-boat-capsizes-in-bayelsa-about-100-passengers-missing/) reported that over 50 people are feared dead and about 100 passengers are missing after a passenger boat capsized in Bayelsa.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/several-feared-missing-as-boat-carrying-mourners-capsizes-in-bayelsa/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/boat-capsizes-with-300-passengers-in-bayelsa/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bayelsa-hundreds-of-people-feared-missing-in-boat-mishap/) reported that several people are feared missing after an overloaded boat carrying mourners capsized in Bayelsa State.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxNUjJHS3F4cFgwQkk3TnZDV042WDVNR2JDdkk3RWRseWFhOU93eDBabWxPc3JGY1l4RXFFTUVTZUhCT0Zjdnc3V0xPR0ItZkQzR185OEtCcWZjVVRIRjJIRmgwVXRjTS00XzIwX1NEMi1wMS14Q3lKSVRCZ2VtNVQ3RVRvOExRVk1uTFF5OE11dy1wRlU?oc=5) reported that dozens are missing off Senegal as West African departures for Europe surge.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/19/canary-island-erects-field-hospital-amid-migrant-influx/) reported that authorities on Spain's Canary Island of El Hierro set up a field hospital at a temporary site to manage a sharp rise in migrant arrivals putting pressure on health services.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/migrant-boat-capsizes-off-senegal-leaving-at-least-one-dead?traffic_source=rss), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/migrant-boat-capsizes-off-senegal-at-least-one-dead-3012792) reported that a migrant boat capsized off the coast of western Senegal, resulting in the death of at least one person.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/19/record-number-of-african-migrants-arrive-in-spains-canary-islands/) reported that official figures show more than 11,000 African migrants reached Spain's Canary Islands in the first 15 days of November.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/19/at-least-one-dead-in-latest-migrant-boat-disaster-off-senegals-coast/) reported that officials stated a wooden vessel carrying around 100 people struck a rocky outcrop and washed ashore.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-canary-islands-north-africa-el-hierro-pedro-sanchez-b3086710.html) reported that more than 11,000 migrants reached Spain's Canary Islands in the first half of November according to government figures.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/17/another-boat-carrying-migrants-arrives-at-el-hierro-in-spains-canary-islands/) reported that Spain’s maritime rescue service stated nearly 2,200 migrants arrived in the Canary Islands over the past two days.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/canary-islands-spain-migration-emergency-b3085520.html) reported that Spain declared a migration emergency on the Canary Islands.

reports.text: [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-next-general-election-national-day-anwar-6583951) reported that Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim stated that the next general election is likely to be held either before or after National Day 2027.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3375596/not-true-anwar-denies-malaysian-government-leaked-najib-pardon-minutes) reported that Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim denied that the government circulated Pardons Board minutes related to former leader Najib Razak's house arrest.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3374928/malaysias-pardons-board-minutes-expose-legal-rift-over-najibs-house-arrest) reported that Malaysia's attorney general objected to former prime minister Najib Razak's house arrest on the grounds that it had no legal basis, though the king approved the arrangement.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/najib-razak-house-arrest-declassified-minutes-attorney-general-hannah-yeoh-6561556) reported that Pardons Board minutes showed Malaysia's AG warned that Najib's house arrest could affect political stability and the country's image, and that Federal Territories Minister Hannah Yeoh also opposed the move.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/article/3374689/foreigners-lose-homes-thailand-malaysias-melaka-elections-7-asia-highlights) reported on seven selected stories from coverage of Asia over the past week, including foreigners losing homes in Thailand and Malaysia's Melaka elections.
[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/melaka-poll-results-analysis-malaysia-general-election-challenges-6552746) reported that a BN-PN alliance achieved a landslide victory in Melaka.
[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/melaka-election-2026-bn-landslide-anwar-ph-pn-6551571) reported that the Barisan Nasional and Perikatan Nasional alliance won 24 seats in the Melaka polls.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374453/malaysias-melaka-poll-shows-ethnic-lines-firming-can-anwar-turn-malay-nationalist-tide) reported that identity politics could decide the outcome of Malaysia's next national election.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374416/malaysias-melaka-election-begins-anwars-ph-seeks-counter-resurgent-umno) reported that voters began casting ballots on Saturday morning to decide who will govern the southern Malaysian state of Melaka over the next five years.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-melaka-state-election-bn-pn-najib-razak-6545381) reported that former Prime Minister Najib Razak's conditional pardon sparked concerns over preferential treatment among some voters.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/former-malaysia-pm-najib-razak-house-arrest-sentence-6545056) reported that Najib Razak had submitted a written request for a second residence to be included in his house arrest arrangements, but this was not approved.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/malaysias-ex-pm-transferred-to-house-arrest-for-1mdb-graft-sentence?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak was transferred from prison to his Kuala Lumpur home for house arrest.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/former-malaysian-leader-najib-razak-returns-home-under-royal-pardon-but-faces-a-separate-15-year-prison-sentence/a-79913437?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Najib Razak returned home under a royal pardon but still faces a separate 15-year prison sentence.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-najib-razak-house-arrest-anwar-ibrahim-umno-6542426) reported that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's anti-corruption agenda has taken a perceived hit despite him not having the final say in former premier Najib Razak's house arrest.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374042/taiwan-pauses-malaysia-investment-talks-after-anwar-remarks-spark-fury-taipei) reported that Malaysia is seeking to reassure Taiwanese investors that it remains a reliable destination for hi-tech manufacturing after Taipei suspended bilateral investment talks.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/10/malaysian-court-clears-former-pm-najib-razak-for-house-arrest-transfer?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Malaysian court cleared former PM Najib Razak for a house arrest transfer.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxORXB4UWVtZXBzZXM1eGhQa0tGX21hamxBcVpnR2lfMUUxV1dyc0RvdXZGQk9KSGxNQ2ZrNjJZSmJrcjNJSjVlZXRkZkVSUjk0NERGWTZSN3RzWFNYWENwdERHZDlQS1lRaF9PaG0tRmNfMW5yeGYyYzI3ZEx0d3Mxb25jeWlMQXF5SzNkdDNLZEl4N05JdmlGVjNBSWxLUms5OWNkYkUyUkNXVEl3cm9iOV84eG0wQlVodHhabkVLR0s0TFdsTTRMeFJR?oc=5) reported that a Malaysia court cleared the way for ex-PM Najib to start house arrest, according to Bernama.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/malaysian-court-clears-final-hurdle-for-former-pm-najib-razaks-transfer-to-house-arrest/article71686082.ece) reported that a Malaysian court cleared the final hurdle for former Prime Minister Najib Razak's transfer to house arrest.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-transport-minister-anthony-loke-resignation-take-effect-immediately-najib-house-arrest-6538901) reported that Malaysian Transport Minister Anthony Loke's resignation takes effect immediately after the court granted Najib house arrest.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/people/article/3373950/malaysia-court-clears-najib-begin-house-arrest) reported that Malaysia's former prime minister Najib Razak arrived home after the High Court cleared the way for him to serve the remainder of his prison term under house arrest.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-ex-pm-najib-razak-released-prison-house-arrest-royal-pardon-6538231) reported that Najib Razak arrived home in Kuala Lumpur to serve the remainder of his jail term under house arrest after being released from Kajang Prison.

reports.text: [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-ukraine-war-live-putin-drones-nuclear-weapons-casualties-b3091880.html) reported that Kyiv stated five Russian military aircraft, including three MiG-31 jets and two Su-34 fighter-bombers, were damaged in a strike on an airbase east of Moscow.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/22/bessent-confirms-hes-living-on-us-military-base-over-iran-fears?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated he is still living at a US military base two weeks after an Israeli warning.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/treasury-secretary-bessent-insists-us-will-continue-squeezing-irans-economy-3013189) reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated the United States will continue to squeeze Iran's economy until Tehran adheres to a deal.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/two-men-stand-trial-uk-next-year-over-raf-fairford-incident-allegedly-linked-iran), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/islamic-terrorism/article-915588) reported that two men charged over the September security incident at the RAF Fairford military base, which British and US prosecutors say was linked to Iran, are to stand trial next year.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915234) reported that British counterterrorism police arrested a US Army officer near Gloucester under investigation over espionage allegations.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90415) reported that British authorities transferred a US Army officer suspected of spying for Russia to American military custody.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/uk-hands-nato-assigned-us-soldier-accused-of-russia-spying-to-us-military?traffic_source=rss) reported that UK authorities transferred the investigation in line with existing international protocols.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/scott-bessent-confirms-relocating-from-washington-home-to-military-base-amid-iranian-threats-101794581505450.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-914821) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed relocating from his Washington home to a military base following Iranian threats.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/13/us-terror-case-raf-fairford-arrests) reported that a suspect held in a New York jail has been linked to a handler behind Iran-linked operations in Britain in connection with the RAF Fairford arrests.

[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/12/3-iranian-backed-men-indicted-in-attempted-plot-on-raf-fairford/) reported that three men, with one working from jail, allegedly conspired to commit around 20 terrorist attacks across the US and Europe, including a plot on RAF Fairford.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914783) reported that a 41-year-old US Army officer stationed at NATO headquarters in the UK was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579836/us-authorities-charge-three-men-over-suspected-terror-plot-targeting-raf-fairford/) reported that United States authorities unsealed an eight-count indictment charging three men for involvement in foreign terror plots targeting RAF Fairford.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/coded-messages-from-jail-cell-how-alleged-iranian-operative-mohammad-dawood-al-saadi-coordinated-foiled-raf-fairford-terror-plot-uk-us-iran-war-101794386640896.html) reported that American and British authorities suspected an Iranian link to the foiled terror plot, while Tehran denied any involvement.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-charges-3-alleged-iran-operatives-for-targeting-raf-fairford-in-uk-20-other-terror-plots-101794384900293.html) reported that US prosecutors charged three alleged operatives for targeting RAF Fairford in the UK and other terror plots.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/us-charges-three-men-for-allegedly-plotting-attack-on-uk-base?traffic_source=rss) reported that the US charged three men for allegedly plotting an attack on a Royal Air Force base in Fairford, UK.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-charges-3-alleged-iranian-operatives-over-plots-targeting-jewish-communities-and-a-uk-airbase/a-79913543?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that US prosecutors claimed three alleged Iranian operatives were planning a campaign of terror against Jewish communities and a UK airbase.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261110-us-iranian-operatives-raf-fairford-terror-plot) reported that the US Justice Department charged three men described as Iranian operatives over an alleged September terrorist plot at Britain's RAF Fairford airbase.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3374046/us-treasury-chief-bessent-moved-military-base-after-iran-threats) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved from his Washington DC residence to a US military base after Iranian threats against his life.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-treasury-chief-bessent-moved-to-military-base-after-iranian-threats-reports-say/article71688103.ece) reported that Iran has previously denied plotting to attend officials and people on U.S. soil.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/ministar-finansija-sad-a-se-preselio-u-vojnu-bazu-zbog-straha-od-irana/) reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved to a military base due to threats from Iran.

[VG](https://www.vg.no/nyheter/i/xJR66p/wsj-usa-evakuerte-fly-fra-britisk-militaerbase?utm_medium=rss) reported that the US moved several military aircraft from a base in the UK following threats from Iran.

[Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/us-soldier-arrested-in-great-britain-on-suspicion-of-spying-for-russia-9czbdwu) reported that British police detained an American soldier accused of passing sensitive information to foreign intelligence services.
[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/11/us-soldier-arrested-in-england-on-suspicion-of-spying-for-russia) reported that the FBI stated the case is of the utmost concern.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/bessent-moved-base-iran-threats.html) reported that Treasury Secretary Bessent was moved from his D.C.-area home to a military base amid Iranian threats.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPcnM2ZmY3ZXBGMkQwN09vMkxoZTNNd3MxSjRnZnFnN3RrUDVNeTk3LUYxVHNWQ2RnMkQ4OVF5RDNlSUlLbzcxUFJvaGFCU3pscExIbVZ1VldROUl3X1pvSktwVDJGcTlYMzNmY3FwRFhJeVJmZHpHd1F4UnpmeHlNOFUxb0ZnRlFiY2oyZA?oc=5) reported that a U.S. soldier was arrested in England on suspicion of espionage related to Russia.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOTWFjbHBKUTJzdVgtMEpEdktjTk16NWFQVkJncFJTV3UxcFJET2Ixc0d2M2lwdjZyYk0xY1RSd0pDbzF4ZFdJeXRORS1TQlItU21NdmRDRVBoRUZhUTQwYnNCWmZ2VE9lenMtdDJ1MXotZ1pxNkNQN09OMlhuWWJvX3QxZWZsWnJMbTJreDQ5YzRnQ0ZwTVB3?oc=5) reported that three individuals were charged in the U.S. with planning terror attacks, including an alleged assault on a British airbase.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-pulls-tankers-special-ops-planes-from-raf-mildenhall-over-iran-threat) reported that air refueling tankers and special operations aircraft dispersed from RAF Mildenhall as force protection levels were elevated.

[Gazeta Wyborcza](https://wyborcza.pl/7,75399,33125223,amerykanie-zabieraja-samoloty-z-kolejnej-brytyjskiej-bazy-boja.html) reported that American tankers were evacuated from a second base in Britain because of an Iran threat.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/us-military-aircraft-pulled-from-second-uk-base-after-iran-threat/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that bombers were withdrawn from RAF Fairford in October after an Iran-linked security incident.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579406/us-withdraws-aircraft-from-second-uk-military-base/) reported that the United States moved at least 10 military aircraft from RAF Mildenhall following an alleged threat linked to Iran.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-relocates-military-aircraft-from-british-base-amid-iran-threats-101794324495306.html) reported that the U.S. Air Force relocated 13 aircraft from RAF Mildenhall to bases in Scotland, Spain, and Germany after identifying a threat.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189962/%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A7-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%B7%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A8-12-%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9) reported that the US military withdrew at least 12 refueling aircraft from a British military base due to an Iranian threat.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/us-evacuates-aircraft-from-british-military-base-after-threat-from-iran-wsj-reports/) reported that the United States evacuated American military aircraft from a base in England following a threat from Iran, according to The Wall Street Journal.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-withdraws-military-aircraft-second-uk-airbase) reported that Sky News stated 12 aircraft left Mildenhall on Monday based on flight tracking sources.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3373947/us-withdraws-9-military-aircraft-second-uk-airbase-after-iran-threat-reports) reported that the United States withdrew military aircraft from a second British airbase following a threat from Iran, according to the Wall Street Journal.
[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/10/world/us-uk-base-evacuated-iran/) reported that US aircraft were evacuated from a second UK base due to an Iran threat.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1118/1599771-russell-brand-youtube-uk/), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/uk-government-urges-google-to-take-down-branded-youtube-message/) reported that the UK government asked Google to remove a YouTube video featuring convicted rapist Russell Brand declaring his innocence.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/nov/19/prison-authorities-consider-russell-brand-youtube-message-rules-victim-distress) reported that prison authorities are weighing up comments issued through the rapist's wife.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxQMy1kYm1oemdYd3hLSUI3cktJbkpTY3Y1SWJJY0xHbFQ3blBMRS1MRnZCWWlDUW15ZkczTHBoTzVzckFnaXJ3Y183R0tnWmp5R3BaaWp0d3NNZ09YbW8tcVEtTENCNllMWkMyU1NoTXpYN0dXYXFrcEFsVEhELURjX0hTQ1dLZGJmZEd5d3EyOA?oc=5) reported that a woman is waiving her anonymity to state that Russell Brand sexually assaulted her when she was 16.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/nov/18/uk-government-russell-brand-youtube-deactivated-google), [BILD](https://www.bild.de/unterhaltung/stars-und-leute/russell-brand-schickte-botschafts-aus-dem-gefaengnis-regierung-will-seinen-youtube-kanal-sperren-lassen-6afe009b82b53b7db9d8f289) reported that UK ministers asked Google to deactivate Russell Brand's YouTube account following a message sent from prison.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/2026/11/18/russell-brand-case-prompts-uk-to-rethink-the-age-of-consent/) reported that Labour sources suggest tightening the UK age of consent law from 16 to prevent age-related power imbalances following the Russell Brand case.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/russell-brand-to-be-punished-as-prison-bosses-reportedly-furious-he-sent-message-out-via-his-wife/Q5YY73F5L5A7XKZOIUTYY45CUI/) reported that Russell Brand will face punishment after prison bosses were angered by a message he sent out via his wife.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQZDNZZE9hdnNBMmR6RlVGZllpWFdoNEZzanNmSXlxSUpUVVJCazBUOXZoVmxFTk1VYXlUWjN5SjJkLVlPRDlFTThfbTRlb2lwcUNUbGlsZS0zOU9IdFhYbnpycEZSMWpLMG9naDRJMk5WN3poLXN2LVZiNmpuT3UtS3FuWDRJTkpu?oc=5) reported that convicted rapist Russell Brand is under investigation for claiming innocence from behind bars.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/russell-brand-and-noel-fielding-joke-about-rape-on-the-2007-big-fat-quiz-of-the-year-20261117-p61ewv.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Noel Fielding stated he is appalled at jokes made in the past and horrified to learn of Russell Brand's crimes.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2026/nov/16/ed-miliband-russell-brand-andy-burnham-brexit-eu-milburn-review-young-people-employment-uk-politics-latest-news) reported that Ed Miliband defended conducting a 2015 election interview with Russell Brand, stating he was taking him on rather than endorsing him.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1116/1599470-russell-brand-message/) reported that comedian Russell Brand could face disciplinary action, including having phone calls restricted, after sharing a message from prison.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/jailed-russell-brands-wife-breaks-her-silence-on-his-incarceration/S5IXT4S2WBBAXANHU4UO2NE5HI/) reported that Russell Brand's wife broke her silence on his incarceration after he was sentenced to 10 years and six months for rape and sexual assault.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/nov/16/ministry-of-justice-investigating-russell-brand-message) reported that the UK Ministry of Justice launched an investigation into a message from Russell Brand from prison.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/russell-brand-under-investigation-over-appalling-prison-statement-20261117-p61eok.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the convicted rapist's comments could breach rules against causing distress to victims.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-16/russell-brand-wife-issues-statement-saying-he-is-not-guilty/107389440) reported that Russell Brand issued a statement from prison maintaining his innocence after being moved to a facility for sex offenders.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/tv-and-radio/2026/nov/16/woman-accusing-david-walliams-grooming-backs-staggered-age-of-consent-call) reported that a woman who accused David Walliams of grooming her expressed support for calls to change the age of consent law following allegations involving Russell Brand.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/russell-brand-rape-accuser-age-of-consent-law-change/) reported that a woman alleging comedian Russell Brand raped her at age 16 called for changes to the UK age of consent law.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/14/woman-who-alleges-russell-brand-raped-her-when-she-was-16-waives-anonymity/) reported that Mia Latter waived her anonymity regarding allegations that Russell Brand raped her when she was 16.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/russell-brand-secretly-moved-to-softer-prison-for-his-own-safety/4D5ZSWVOYBH3NNSKHBKV4WAL5E/), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/russell-brand-moved-to-new-prison-20261116-p61ecw.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Russell Brand was moved to a softer British prison following his rape conviction.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/uk-tv-star-jeremy-edwards-says-david-walliams-sexually-humiliated-him-during-sketch-on-stage/IDUUVNUX4FD67ET7FX5AEYQKOA/) reported that UK TV star Jeremy Edwards stated David Walliams sexually humiliated him during a stage sketch.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/uk-to-consider-changing-age-of-consent-after-brand-case-walliams-claims-20261116-p61ec9.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the UK will consider changing the age of consent following a case involving Russell Brand and claims regarding David Walliams.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/law/2026/nov/15/uk-government-to-consider-changing-age-of-consent-after-allegations-against-russell-brand) reported that the UK government will consider changing the age of consent following allegations against Russell Brand.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/uk-police-investigating-comedian-david-walliams-over-serious-allegations-20261114-p61e67.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that British police are investigating comedian and author David Walliams over reports of alleged serious sexual offenses.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQczlhMFFEcjA0WHlFTW10cmZFdE9PYkpNemV2WV9pRHhxbTJMaE83akxtVnM4MVV0M3hWMkZTaFdSR0hBckU2NlgwcHB3SDVROUU4U0huVGJxc0pRSEVXWjVBM2h6X0RIaTl2V1BBOU5EeGZjQlpiSzlhTWRIb0x5QnhuOXd6ZHNnTHhUMklUczRRLWV5OXFoZXFHZEFwMUU?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/uk-police-open-sex-offence-probe-into-comedian-and-author-david-walliams?traffic_source=rss) reported that British police launched a sex offense investigation into children's author and TV personality David Walliams.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/david-walliams-investigated-by-police-over-serious-sexual-offences/W6ULC66545D6RCOODEOSQMALAM/) reported that the Metropolitan Police's complaints regarding David Walliams are separate from claims reported by ITN and the Guardian.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/uk/british-childrens-author-david-walliams-investigated-over-grooming-assault-allegations-involving-minors/articleshow/135812274.cms) reported that a British children's author is being investigated over grooming and assault allegations involving minors.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-14/six-more-women-accuse-russell-brand-of-sexual-offences/107385408), [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNS1dvX1hiNzRzS09VWFU2UmFCNzVUZ290Tkx0QzRoTl9la3RseTNUWVNXZHhCUThYWDdTd25RNmpWTGJBVDl1ZUZQcHgxTjBaNTFWUUtmbVdyMkxFYXBLdlpiTjgxMFdFQ2NnZUpGTlY5ZXpKYVUtcUdwd1VjNlZsaXZpWU9vbVFEd3NVX1pKYTFiazhodE9BUA?oc=5) reported that six more women came forward with allegations of sexual offences against Russell Brand.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/13/families-clear-homes-of-david-walliams-books-after-sexual-offence-allegations) reported that families cleared their homes of David Walliams books following sexual offense allegations.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/13/david-walliams-allegations-met-police-investigation), [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-14/uk-police-launch-investigation-into-david-walliams/107385506), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/uk/2026/1113/1599155-met-walliams/) reported that London's Metropolitan Police launched an investigation into actor and comedian David Walliams following allegations of sexual offenses.
[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/brand-accused-of-sexual-misconduct-by-six-more-women/DS6N6PMGSZDALLOC4LDHW6S57M/) reported that Brand was accused of sexual misconduct by six more women.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/tv-and-radio/2026/nov/11/jonathan-ross-david-walliams-russell-brand-revelations) reported that TV presenter Jonathan Ross said he was genuinely unaware of David Walliams and Russell Brand's conduct.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/britain-david-walliams-court-accused_n_6af38776e4b0a8468d8bf053) reported that British comedian and children's author David Walliams was accused of sexual misconduct and unsuccessfully sought a court injunction to bar two news outlets from identifying him.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/world/europe/jemima-goldsmith-russell-brand-assault.html) reported that Jemima Goldsmith accused Russell Brand of violence and coercive control during their relationship.

reports.text: [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/26/milei-becomes-the-first-head-of-state-to-visit-alliana-in-paraguay-after-pena-s-fall?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Argentine President Javier Milei traveled to Asunción to back Paraguayan President Pedro Alliana.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/politica/escandalo-ueno-bank-milei-reunio-paraguay-sucesor-santiago-pena-ofrecio-asistencia-economica-financiera_0_mlCfzuQmoz.html) reported that Javier Milei traveled to Asuncion, met with Pedro Alliana, and offered economic and financial assistance following the Ueno Bank scandal.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/tras-el-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-javier-milei-se-reune-con-pedro-alliana-nuevo-presidente-de-paraguay-nid26112026/) reported that Javier Milei met with new Paraguay president Pedro Alliana following the Ueno Bank scandal.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/imputarian-expresidente-pena-por-lavado-de-activos-y-soborno) reported that prosecutors plan to indict former president Peña for asset laundering and bribery in an expanded filing for the Ueno Bank case.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/paraguay-prepara-ley-de-emergencia-por-crisis-de-ueno-bank-garantizara-indemnizaciones-a-miles-de-trabajadores/) reported that Paraguay prepared an emergency law for the Ueno Bank crisis to guarantee compensation for workers.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/fiscalia-de-paraguay-acusa-al-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-a-dos-familiares-por-lavado-de-activos-y-cohecho-por-el-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-3603960) reported that Paraguay's prosecutor's office accused former president Santiago Peña and two relatives of asset laundering and bribery.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-a-santiago-pena-por-lavado-de-activos-y-cohecho-por-el-caso-ueno-bank-33294119) reported that the Paraguayan Prosecutor's Office accused former president Santiago Peña of money laundering and bribery in the Ueno Bank case.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-expresidente-pena-lavado-activos-cohecho-ueno-bank_1795556481) reported that the new charges against the former president constitute an expansion of the initial accusation of breach of trust and negligent administration.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/detienen-a-hermano-del-expresidente-santiago-pena-por-el-caso-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-33282464) reported that Paraguay's Prosecutor's Office ordered the arrest of former president Santiago Peña's brother, Francisco Peña, and his wife over alleged money laundering.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/detienen-al-hermano-y-a-la-cunada-del-expresidente-de-paraguay-santiago-pena-en-medio-del-caso-ueno-bank-son-investigados-por-lavado-de-activos-3603618) reported that Francisco Peña and Rocío Caballero were captured following a fiscal order investigating a simulated purchase of 1,184 hectares.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/detienen-hermano-cunada-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-investigados-caso-ueno_1795476703) reported that judicial authorities detained the brother and sister-in-law of former Paraguayan president Peña in connection with the Ueno case involving a real estate acquisition.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/detenido-hermano-del-expresidente-de-paraguay-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank) reported that agents intercepted Francisco Peña Palacios as he left his home regarding the Ueno Bank scandal.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-detention-pena-brother-ueno/) reported that Paraguay's Prosecutor's Office ordered the preventive detention of Francisco Peña, brother of former president Santiago Peña, over links to the Ueno Bank scandal.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/fiscalia-paraguay-ordena-detener-hermano-expresidente-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_202611236b04a39cff6fec2921993996.html) reported that Francisco Peña and his wife are under suspicion for alleged money laundering and self-interested administration in a real estate operation linked to the bank.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-abre-investigacion-penal-contra-el-exfiscal-general-de-paraguay-por-el-caso-ueno-bank-33238340) reported that Paraguay's Attorney General's Office opened a criminal investigation against former Attorney General Emiliano Rolón.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-abre-investigacion-penal-exfiscal-general-paraguay-ueno-bank_1795221891) reported that the Paraguayan Attorney General's Office opened a criminal investigation against the former attorney general regarding Ueno Bank, alongside the resignation and preventative detention of former Central Bank head Carlos Carvallo and three board directors.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/19/ueno-bank-collapse-claims-paraguay-s-attorney-general-and-the-head-of-itaipu?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Paraguay's Attorney General Emiliano Rolón resigned and the Paraguayan director of the binational Itaipú dam departed following the Ueno Bank collapse.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-attorney-general-rolon-resigns/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay’s Attorney General Emiliano Rolon Fernandez resigned to stop an impeachment trial in the Chamber of Deputies.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-moved-to-military-prison/), a state-media outlet, reported that a criminal guarantees judge ordered the immediate transfer of former president Santiago Peña to the Viñas Cué military prison in Asuncion.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/paraguay-ex-president-moved-to-military-jail-amid-special-treatment-reports?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was accused of corruption following the collapse of Ueno Bank earlier in the month.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/santiago-pena-trasladado-carcel-militar-evitar-privilegios_1794875745) reported that Santiago Peña was transferred to a military jail to avoid privileges following an immediate transfer order by penal guarantee judge Osmar Legal.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-ex-president-pena-moved-vinas-cue-military-prison/) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña entered a military prison following a judge's transfer order in the Ueno Bank case.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/santiago-pena-ingresa-a-una-carcel-militar-en-paraguay-esposado-y-con-chaleco-antibalas-33164061) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was placed in preventive detention at a military prison.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-escandalo-por-los-privilegios-de-santiago-pena-en-prision-fuerza-su-traslado-a-otra-carcel-nid16112026/) reported that the scandal over Santiago Peña's privileges in prison forced his transfer to another military jail in Paraguay.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/juez-en-paraguay-ordena-trasladar-al-expresidente-santiago-pena-a-carcel-militar-sera-recluido-en-la-prision-de-vinas-cue/) reported critics denounced alleged privileges granted to the former leader, including a gymnasium.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/entrega-jefe-juridico-banco-central-paraguay-investigado-caida-ueno-bank_1794790896) reported that Aldo Rodríguez, head of the legal department of the Central Bank of Paraguay, surrendered to a police station in Asunción after an arrest warrant was issued over an altered report in the Ueno Bank case.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/asi-vive-la-principal-plaza-de-mercado-de-asuncion-la-crisis-financiera-por-la-caida-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-3600940) reported that sellers at Mercado 4 in Asunción stated sales have plummeted due to the Ueno Bank financial crisis.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-caida-del-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-revela-el-avance-de-los-tecnomagnates-en-america-latina-nid14112026/) reported that the crisis of Paraguay's digital bank exposed links between technology entrepreneurs, governments, and far-right financing networks.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-asociacion-criminal-pena-cupula-bcp-caso-ueno-bank_1794677588) reported that Paraguayan prosecutor Christian Benítez stated a new charge of criminal association has been added against former president Santiago Peña and the Central Bank leadership in the Ueno bank case.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/how-a-bank-collapse-in-paraguay-brought-down-the-countrys-president-explained/article71677767.ece) reported that millions of customers abruptly lost access to savings and pension accounts after regulators seized a bank in Paraguay.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-criminal-association-ueno/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay's Public Prosecutor's Office added a charge of criminal association as perpetrator against former president Santiago Peña.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/fiscalia-acusa-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal) reported that the prosecutor's office accused former Paraguayan president Peña of leading a criminal association, which carries a sentence of up to 15 years in prison.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/milei-se-comunico-con-pedro-alliana-el-sucesor-de-santiago-pena-en-paraguay-nid13112026/) reported that Javier Milei communicated with Pedro Alliana, the successor of Santiago Peña, and expressed readiness to collaborate.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/crisis-en-paraguay-fiscalia-pide-ampliar-la-imputacion-contra-el-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-lo-acusa-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal-3600892), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-fiscalia-de-paraguay-complica-la-situacion-de-pena-con-una-nueva-imputacion-por-asociacion-nid13112026/), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fiscalia-acusa-a-expresidente-paraguayo-de-liderar-asociacion-criminal-santiago-pena-protegio-desde-el-poder-a-ueno-bank-senala/) reported that the Paraguayan prosecutor's office expanded charges against former president Santiago Peña, accusing him of leading a criminal association and protecting Ueno Bank from power.

[Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

reports.text: [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/27/russian-drone-strikes-hit-ukraines-energy-rail-and-civilian-infrastructure-causing-deaths) reported that Ukraine halted all electricity exports and increased imports to their highest level following Russian drone strikes on energy, rail, and civilian infrastructure.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189129-russian-forces-launch-nearly-60-strikes-on-sumy-region-in-24-hours-injuring-one.html) reported that Russian forces launched nearly 60 strikes on the Sumy region over 24 hours, injuring one person.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189218-russian-strikes-hit-railways-and-energy-infrastructure-in-nine-ukrainian-regions-overnight-pm-koretskyi.html) reported that Russian strikes hit infrastructure, industrial facilities and residential buildings in nine Ukrainian regions overnight, leaving one person dead.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-crime/4188803-ssu-detains-serviceman-suspected-of-guiding-russian-strikes-at-ukraines-defense-forces-in-donetsk-region.html) reported that the military counterintelligence unit of the Security Service of Ukraine detained a serviceman suspected of guiding Russian strikes at Ukraine's Defense Forces in the Donetsk region.

[TASS](https://tass.com/society/2223397), a state-media outlet, reported that Russia's Federal Security Service detained a Russian citizen who carried out assignments while passing intelligence to Ukraine in an assassination scheme.

[TASS](https://tass.com/society/2223261), a Russian state outlet, reported that the FSB Directorate for Crimea and Sevastopol initiated a criminal case against a Russian national for providing intelligence to Ukraine on a former Donetsk security official.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648919-moscow-car-bombing-ukraine/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that a woman suspected of acting on orders from Kyiv's intelligence services was detained over the car bombing of an ex-Ukrainian prime minister's aide.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/russia-s-fsb-arrests-woman-over-car-bombing-of-intelligence-officer-sergei-zavorotny-says-she-was-manipulated-by-scammers), [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/16/suspect-arrested-over-moscow-car-bombing-of-pro-russian-ukrainian-pms-ex-aide-a94278) reported that Russia's Federal Security Service detained a woman in Moscow suspected of involvement in the car bombing of intelligence officer Sergei Zavorotny after scammers coerced her into planting the bomb.

[TASS](https://tass.com/society/2218515), a Russian state outlet, reported that a Ukrainian agent was detained in Crimea while retrieving a package from a cache in Simferopol and confessed to passing data on air defenses and combat ships.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/14/after-detaining-polish-spies-in-kaliningrad-the-fsb-released-their-alleged-messages-in-polish-native-speakers-say-they-contain-errors-and-unnatural-phrasing) reported that native speakers stated Polish-language messages released by Russia's Federal Security Service alongside its announcement of detained Polish citizens contained errors and unnatural phrasing.

[Politika](https://www.politika.rs/scc/clanak/802455/uhapsene-dve-osobe-u-beceju-zaplenjeni-marihuana-i-amfetamin) reported that two people were arrested in Bečej and marijuana and amphetamines were seized.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89899), a Russian state outlet, reported that the FSB detained four individuals in three separate incidents in Adygea, Donetsk, and Omsk.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648710-polish-spies-russia-kaliningrad/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Russia’s FSB detained two suspected Polish spies in the Kaliningrad Region for allegedly gathering intelligence on military facilities.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNaU1HVHRST0JBSXdCOFhiSXJwVHVSRTFiOVd3dlF0WV9ZdnQ0MERmR0JSRlV5RnNHcThoZEJvOGVuY08wOU1xTlNXX3dXTjhHbWJYNnhvbXJQNFNLMmpKRl9ieHh0VXR6a1g2dW1pNjFEbjkwalBIZk1KcjZsdEQ2UVAwY2NlaF9VVHRhdXhsX1ZuMHo2dzBVWktGbk5sOW9teFNZdHNKT1M1MkdvWGJnMHRB?oc=5) reported that Russia said it arrested two suspected Polish spies in Kaliningrad.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/fsb-u-kalinjingradskoj-oblasti-otkrivena-mreza-agenata-poljskih-sluzbi/herfvef) reported that the Russian Federal Security Service discovered a network of agents of Polish intelligence services in the Kaliningrad region.
[TASS](https://tass.com/society/2215881) reported that the FSB detained two agents of Poland's military intelligence service and internal security agency.

reports.text: [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/28/8065073/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189467-russian-army-loses-2825-troops-10-air-defense-systems-in-war-against-ukraine-in-past-day.html) reported that Ukraine's General Staff stated Russia lost 2,825 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.
[TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2226307), a state-media outlet, reported that air defenses destroyed 123 drones approaching Moscow overnight out of a total of 462 UAVs heading toward the region.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189128-air-defences-shoot-down-110-of-155-russian-drones-launched-against-ukraine-overnight.html) reported that Ukrainian air defence forces shot down 110 out of 155 Russian drones overnight with strikes recorded at 27 locations.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91387) reported that Russia launched 155 drones against Ukraine overnight, striking infrastructure in several regions, while Estonia scrambled NATO jets.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2225519) reported that alert air defense forces intercepted Ukrainian UAVs over three Russian regions.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2225309), a Russian state media outlet, reported that the Ukrainian army lost roughly 1,110 troops in frontline battles over the past 24 hours.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188726-russia-loses-another-2319-troops-and-four-aircraft-in-war-against-ukraine-in-past-24-hours.html) reported that total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion reached approximately 2,319 casualties and four aircraft in the past 24 hours.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2224895), a Russian state media outlet, reported that Russian air defenses intercepted 20 Ukrainian drones over three Russian regions in 12 hours.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187903-russias-war-casualty-toll-in-ukraine-up-by-1848-over-past-day.html) reported that Russia has lost an estimated 1,641,489 troops since February 24, 2022, including 1,848 over the past 24 hours.
[TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2223015), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that the Ukrainian army lost up to 1,060 troops along the engagement line in the past day.
[TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222869) reported that Russian forces struck a gathering of Ukrainian army commanders and representatives of the military-industrial complex.

[TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222871) reported that Russia's top brass stated Kiev lost 1,185 troops along the engagement line in the past day, including roughly 260 troops in the responsibility area of Battlegroup North.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187055-air-defense-neutralizes-117-of-148-russian-drones-launched-against-ukraine-overnight.html) reported that air defense forces neutralized 117 of 148 drones launched by Russian forces overnight.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186648-russia-loses-another-2150-troops-in-war-against-ukraine.html) reported that Russia's total combat losses from February 24, 2022, to November 20, 2026, reached approximately 1,633,130 personnel, including 2,150 troops killed or wounded over the past day.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063370/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185843-russia-loses-1970-troops-over-past-day-in-war-against-ukraine.html) reported that Ukraine's General Staff updated Russian combat losses by 1,970 soldiers over the past day.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185395-russian-army-loses-another-1620-personnel-four-mlrs-in-ukraine.html) reported that Russia's estimated combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion reached approximately 1,620 personnel and four MLRS over the past day.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062912/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff stated Russia lost 2,230 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/united-states-warns-madagascar-over-growing-security-ties-with-russia/) reported that the deputy head of US Africa Command stated that similar partnerships with military-led governments in Africa have failed to improve security.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/us-cautions-madagascar-over-growing-military-ties-with-russia/) reported that the United States has raised concerns over Madagascar's growing military cooperation with Russia.
[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/uk-authorities-arrests-us-soldier-suspected-of-spying-for-russia) reported that UK authorities arrested a US soldier suspected of spying for Russia.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/11/ukraine-indonesian-pow-prisoner-of-war-russia) reported that Ukraine captured its first Indonesian prisoner of war amid a surge in Russian recruitment.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/world/europe/uk-us-army-arrest-espionage-russia.html) reported that a 41-year-old US soldier was arrested in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/british-counterterrorism-police-arrest-us-soldier-accused-of-spying-on-behalf-of-russia/a-79913240?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that British counterterrorism police arrested a US soldier near Gloucester in England who was suspected of espionage activity in connection with Russia.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/world/us/1740733-us-restricts-entries-travellers-1-african-country-reason/) reported that the United States announced a restriction and warning for travellers from a major African country.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crkgv58pknyeo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a US general warned Madagascar that a security deal with Russia resembling the Sahel model could lead to greater instability in Africa.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611110179.html) reported that the United States Department of State advised its citizens against travelling to 23 countries placed under its highest travel warning category.

reports.text: [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/detienen-en-jalisco-a-la-rana-operador-de-celula-del-cjng-es-ligado-a-homicidios-y-venta-de-droga/) reported that authorities detained "La Rana", an operator of a CJNG cell in Jalisco, during an operation where two weapons, cartridges, six vehicles, a drone, and a money-counting machine were secured.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/detienen-en-sinaloa-a-samuel-felix-productor-de-drogas-ligado-a-los-mayos-le-aseguran-un-arma-larga-y-cargadores/) reported that Samuel Félix, a synthetic drug producer linked to Los Mayos, was detained in Sinaloa along with a long gun and magazines.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/detienen-a-hombre-por-incendio-en-vivienda-improvisada-de-iztapalapa-hallan-dos-perros-sin-vida/) reported that a man was detained regarding a fire in an improvised dwelling in Iztapalapa and placed at the disposal of ministerial authorities.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/aseguran-20-envoltorios-de-droga-y-un-dron-en-nogales-sonora-despliegan-operativo-de-vigilancia/) reported that Public Safety deployed a surveillance operation in Nogales, Sonora, securing 20 drug packets and a drone.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/detienen-a-hombre-tras-cateo-en-iztapalapa-aseguran-arma-larga-250-cartuchos-y-marihuana/) reported that a man was detained after a raid in Iztapalapa where authorities secured a long gun, 250 cartridges, and marijuana.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/detienen-a-cuatro-en-cateos-en-coyoacan-y-tlalpan-investigan-venta-de-relojes-robados-a-usuarios-del-aicm/) reported that authorities detained four individuals during raids in Coyoacan and Tlalpan while investigating the sale of stolen watches to airport users.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/fgr-atrae-tres-carpetas-de-investigacion-tras-protesta-de-madres-buscadoras-garantiza-atencion-en-todos-los-casos/) reported that the Attorney General's Office attracted three investigation files following a protest by searching mothers and guaranteed attention in all cases.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/vinculan-a-proceso-a-la-pocha-y-el-nazi-presuntos-lideres-del-cartel-del-noreste-se-les-decomisaron-armas-del-ejercito/) reported that the Attorney General's Office stated that suspects identified as 'La Pocha' and 'El Nazi', alleged leaders of the Northeast Cartel, were bound over for trial and placed in preventive detention at the Altiplano maximum-security prison.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/vinculan-a-proceso-a-presunto-lider-de-los-gallos-faccion-de-la-union-tepito-operaba-en-cuauhtemoc-y-naucalpan/) reported that Howard 'N', alias 'El Jaguar', alleged leader of a Los Gallos faction of La Unión Tepito, was bound over for trial and faces aggravated conspiracy charges.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/caen-tres-presuntos-integrantes-de-la-union-tepito-en-calles-de-alcaldia-cuauhtemoc-aseguran-177-envoltorios-de-presunta-droga/) reported that three suspected members of La Unión Tepito were arrested in Cuauhtémoc with drug packages following investigations.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/aseguran-106-kilos-de-marihuana-y-364-cartuchos-en-chihuahua-decomisan-dos-vehiculos-robados/) reported that authorities secured 106 kilograms of marijuana, 364 cartridges, and two stolen vehicles in Chihuahua, placing them at the disposal of corresponding authorities.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/aseguran-18-vehiculos-y-una-bodega-presuntamente-ligada-al-cjng-en-ocotlan-33167623) reported that authorities secured 18 vehicles and a warehouse allegedly linked to the CJNG in Ocotlan following a clash between military personnel and suspected cartel members.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/detienen-a-siete-personas-tras-cateo-por-presunta-venta-de-drogas-en-iztapalapa-aseguran-marihuana-y-cocaina/) reported that seven people were detained after a raid for suspected drug sales in Iztapalapa, resulting in the seizure of marijuana, cocaine, and a firearm replica.
[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/15/estados/025n1est?partner=rss) reported that singer Gabito Ballesteros was detained by state police in Queretaro for carrying a weapon.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/caso-gabito-ballesteros-aseguran-dos-armas-y-detienen-a-seis-personas-tras-concierto-en-queretaro-fgr-abre-carpeta-de-investigacion/) reported that the Attorney General's Office opened an investigation after six people were detained and two weapons were secured following a concert in Queretaro.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/14/estados/021n2est?partner=rss) reported that six alleged members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel were killed during a clash with state and federal forces in Guanajuato.
