reports.text: [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/police-investigating-bomb-threats-against-schools-in-germany-and-denmark?traffic_source=rss) reported that police are investigating bomb threats against schools in Germany and Denmark following hoax emails sent to schools across Europe earlier in November.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/german-police-respond-to-multiple-school-bomb-threats/a-80018842?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that German police are responding to bomb threats against a series of schools but do not believe them to be credible.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/bomb-threats-emailed-to-german-schools/CIWF7D7MORBVXH54XTOGHHDLRA/) reported that more than 450 schools in Baden-Wuerttemberg received the emailed bomb threats.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/8703d9468de5), a state-media outlet, reported that Italian authorities stated school bomb threats were aimed at destabilising institutions and posed no concrete danger.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPbjZhbFk0amM2UzJvb1FIRXRrMjhhLWJmUVBUTkZXUExtLXp1VExsR0tKZmQzbFQxT2VpWDk5MDh3TElwdC03bmlZVjktcThjMEs2eWRRbWxWZ0cyRVd5c3lMLXFBSUVEUmMxaGRhcWtRb19YR2tLb01Dem5mX3ROSWpMMXZCY2hOYU5fdXMxajl6aDNNWVdxaW5R?oc=5) reported that Italy received fake bomb threats targeting nearly 7,500 schools.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/speciali/ansa-newsroom/2026/11/18/ansa-newsroom-fuori-tutti-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-caos-e-evacuazioni_732f890a-dda9-4cbc-9dca-a464e6d7c70b.html) reported that bomb alarms caused chaos and evacuations at schools.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915187) reported that more than 8,000 bomb hoaxes targeted schools, airlines, and media outlets across Europe, disrupting flights and classes.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/italian-schools-hit-by-new-wave-of-bomb-and-poison-threats) reported that under new security guidelines, Italian schools are no longer automatically evacuated for vague mass threats, leaving the decision to schools.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/europe-scrambles-to-respond-to-wave-of-bomb-threats-disrupting-transport-media-and-schools/) reported that an unprecedented wave of bomb threats disrupted transport, media, and schools across Europe.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894w453e90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that schools across Italy received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQSFJJaFJoR2JHVWdTZmVzdkw2MDhTc29qU0pDRmdmaXpwWjN2Q3VyYjlFUWJkRmJHTmlaNFFYdWIxdTFHR3p5VGlTaGExYzFwZ3BTRjV6dTJuQWdibllJN1lwd3E1RThuUEU2ekpfbU1GSUJwU2tyMkd5a3daSEkwNm5YU19zUEIxLWpSNjNDS0lzT1NCd2ZQRG1COA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/italian-schools-hit-by-fresh-bomb-threats-premiers-office-targeted-3725511) reported that Italian schools remained open despite a fresh wave of email bomb threats that led to evacuations and security inspections in several regions.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-hybrid-warfare-hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-to-schools-in-italy-uk-in-latest-disruption) reported that hoax bomb alerts were sent to schools in Italy and the UK.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-thousands-of-schools-evacuated-in-italy-as-bomb-threats-spread-across-europe) reported that thousands of schools were evacuated across Italy following a series of hoax bomb threats.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

[Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.

[De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/bommeldingen-op-honderden-scholen-in-italie-ierland-en-schotland/164394527.html) reported that hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland following anonymous bomb threat emails.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/vuelven-evacuar-cientos-escuelas-italia-falsas-amenazas-bomba-segunda-vez-mes_0_7GXzyxNE7g.html) reported that hundreds of schools in Italy were evacuated for the second time in less than a month following anonymous emails containing bomb threats directed at principals.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/11/pais-correm-para-buscar-filhos-apos-ameacas-de-bomba-em-ao-menos-312-escolas-na-italia-governo-descarta-perigo-iminente.ghtml) reported that at least 312 institutions were affected by the sequence of bomb threats against Italian schools, causing anxiety among parents.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914575) reported that at least 300 Italian schools were evacuated after receiving email bomb alerts signed by Mikhail Andropov.

[Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d8%a5%d8%ae%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1-%d9%85%d9%86-300-%d9%85%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a9-%d8%a8%d8%b3%d8%a8%d8%a8-%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a7%d8%a6) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving identical emails warning of bombs inside educational institutions.

reports.text: [TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2226349), a state-media outlet, reported that a Ukrainian Armed Forces drone struck a company bus belonging to Miratorg in Russia's Bryansk Region, injuring nine people.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/28/8065075/) reported that Russian attacks on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast injured five people, including a 15-year-old boy, with a 26-year-old woman hospitalized in serious condition.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/28/8065074/) reported that Russian attacks targeted 49 settlements across Zaporizhzhia Oblast with casualties recorded in the city of Zaporizhzhia.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189470-russians-launch-701-attacks-on-zaporizhzhia-region-in-past-day-one-killed-five-injured.html) reported that Russian occupation forces launched 701 attacks on 49 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region killing one person and injuring five others.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/28/8065080/) reported that Russian strikes on Donetsk Oblast killed three people in Sloviansk and one in Malotaranivka while eight people were injured across three settlements.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189402-death-toll-in-russian-strike-on-nizhyn-rises-to-three-seven-injured.html) reported that three people were killed and seven others injured in a Russian strike on an industrial facility in Nizhyn, Chernihiv region.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8065027/) reported that Russian forces attacked Dnipropetrovsk Oblast over 20 times, injuring one woman in attacks targeting Dnipro alongside the Pavlohrad, Synelnykove and Nikopol districts.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/27/drone-strikes-kill-2-in-kursk-and-bryansk-regions-amid-overnight-attacks-a812391) reported that drone strikes killed two people in the Kursk and Bryansk regions, while falling debris in St. Petersburg wounded a 44-year-old woman after damaging an apartment building.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91428) reported that Russian attacks on Nizhyn and Chernihiv killed three people and injured five others, with authorities warning people may still be trapped under rubble.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8064968/) reported that a Russian Shahed drone hit a 15th-floor flat in Kharkiv, killing 38-year-old IT specialists Daria and Valerii along with their cat.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8064954/) reported that Russian forces attacked a business in Nizhyn, Chernihiv Oblast, killing two people and potentially trapping others under the rubble.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8064970/) reported that Russian forces attacked a civilian business in Malyn hromada, Zhytomyr Oblast, killing one person and injuring two.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188924-injury-toll-from-russian-attack-on-kharkiv-rises-to-eight-one-killed.html) reported that the number of people injured in a Russian attack on Kharkiv rose to eight, with one person killed.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064783/) reported that Ukrainian defence forces struck the Marinovka airbase in Volgograd Oblast and a Transneft oil pipeline station in Bashkortostan.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064848/) reported that Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia's Dniprovskyi district, killing one person and injuring four.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1126/1600710-ukraine-war/) reported that seven people were hurt as Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles, and that US President Donald Trump and NATO chief Mark Rutte urged Russia not to expand the war.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91254) reported that Russian drone strikes killed two people and injured two others in Kharkiv while attacks across the Dnipropetrovsk region injured one man and damaged civilian and energy infrastructure.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOOUhrdXc0NFhybXpCcmF1VjM2RlFseVBqOW0xdXJBQlZWT0w5TmZRTjFTbEpjWTVlZHBmMHZMQ0tVcm5OMnk5RjhKWklxQlFfY1hDQTB4dmZNQWwwd2tLb0xLNGRNbUpNXzNCZGw0Sm1fNlhkSEUzNUZvQ2hkVHNOMGhOOFJlSnZJcXQ4UldFb01FY2J2YmpLUW1NTi1rWnRBb3c?oc=5) reported that the mayor stated Russian forces struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064721/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188730-drone-strike-on-highrise-building-in-kharkiv-kills-two-people.html) reported that two people were killed in a Russian drone attack on Kharkiv's Novobavarskyi district.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649372-zaporozhye-drone-strike-ukraine/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that five people were killed and three others wounded in a Ukrainian drone strike on Russia's Zaporozhye Region.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91219) reported that a Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv late Wednesday injured four people and damaged a shopping mall and non-residential buildings.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/9a393eb3ecf3) reported that Kyiv mayor stated Russia targeted the capital with ballistic missiles, while US envoy Jared Kushner warned against escalation and stated the territorial issue is deadlocked.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064631/) reported that a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia's Kosmichnyi district injured six people, including a child, and damaged houses, a warehouse, and cars.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064773/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188859-russian-strike-kills-four-police-investigators-in-zaporizhzhia.html) reported that a Russian strike killed four police investigators from the unit handling particularly serious crimes in Zaporizhzhia Oblast.
[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2225101) reported that two people sought medical attention following a drone attack on an industrial zone in Nevinnomyssk in Russia's Stavropol Region.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064746/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188825-russian-forces-drop-two-aerial-bombs-on-sloviansk-killing-one-person-injuring-another.html) reported that a Russian attack hit a post office and dropped aerial bombs in Sloviansk, killing one person.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/26/russian-strikes-on-ukraine-kill-two-in-kharkiv-and-injure-seven-in-kyiv) reported that Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said a Russian missile strike wounded seven people in Kyiv.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064722/) reported that Russian forces launched nearly 20 drone attacks on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, injuring a 46-year-old man and damaging commercial and infrastructure facilities.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/andalucia/mujer-hospitalizada-caerle-techo-vivienda-brenes-borrasca-charles_202611126af576af9a31a65adcd95052.html) reported that a woman was hospitalized after a roof collapsed in Brenes due to Storm Charles.

reports.text: [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/nato-deploys-awacs-airborne-radar-to-monitor-polish-airspace) reported that NATO authorized deploying an AWACS reconnaissance aircraft to Poland after prosecutors stated three Russian cruise missiles fell on its territory.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91319) reported that Czech President Petr Pavel urged NATO to be ready to shoot down Russian drones and missiles violating allied airspace.
[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1124/1600432-poland-russia-ukraine/) reported that Poland stated a Russian reconnaissance drone briefly entered its airspace during an overnight attack on Ukraine.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90854607) reported that NATO is considering a stronger military presence in Europe and deployed an early warning radar plane following Russian missile and drone breaches of Polish airspace.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/finland-summons-russian-ambassador-over-unacceptable-actions-in-europe-3725931) reported that Finland's Foreign Ministry summoned Russia's ambassador for talks, calling Moscow's dangerous and irresponsible actions in Europe unacceptable.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/24/russia-ukraine-poland-drone-patriots-latest-news-updates), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064344/) reported that Poland's Defence Ministry believes Russia deliberately sent a drone across the Ukrainian border into Polish airspace.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064315/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187891-russian-drone-enters-polish-airspace-during-attack-on-ukraine.html) reported that a Russian drone entered Polish airspace during an attack on Ukraine and the Polish military refrained from shooting it down due to risks.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-unmanned-aerial-vehicle-violates-polish-airspace-days-after-missile-incursion/) reported that Poland's Government Security Center issued an air-attack alert in parts of the Lublin region after a Russian unmanned aerial vehicle violated airspace.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90985) reported that Poland's military authorized the destruction of the drone but withheld firing due to safety risks.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/finland-summons-russian-ambassador-as-it-condemns-russias-dangerous-and-reckless-actions-i) reported that Finland summoned the Russian ambassador after a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating Finnish airspace.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064207/) reported that Poland will summon Russian ambassador Georgy Mikhno following a 20 November airspace violation.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064278/) reported that NATO's allied aircraft will complement ground-based systems following Russian missiles violating Polish airspace.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90373428) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump stated in an interview with Fox News that Vladimir Putin launched several missiles toward Poland by mistake.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/nato-parliamentary-assembly-convenes-amid-russian-airspace-violations/live-80016415?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and German Foreign Minister Wadephul are set to address the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin amid discussions on Russian airspace violations.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90376380) reported that NATO convened an emergency meeting after two Russian missiles and a drone entered Polish airspace.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/23/all-three-flying-objects-that-fell-in-poland-turned-out-to-be-russian-x-101-cruise-missiles) reported that debris recovered in all three Polish towns where objects fell during the overnight attack on Ukraine turned out to be Russian X-101 cruise missiles.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064097/) reported that missile debris recovered at three sites in Poland has been identified as belonging to Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/poland-identifies-russian-cruise-missiles-behind-strikes-near-ukraine-border-nato-to-hold-discussions-101795373162372.html) reported that Poland Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated missile impacts near the Nowa Dęba military training ground were unlikely to be coincidental.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/polish-prosecutors-office-points-that-three-russian-missiles-hit-poland-on-friday/), a state-run outlet, reported that the Prosecutor's Office in Lubin investigating the incident indicated three Russian systems impacted Polish soil.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNM1VMUS1oUkxlYzRWaDg5WjNPbGJoV2t1LTlRNkVMWnF6a3Q3aUljXzlCal9hWmdhWnlkYzdKNjdFVGdwVk1WUFFucGdfbUlnY3RtUjBsdFBxVTdmTGNjcnJ1a0VDNnk5eFh5NDdWaGNWcjNWcFI2WkoxZnFUbkI5UHZ6YTdYZUVMa19Ldk5YTERtX3ZialpvbjI4eFVoQ0Eyd2l0NGxoVQ?oc=5) reported that prosecutors stated three Russian missiles flew into Poland on Friday.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/moldova-finland-report-russian-airspace-violations-day-after-suspected-russian-missiles-flew-into-poland/) reported that Moldova and Finland reported separate instances of airspace violations by Russia.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90845) reported that wreckage from a Russian Kh-101 cruise missile that crashed in Poland was manufactured in Russia in late 2026.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/russian-helicopter-suspected-of-violating-finnish-airspace/a-80010133?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Finland's Defense Ministry thinks a suspected Russian helicopter airspace incursion is linked to an earlier drone strike on a Russian cargo ship.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90848) reported that a jet-powered unmanned aerial vehicle violated Moldova's airspace twice during a Russian aerial attack on Ukraine.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89816890) reported that a new jet-powered drone violated the airspace of the Republic of Moldova amidst Russian attacks on Ukraine.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-three-airspace-violations_n_6b004317e4b0976dc4a2f08e) reported that Poland condemned three airspace violations by Russia as a provocation.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186925-trump-claims-putin-sent-drones-and-little-missiles-into-poland-by-mistake.html), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/trump-says-putin-launched-a-couple-of-small-missiles-into-poland-by-accident-a-couple-of-little-missiles) reported that US President Donald Trump claimed Russian drones and missiles entered Polish territory by mistake.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-airspace-violations?traffic_source=rss) reported that Poland condemned a Russian provocation after airspace violations during European troop exercises.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89556156) reported that Moldova's permanent representative to the OSCE strongly condemned violations of national airspace amid Russian attacks on Ukraine.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-20/ukraine-war-spills-over-into-eastern-poland.html) reported that residents of eastern Polish border regions live with SMS alerts about Russian attacks and the sound of fighter jets as the Ukraine war spills over.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186768-ukraine-cooperating-with-poland-in-probe-into-airspace-violation-fm-sybiha.html) reported that Ukraine is working closely with Poland to assist in investigating the airspace violation during Russia's massive attack.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-3-airspace-violations-a94331) reported that Poland condemned a Russian provocation after three airspace violations.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/unidentified-object-falls-in-eastern-poland-amid-major-russian-attack-on-ukraine), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063740/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90676), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/9f4712724be0), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/poland-reports-airspace-violation-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine-investigates-debris-crash/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186756-poland-investigating-crash-of-unidentified-object-near-border-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine.html) reported that Poland is investigating a possible airspace violation or falling unidentified object during a Russian attack on Ukraine.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90692) reported that Poland evacuated its Rzeszow Airport control tower for the first time during the attack.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89347044) reported that Germany reaffirmed its defense commitments to Moldova and prioritized airspace protection following repeated Russian drone incursions.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89297987) reported that an unidentified drone entered Moldovan airspace from Ukraine, traveling for nine minutes from the Vinnytsia region.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88193791) reported that fragments of a Gerbera-2 drone were discovered near the village of Cuhureștii de Sus following a November 17 incursion.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185880-debris-of-russian-gerbera2-drone-found-in-moldova.html) reported that drone debris was also found near the village of Naslavcea in Moldova's Ocnița district.

[Hungary Today](https://hungarytoday.hu/hungarian-conservatives-condemn-russian-drone-attack-on-ukraines-transcarpathia/) reported that several Russian drones struck Ukraine’s Transcarpathian region, targeting areas around Mukachevo.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88197893) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha condemned the incursion of Russian drones into Moldovan airspace.

reports.text: [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642446/how-the-trump-administration-determined-jensen-huang-is-not-a-national-security-threat) reported that Jensen Huang's reinstatement has angered both Republican and Democratic members of Congress.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91222) reported that Congressman Gregory Meeks demanded that the Trump administration immediately halt US government involvement in a proposed $10 billion acquisition of Lukoil assets.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNMU85QnkyODhXZWxwenBBNWVKaElURnNWbDVVd2FtRlQ3N0F1d3A2YXYyLW5zUnJCQzdXZHRreXhDeWpZNTcyT2hVcHlrMHJqVUt2bUUwR2JEdUxUMFk4LWFQenp5TGY0RTJFUXFUN1hPSGtfcTZvZmRGc0MyWkhUTmtzQnh3My04UTJaVVN4dVNSVWtRc0tpaEoxeGd3QnA3UTZ1Wl91SGhfTmxpQVNIVDE2WjRuM2tES284?oc=5) reported that President Trump's intervention on behalf of Jensen Huang gave Democrats another 2028 target.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/24/nvidia-jensen-huang-congress) reported that lawmakers from both parties are demanding answers regarding the Nvidia CEO's reinstatement and national security risks.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-nvidia-jensen-huang-democrats-2028-b3090601.html) reported that President Donald Trump's bailout of Nvidia provided 2028 Democrats with a target to accuse him of cozying up to tech executives.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/don-trump-jr-1789-capital-investments-investigation-b3090820.html) reported that Rep. Jamie Raskin ordered four businesses to hand over records detailing interactions with 1789 Capital.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/us/2026/11/23/democrats-signal-plan-to-investigate-corruption-claims-against-trump-administration/) reported that Democrats signaled plans to investigate corruption claims against the Trump administration as they begin Congress with the largest House majority this century.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-tightens-control-over-government-information-as-democrats-prepare-investigations-101795251875656.html) reported that Donald Trump issued an order to control information reaching Congress and limit Democratic investigations.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/19/nx-s1-6046487/gregory-meeks-trump-xi-putin-summit) reported that Representative Gregory Meeks raised concerns about U.S. alliances after Donald Trump's summit with Xi and Putin and discussed Chinese espionage amid the Nvidia scandal.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/new-leader-us-democrats-pledges-target-trump-corruption.1137326) reported that US House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries pledged to target Trump corruption.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10942704) reported that US Representative Robert Garcia sent letters to twelve of Donald Trump's top allies and former aides to investigate corruption and Epstein files.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90523), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063526/) reported that US House Republicans are seeking to strip Ukraine-related provisions and intelligence sharing from the National Defense Authorization Act.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/us/politics/democrats-cast-investigative-net.html) reported that House Democrats preparing investigations into President Trump and his administration would focus on officials including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/us-democrats-nominate-hakeem-jeffries-to-be-first-black-house-speaker/FZUIGY57NBFHLPB4ARKRE67QME/) reported that Hakeem Jeffries secured 251 votes to become the new leader of US House Democrats.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/robert-garcia-trump-records-investigations) reported that incoming Democratic oversight chair Robert Garcia plans investigations into Trump family finances, Department of Homeland Security misconduct, and Epstein files.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/house-democrats-target-trump-family-senior-officials-as-oversight-investigations-loom-101795010718436.html) reported that Robert Garcia asked 13 people, including Trump Jr., Eric Trump, Jared Kushner, and JD Vance, to preserve records.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-17/record-revenues-over-60-deaths-and-little-oversight-democrats-target-trumps-immigration-jails.html) reported that lawmakers taking control of Congress in January stated there will be increased oversight of ICE detention centers.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/politics/congress-trump-investigations.html) reported that the Trump administration has been laying the groundwork to thwart newly empowered Democrats' attempts at oversight.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/politics/trump-democrats-congress-oversight-committee.html) reported that the White House threatened Congress, stating that aggressive oversight investigations could be a crime.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/11/democrat-investigation-white-house-letter-garcia) reported that the incoming Democratic chair of the congressional committee responded that Trump has something to hide.

reports.text: [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/26/world/americas/nayib-bukele-salvador-haiti.html) reported that El Salvador's president Nayib Bukele has widespread support among Haitians due to his efforts against gangs.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/el-salvador-formalizes-nayib-bukeles-candidacy-for-early-elections-in-2027/) reported that El Salvador’s Supreme Electoral Tribunal made official Nayib Bukele’s candidacy for early elections in 2027.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/the-debate/20261124-the-bukele-method-will-salvadoran-leader-s-strong-arm-tactics-work-for-haiti) reported that citizens of Haiti are cheering the Salvadoran president's method.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/el-salvador-clears-bukele-third-term/) reported that El Salvador’s Supreme Electoral Tribunal registered Bukele and Ulloa for the February 28, 2027 vote.

[Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/jovenes-se-manifiesta-para-exigir-inversion-social-y-rechazan-el-envio-de-tropas-a-haiti/) reported that young Salvadoran demonstrators took to the streets to demand social investment and reject the deployment of troops to Haiti.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-vira-heroi-no-haiti-com-guerra-a-gangues-apos-sumico-de-militares-envolto-em-misterio.shtml) reported that four Salvadoran military personnel who were members of an international gang-fighting force instituted by the UN in Haiti disappeared on October 18.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/tribunal-electoral-salvadoreno-oficializa-la-candidatura-presidencial-de-bukele-para-buscar-tercer-mandato-33283296) reported that the Salvadoran electoral tribunal officialized Nayib Bukele's presidential candidacy to seek a third consecutive mandate.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/bukele-shares-details-on-deaths-of-salvadoran-troops-in-haiti-intervention?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bukele shared details on the deaths of Salvadoran troops in the Haiti intervention following the kidnapping of four technicians by gangs in October.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNSEV2cEFJbWwwUnh4OTBzdW1jQTlfdG5MdWxCN2YtaDNmSGpvN2c5MEZYLWwxTkdIYnUtQ0xQYXVYTktNV01Hc3hlTFgtVm9hQkV0ejhqV3pzSXluOFJ2X3RoWHRQLU1CZVR4R1dCVlNPc1pKTHZzMWRVVGlSVDJ5dWpydGFpUUUtaXpMSThxQVFsbV9YNXNDV3QyTDRTQQ?oc=5) reported that El Salvador's President Bukele revealed how three Salvadoran soldiers died fighting gangs in Haiti.
[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/23/what-are-haiti-security-forces/) reported that six main forces are involved in the effort to fight gangs in Haiti.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/bukele-lleva-guerra-pandillas-haiti_202611226b027809c0d5c85b96c4490e.html) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele sent 2,500 soldiers to Haiti following the disappearance of four soldiers.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/22/operacao-militar-de-el-salvador-no-haiti-ignora-mandato-da-onu-e-exporta-modelo-bukele-sob-temor-de-excessos.ghtml) reported that thousands of Haitians marched in Port-au-Prince while El Salvador's military operation in Haiti ignores a UN mandate.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bukele-for-third-consecutive-term-office/) reported that Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy to seek a third consecutive term as president of El Salvador in February 2027 following constitutional reform.

[El Estímulo](https://elestimulo.com/internacionales/2026-11-20/bukele-ya-es-candidato-a-su-tercer-periodo-en-la-presidencia/), [Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/bukele-se-inscribe-en-el-tse-para-un-tercer-periodo-presidencial/) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy with the Supreme Electoral Tribunal for a third presidential term.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/salvadoran-military-is-teaching-haitis-gangs-a-lesson-bukele/), a Salvadoran state-media outlet, reported that approximately 2,500 Salvadoran soldiers are participating in a mission in Haiti.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/20/nayib-bukele-third-term-el-salvador-haiti-troops/) reported that El Salvador President Nayib Bukele's deployment of 2,500 troops to Haiti draws scrutiny over security and democracy.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/nayib-bukele-va-por-un-tercer-mandato-en-el-salvador-asi-fue-el-camino-de-reformas-que-permitio-su-nueva-candidatura-necesitamos-seis-anos-mas-3602666) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy for the February 2027 elections to seek a third presidential term.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/20/salvador-le-president-bukele-profite-de-sa-reforme-constitutionnelle-pour-se-presenter-a-un-troisieme-mandat_6813581_3210.html) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele formalized his candidacy for a third presidential term after constitutional modifications in 2025.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/el-salvadors-bukele-expected-to-formalise-bid-for-third-presidential-term?traffic_source=rss), [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPOFQyR3VjRGNVUmZDV3lMOGdubmRvbU1tbTZsMTNLQ2x2QkUwSzVSLUE3RThET0xBQ3RmVEVWZS10b1JKZGxZNUVNNUMzZjROUVN5Yk4xc2ZlbTdhZDlCVUxKX1FFYmctY1huMG9yejFxT3ZxbE92cno3V1RnYWJKUXVPZjRxZmZJRVBkVTNBU0hxNUFzNUJuWmY2d3VYSWlqRnFudXNvcVR6UmhURGRFNw?oc=5) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele seeks a third presidential term while his forces fight gangs in Haiti.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/nayib-bukele-inscribe-su-candidatura-para-las-elecciones-de-2027-en-el-salvador-33223136), [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/apos-retirar-limites-de-mandatos-bukele-registra-candidatura-para-se-manter-no-poder-em-el-salvador.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy to run for a third term in the February 28 elections.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/19/haitians-brooklyn-rally-bukele-haiti-gangs/) reported that Haitian demonstrators gathered in Brooklyn to support Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele as his forces continued military operations against gangs in Haiti.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261119-haiti-salvador-s-bukele-publishes-video-of-attack-on-gang-leader-s-house) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele stated his troops demolished the lavish home of a prominent gang leader in Haiti known as Jeff Gwo Lwa.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/nayib-bukele-reacciona-a-las-multitudinarias-marchas-de-apoyo-en-haiti-y-promete-una-victoria-contra-las-pandillas-nunca-espere-algo-asi-3602255) El Tiempo reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele reacted to large-scale marches of support in Haiti, promising victory against armed gangs.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/bukele-confirms-airstrike-on-haitian-gang-leader-jeffs-luxury-mansion) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele confirmed an airstrike destroying the luxury mansion of Haitian gang leader Jeff Larose.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/bukele-anuncia-que-militares-salvadorenos-destruyeron-la-casa-de-un-jefe-pandillero-en-haiti-33197904) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele published a video showing military helicopters attacking the house of gang leader Jeff Gwo Lwa in Haiti.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/haiti-formaliza-acordo-com-el-salvador-enquanto-tropas-de-bukele-atacam-gangues.shtml) reported that Haiti formalized a cooperation agreement with El Salvador on the same day thousands marched in Port-au-Prince.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/miles-de-personas-marchan-en-haiti-en-respaldo-a-operaciones-de-tropas-militares-de-el-salvador-en-el-pais-presidente-nayib-bukele-reacciono-3601946) reported that thousands of people marched in Haiti in support of military troop operations by El Salvador.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPMVp1by1yclVIYnJfVnZTOEo0LWk2TFE4ampJMlFTdGVudVRMM2FROVpOUFp3WkZfTU5FVWZYMGx5OUE5d2M1TGU3UEMtUUk4Wk90cGdNeFA5dVJFT3BSSFhUeXM3azg2N1VYUEozVGRMNGw4ZlphRE9xZXRhZjlPZmJnbGx1V2c5WXZOV0pQcnktSGVHc0QtQXhzVkVGaFVURkhFdA?oc=5), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3374964/el-salvadors-bukele-says-his-troops-destroyed-gang-leaders-mansion-haiti) reported that El Salvador’s President Nayib J. Bukele confirmed and celebrated that his troops had destroyed or demolished the home of a key Haitian gang leader known as Jeff.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/18/bukele-strikes-gang-leader-home-vertieres-day/) reported that the operation marks the second reported strike on a gang leader’s residence by Salvadoran forces, following a previous attack on the home of Wilson “Lanmò San Jou”.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-diz-que-militares-salvadorenhos-destruiram-casa-de-chefe-de-gangue-no-haiti.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced the destruction of a Haitian gang leader's house during an offensive.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/haitians-rally-in-celebration-of-el-salvadors-anti-gang-troop-deployment?traffic_source=rss), [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/17/haitians-take-streets-support-el-salvador-troops/), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/haitians-demonstrate-in-support-of-el-salvadors-bukele-and-anti-gang-troops/) reported that thousands of Haitians took to the streets in Port-au-Prince to celebrate and thank El Salvador's anti-gang military troop deployment.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/haiti-formalises-security-pact-with-el-salvador-as-thousands-march-in-support-of-bukele) reported that Haiti formalised a security pact with El Salvador as thousands marched in support of Bukele, and noted the UN recorded 4,595 deaths and 2,050 injuries due to armed violence in Haiti in the first 10 months of 2026.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941169) reported that thousands of people poured into the streets of Port-au-Prince and beyond to praise El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261118-haitians-rally-behind-bukele-as-salvadoran-troops-battle-gangs) reported that thousands of Haitians took to the streets to urge El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele to continue fighting gangs as Salvadoran troops bolstered security forces.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/policias-militares-y-soldados-de-bukele-haiti-suma-fuerzas-contra-las-pandillas-pero-sigue-sin-saber-como-recuperar-el-control-3601736) reported that a Crisis Group report warned that a lack of coordination exposes the civilian population and called for strengthening Haitian institutions.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/17/haitians-rally-bukele-salvadoran-troops-haiti/) reported that thousands of people in Port-au-Prince demonstrated to praise Nayib Bukele and Salvadoran troops, as a new report warned that Haiti lacks a long-term plan to confront gangs.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/haiti-praises-salvadoran-troop-deployment-ahead-of-bukele-talks-101794861044668.html) reported that Haiti praised the deployment of Salvadoran troops ahead of talks with President Nayib Bukele.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/haiti-weighs-future-of-salvadoran-troops/) reported that Haiti's prime minister is due in El Salvador on November 16 and 17 to discuss Salvadoran troops, while a gang leader asks the UN for talks.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/bukele-sera-el-salvador-de-haiti-los-riesgos-y-las-alertas-alrededor-de-su-ultima-gran-apuesta-nid14112026/) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele launched a mission with more than 2,000 soldiers in Haiti.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/14/el-salvador-bukele-model-haiti-gang-offensive/) reported that El Salvador deployed roughly 2,500 troops to Haiti as President Nayib Bukele exports his hard-line security model.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/spain-workers-1-general-strike-14-years/) reported that Spain's unions and tenant groups united across more than 50 cities in a general strike to demand rent caps, higher wages, and price controls.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/spain/2026-11-12/spains-general-strike-draws-uneven-participation-and-large-street-protests.html) reported that demonstrations during Spain's general strike were overwhelmingly peaceful, although clashes were recorded in Madrid and Barcelona.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-housing-protests-madrid-barcelona-b3083749.html) reported that more than 3 million people took to the streets in Spain for housing protests, resulting in at least 115 arrests nationwide.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-general-strike-protesters-riot-police-clash-b3083461.html) reported that millions of workers took to the streets during the general strike in Spain over housing costs.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/spain-holds-its-first-general-strike-in-14-years-amid-mass-protests-and-police-charges) reported that riot police clashed with masked protesters in Madrid and Barcelona during Spain's first general strike in 14 years, leaving more than 70 people arrested.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648726-barcelona-protests-clashes-rally/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that masked rioters smashed windows, looted shops, and set fires after tens of thousands marched in Barcelona demanding affordable housing.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2026/nov/11/police-clash-with-protesters-during-spains-general-strike-video) reported that clashes erupted in the streets of Barcelona and Madrid as millions of Spanish workers took part in the general strike.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/spain-general-strike-over-housing-costs-before-national-election) reported that millions of Spanish workers shut down businesses and public transportation in a protest over housing costs.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641245/un-rights-chief-calls-for-imran-khans-release-urges-political-de-escalation) reported that the UN rights chief called for Imran Khan's release and urged political de-escalation while Amnesty stated Imran faces solitary confinement and denial of medical care.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583656/ihc-orders-medical-examination-improved-facilities-for-bushra-bibi/) reported that the Islamabad High Court took serious notice of complaints by Bushra Bibi regarding medical difficulties.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640983/ihc-orders-medical-care-for-bushra-bibi-in-jail-amid-eyesight-concerns), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045411/ps190m-corruption-case-ihc-directs-proper-medical-care-hygienic-living-conditions-for-bushra-bibi) reported that the Islamabad High Court directed prison authorities to ensure proper medical care and hygienic living conditions for Bushra Bibi.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045191/8-pakistan-bar-council-members-call-on-judiciary-to-take-note-of-imrans-plea-for-medical-treatment) reported that eight members of the Pakistan Bar Council called upon the judiciary to ensure implementation of the Supreme Court's order regarding Imran Khan's medical treatment.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxNUm9CVHJndDZlZ0dWQk9mbGJyNmNRcmpsVHRmM3IwYkxtUjl0UFlkUXhyVHNMTjhMSGNnQ0Z1NEd5UmlselRYUUxvQ2ctTV81SEhEMEtWcFU4eDh2NDZxNDZDZXJxOEJKbW5CZnZPME1vUlRKakhiNXNsZ05JV09Ial9ybEl6VDUxOHNHNFVld1JEaGZoWEdVcVY5NkxRQ19yQ1JCMXJ6MXpHcUVYdFdRU1VmT3MxNTZBbEtscW5zVnJVLVQz?oc=5) reported that Azma Bokhari called Imran Khan's medical concerns propaganda.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/imran-khan-sons-accuse-pakistan-govt-of-torturing-former-pm-health-risks-imprisonment-latest-updates-101794892907522.html) reported that Sulaiman Isa Khan and Kasim Khan stated that former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan's health has deteriorated after over three years in solitary confinement and accused the government of torturing him.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/jailed-pakistan-ex-pm-imran-khan-writes-to-judges-seeks-vital-medical-care?traffic_source=rss), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/i-may-not-return-alive-imran-khan-asks-courts-for-treatment-says-22-hour-isolation-is-killing-him/articleshow/135893352.cms) reported that jailed former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan wrote to judges stating he may not return alive and seeking medical care for himself and his wife.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640599/i-may-not-return-alive-imran-urges-top-judges-to-enforce-court-orders-ensure-medical-treatment), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582222/imran-khan-writes-to-top-judges-detailing-severe-health-risks-and-isolation-in-prison/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044922/i-may-not-return-alive-in-open-letter-to-top-judges-imran-pleads-for-medical-treatment-for-him-and-bushra-bibi) reported that Imran Khan wrote an open letter to top judges detailing severe health risks and appealing for medical treatment for himself and Bushra Bibi.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/imran-khan-seeks-medical-treatment-for-himself-and-bushra-bibi-in-open-letter-to-top-judges/) reported that Imran Khan sought medical treatment in an open letter to the chief justice of Pakistan.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582223/lawyers-submit-affidavits-detailing-severe-health-and-sanitary-issues-for-imran-khan-and-bushra-bibi/) reported that lawyers submitted affidavits detailing severe health and sanitary issues for Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582310/imran-khan-expected-to-meet-lawyers-on-tuesday/) reported that Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf submitted a list of six lawyers to jail authorities for an expected meeting with party founder Imran Khan.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044913/lawyers-submit-affidavits-detailing-nov-11-meeting-with-imran-bushra-at-adiala-jail) reported that lawyers for Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi submitted affidavits detailing a jail meeting to the Islamabad High Court.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/imran-khan-asim-munir-deal-sisters-release-from-jail-hospital-visit-spark-buzz-in-pakistan/articleshow/135801979.cms) reported that the release of Imran Khan's sisters from jail and a hospital visit sparked buzz regarding a potential deal in Pakistan.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640124/fact-check-viral-video-of-noreen-and-uzma-is-old-not-of-release-from-kot-lakhpat-jail) reported that a viral video claiming to show Noreen and Uzma's release from Kot Lakhpat jail is old and originated from an August 10, 2026 TikTok clip.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-check/misused-jonvic-remulla-video-bato-dela-rosa-icc-warrant/) reported that an old Remulla interview clip was misused to falsely claim Dela Rosa has no ICC warrant.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxQa2Q2R3V4NmxCVC01TnNYZDUzUzVqNEpOUEphazdhbUlyRHFsQkhlRHFST05tQ2ZhcWtmSGNfYW02SE91RVVwV0d4OHY0WG1PTGcwcXdUYUoxOWh6TUhMY0VfZzdVSmN0eTZMWXN5QXl5MWJoLW1BczlZZ2ZCLWU0MkNXbmFFNmV4VzNyZHZqRi0?oc=5) reported that Imran Khan's two sisters were released after weeks in detention.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580849/imran-khans-sisters-released-from-jail-following-backchannel-political-understandings/) reported that the release followed backchannel political understandings.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/pakistan-releases-two-sisters-of-ex-pm-imran-khan-from-jail?traffic_source=rss) reported that Aleema Khan remains detained nearly two months after their arrest.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639924/uzma-khan-noreen-niazi-released-after-50-days-in-detention) reported that Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi were released after 50 days in detention, while PTI founder's sister Aleema Khan remains incarcerated at Kot Lakhpat Jail.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044037/imrans-sisters-uzma-noreen-released-from-jail-after-extended-detention-orders-withdrawn-says-lawyer) reported that Dr Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi were released from Kot Lakhpat jail following the withdrawal of their extended detention orders.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639913/fazal-chaudhry-rules-out-any-possibility-of-deal-leniency-for-pti-after-imrans-sisters-released) reported that Fazal Chaudhry ruled out any possibility of a deal or leniency for PTI and stated that rumours of backdoor channel talks are baseless.

reports.text: [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261126-moscow-drone-incursions-poland-to-create-no-fly-zone-at-ukraine-border) reported that Poland will soon create a no-fly zone near the Ukrainian border following several airspace incursions.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064636/) reported that Polish Deputy Defence Minister Cezary Tomczyk stated that NATO does not support shooting down Russian drones over Ukraine because it would create numerous complications.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064605/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91179), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/25/bloomberg-poland-proposes-that-nato-consider-shooting-down-russian-missiles-over-ukraine-headed-toward-alliance-territory) reported that Poland urged NATO allies to consider intercepting Russian missiles over Ukraine if they are heading toward alliance territory.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/poland-says-will-create-no-fly-zone-at-ukraine-border-after-repeated-airspace-violations), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064627/) reported that Poland announced plans to create a no-fly zone near its border with Ukraine around the turn of the year following airspace incursions.

[UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/nato-sends-awacs-forward-after-russian-incursion-into-poland/) reported that NATO forward deployed an AWACS aircraft following Russian missile and drone incursions into Polish airspace.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064413/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that restrictions on the use of SpaceX's Starshield terminals for military personnel continue to be recorded.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223625), a Russian state outlet, reported that NATO announced the deployment of AWACS early warning aircraft to Poland following ambassador discussions on airspace violations.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/poland-russia-airspace-ukraine-drone-b3090416.html) reported that Poland will deploy an early-warning aircraft after an object entered its airspace and that the drone was not shot down due to concerns regarding risks to civilians.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-23-nato-to-send-early-warning-system-aircraft-to-poland-after-missiles-incident/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91000) reported that NATO will deploy an AWACS early-warning system aircraft to Poland following a missile incident.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/23/4983508_nato_izprashta_samolet_za_ranno_preduprejdenie_v/?ref=rss) reported that NATO is sending an early warning aircraft to Poland following a missile incident, according to a Polish deputy defense minister.
[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23983014) reported that NATO will deploy an AWACS military aircraft to Poland as part of its response to the incident involving three missiles.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/polish-authorities-find-russian-missile-remains-at-three-sites-following-airspace-incursion/) reported that the Lublin District Prosecutor's Office announced that debris from Kh-101 cruise missiles was discovered at three sites in eastern Poland following an airspace incursion.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90841) reported that NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte pledged in Warsaw that the alliance will defend every inch of Polish territory.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90830) reported that Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz announced Poland will receive strong support from NATO allies to strengthen border security.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/swedish-gripen-pilot-unable-to-shoot-down-suspected-russian-missile-over-poland-due-to-poor-weather-commander-says/) reported that a Swedish Gripen pilot participating in a NATO air defense deployment was unable to shoot down a suspected Russian missile over Poland due to poor weather.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/nato-pledges-to-defend-poland-after-russian-missile-incursion/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that NATO chief Mark Rutte pledged to defend Poland after two Russian missiles hit its southeast during a meeting of the alliance's council in Brussels.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/russian-missiles-hit-poland-what-happened-and-could-nato-respond?traffic_source=rss) reported that Warsaw accused Moscow of intentional provocation after Russian missiles hit Poland, while the bar for triggering NATO's collective defense clause remains high.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063930/) reported that the pilot of a Swedish Gripen fighter jet patrolling Polish airspace during airspace violations on Friday 20 November was authorized to shoot down a Russian missile but unable to identify it.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90803) reported that a Swedish JAS 39 Gripen pilot received NATO authorization to shoot down a suspected Russian Kh-101 cruise missile during Friday’s airspace violation over southern Poland, but held fire due to weather.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90785) reported that European Union, British, and NATO leaders condemned Russia's overnight violation of Polish airspace.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641478/russian-missiles-land-in-poland-amid-nato-drills), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3375302/russian-missiles-land-poland-europe-holds-military-drills-nearby) reported that two Russian missiles and a suspected drone landed in Poland during European military drills, prompting the Polish prime minister to call it an intentional provocation.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/russia-fires-cruise-missile-into-poland-during-british-troop-drills/3IBFJX7GAZGOLJUZRDPA2ND3PY/) reported that Russia fired a cruise missile into Poland during British troop drills 100 kilometers from the exercise.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPb2dKNkEyLW5VNkNqNmI3U2lRMGcwUzZxUEUzb2FqTmVPYmFSZVhWYXM3Z0VfN3JfVi1FbkZydE5UWkRmNlhSZTFOa1pBLUpMaG5lRzZKbmJRYjdkcHZRYXlwWVlSQ3hoSUxwSzdtZDRld1FCSzVUUThhR1dicE5XbjNiSnc5VThLSGdpUkhrM2xueDRmR19DYg?oc=5), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/russian-missile-incursion-into-poland-seems-intentional-tusk-says/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that the Polish prime minister stated a Russian missile's crash in Poland was likely an intentional provocation.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063854/) reported that Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi was at Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport when Russian missiles and a drone violated Polish airspace.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQVGl6dU85bExfQlhuODY0Rkh6a3M2UVhRTlV1QmRsclI5ZHpRbWo5M3JIbUdydkRzOFNrZkZ6RDBIMHJVNGhqeklnRl9UVVAzRFpFUUk0OTVDVnU3RVh2VjdWZ2ktMUhMNmZZMUZkVDE5RFAtTjJ4UEZjUDlKZWd4YlhSaFBoYXdnYVI1ajFaRkdnTkpyMExkU0U4YjBHMTNSblZkRWt6aUVtTGJ5UWU1RVdrNA?oc=5), [Military.com](https://www.military.com/european-troops-from-11-countries-hold-a-drill-in-poland-for-a-potential-postwar-ukraine-mission) reported that European troops from 11 countries began a two-week military exercise in Poland on November 9 to test the coalition's ability to deploy in Ukraine once the war ends.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqx2x9dklxnro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/warsaw-says-russian-missiles-hit-poland-intentional-provocation.1137425), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/poland-says-russian-missile-that-crashed-in-its-territory-was-a-provocation-20261121-p61g3a.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the incident in which objects hit Poland as an intentional provocation from Moscow.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90744) reported that Donald Trump stated on Fox News that Russian drones and missiles had previously entered Poland by mistake.

[The Cipher Brief](https://www.thecipherbrief.com/washington-should-allow-ukraine-to-hit-russia-s-ballistic-missile-launchers) reported that a traveler to Ukraine visited soldiers and leaders in Kyiv, Dnipro, Pavlohrad, and Kharkiv, arguing that Washington should allow Ukraine to hit Russia's ballistic missile launchers.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/russian-missile-attacks-hit-major-bridges-across-kyiv/) reported that Russian ballistic missiles struck three bridges spanning the Dnipro River in Kyiv, killing six people.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/ukraine-russia-crimea-strikes-bridge-kyiv-power-outage-poland/107411538), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/russia-pummels-ukraine-putin-vowed-painful-attack.1137390) reported that Russia pummelled Ukraine with dozens of missiles and hundreds of drones overnight, killing eight people, hours after President Vladimir Putin vowed a painful response.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90708) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Ukraine destroyed one of three Russian ballistic missile launchers and downed 79 cruise missiles.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89346957) reported that Russia proposed that European representatives travel to Moscow to clarify their position on peace talks concerning Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063766/) reported that the Ukrainian Prime Minister stated energy sites, businesses, and houses in nine oblasts and a wastewater facility in Kyiv were damaged, with the Kyiv death toll rising to six and 28 injured across Ukraine.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186726-death-toll-from-russian-attack-on-kyiv-rises-to-six-15-injured.html) reported that the death toll from the overnight attack on Kyiv rose to six, with 15 injured.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-kyiv-targeted-by-missile-strikes-bridges-hit/live-79999822?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that at least three deaths were reported in Kyiv following missile strikes.
[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/3-killed-in-bridge-strikes-on-kyiv-mayor-says-a94324) reported that eight people were killed across Ukraine in the strikes.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/20/putin-invites-european-leaders-to-moscow-for-peace-talks-as-russia-pounds-kyiv/) reported that Vladimir Putin invited European leaders to Moscow for peace talks.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/ukraine-crimean-bridge-destruction-significance-explained/107408488) reported that an expert stated Ukraine's destruction of the Crimean Bridge marked a huge blow to Vladimir Putin's credibility.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261120-live-deadly-russian-attacks-damage-two-bridges-in-kyiv-mayor-says), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063728/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186643-kyivs-podilskyi-and-darnytskyi-bridges-damaged-in-russian-ballistic-attack-mayor.html), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/russian-missile-and-drone-attack-on-kyiv-kills-three-and-damages-three-dnipro-bridges-mayor-says) reported that Russian attacks damaged bridges in Kyiv.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1120/1599948-ukraine-russia/) reported that a Russian ballistic missile attack hit three bridges on Kyiv's Dnipro River and killed three people, according to the city's mayor.

reports.text: [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/27/2027-you-cant-own-imo-ngoforo-blasts-wike-over-demand-to-handle-state/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ngoforo-blasts-wike-over-demand-to-handle-imo/) reported that Mazi Franklin Ngoforo blasted FCT Minister Nyesom Wike over a demand to handle Imo State.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/pandef-ex-agf-urge-tinubu-to-tackle-niger-delta-neglect/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PANDEF and former AGF Kanu Agabi urged President Tinubu to tackle Niger Delta neglect during an Abuja event.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/27/adc-pcc-condemns-deadly-attacks-on-ndc-members-in-edo-delta/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council condemned the reported killing of more than four persons in attacks on Nigeria Democratic Congress members in Edo and Delta states.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611270169.html) reported that PANDEF warned against political thuggery and violence following Delta killings and sought government aid for bereaved families.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-nothing-wrong-with-rig-and-die-slogan-2baba/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-2baba-backs-rig-and-die-slogan-demands-severe-penalties/) reported that Nigerian music star Innocent Idibia, known as 2Baba, backed the 'rig and die' slogan associated with the Nigeria Democratic Congress while demanding severe penalties for election rigging.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/okpebholo-denies-involvement-in-alleged-violent-attack-on-ndc-members/) reported that Edo State Governor Monday Okpebholo denied any involvement by the state government and the All Progressives Congress in a violent attack on NDC members.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/youre-a-political-errand-boy-imo-apc-rejects-wike-says-state-not-for-sale/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/imo-apc-accuses-wike-of-plotting-to-manipulate-2027-elections/) reported that the Imo State chapter of the All Progressives Congress accused FCT Minister Nyesom Wike of attempting to interfere in the state's politics and manipulate upcoming elections.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/imo-apc-dismisses-wikes-claims-insists-unity/) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Imo State accused Federal Capital Territory Minister Nyesom Wike of attempting to interfere in the party.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ndc-using-rig-and-die-slogan-to-mobilise-for-mass-rigging-keyamo/) reported that Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development Festus Keyamo accused the Nigeria Democratic Congress of using a rig and die slogan to mobilize for mass rigging.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-condemns-attacks-on-ndc-members-in-edo-delta-seeks-investigation/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council condemned attacks on the leadership and members of the Nigeria Democratic Congress.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/i-have-no-time-for-anybody-okpebholo-denies-involvement-in-ndc-edo-attack/) reported that Edo State Governor Monday Okpebholo denied involvement in the NDC Edo attack during an APC presidential campaign rally in Ehor.
[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611260277.html) reported that gunmen opened fire at a rally for Peter Obi in Edo following a previous attack on an NDC event that killed six people.
[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/928139-gunmen-open-fire-at-peter-obis-rally-in-edo.html) reported that gunmen opened fire at a rally for Peter Obi in Edo.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/nigeria-opposition-accuses-ruling-apc-of-attacks-on-presidential-candidate-peter-obi/) reported that Nigeria's opposition accused the ruling All Progressives Congress of orchestrating attacks on presidential candidates during campaign rallies across the country.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/25/attack-on-opposition-ndc-cannot-be-intimidated-out-of-2027-elections-national-chairman/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Chairman declared the party cannot be intimidated out of the 2027 elections and notified the UN, EU, and US of coordinated attacks on members.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/atiku-wants-tinubus-reply-over-igbohos-claim-president-asked-him-to-sustain-operations/) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar asked President Bola Tinubu to reply over claims that the President asked Yoruba activist Sunday Igboho to sustain operations.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/obi-urges-nigerians-to-defend-votes-in-2027-election/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress presidential candidate Peter Obi urged Nigerians to vote for him in the 2027 presidential election.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ndc-chieftain-dismisses-apcs-structure-insists-peter-obi-has-pathway-to-victory/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress insisted its presidential candidate Peter Obi has a viable pathway to victory in the general elections.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-election-why-attack-ndc-if-obi-has-no-path-to-victory-akpata-asks/) reported that former Nigerian Bar Association president Akpata questioned why the APC is preventing the Nigeria Democratic Congress from campaigning if Peter Obi has no path to victory.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-morka-questions-obi-ndc-over-rig-and-die-slogan/) reported that All Progressives Congress National Publicity Secretary Felix Morka questioned the meaning and legal basis of the Nigeria Democratic Congress slogan.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/south-east-governors-working-for-my-re-election-tinubu/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-all-south-east-governors-backing-my-re-election-tinubu/) reported that President Bola Tinubu claimed all South-East governors are backing his re-election bid.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743033-kwankwaso-reacts-claim-sending-kano-governor-abba-yusuf-negotiate-apc-return-tinubu/) reported that Rabiu Kwankwaso's movement denied claims that he sent Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf to negotiate a return to the APC with President Bola Tinubu.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/kwankwaso-denies-sending-yusuf-to-negotiate-apc-return/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Kwankwaso denied sending Governor Abba Yusuf to President Tinubu to negotiate an APC return.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/24/yusuf-kwankwaso-made-me-swear-by-the-quran-to-return-to-apc-he-took-my-wife/) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf stated Rabiu Kwankwaso made him swear by the Quran to return to the APC and took his wife.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/kano-ndc-apc-clash-over-alleged-2027-election-rigging/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress accused the Kano State Government of plotting to manipulate the 2027 governorship election.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927363-why-kwankwaso-didnt-join-apc-with-me-kano-governor.html) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf stated Rabiu Kwankwaso's public utterances scuttled his plan to lead followers into the APC.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/kwankwaso-asked-me-to-swear-on-quran-over-apc-return-deal-kano-gov/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Kano Governor Abba Yusuf said Kwankwaso asked him to swear on the Qur'an over a deal to join the APC if he won at the Supreme Court.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-apc-to-ndc-resolve-your-candidates-eligibility-issues-stop-playing-victim/) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Kano State challenged the New Nigeria Democratic Congress to resolve candidate eligibility issues.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/why-accord-is-supporting-tinubus-re-election-national-publicity-secretary/) reported that Accord national publicity secretary Ambassador Joseph Omorogbe spoke about his party supporting President Tinubu's re-election.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/925748-ndc-local-government-chairman-others-join-apc-in-kano.html) reported that local government executives of the Nigeria Democratic Congress in Bichi Local Government Area of Kano State defected to the All Progressives Congress.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/ndc-loses-bauchi-gov-candidate-kano-executives-to-apc/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress Bauchi State governorship candidate Ibrahim Kashim and Kano executives defected to the All Progressives Congress.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ndc-vice-chairman-five-ward-chairmen-kwankwasiyya-leaders-defect-to-apc-in-kano/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741689-ndc-suffers-major-blow-kano-vice-chairman-ward-leaders-join-apc/) reported that the political structure of the Nigeria Democratic Congress in Bichi Local Government Area of Kano State suffered a setback following the defection of the vice-chairman and ward chairmen to the APC.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/police-arrest-8-over-apc-ndc-clash-in-kano/) reported that the Kano State Police Command arrested eight suspects following a clash between supporters of the APC and the NDC.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925709-2027-bauchi-ndc-governorship-candidate-defects-to-apc.html) reported that Ibrahim Kashim is listed by the Independent National Electoral Commission as the NDC flagbearer in Bauchi State.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/bauchi-ndc-governorship-candidate-dumps-party-for-apc/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741676-breaking-drama-governorship-candidate-resigns-apc-ndc/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kashim-dumps-ndc-for-apc-ahead-of-bauchi-2027/) reported that Ibrahim Kashim, the Nigeria Democratic Congress governorship candidate in Bauchi State, defected to the ruling All Progressives Congress.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-setback-for-ndc-as-another-chieftain-dumps-party/) reported that the crisis rocking the Nigeria Democratic Congress deepened following the resignation of another chieftain.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/ndc-deputy-national-publicity-secretary-dumps-party/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Deputy National Publicity Secretary of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, Abdulmumin Abdulsalami, resigned citing injustice and exclusion.
