reports.text: [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/seguridad/yo-voy-a-matar-al-papa-procesaron-al-vecino-de-pilar-que-amenazo-con-un-atentado-contra-leon-xiv-en-nid25112026/) reported that a neighbor in Pilar was prosecuted by Federal Judge Adrián González Charvay for making threats and public intimidation regarding an assassination threat against Pope Leo XIV during his visit to the country.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/regions/1010768/pope-leo-xiv-approves-elevation-of-la-union-marian-shrine-to-minor-basilica/story/) reported that a Marian shrine located in La Union province has been elevated to a minor basilica.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/papa-leon-xvi-pide-a-lideres-de-paises-en-guerra-que-se-comprometan-a-encontrar-la-paz-recemos-por-las-victimas/) reported that Pope Leo XVI asked leaders of countries in war to commit to finding peace and prayed for victims and populations affected by drought.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/regions/1010379/pope-leo-xiv-names-oblates-priest-as-new-jolo-apostolic-vicar/story/) reported that Pope Leo XIV appointed Father Gerry Gamaliel Sebastian Delos Reyes as the new apostolic vicar of Jolo.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/castilla-y-leon/papa-leon-xiv-nombra-arzobispo-vallisoletano-aurelio-garcia_202611216b01e337c0d5c85b96c4077e.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV named Aurelio García, secretary of the Dicastery for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments in Rome, as archbishop.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/papa-leon-alerta-sobre-riesgos-enormes-de-la-tecnologia-sin-regulacion-pide-proteger-el-espacio-ultraterrestre-de-usos-no-pacificos/), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/el-papa-leon-xiv-advierte-sobre-el-enorme-riesgo-para-la-humanidad-que-representa-el-desarrollo-tecnologico-sin-etica-3603007) reported that Pope Leo XIV warned against the enormous risks to humanity posed by unethically regulated technology.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/nelson-castro-respondio-a-las-criticas-que-recibio-por-su-cobertura-de-la-visita-del-papa-leon-xiv-a-nid20112026/) reported that journalist Nelson Castro responded to criticism he received regarding his coverage of Pope Leo XIV's visit to Peru.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/pope-leo-forgives-person-who-hit-him-in-eye-with-rosary/news) reported that Pope Leo XIV forgave the person who threw a rosary that hit him in the eye before his final Mass in Peru.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/17/leo-xiv-after-his-tour-there-is-no-need-to-hate-each-other-or-use-such-violent-language?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV criticized aggressive political debate and polarization.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/peru-to-investigate-technical-failures-at-pope-leo-xivs-mass-in-lima/) reported that Peru's Foreign Ministry announced an investigation into technical failures involving audio systems and giant screens during Pope Leo XIV's mass in Lima.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/17/pope-leo-xivs-visit-shines-global-spotlight-on-perus-afro-peruvian-heritage-and-cultural-d/) reported that Pope Leo XIV visited the town of Zaña during his tour of Peru.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/del-papacoptero-al-golpe-de-una-pulsera-en-el-ojo-los-momentos-insolitos-del-viaje-del-papa-por-suramerica-3601655) reported that Pope Leo XIV completed a 12-day tour visiting Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru, which featured incidents including being struck in the eye by a rosary bracelet.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/17/video-shows-pope-leo-xiv-struck-in-the-face-by-rosary-bracelet) reported that Pope Leo XIV was struck in the face by a rosary bracelet thrown from the crowd in Lima.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/cancilleria-de-peru-investiga-fallas-tecnicas-durante-la-ultima-misa-del-papa-leon-xiv-en-lima-empresas-contratistas-podrian-recibir-sanciones-3601533) reported that the Peruvian Chancellery is investigating technical failures during the Pope's final mass in Lima.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-papa-leon-xiv-no-levantara-las-restricciones-de-francisco-a-la-misa-en-el-antiguo-rito-en-latin-nid17112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV stated he will not lift restrictions on the old Latin mass during his flight back to the Vatican.

reports.text: [CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-27/DR-Congo-clashes-displace-civilians-disrupt-Ebola-response-1SpY0OVsl9e/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that renewed clashes between government forces and the CRP rebel group in eastern DR Congo displaced thousands of civilians and disrupted the Ebola response.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ebola-who-demands-faster-vaccine-trials-as-dr-congo-death-toll-hits-5900/) reported that the WHO demanded faster vaccine trials as the DR Congo death toll hit 5,900.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/who-seeks-faster-ebola-vaccine-trials-as-drc-deaths-hit-5900/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the WHO wants faster vaccine trials as the Bundibugyo outbreak in the DRC passes 12,000 cases and 5,900 deaths, with insecurity hampering the response.

[The East African](https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/sustainability/ebola-outbreak-fuels-violence-against-women-girls-in-congo-5685710) reported that the Ebola outbreak in Congo has fueled violence against women and girls by limiting movement and increasing tensions.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/44de564b66e4) reported that the WHO stated nearly $1.6 billion is needed over the next six months to strengthen disease detection and care and contain the spread of the virus.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/dr-congo-ebola-12000-cases-5900-deaths/) reported that health authorities stated the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpassed 12,000 infections and 5,900 deaths.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE5Cdk1qbkU5dEpLRVNybXVHcU1LNGdGQngxRGwwUzk1WG9KWVUzRWROM04yUXhaZjViazBISWptSkg2SFNubG56TEFQYUZBY3A0NjFxWFowNUNDemMyNktFQmRWU0RRTmdyTkxfLUY1ZV83b2FTQ0NKdlVKQmM?oc=5) reported that Ebola cases reached 12,000 in Congo as the second-largest outbreak on record grows.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/ebola-un-says-outbreak-driving-spike-in-gender-based-violence-in-congo/) reported that the UN stated the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is driving a spike in gender-based violence.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/democratic-republic-of-congos-confirmed-ebola-cases-top-12000-3726019) reported that Health Ministry data showed 12,021 cumulative Ebola cases including 5,904 deaths as the virus spread to eight provinces.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261126-fighting-in-eastern-congo-forces-ebola-workers-to-evacuate-disrupts-outbreak-response) reported that escalating fighting in eastern Congo forced Ebola response workers to leave affected areas and disrupted containment efforts.

[The East African](https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/sustainability/health/un-peacekeepers-evacuate-ebola-response-workers-trapped-by-fighting-in-eastern-congo-5685428) reported that UN peacekeepers evacuated Ebola response workers trapped by clashes in Ituri province.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168883) reported that UN peacekeepers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo stepped up efforts to protect civilians in the Ebola-hit Ituri province amid renewed fighting.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/congo-ebola-cases-cross-12000-while-clashes-hinder-containment), [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/649377-dr-congo-fighting-forces-ebola-response-teams-evacuation/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that confirmed Ebola cases in eastern Congo surpassed 12,000 as clashes between rebels and government troops forced response teams to evacuate and hindered containment efforts.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/dr-congo-ebola-cases-surpass-12000-as-fighting-disrupts-response-in-east?traffic_source=rss), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/congo-ebola-outbreak-crosses-12000-cases-as-fighting-disrupts-response/articleshow/136187000.cms) reported that confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpassed 12,000.
[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/ebola-cases-in-congo-surpass-12000-in-fastest-growing-outbreak) reported that the ongoing outbreak is the fastest-growing in history.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxOODk5TW1rbDA5Ml84Vzh3OWVzdW12UkFLbXJzQlZSbG9rNTQxZGl1bjBPQ1FsNURnQ21MU3FFX1RqZFVDdzJrSXR5YkRTTndHcERGWUpyaklFeWxlQ2l4aXhKT1ctM1cwMDdtOHg5RHQ3ZmhqVTIyWFVHUWdHSG40WExZWkJSM1lZNndDSFBlbEdNNnM?oc=5) reported that the Ebola outbreak in Congo reached 12,000 cases as violence forced some responders to evacuate.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNRDFtT0M3ampBX21sZVc4a0VHSDhwMjcwdm16S2ltOE1SUnBEN29UbmhFQVg2d0U0cmVLTVdrU3k5TS15eWNsUGZKekFqYWFUdGlkTlpWTG93ZHlEUE5CRkJYV2ZfU3lQcUpYcEpiT2g2MXN1OHJWSzhPNWdsX2hwbHJPQVlvQm41UFBNZE5ES1N1d1FMZEkybDJ0ZVp0cHRpSWVibA?oc=5) reported that fighting in eastern Congo forced Ebola workers to evacuate, threatening the outbreak response.
[TASS](https://tass.com/society/2224841) reported that the African Union and WHO estimated the cost of the Ebola response in Africa at nearly $1.6 billion for the Bundibugyo virus outbreak.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/ebola-fight-runs-up-against-customs-rites-in-remote-dr-congo-3014028) reported that health workers facing the Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo encounter challenges due to local customs and suspicions.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-24/DR-Congo-Ebola-deaths-near-5-800-as-infections-rise-1SkCcAykyVG/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that the death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reached 5,779 with 11,793 confirmed infections.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/ebola-death-toll-in-congo-far-higher-than-official-figures-suggest) reported that gravediggers in Bunia have been burying far more people than official Ebola death records indicate.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/25/world/science-health/ebola-violence-women-congo-unicef/) reported that UNICEF stated the Ebola epidemic in Congo has been tied to rising violence against women and girls and has killed more than 5,800 people since May.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/24/japan/japan-first-ebola-response-drill/) reported that the Japanese government held its first infectious disease response drill addressing Ebola amid the outbreak in Congo.
[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168865) reported that WHO staff and Ebola responders remain trapped in a hospital in Ituri province due to heavy fighting.

[The Telegraph](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/global-health/science-and-disease/trapped-ebola-health-workers-rescued-in-congo/) reported that trapped Ebola health workers were evacuated from a hospital under very challenging circumstances after three days of fighting.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-23/DRC-fighting-traps-health-workers-disrupts-Ebola-response-1SiVz3ihhQI/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that the WHO chief called for an immediate cessation of hostilities after heavy fighting broke out near a hospital in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, disrupting Ebola response efforts.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168858) reported that the WHO stated heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri province has disrupted Ebola response work and forced emergency evacuations.

[Reuters](https://news.google.?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/who-chief-calls-for-peace-amid-heavy-fighting-in-ebola-hit-dr-congo-region?traffic_source=rss), [Punch](https://punchng.com/who-chief-pleads-for-peace-in-ebola-hit-dr-congo-area/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the WHO chief stated that fighting near the Ebola outbreak area in the DR Congo disrupts response efforts.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/geography-violence-distrust-hitting-dr-congo-ebola-fight-handicap-international-3013396) reported that Handicap International stated geography, violence, and distrust are three major challenges hampering efforts to quell the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/scientists-are-learning-more-about-the-rare-ebola-virus-in-congo-outbreak-3013248) reported that researchers gained insights into the rare Bundibugyo strain during the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/congo-ebola-outbreak-africa-chidlren-b3088643.html) reported that more than 1,200 children under five contracted the rare Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261118-strain-specific-ebola-vaccines-to-be-trialled-in-drc-who-announces) reported that two vaccines against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain are set to enter trials in the outbreak's epicentre next week.

[Foreign Policy](https://foreignpolicy.com/2026/11/18/congo-ebola-outbreak-budnibugyo-constitution-conflict-m23/) reported that six months in, the out of control Ebola outbreak shows no sign of slowing down.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/a-hunger-crisis-is-making-ebola-even-deadlier-101794971716235.html) reported that an Ebola outbreak sweeping East Africa is fueling a hunger crisis that increases the chances of death for infected individuals.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168827) reported that the UN announced the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo more than doubled in three months, with over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths reported.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/ebola-congo-six-months-radio-children-b3086362.html) reported that children in DR Congo are sharing information on the airwaves to fight myths as the Ebola outbreak passes the six-month mark.

[Reuters](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that Barrick is furloughing some personnel at its Congo mine due to Ebola concerns.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/africa/congo-ebola-community-transmission.html) reported that health teams in eastern Congo struggle against fear and mistrust that drive fatal delays in seeking medical care during the Ebola outbreak.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170097.html) reported that Africa's top public health agency warned that the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo remains out of control six months after it was declared.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Africa-CDC-warns-of-immense-challenges-over-fragile-Ebola-gains-1S7pjUCAWQ0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that the Africa CDC warned of immense challenges over fragile Ebola gains as the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak spread to 67 health zones across eight provinces in the DR Congo with over 11,100 confirmed cases and more than 5,400 deaths.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/utilise-skills-acquired-during-orientation-rivers-nysc-coordinator-urges-corps-members/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Rivers NYSC coordinator Moses Oleghe urged 2026 Batch C Stream II corps members to use skills from the SAED in-camp training after orientation camp.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/20/nysc-applauds-partnership-with-nigerian-army-seeks-sustained-security-for-corps-members/) reported that NYSC Director-General Brig. Gen. applauded the partnership with the Nigerian Army and sought sustained security during orientation exercise camp tours.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/ndic-organises-sensitisation-programme-on-savings-for-a-nysc-members-in-kogi/) reported that the NDIC organised a sensitisation programme on savings for NYSC members in Kogi.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndic-lectures-corps-members-in-kogi-to-avoid-ponzi-schemes-embrace-saving-habit/) reported that the Nigeria Deposit Insurance Corporation warned corps members in Kogi State to avoid unregulated financial institutions and embrace a saving habit.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/ndic-urges-corps-members-to-embrace-financial-discipline/) reported that the Nigeria Deposit Insurance Corporation urged corps members in Delta State to embrace financial discipline.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/nysc-pays-oyo-corps-members-delayed-allowances-blames-technical-glitch/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the National Youth Service Corps paid delayed October 2026 allowances to Oyo State corps members and blamed a technical glitch.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741830-nysc-camp-crisis-lawmaker-tells-governors-what-overcrowding-worsens/) reported that Labour Party lawmaker Philip Agbese urged Nigerian governors to expand NYSC orientation camps due to overcrowding.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/925791-nysc-seeks-stronger-protection-for-corps-members-in-north-east.html) reported that the NYSC called for stronger security collaboration with the Nigerian Army to protect corps members serving in the North-east.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/17/reciprocate-youth-corps-contributions-to-states-with-befitting-orientation-camps-accommodation-lp-lawmaker-tells-governors/) reported that Benue State Labour Party leader Hon. Philip Agbese called on state governors to reciprocate Youth Corps contributions with orientation camps and accommodation.

[Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/politics/oburu-s-uphill-task-in-uniting-four-rival-camps-in-siaya-governor-race-5672022) reported that competing camps emerged in the Siaya governor race, each advancing its own candidate.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/16/nysc-seeks-army-protection-for-corps-members-during-2027-polls/) reported that National Youth Service Corps Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu sought Army protection for corps members during the 2027 polls.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/15/nysc-boss-urges-corps-members-to-embrace-vocational-skills-for-self-reliance/) reported that National Youth Service Corps Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu urged corps members to embrace vocational skills.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/nysc-records-more-female-corps-members-since-2021-dg/) reported that the National Youth Service Corps has recorded a higher number of female corps members than males since 2021.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/gombe-gets-ultra-modern-nysc-permanent-orientation-camp/) reported that Gombe State Governor Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya completed the construction of an ultra-modern permanent NYSC orientation camp in Boltongo.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-nysc-dg-seeks-security-for-corps-members/) reported that NYSC Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu solicited the support of the Nigerian Army in ensuring security for corps members.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/nysc-dg-urges-state-governors-to-expand-orientation-camps/) reported that NYSC Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu appealed to state governors to expand orientation camps.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/12/nysc-camp-congestion-centre-tasks-state-governors-to-rise-to-their-civic-responsibilities-improve-on-corp-members-welfare/) reported that CESJET expressed deep concern over persistent congestion and inadequate accommodation facilities at NYSC camps.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1740957-1-nysc-camps-governors-told-improve-accommodation-sanitation-corps-members/) reported that CESJET urged Nigerian governors to tackle overcrowding after over 4,300 corps members were deployed to a Sagamu facility built for 2,000.

reports.text: [EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/27/remarks-by-president-antonio-costa-at-the-press-conference-following-the-special-european-council-meeting-of-26-november-2026/), a government outlet, reported that European Council President António Costa presented the main results of the Special European Council meeting during a press conference.

[EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/25/media-advisory-special-european-council-meeting-of-26-27-november-2026/) reported that the EU Council published a media advisory detailing approximate timings and press opportunities for the special European Council meeting.

[EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/24/special-european-council-of-26-27-november-2026-invitation-letter-by-president-antonio-costa-to-the-members-of-the-european-council/) reported that European Council President António Costa invited leaders to a special meeting of the European Council on November 26-27, 2026, in Brussels, which includes a Euro Summit.

[EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/16/speech-by-president-antonio-costa-at-the-eu-enlargement-forum-2026/) reported that European Council President António Costa delivered a speech at the EU Enlargement Forum.

[EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/13/remarks-by-president-antonio-costa-at-the-press-conference-following-the-informal-meeting-of-heads-of-state-or-government-of-13-november-2026/) reported that European Council President António Costa delivered remarks at a press conference following the informal meeting of Heads of State or Government.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-pro-palestine-protesters-in-dublin-rally-against-european-political-community-summit/) reported that pro-Palestinian demonstrators staged a protest in Dublin against the European Political Community Summit.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/2026/11/13/welcoming-taoiseach-finds-hugs-and-kisses-the-first-political-pitfall-at-dublins-epc-summit/) reported that Taoiseach Micheál Martin greeted 50 world leaders individually at Dublin's EPC summit.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/85052928) reported that Moldova's president stated at the summit that Moldova has friends in Europe.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4184319-european-political-community-ukraine-must-set-its-own-terms-for-peace-and-receive-credible-security-guarantees.html) reported that participants at the European Political Community summit in Dublin adopted a declaration reaffirming that Ukraine must set its own terms for peace and receive credible security guarantees.

[EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/12/joint-statement-by-president-costa-and-president-von-der-leyen-following-their-meeting-with-president-zelenskyy-in-dublin/) reported that President Costa and President von der Leyen issued a joint statement following their meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin.

[EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/12/remarks-by-president-antonio-costa-at-the-press-conference-following-the-meeting-of-the-european-political-community-in-dublin/) reported that European Council President António Costa outlined the main results of discussions during the European Political Community meeting.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/84500755) reported that Moldovan President Maia Sandu is attending the European Political Community summit in Dublin, Ireland.

[EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/12/opening-remarks-by-president-antonio-costa-at-the-meeting-of-the-european-political-community-in-dublin/) reported that European Council President António Costa co-chaired the ninth meeting of the European Political Community in Dublin.

reports.text: [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/vance-and-rubio-meet-qatar-pm-uncertainty-mounts-iran) reported that Qatar's prime minister visited Washington for a biannual meeting of the US-Qatar Strategic Dialogue with Rubio.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxOQVExRXR2RWtYa0VYeVJad1JyanJJWTNvUXVFcGY2TnhtMS1ZS1dkLW9vV0FneklNMDV2d2dIWEpfeUpoMFB6TkZuQnJPbm1GWTRwLXh4TUF1QTctV2JjaUpkQnFhWENLMGlwaU1aVFhQcXh4NC1rUHFNVmVvZTVfN0FkVVZPVU8tREsyRDF1SQ?oc=5), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/rubio-meets-qatari-pm-iran-standoff-deepens), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/vance-rubio-meet-with-qatari-pmas-uncertainty-mounts-over-trumps-intentions-with-iran/article71737051.ece) reported that JD Vance and Marco Rubio met with the Qatari prime minister as uncertainty mounted over US intentions with Iran.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-house-speaker-elect-hakeem-jeffries-refuses-to-meet-with-stephen-miller-says-he-ll-work-directly-with-trump-101795394069909.html) reported that US House speaker-elect Hakeem Jeffries refused to meet with White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller while expressing willingness to work directly with Donald Trump.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/trump-floats-stephen-miller-as-potential-2028-presidential-candidate/) reported that US President Donald Trump publicly mused about his chief of staff, Stephen Miller, running for the White House.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/trump-defends-putin-floats-a-stephen-miller-presidential-run-and-says-hed-work-with-dems-news-briefing-takeaways/) reported that US President Donald Trump defended Putin and floated a Stephen Miller presidential run during a news briefing.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNaTU4R2xyVnVLVmlyd0djZGdkVWhrM1ZiOUxkSllPaHFDREpPRy12V3d5T3NpUjN0RXVfRlpfSFlWalVFbldqNm0xZGYxTFJ3WUtKMUNJWV8zZ21Zb2pQaW1JYm84UF9tamRmdmlHQVBDeGl5YWJqUk5CRG5PRU9XX1FXMU5PeG9rX3JOM3Z3VTFEUTNfZEx4SGdrVkNwNU01dTh1Y01R?oc=5), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/trump-republican-succession-battle-vance-rubio) reported that US President Donald Trump appeared to audition potential successors as JD Vance and Marco Rubio joined him at a White House briefing, while Stephen Miller stole the spotlight.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915604) reported that Trump addressed Iran, artificial intelligence, and tariffs at the briefing.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/video/2026/nov/20/could-pete-buttigieg-win-the-white-house-in-2028-politics-weekly-america) reported that former transportation secretary Pete Buttigieg is among potential contenders starting to make moves for a 2028 presidential run.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-approval-holds-near-career-low-at-32-after-midterms-drubbing-poll-101794886976742.html) reported that Donald Trump's popularity declined as the US war with Iran impacted personal finances and pushed fuel prices higher.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxPRUpsOFJNT0Q1TUExNXF1cUJ6b1ExaTFpTFptdnluUVRMR1RvNDFkQlpLa3ZxeUxRM0kxOEJyQVJkeTJIOHBxTjhlQ05nUmp6dVQ2emVBclZ3TTJLbERHeUpRTkIwMmFLaG1VeVA1UU91Yk5UZFFaU2dZVFFCNzY1RXNTRjFCTHhpRGhWQksxQndNNHZZT1hGX1RQMGtVS25GNGQ4T2VmOHZmSHNl?oc=5) reported that a Reuters/Ipsos poll found Donald Trump's approval rating holding near a career low at 32%.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-endorse-vance-rubio-cruz-2028-b3083857.html), [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/12/world/vance-buttigieg-us-presidential-hopefuls/) reported that a Reuters/Ipsos poll found Vance, Rubio, Ossoff, and Buttigieg leading potential contenders for the 2028 White House race.

reports.text: [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743713-why-kwankwaso-backing-peter-obi-2027-election-bwala-explains/) reported that Daniel Bwala alleged Rabiu Kwankwaso's alliance with Peter Obi is part of a strategy to build southern support for a 2031 presidential bid.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743607-tinubu-atiku-obi-common-2-presidential-candidates-fashola/) reported that former Lagos state governor Babatunde Fashola discussed common characteristics between President Bola Tinubu, Atiku Abubakar, and Peter Obi.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743546-sacking-tinubu-atiku-obi-makinde-set-decisive-show/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/morning-recap-atiku-obi-makinde-meet-monday-fake-emergency-calls-hit-58m-other-top-stories/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the ruling All Progressives Congress stated that a planned meeting between opposition figures Atiku Abubakar, Peter Obi, and Seyi Makinde poses no threat to President Bola Tinubu's 2027 bid.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743503-2027-presidency-seyi-makindes-camp-speaks-alleged-plan-step-atiku/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-election-makinde-may-succumb-to-atiku-i-wish-hes-with-us-bwala/) reported that Seyi Makinde's campaign labeled claims that he will step down from the 2027 presidential race for Atiku Abubakar as fake news.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928199-kano-apc-kicks-as-group-petitions-against-2023-governorship-election-petition-judgement.html) reported that the Kano APC council described a petition authored by Suleiman Malali regarding the 2023 governorship election petition judgment as legally flawed.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-your-sacrifices-wont-be-in-vain-obi-to-families-of-slain-ndc-members/) reported that former presidential candidate Peter Obi condemned the killings of Nigerian Democratic Congress members.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/ndc-alleges-plot-to-silence-obi-opposition-members-vows-to-resist-intimidation/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress alleged a plot to silence Peter Obi and opposition members, while the APC denied the accusation.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/why-g5-didnt-align-with-obi-atiku-in-2023-makinde/) reported that Seyi Makinde explained that he championed the zoning of the PDP presidential ticket to the South after Muhammadu Buhari's administration.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/why-g5-governors-rejected-obi-atiku-in-2023-makinde/) reported that Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde explained why the G5 aggrieved PDP governors refused to support the party's presidential candidate in 2023.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/reps-seek-fg-intervention-as-planned-protest-threatens-60000bpd-oil-production-in-ondo/) reported that the House of Representatives called on the Federal Government to urgently intervene in infrastructural challenges facing oil-producing areas in Ondo due to a planned protest threatening oil production.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/25/oborevwori-killers-of-four-at-ndc-delta-rally-will-be-brought-to-book-visits-scene/) reported that Delta State Governor Sheriff Oborevwori visited the scene and vowed to bring to book the killers of four people at an NDC Delta rally.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/delta-attack-obi-omo-agege-visit-family-of-slain-ndc-member/) reported that NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi and Delta Central senatorial candidate Ovie Omo-Agege visited the family of a slain NDC member following a Delta attack.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611240388.html) reported that police stated six people were killed in an attack on Ovie Omo-Agege's campaign in Delta, and the Inspector-General ordered a probe.
[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611240430.html) reported that the death toll from a boat mishap in Bayelsa State rose to 32 following the recovery of three additional bodies.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743143-peter-obi-cleric-shares-spiritual-observation-ndc-candidate-2027-election/) reported that Prophet Ekong Ituen revealed a fresh prophecy regarding Peter Gregory Obi's chances in the 2027 presidential election.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743144-oshiomhole-speaks-tinubu-buhari-atiku-kwankwaso-edo-people-collected-dollars/) reported that Adams Oshiomhole revealed how President Bola Tinubu stopped Atiku Abubakar.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/delta-residents-protest-killing-of-four-ndc-members-demand-arrests/) reported that residents of the Uduere community in Ughelli North Local Government Area staged a protest over the killing of four NDC members and demanded arrests.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/24/reps-member-seeks-urgent-intervention-over-bayelsa-boat-mishap-calls-for-safer-boats/) reported that a member of the House of Representatives urged the House to urgently intervene in the boat mishap.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/bayelsa-reps-direct-nddc-nema-others-to-supply-safer-boats-life-jackets/) reported that the House of Representatives directed the managements of the Niger Delta Development Commission and other agencies to supply safer boats and life jackets.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bayelsa-boat-mishap-victims-get-mass-burial/) reported that 29 victims whose bodies have been recovered were given a mass burial at the Azikoro cemetery in Yenagoa.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/opposition-supporters-now-being-murdered-for-their-political-choices-obi-raises-alarm-over-delta-killings/) reported that Peter Obi raised the alarm over the growing murder of opposition supporters.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-omo-agege-predicts-peter-obis-victory-says-apc-has-no-chance-in-delta/) reported that former Deputy Senate President Ovie Omo-Agege dismissed the possibility of the APC securing electoral victories in Delta State.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/delta-attack-obi-calls-for-probe-protection-of-opposition-supporters/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/delta-killings-obi-demands-justice-for-four-ndc-supporters/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Peter Obi demanded a probe and justice for the deaths of four supporters in a Delta State attack.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742955-2027-presidency-bwala-predicts-apc-victory-south-east-states-concedes-obis-stronghold/) reported that Daniel Bwala predicted the APC will win three South-East states in the 2027 election but could struggle in Abia and Anambra due to Peter Obi's influence.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/24/boat-tragedy-gov-diri-appeals-for-fgs-support-to-complete-senatorial-roads/) reported that Bayelsa State Governor Douye Diri made a fresh appeal to the Federal Government to help complete three senatorial district road projects following a boat tragedy.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ndc-dismisses-rift-with-obi-over-campaign-funding/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/ndc-denies-rift-with-obi-over-2027-campaign-funding/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress dismissed reports of a disagreement between the party and presidential candidate Peter Obi over campaign funding.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/tinubu-orders-aide-end-katsina-party-feud/) reported that Nigerian President Bola Tinubu ordered his political adviser to resolve a party feud with Katsina's governor.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/nigerians-need-solutions-not-presidential-pity-party-atikus-aide-tells-tinubu/) reported that Phrank Shaibu, media aide to Atiku Abubakar, criticized President Bola Tinubu over remarks regarding water supply at the Presidential Villa.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-approves-n250m-for-bayelsa-boat-mishap-victims-families/) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved N250 million in financial assistance for families of victims of the Bayelsa boat accident.

[The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/tinubu-mourns-bayelsa-boat-tragedy-victims-scales-down-ibadan-rally/) reported that in a tribute to the victims of the boat mishap in Bayelsa State, President Bola Tinubu ordered the All Progressives Congress to scale down its Ibadan rally.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-donates-n250m-to-families-of-bayelsa-boat-victims/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Tinubu donated N250m to families of Bayelsa boat mishap victims and ordered stricter waterway safety as the death toll rises to 29.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/22/2027-obi-endorses-smartballot-urges-ndc-candidates-supporters-to-embrace-technology/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress presidential candidate Peter Obi endorsed SmartBallot and urged candidates and supporters to embrace technology.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-peter-obi-endorses-smartballot-for-election-monitoring/) reported that Peter Obi endorsed SmartBallot for election monitoring and urged supporters to register.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742693-2027-election-political-analyst-predicts-states-peter-obi-win-nigeria/) reported that political analyst Aninze Ekene predicted Peter Obi's 2027 election performance across various regions.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742705-2027-election-abuja-cleric-shares-vision-peter-obi-prediction/) reported that Abuja-based cleric Reverend Ezekiel Dachomo shared a vision that Peter Gregory Obi would win the 2027 presidential election.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/rev-dachomo-endorses-peter-obi-for-2027-presidential-election/) reported that Plateau State-based clergyman Rev. Ezekiel Dachomo endorsed Peter Obi for the 2027 presidential election.
[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641678/death-toll-from-nigeria-boat-accident-rises-to-24) reported that the death toll from the boat accident rose to 24.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-nema-deploys-technical-team-as-death-toll-rises/) reported that the National Emergency Management Agency deployed a technical team to Bayelsa State to reinforce search and rescue operations.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/nema-deploys-technical-team-as-bayelsa-boat-accident-death-toll-hits-24/) reported that NEMA deployed a technical team to Bayelsa State to strengthen search and rescue operations following a boat accident.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/tinubu-mourns-victims-of-bayelsa-boat-accident-orders-low-key-oyo-apc-rally/) reported that President Bola Tinubu expressed deep sadness over the tragic incident in Ukubie and ordered a low-key Oyo APC rally.

reports.text: [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/andrea-stewart-cousins-new-york-s-first-black-woman-senate-leader-dies-at-76-101795813790444.html) reported that New York Senate Majority Leader Andrea Stewart-Cousins died at the age of 76.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/27/us/andrea-stewart-cousins-dead.html) reported that Andrea Stewart-Cousins, New York’s first female Senate majority leader, died at age 76 after serving in the state senate for 20 years.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxOQnZNTnE5WDN4cFY0dGtjX3BEVWlSYWVTT3B2YWVreVlaTTF1QkgwVWVuYTBxUTJ2anltc2hPcWU5S1ZUcHRoaFJJUndwVEVpR3ljTmNOM3Y2MXJHWXpiYnozT0lKOF9qSHRuVWlDUXMtT3VwLXJTTXBsaW52RzVHemg5SC1MLVF5WEtPZlpvM3NUM1c1MFJtMlNHbGFtN0poSDZRV29QQ1M3Qm55SlE?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/alaska-ends-deal-to-give-voter-records-to-us-justice-department?traffic_source=rss) reported that Alaska ended its voter data agreement with the US Justice Department following the 2026 midterm elections.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/us/politics/dan-sullivan-concedes-alaska-senate-race-mary-peltola.html) reported that Sullivan conceded the Alaska Senate race to Peltola after the Trump administration dropped a lawsuit intended to potentially block certification.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-23/ty-article/.premium/mark-ruffalo-accused-of-antisemitism-again-after-attacking-schumer/000001a2-09b3-d9e4-ada3-9db38a4a0000) reported that actor Mark Ruffalo attacked Chuck Schumer's entrenched religious beliefs as Van Hollen's bid to unseat Schumer proceeds.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/diaspora/antisemitism/article-915762) reported that Mark Ruffalo threw his support behind Senator Chris Van Hollen in the race for Senate leader against Chuck Schumer.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/microsoft-outage-hits-outlook-teams-worldwide-draws-130000-us-reports/) reported that a major global Microsoft outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies across multiple regions.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-outage-services-across-all-previously-affected-environments-restored-microsoft-365-outage-teams-outlook-101794629719606.html) reported that Microsoft stated services across all previously affected environments have been restored.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10936977) reported that Microsoft issued an apology as a global outage affecting email and office software services stretched into a second day.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b), [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/tech/2026-11-13-microsoft-outage-disrupts-email-and-workplace-services-across-south-africa/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581230/hours-long-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-and-governments-globally/) reported that Microsoft stated it was seeing improvements for Outlook email and other Microsoft 365 services following a global outage that disrupted businesses and governments.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-stabilizing/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident and that a broader rollout of software fixes was stabilizing the system.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/14/microsoft-deeply-sorry-for-global-disruption-that-could-have-billion-dollar-impact-on-australia) reported that Microsoft said it was deeply sorry for the global disruption and that services were being restored.

reports.text: [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/tajani-says-zelenskyy-not-telling-truth-on-benghazi-3726082) reported that Turkish Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani stated allies were not informed beforehand of Ukrainian operations against Russian vessels in Libya.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8065044/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4189426-zelensky-confirms-to-meloni-that-ukraine-did-not-coordinate-libya-operation-with-europe.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed to Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni that the operation against Russian ships near Libya was carried out without prior coordination with international partners.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-hit-oil-military-facilities-across-11-russian-regions-over-past-week-zelensky-says/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated Ukraine hit oil and military facilities across 11 Russian regions over the past week.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/italy-challenges-zelenskyys-claims-of-coordination-on-libya-strikes) reported that Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani disputed Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's account of coordination over attacks in Libya.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/182acff5a916), a state-run outlet, reported that Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said allies were not informed of Ukrainian military operations targeting Russian vessels in Libya.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-says-ukraine-aligns-naval-strikes-with-partners-italy-denies-coordination-over-libya-attack/) reported that Ukrainian naval drones struck the Russian Navy corvette Merkury at the port of Benghazi in Libya on Nov. 22.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8064990/) reported that Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani denied that Ukraine coordinated its operation against a Russian ship in Libya with international partners.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/zelenskyy-says-ukraine-coordinates-strikes-on-russian-ships-with-partners-3726062) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Ukraine coordinates attacks on Russian ships with countries whose waters or infrastructure are involved.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/27/italy-not-informed-about-ukraine-drone-strike-on-russian-ships-in-libya/) reported that Italy joined voices expressing concern about Ukraine's attack on Russian ships in Libyan waters and was not informed of the drone strike.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91340) reported that French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said Ukraine was exercising its rights in defending against drone strikes on two Russian vessels off the Libyan coast.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91317) reported that Italy summoned Ukraine's military attaché over Ukrainian strikes on Russian ships near Benghazi, Libya.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/italys-meloni-concerned-after-ukraine-attack-on-russian-ship-in-libya/) reported that Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni expressed concern after a Ukrainian attack on a Russian ship in Libya while speaking in Brussels ahead of a European Union leaders' meeting.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188644-russian-aircraft-and-vessels-carrying-military-cargo-legitimate-targets-for-ukraine-zelensky.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russian aircraft, warships, and vessels transporting Russian weapons are legitimate targets for Ukraine.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQRGl5eGplZXIyMktvQUNpVzZ6LV84eU50Qnp6dzZiWEhScWZzaXZuVzVjdTNVZWlHQXVINHQ1SzRRZnRvZHRQWDZyLXJZRXlUQ3JZbkZZR0lTQWJ2RGE4S1pySVFSekZ3QnZWOFJOd1hwUkJKNkxMSF9oM2ZxM2s4VV9UMG5TRGkyRlIyRFFWcUd5a3RwSzZyZzR3NmQ?oc=5) reported that Italy rebuked Ukraine over attacks on Russian ships in Libya.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261125-french-fm-defends-ukraine-s-attacks-on-russian-ships-in-libya), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/french-foreign-minister-defends-ukraine-attacks-in-libya-3013954) reported that French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot defended Ukraine's drone attacks on Russian ships in Libyan waters, calling them a legitimate act of self-defense.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064548/) reported that French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot accused Vladimir Putin of trying to undermine stability during his defense of the maritime drone attack.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/ukraine-strikes-russian-ships-libya-giorgia-meloni-italy/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni faces worry in Rome that Ukraine's strikes on Russian ships could destabilize Libya.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/video/ukraine-strikes-russian-ships-1-500-miles-from-frontline) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya using sea drones that sank the navy vessel.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/italy-watches-worryingly-as-ukraine-strikes-russian-boats-in-libya) reported that Italy is concerned over Ukraine's naval drone strikes on two Russian vessels in and off Benghazi.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOTzIzWjZLTEdiVXRtR0I1cEJ3MFVCUzF5ZktKdWRUQlNtMEVDTnQ4Mk5xU2tvODVlRUJFeE5KOGlieGxsYkp5c1dhZklONzRZNW1VWTR4OVM1MGFQM0cxRXBaQm93b1lhWG1qR3F0ZGV2VTRRRGxtbTRkU1VYQ2c2dEtHckpXQmJCbmpYZlNKeFVrNW8zVjBldDFEWGc1TmIzRTJTM0ozNy1yanVq?oc=5) reported that Ukraine stated the attack on Russian ships in Libya was an act of self-defense.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/zelenskyy-confirms-ukraine-struck-russian-cargo-ship-in-baltic-waters) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed Kyiv was behind a drone strike on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188087-zelensky-confirms-strike-on-russian-ship-in-gulf-of-finland.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed that Ukraine struck the Russian cargo ship Sparta II with a drone in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPbWEtbTJSQnAySDRBUUhIYkZMdFBILXZkQlptS08xUGdBVnFxTjBrWE0xWlBld1Z2dG1nUUE5bDhrZUlqU01VcnZhVXZVQ1lZay11RTNYYWZOeUtKMUp3UDM2eUdUNDgyNnJuWUJxOENiZVRuRmlsUlAwWkpSdWZ6T2JpMGM3ZmNqRmk3NGx6OVhsekJRS2EydnZ3eVBabktYWU1qWVFwTXBrMDk4eEZyR0IzcDVzRUgxT0E?oc=5), [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2223735) reported that a Russian cargo ship hit by drones was towed to St. Petersburg.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187975-ukraines-right-to-selfdefense-is-not-geographically-restricted-foreign-ministry-says-on-strikes-against-russian-vessels.html) reported that Ukraine's Foreign Ministry stated that the threat to Libya comes from Russian warships and weapons carriers, and its actions are directed solely against the aggressor.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/24/ukraine-invokes-u-n-charter-in-defense-of-its-strike-on-russian-warship-in-libya) reported that Ukraine invoked the U.N. Charter to state the strike on the Russian corvette Merkuriy off the coast of Libya was an exercise of its legitimate right to self-defense.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188092-sybiha-tajani-discuss-security-in-black-and-mediterranean-seas-following-strikes-on-russian-vessels-off-libya.html) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and Italian counterpart Antonio Tajani discussed security challenges in the Black and Mediterranean Seas following strikes on Russian vessels off Libya.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOTnR2aXdGN1dOTnJ1QmhWQWhjWnEwOHQ3QzJ2VExKcHRVZEE3TlloVi11NnJRajdKaThMRGIxeElNM2ZvWWJ5c2dmT2xLbzA1ZHRra0JHTGdteC03dXA5RWFXWTMxejFtSC1odHJiem9QOTY1eWN6OXVEQjV4eUtXX1duQTFLellMcjBCb0NzLUIwT0c1S1FFZEU5N2ZLc3M?oc=5) reported that a Russian strike on Ukraine killed two people and wounded children as Kyiv explained its naval attack near Libya.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91048) reported that Ukraine defended its naval drone operation against Russian military assets near Libya as a legitimate act of self-defense.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/foreign/927595-un-mission-condemns-ukrainian-attacks-on-russian-ships-in-libya.html) reported that the UN mission condemned the Ukrainian attacks on Russian ships in Libya and urged an investigation.

[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/mideast-africa/2026/11/23/ukraine-confirms-it-sank-russian-corvette-in-libyan-port/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed Ukraine was behind the explosive sinking of the Russian corvette Merkury in the Libyan port of Benghazi.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/europe/ukraine-libya-russian-ships.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukrainian naval drones sank a corvette and hit a dry cargo vessel near Libya.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261124-live-tripoli-demands-explanation-from-kyiv-for-striking-russian-ships-in-libyan-waters) reported that the Tripoli-based Libyan foreign ministry condemned the Ukrainian drone attack.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-kyiv-claims-strike-that-sank-russian-ship-off-libya/live-80015859?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/volodymyr-zelenskyy-claims-ukraine-sank-russia-warship-benghazi-libya/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/europe/ukraine-libya-russian-ships.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukrainian naval drones sank a Russian warship off Libya.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/benghazi-libya-russian-ship-sunk-drone-ukraine/33903623.html) reported that authorities of the eastern-based Libyan government said a suspected sea drone caused an explosion aboard a Russian ship docked at a naval base near Benghazi.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-kyiv-claims-strike-that-sank-russian-ship-off-libya/live-80015859?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the attack was carried out with Ukrainian-made naval drones.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/teske-optuzbe-iz-libije-ukrajinski-napad-proglasili-objavom-rata-traze-da-se-zelenski-stavi-na-listu-terorista/261123286) reported that Libyan Presidential Council member Musa al-Koni described a Ukrainian attack on the port of Benghazi as an act of war and called for an emergency UN Security Council session.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90949) reported that the strike on the frigate Merkury destroyed one of Russia's most advanced and expensive warships, which was equipped with sophisticated radar systems.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/23/ukraine-releases-footage-of-strikes-on-two-russian-vessels-off-libya) reported that Ukraine released footage showing strikes against two Russian vessels off the Libyan port of Benghazi.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187865-zelensky-ukraine-to-continue-naval-strikes-after-hitting-two-russian-vessels-off-libya.html) reported that Volodymyr Zelensky stated Ukraine is responding appropriately to Russian attacks and that its naval operations will continue.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/ucrania-afunda-navio-de-guerra-russo-de-r-1-bi-na-libia-veja-video.shtml) reported that Ukraine launched an attack with seven maritime drones against a Russian warship in the port of Benghazi.

reports.text: [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/political-violence-threatens-polls-in-9-states-inec-raises-alarm/) reported that Independent National Electoral Commission Chairman Joash Amupitan raised an alarm that political violence threatens polls in nine states.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-chairman-condemns-wave-of-campaign-violence/) reported that INEC Chairman Joash Amupitan lamented that the build-up to the general elections has witnessed a wave of campaign violence.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-polls-were-working-with-security-agencies-to-prosecute-offenders-inec/) reported that INEC stated it is working with security agencies to prosecute electoral offenders.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/cng-warns-politicians-against-inciting-violence-ahead-of-2027-elections/) reported that the Coalition of Northern Groups warned political leaders against deploying inflammatory rhetoric, threats, and intimidation.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/i-receive-death-threats-almost-daily-inec-chairman-amupitan/) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan disclosed that he receives death threats almost daily over his role.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/campaign-violence-inec-awaits-police-case-files-to-prosecute-offenders/) reported that INEC Chairman Professor Joash Amupitan stated swift action was necessary so that impunity is decisively checked before January.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-warns-against-election-violence-fake-news-moves-to-avert-2023-glitches/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission raised concerns over threats of electoral violence and fake news with less than two months to the 2027 general elections.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/21/akpabio-to-apc-supporters-dont-be-provoked-to-violence-win-with-votes/) reported that Senate President Godswill Akpabio urged APC support groups and members not to be provoked to violence.

[The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/inec-police-strengthen-collaboration-for-elections-security-in-rivers/) reported that INEC and security agencies in Rivers State pledged to strengthen collaboration for election security.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/akpabio-warns-apc-supporters-against-electoral-violence-ahead-of-2027/) reported that Senate President Godswill Akpabio cautioned members and support groups of the All Progressives Congress against engaging in violence or retaliation.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/inec-warns-youths-against-electoral-violence-manipulation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that INEC urged young Nigerians to reject electoral violence, hate speech, and misinformation ahead of the 2027 elections.

[The Chronicle (Ghana)](https://thechronicle.com.gh/disqualify-candidates-over-political-violence-senate-urges-inec/) reported that the Nigerian Senate asked the Independent National Electoral Commission to disqualify any political candidate whose supporters are found to have instigated political violence.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-inec-police-move-to-prevent-electoral-violence-in-rivers/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission and Rivers State Police Command resolved to prevent electoral violence.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-prosecute-electoral-violence-suspects-or-face-legal-offensive-serap-warns-inec/) reported that SERAP issued a seven-day ultimatum to INEC Chairman Professor Joash Amupitan to prosecute electoral violence suspects.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-serap-gives-inec-chairman-seven-days-to-prosecute-electoral-violence-suspects/) reported that the Socio-Economic Rights and Accountability Project gave INEC Chairman Professor Joash Amupitan a seven-day ultimatum to prosecute electoral violence suspects.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/chatham-house-protesters-who-confronted-amupitan-were-paid-uk-based-lawyer-alleges/) reported that a UK-based Nigerian lawyer alleged that protesters who confronted INEC Chairman Professor Joash Amupitan were paid.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/uk-protesters-against-inec-chair-were-rented-lawyer/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a UK-based Nigerian lawyer alleged that protesters who demonstrated against INEC Chairman Joash Amupitan in London were paid.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-amupitan-confronted-by-protesters-in-london-over-alleged-duplicate-voter-registrations/) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan was confronted by Nigerian protesters in London over alleged duplicate voter registrations.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-inec-chairman-amupitan-faces-angry-diaspora-protesters-in-london-defends-electoral-credibility/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/video-protesters-block-amupitans-vehicle-in-london-demand-resignation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that diaspora protesters in London surrounded and blocked the vehicle of INEC Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan, demanding his resignation.

reports.text: [La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/27/capital/034n1cap?partner=rss) reported that the Morena bench in the local Congress aims to approve the harmonization of the local mobility law with the general mobility law during the current ordinary session period.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/reconoce-el-plan-general-de-desarrollo-el-derecho-del-cuidado/) reported that the General Development Plan document proposes a public system with services and infrastructure directed at children, older adults, people with disabilities, and priority groups.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/pan-en-congreso-cdmx-pide-3-meses-de-parlamento-abierto-para-analizar-plan-general-de-desarrollo-es-indispensable-que-ciudadania-lo-conozca/) reported that PAN in the Mexico City Congress requested a 3-month open parliament to analyze the General Development Plan.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/cesar-cravioto-califica-como-montaje-acusaciones-en-su-contra-tras-violencia-en-congreso-cdmx-pan-exige-su-renuncia/) reported that César Cravioto denied accusations of violence against him in the Mexico City Congress, calling them a montage, while the PAN demanded his resignation.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/24/capital/027n2cap?partner=rss) reported that as part of the General Development Plan discussion, the Iztapalapa mayor's office will deliver a study to the capital's Congress to regularize 28 settlements.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/congreso-cdmx-realizara-parlamento-abierto-sobre-plan-general-de-desarrollo-buscan-exponer-alcances-asi-como-recoger-opiniones-y-propuestas/) reported that Mexico City's congressional Jucopo president Xóchitl Bravo stated the General Development Plan sent to the local legislative power is a project and not the final document, and announced an open parliament to gather opinions and proposals.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/18/capital/030n2cap?partner=rss) reported that members of towns and neighborhoods of Mexico City alerted about modifications made to the general development plan project sent to Congress.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/mininterior-alejandro-ordonez-radico-bases-del-plan-de-desarrollo) reported that Interior Minister Alejandro Ordoñez filed the bases of the Development Plan before Congress.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/congreso-arranca-analisis-de-las-bases-del-plan-nacional-de-desarrollo) reported that the Congress planning commission has until January to issue its concept on the National Development Plan.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/titular-de-metropolis-pide-a-fuerzas-politicas-tener-dialogo-de-altura-por-plan-general-de-desarrollo-documento-ha-sido-bien-cuidado-considera/) reported that the head of Metrópolis called on political forces to have a high-level dialogue regarding the General Development Plan during an appearance before the local Congress.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/morena-acelera-ruta-legislativa-para-aprobar-plan-general-de-desarrollo-en-cdmx-33105225) reported that Morena is accelerating the legislative path to approve the General Development Plan.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/diputada-local-del-pan-asegura-que-no-tendran-prisa-por-aprobar-el-plan-de-desarrollo-este-ano-exige-consulta-ciudadana/) reported that a local PAN deputy demanded a citizen consultation and questioned land acquisition policies in the plan.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/plan-general-de-desarrollo-sera-aprobado-antes-del-15-de-diciembre-morena-cdmx-sera-el-regalo-de-navidad-para-nuestra-ciudad-dicen/) reported that Morena CDMX stated the plan will be approved before December 15 without entering a new public consultation process.

reports.text: [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8065058/) reported that a Russian drone strike damaged two educational institutions in the center of Kremenchuk, Poltava Oblast, injuring children.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-drone-attack-on-kremenchuk-injures-4-including-3-children/) reported that a Russian drone attack on Kremenchuk damaged two educational institutions in the city center and injured four people, including three children.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91457) reported that Russian attacks across Kharkiv and the surrounding region left 13 people injured or suffering acute stress reactions, including three girls.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8065024/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189394-russian-attack-on-pisochyn-in-kharkiv-region-leaves-eight-injured-including-three-children.html) reported that eight people, including three children, were injured in a Russian attack on the village of Pisochyn near Kharkiv.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189423-russian-drone-attack-damages-two-educational-facilities-in-kremenchuk-injuring-two-children.html) reported that a Russian drone attack damaged two educational facilities and injured two children in Kremenchuk.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2226017) reported that eleven civilians were killed and 20 injured in Ukrainian attacks on the Kherson Region over a week, including two killed on the R-280 Highway.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8064978/) reported that Russian forces struck Lozova in Kharkiv Oblast with jet-powered drones, injuring two people and starting fires.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2225947) reported that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated that relations between Russia and Kazakhstan are developing in all possible areas.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8064927/) reported that a 40-year-old man who sustained chest injuries during a Russian drone attack on Chernihiv died in hospital.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189308-russian-drone-attack-on-kremenchuk-injures-two.html) reported that a 55-year-old woman and a 17-year-old girl were injured in a Russian drone attack on Kremenchuk in the Poltava region.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2225691), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that three civilians were injured in a Ukrainian drone attack on Novorossiysk and did not require hospitalization.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064707/) reported that the number of injured in Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia rose to 11, including two children, with energy infrastructure also damaged.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064717/) reported that two people are in serious condition among seven total injured in a Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/ecuador-and-us-review-joint-military-operations-official-says?traffic_source=rss) reported that joint military efforts between Ecuador and the US have been paused while the US investigates a lethal operation carried out by Ecuador.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/americas/ecuador-us-military-operations-trump.html) reported that the Trump administration has halted military operations while it investigates an operation by Ecuadorean forces that killed an accused gang leader.
[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/russian-attack-in-ukraine-leaves-two-dead-and-40-injured/) reported that a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia killed two people and injured 40 others.

[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2223753) reported that municipal head Ruslan Khomenko stated that Ukrainian drone and artillery attacks in the Kherson Region left two civilians dead and seven injured, with 464 artillery and mortar strikes and 440 drone attacks recorded on Alyoshki.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2223101), a state-media outlet, reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump did not discuss the appointment of a Russian ambassador to the U.S. and that the conversation was more conceptual.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4187214-zelensky-names-settlements-where-ukraine-proposes-to-conduct-humanitarian-missions.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky named settlements in the Kherson and Zaporizhzhia regions where Ukraine proposes conducting humanitarian missions.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063949/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy named 15 settlements in Russian-occupied Kherson and Zaporizhzhia oblasts where Ukraine proposes humanitarian evacuations similar to the Oleshky operation.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/humanitarian-mission-for-kostiantynivka-is-it-a-trap/a-79996772?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed an evacuation of the Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063649/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated that Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin did not discuss a proposed five-day ceasefire in Kostiantynivka.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186206-russian-assault-troops-in-kherson-regions-island-zone-readily-surrender-press-officer.html) reported that Russian servicemen sent to storm the islands in the Dnipro River delta near Kherson readily surrender to Ukrainian forces.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185902-ukrainian-military-ready-to-conduct-further-civilian-evacuations-from-occupied-kherson-region-press-officer.html) reported that Ukrainian military personnel are prepared to carry out further civilian evacuations from temporarily occupied areas of the Kherson region.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-russia-negotiating-another-oleshky-style-humanitarian-mission-lubinets-says/) reported that Ukrainian human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets stated that Ukraine and Russia are negotiating another humanitarian mission.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/13/kremlin-says-ready-for-civilian-evacuation-from-ukraines-kostiantynivka-a94257) reported that the Kremlin stated it is ready for civilian evacuation from Ukraine's Kostiantynivka.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062720/) reported that Ukraine's Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets stated that Kostiantynivka was not raised in talks on humanitarian missions.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062686/) reported that Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets shared updates on 105 animals evacuated from occupied Oleshky.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/putin-proposes-joint-humanitarian-operation-with-ukraine-in-kostiantynivka-modeled-on-earlier-evacuation-mission-in-oleshky) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed organizing a humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka, modeled on an earlier evacuation mission in Oleshky.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4184013-humanitarian-mission-needed-in-occupied-hola-prystan-community-similar-to-oleshky-operation-local-official.html) reported that local officials stated a similar humanitarian mission is urgently needed in the occupied Hola Prystan community.

reports.text: [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10952169) reported that South Korean shares ended higher on Friday, extending gains led by technology shares amid hopes for market-stabilizing measures.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261127004700320) reported that South Korean shares ended higher on Friday, extending gains on hopes of policy support.

[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261125006100320), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10949278) reported that South Korean shares retreated over 6 percent as an overnight sell-off in technology stocks on Wall Street revived AI uncertainties.
