reports.text: [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/nuclear-holocaust-risk-trump-claims-iran-missiles-can-reach-europe/articleshow/136207250.cms) reported that US President Donald Trump expressed concern over Iran's missile capabilities and stated that Iranian missiles could reach Europe.

[Military Times](https://www.militarytimes.com/news/your-military/2026/11/25/all-carrier-strike-group-5-sailors-returning-from-deployment-to-be-provided-ashore-accommodations/) reported that sailors from the USS George Washington carrier strike group will be provided ashore accommodations in off-ship beds upon returning from their deployment.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/21/vance-trump-iran-nuclear-weapon) reported that US Vice President JD Vance stopped short of endorsing Donald Trump's claim that Iran was close to a nuclear weapon.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532390/Lula-says-Iran-has-no-intention-of-developing-nuclear-weapons), a state-media outlet, reported that Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva challenged Washington's justification for war against Iran, calling US claims fabricated.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that US Vice President JD Vance declined to back Donald Trump's Iran strikes despite the president's demand for public endorsement.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584922/vance-avoids-endorsing-trumps-iran-strike-decision/) reported that US Vice President JD Vance declined to say whether he would have ordered military strikes against Iran as President Donald Trump urged him.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/us/2026/11/20/us-vice-president-jd-vance-declines-to-say-he-would-have-ordered-iran-strikes/) reported that US Vice President JD Vance declined to say whether he would have ordered strikes on Iran and called for the US to exit the conflict.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/cd9e5cc2714e) reported that US Vice President JD Vance stated the decision to attack Iran was Donald Trump's call and his role is to support the president.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-vice-president-vance-declines-say-he-would-have-ordered-iran-strikes) reported that JD Vance avoided directly endorsing US strikes on Iran.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/uss-george-washington-carrier-iran-b3087975.html) reported that the U.S. military returned to having two aircraft carriers supporting Iran war operations after the USS George Washington departed the Middle East.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641168/us-carrier-uss-george-washington-leaves-middle-east-after-3-months-report) reported that the US carrier USS George Washington left the Middle East after three months, while the USS Theodore Roosevelt and USS George HW Bush carrier strike groups remain in the region.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/donald-trump-calls-jd-vances-iran-ceasefire-memorandum-a-waste-of-time-after-midterm-losses-101795076049336.html) reported that Donald Trump criticized a June memorandum negotiated by Vice President JD Vance regarding an Iran ceasefire, saying he preferred a formal agreement.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/americki-nosac-aviona-uss-george-washington-nakon-tri-mjeseca-napustio-bliski-istok/261119009) reported that the US aircraft carrier USS George Washington left the Middle East after a three-month deployment in the region.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPZnlZbjhYV1JEWk1EQ3dZVXZtWG14LW5RT3hwakkyeTZzMzJQcktfM19vZHFkZGc1blFHRFUzTkM0Nko1bVhQNWYwMms5UDVLb0p6NlFkZS1EX21WTjNmTXVQSTlsNDBLN0pvU3h4Y096N3VCMHEwbVZlQ2R2NHBoQ0FKY2xEZXpzakMyZU5hdkxsRk5jbzlUbnpvRHFSUUYxeVRhc0pvVjMtTEU?oc=5) reported that the US military returned to two aircraft carriers in the Middle East.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-may-have-just-two-aircraft-carriers-in-persian-gulf-as-uss-george-washington-heads-to-japan-101795033013797.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915382) reported that the USS George Washington aircraft carrier left the Middle East to return to the US 7th Fleet.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-angry-vance-iran-war-midterms-b3087494.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-915361) reported that President Trump has grown frustrated with Vice President Vance after Vance blamed the Iran war for Republican midterm losses.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640809/us-naval-presence-in-middle-east-exceeds-peak-of-iran-war-israeli-institute) reported that an Israeli institute stated US air power stationed at land bases in the Middle East is below March levels despite the presence of more than 200 aerial refueling aircraft.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-deployment-uss-theodore-roosevelt-marks-third-carrier-in-middle-east-iran-war) reported that the Navy's USS Theodore Roosevelt strike group joined two other aircraft carriers enforcing a blockade of Iran.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/us-naval-presence-in-middle-east-tops-peak-of-iran-war-israeli-institute-3725689) reported that an Israeli security institute stated the US naval presence in the Middle East exceeds the peak level of the war on Iran in early 2026.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640763/us-vice-president-vows-trump-will-not-let-iran-conflict-become-another-forever-war), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/jd-vance-says-us-will-not-fight-forever-war-with-iran-defends-donald-trumps-military-action/articleshow/135909834.cms), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045146/trump-is-not-going-to-let-iran-conflict-become-a-forever-war-asserts-vance) reported that US Vice President JD Vance stated that President Donald Trump will not allow the conflict with Iran to become a prolonged military commitment or forever war.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219269), a Russian state outlet, reported that Vice President JD Vance stated that President Donald Trump will get the country out of the conflict with great results.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/jd-vance-says-donald-trump-will-end-iran-war-before-2028-rules-out-forever-war-as-third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-101794879757205.html) reported that JD Vance stated Trump will not let the Iran war become a forever war as a third US aircraft carrier reaches the Middle East.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374663/third-us-aircraft-carrier-reaches-middle-east-trump-weighs-iran-options) reported that US Central Command stated in a social media post that a third American aircraft carrier reached the Middle East.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/iran-war-jd-vance-trump-aircraft-carrier-middle-east-b3085980.html) reported that Vice President JD Vance stated Iran will not be a 'forever war' as the USS Theodore Roosevelt and its strike force arrived in the Middle East.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640643/vance-undecided-on-2028-presidential-run-report), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/vance-undecided-on-2028-presidential-run-axios-reports-3725637) reported that US Vice President JD Vance is undecided about a 2028 presidential run.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/uss-theodore-roosevelt-brings-us-carriers-in-middle-east-to-three-3725641), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-us-increases-carrier-presence-in-middle-east-to-3-as-uss-theodore-roosevelt-arrives-in-region-report/) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt entered the US Central Command area, increasing the number of US carrier strike groups in the region to three.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNYmZiWEcxLU9Xck9JR2h3VDIwa1VETmRCam5zQm1BWmhNcGhZS0pBdi1BZGRZLXhZT3VmUG5wYld2N1gydV8teDVFc0UtNVljakJ5Q1JNRkRUb0dqRDRfX0p4QVBGdkZRaWd3Y1J6aFdZWlZhVGt5LWxzcG9mRHVPYnBXZFFrSXVqYXkxd081YzdlNTN1T05yVTgwZUIzSUhQQWc?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/third-american-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-west-asia-as-trump-keeps-options-open-in-iran-war/article71709128.ece) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East, bringing the total number of US aircraft carriers in the region to three.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-the-middle-east-as-trump-keeps-options-open-in-the-iran-war) reported that the flotilla in the Arabian Sea includes 13 destroyers, two cruisers, and a littoral combat ship.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/uss-roosevelt-arrives-in-middle-east-is-the-us-iran-war-about-to-resume?traffic_source=rss) reported that the aircraft carrier USS Roosevelt joined two others operating in the US Central Command area of responsibility.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/16/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-amid-tensions-with-iran?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-iran-says-tankers-hit-mins) reported that a third US aircraft carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, arrived in the Middle East amid tensions with Iran.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/16/iran-escalates-threats-against-us-forces-and-gulf-states-as-third-american-carrier-arrives/) reported that Iran escalated threats against US forces and Gulf states as the carrier arrived.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/podcasts/trending-middle-east/2026/11/16/third-us-aircraft-carrier-reaches-middle-east-death-sentences-over-jordan-attacks-and-lebanon-qatar-gas-talks/) reported that a third US aircraft carrier reached the Middle East alongside death sentences over Jordan attacks and Lebanon-Qatar gas talks.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/2026-11-16/ty-article/reports-third-u-s-aircraft-carrier-deployed-to-middle-east/000001a1-e243-da30-a7fb-faff85dc0000) reported that the deployment of a third U.S. aircraft carrier would bring the American military presence in the Middle East to its highest level since April.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/16/iran-war-live-tehran-warns-it-may-strike-first-before-another-us-attack?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iran warned it would not simply wait for an attack as the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/still-in-state-of-war-says-iran-as-third-us-carrier-arrives-in-west-asia-to-join-blockade-101794793624263.html) reported that three US aircraft carriers are part of a force of more than 20 US Navy ships enforcing a blockade of Iranian ports.
[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4411284) reported that the US aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt is preparing to join American forces deployed in the Middle East.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203212/%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B0%D8%A7-%D9%86%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%81%D9%84%D8%AA/) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt returned to the Middle East to join the USS George HW Bush and USS George Washington already stationed in the region.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/15/iran-war-live-bahrain-nationwide-threat-alert/) reported that Bahrain issued a nationwide threat alert amid Iran attack claims and a Saudi-led coalition intercepting missiles.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-embassy-in-bahrain-issues-security-alert-warns-americans-of-possible-houthi-attacks-101794779378382.html) reported that the US Embassy in Bahrain issued a security alert warning Americans of possible Houthi attacks and urging travelers to stay updated on airport and airline operations.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/uss-theodore-roosevelt-third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-amid-iran-tensions-101794783044980.html) reported that a third US aircraft carrier arrived in the Middle East amid heightened tensions with Iran following claims of strikes on US assets in Bahrain.

reports.text: [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/sanchez-makes-last-bid-beat-right-ahead-spain-election-day.1137811) reported that Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez made a last-minute bid at a final campaign rally in Madrid to beat the right ahead of election day.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/espana-vota-entre-la-bonanza-economica-y-el-malestar-social-vivienda-jovenes-y-vox-seran-claves-en-resultado-entre-sanchez-y-nunez-feijoo-3604746) reported that Spain votes between economic growth and social discontent, with housing, young people, and Vox key to the result between Sánchez and Núñez Feijóo.

[Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/feijoo-busca-a-sevilla-en-su-cierre-de-campana-para-poder-llegar-al-ejecutivo-este-29n/) reported that Alberto Núñez Feijóo chose Seville for his national campaign closing event ahead of the November 29 election.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/rfi/irrupcion-ia-campana-elecciones-espana_1795795464) reported that artificial intelligence is increasingly used in Spain's election campaign to summarize programs or provide voting recommendations.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/sanchez-feijoo-colau-y-abascal-cierran-campana-para-eleccion-en-espana-esperan-lograr-la-victoria/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/elecciones-espana-candidatos-cerraron-campanas-fuertes-llamados-voto-criticas-adversarios_0_2OCLel2krJ.html) reported that candidates Pedro Sánchez, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, Santiago Abascal, and Ada Colau closed campaigns for Spain's election with rallies.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-27/frente-amplio-apela-a-una-remontada-epica-dos-buenas-horas-de-debate-rescatan-dos-semanas-grises-de-campana.html) reported that Ada Colau raised the morale of the left wing in Spain ahead of the election.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/feijoo-gana-debate-cuatro-aventaja-diez-puntos-sanchez-confianza-gobernar_202611276b09ac9f5cb1082f89b6a79b.html) reported that PP leader Feijóo won a four-way debate and led Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez in confidence to govern by 29.7% to 22.7%.

reports.text: [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-apc-apga-stakeholders-unite-for-tinubus-re-election-in-anambra/) reported that APC and APGA stakeholders in Orumba South Local Government Area of Anambra State united to support President Bola Tinubu's re-election.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/apc-chieftain-takes-tinubus-renewed-hope-agenda-to-ondo-communities/) reported that a grassroots development initiative for the Renewed Hope agenda was launched across Ondo State communities.

[The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/lokpobiri-akpe-others-intensify-mobilisation-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that Bayelsa State Deputy Governor Peter Akpe, Minister of State for Petroleum Resources Heineken Lokpobiri, and other leaders intensified mobilization for President Bola Tinubu's re-election.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/nwokos-supporter-injured-during-apc-primary-dies/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Senator Ned Nwoko announced that a supporter injured during the APC Delta North senatorial primary has died.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-ex-niger-delta-militants-join-tinubus-re-election-mobilisation-in-ondo/) reported that ex-Niger Delta militants joined the campaign for the re-election of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu in Ondo state for 2027.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/makinde-accuses-tinubu-of-politicising-deep-seaport-approvals-questions-timing/) reported that Oyo State Governor and APM presidential candidate Seyi Makinde criticised President Bola Tinubu over the timing of deep seaport approvals.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-ondo-senator-urges-apc-members-to-unite-for-tinubus-re-election/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Ondo North senator Jide Ipinsagba urged APC members to unite for President Bola Tinubu's 2027 re-election.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/zulum-mourns-two-apc-supporters-killed-in-road-crash/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Borno Governor Babagana Zulum mourned two APC supporters killed in a Biu-Damaturu road crash while en route to a Maiduguri rally, with 11 others injured.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-to-terrorists-bandits-now-is-your-chance-to-lay-down-arms/) reported that President Bola Tinubu renewed his call on terrorists and bandits to lay down their arms and renounce violence.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-to-terrorists-bandits-this-is-your-window-to-surrender-now-lay-down-your-arms/) reported that President Bola Tinubu challenged terrorists and bandits to surrender their weapons and abandon violence during an APC rally in Borno State.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/17-die-25-injured-in-zamfara-road-crash-frsc/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Federal Road Safety Corps confirmed 17 people died in a road crash at Kisami village along the Gummi-Daki Takwas-Anka Road.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamfara-govt-suspends-campaign-after-road-crash/) reported that the Zamfara government suspended campaign activities in Maru Local Government Area following the accident.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/zamfara-frsc-confirms-death-of-15-people-while-returning-from-maru-campaign-flag-off/) reported that the Federal Road Safety Corps Zamfara State Command confirmed the death of 15 people in a fatal car crash while returning from the Maru campaign flag-off.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/927635-makinde-accuses-apc-of-importing-supporters-for-tinubus-rally-orders-fumigation.html) reported that Mr Makinde alleged during a live radio programme that the APC mobilised supporters from neighbouring states to attend Saturday's rally.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/omo-agege-attack-makinde-campaign-accuses-apc-of-political-violence-2/) reported that the Makinde campaign alleged opposition parties suffered attacks in Sokoto, Kebbi, Edo, Lagos, Cross River, Kaduna, and Kano states.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/24/apc-campaign-council-engages-media-highlights-tinubus-reforms-ahead-of-2027/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council engaged media practitioners in Lagos.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/927466-talata-mafara-agog-as-lawal-flags-off-apc-campaign-in-zamfara.html) reported that the rally brought together major APC stakeholders in the state, including the Director General of the Tinubu/Shettima Presidential Campaign Council.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-apc-flags-off-presidential-guber-campaign-in-zamfara/) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Zamfara State has flagged off its presidential and gubernatorial campaign ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742975-2027-elections-tragedy-15-apc-supporters-die-death-disclosed-party-takes-action/) reported that the Zamfara APC postponed its Maru rally after a road accident killed 15 supporters travelling to a campaign event.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742948-breaking-apc-campaign-turns-bloody-members-die-road-accident/) reported that over 10 APC members died in a road crash after attending a governorship election campaign launch.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927545-15-apc-supporters-killed-27-injured-in-zamfara-road-crash-party-postpones-rally.html) reported that 15 APC supporters died and 27 others were injured in a road crash in Zamfara, according to the FRSC.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/gombe-community-seeks-justice-for-three-killed-by-air-force-personnel/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Lawanti Community Development Foundation demanded an independent probe and prosecution regarding the alleged killing of three residents by Air Force personnel in Gombe.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/926947-enugu-apc-suspends-campaigns-over-finance-directors-death.html) reported that the Enugu State APC suspended campaigns following the death of its finance director Festus Oshaba-Onuh.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/three-killed-13-injured-as-military-residents-clash-in-gombe/) reported that three people were killed and 13 others injured following a clash between the military and residents in Gombe.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/edu-assures-kebbi-women-of-better-days-mobilises-support-for-tinubu/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council Women Mobilisation Directorate, led by Dr Betta Edu, assured Kebbi women of better days and mobilised support for Tinubu.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/926754-apc-campaign-finance-director-dies-in-road-crash.html) reported that Festus Onuh, chairman of Ferotex Construction Company Ltd and an APC campaign finance director, died in a road accident while travelling along Port Harcourt.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/several-injured-vehicles-damaged-as-suspected-thugs-attack-apc-campaign-convoy-in-gombe/) reported that five campaign buses conveying All Progressives Congress supporters were vandalised and several members sustained injuries after suspected thugs attacked an APC campaign convoy in Gombe.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/gombe-apc-chairman-campaign-dg-flown-to-abuja-after-accident/) reported that Gombe State APC Chairman Mohammed Dantata Ndus and the campaign director-general were flown to Abuja after an accident in which two persons died.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-radda-warns-katsina-voters-against-irresponsible-politicians/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Katsina Governor Dikko Radda urged Kankia voters to back the APC, Tinubu, and party candidates in 2027.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/926268-gov-lawal-inaugurates-campaign-council-says-the-mission-to-rescue-zamfara-is-in-progress.html) reported that Zamfara State Governor Lawal inaugurated a campaign council to strengthen the party and build on good governance.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/pdp-delegation-visits-injured-apc-leaders-at-gombe-hospital/) reported that a Gombe State Peoples Democratic Party delegation visited injured APC leaders at a Gombe hospital.

[The Chronicle (Ghana)](https://thechronicle.com.gh/radda-warns-against-419-politicians-as-supporters-rally-for-apc/) reported that Katsina State Governor Malam Dikko Umaru Radda urged voters to reject 419 politicians in the 2027 general elections.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-approves-establishment-of-inland-dry-port-in-kebbi/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu approved the establishment of an inland dry port in Kebbi State following a request by Governor Nasir Idris.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/tinubu-courts-kebbi-support-for-2nd-term-approves-inland-dry-port/) reported that President Bola Tinubu wooed Kebbi voters with development pledges, including approval for an inland dry port.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/1-killed-6-injured-in-road-crash-involving-gombe-apc-leaders/) reported that one person was killed and six others injured in a road accident involving Gombe State APC leaders.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nnorth-east/925953-terrorists-disrupt-apc-campaign-in-borno.html), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741914-just-terrorists-disrupt-apc-campaign-borno-details-emerge/) reported that suspected terrorists launched mortar bombs and IED attacks targeting the campaign team of Mohammed Mungono in Borno State.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/kebbi-apc-rally-tinubu-approves-dry-inland-port-for-kebbi-seeks-support-for-apc-in-2027/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-approves-kebbi-inland-dry-port-promises-completion-of-landmark-projects-improved-security/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/at-apc-presidential-rally-in-birnin-kebbi-tinubu-approves-inland-dry-port-for-kebbi/) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved the operationalisation of the Tsamiya Inland Dry Port in Kebbi State.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/two-die-gombe-apc-chairman-campaign-dg-injured-in-crash/) reported that Gombe State Chairman of the All Progressives Congress Mohammed Dantata Ndus and the director-general of the party's 2027 governorship campaign were injured in a vehicle crash while two people died.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-apc-supporters-throng-kebbi-stadium-for-tinubus-rally/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu's presidential rally in Kebbi State attracted a massive crowd of APC supporters and party loyalists.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/17/kebbi-state-ready-to-receive-tinubu-for-presidential-campaign-launch-info-commissioner/) reported that the Kebbi State Government, the All Progressives Congress, and state residents declared readiness to receive President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for the presidential campaign launch.

reports.text: [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-voters-register-shrinks-to-100m-after-inec-removes-1-6m-records/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission removed more than 1.6 million invalid, duplicate, and deceased persons records from the supplementary voters register, bringing the total to 100 million.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611250546.html), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/atiku-at-80-tinubu-advocates-politics-without-bitterness-celebrates-arthur-eze-at-78/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu congratulated Prince Arthur Eze on his 78th birthday.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/inecs-verified-voters-register-exceeds-100-million-says-amupitan/) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash O. Amupitan stated that the commission's verified voters' register exceeds 100 million.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/24/2027-actionaid-challenges-inec-over-voter-register-errors-result-transparency/) reported that ActionAid Nigeria challenged the Independent National Electoral Commission to account for errors in the voters' register.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927454-2027-politics-watch-atikus-withdrawal-denial-tinubus-lagos-turnout-push-seraps-suit-against-inec.html) reported that Atiku Abubakar rejected claims that he had quit the presidential race and Bola Tinubu urged greater voter mobilisation.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/rep-dasuki-inec-under-amupitan-has-worst-voter-data/) reported that House of Representatives Deputy Minority Leader Abdussamad Dasuki raised alarm over the poor state of the Independent National Electoral Commission's voter data.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-under-amupitan-has-worst-voter-data-compromised-register-could-jeopardise-2027-election-rep-dasuki/) reported that Deputy Minority Leader Dasuki stated that compromised voter registers could jeopardise the 2027 election.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/serap-drags-inec-data-protection-commission-to-court-over-alleged-ai-fraud-in-voters-register/) reported that SERAP filed a lawsuit against the National Data Protection Commission and INEC over alleged artificial intelligence fraud in the voters' register.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/serap-sues-ndpc-inec-over-ai-manipulation-of-voters-register/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that SERAP sued NDPC and INEC at the Federal High Court in Abuja seeking an independent probe into AI-generated photos and possible data breaches in the voters' register.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-voter-register-row-sparks-electoral-manipulation-fears/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/serap-sues-ndpc-inec-over-alleged-ai-manipulation-of-voters-register/) reported that AI-generated photos in INEC's preliminary voter register sparked concerns, leading SERAP to file a lawsuit against the National Data Protection Commission and INEC.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/inec-backs-code-for-independent-tabulation-of-2027-election-results/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission endorsed a voluntary Code of Conduct for independent tabulation and publication of election results.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926632-atiku-asks-inec-to-open-ai-system-for-independent-audit-ahead-of-2027-elections.html) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar asked INEC to open its AI system for an independent audit ahead of the 2027 elections.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-must-open-ai-system-to-independent-audit-atiku/) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar demanded an independent audit of INEC's artificial intelligence system.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/2027-independent-results-tabulation-cant-replace-statutory-collation-inec-declares/) reported that INEC declared independent results tabulation cannot replace statutory collation.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-atiku-demands-scrutiny-of-inecs-ai-system-for-processing-election-results/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/atiku-demands-independent-audit-of-inecs-ai-system-ahead-of-2027-elections/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742321-2027-elections-atiku-challenges-inec-reveal-ai-technology-source-code/) reported that former Vice President Atiku Abubakar demanded that INEC submit its proposed artificial intelligence system for processing election results to independent scrutiny.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/n11-2tr-opaque-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-military-budget-ndc/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council accused President Bola Tinubu's administration of prioritising opaque spending on a pipeline security bill.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/ndc-raises-the-alarm-over-voter-register-demands-nationwide-audit-by-inec/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council raised concerns over the integrity of the Independent National Electoral Commission and demanded a nationwide audit.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndc-alleges-voter-register-inflation-demands-probe-of-n11-2trn-nnpcl-funds/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress raised concerns over the credibility of the 2027 general elections and the handling of public funds.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925913-2027-inec-proposes-code-to-regulate-independent-result-tabulation.html), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170671.html) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission proposed a code of conduct to regulate independent election result tabulation ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-makinde-campaign-faults-tinubu-over-federal-recruitment-freeze/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/makinde-campaign-slams-tinubu-over-recruitment-embargo/) reported that Seyi Makinde's Allied Peoples Movement Presidential Campaign Organisation criticised President Bola Tinubu over a federal recruitment freeze.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925987-makinde-campaign-group-criticises-tinubu-over-federal-governments-recruitment-freeze.html) reported that Mr Makinde's campaign organisation stated that the employment restriction would worsen Nigeria's high unemployment rate.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ndc-alleges-n11-2trn-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-military-budget/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/ndc-tinubus-n11-2trn-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-twice-defence-budget/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress accused President Bola Tinubu's administration of presiding over an opaque N11.2 trillion pipeline security bill and demanded a forensic audit.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/924782-makindes-campaign-group-demands-probe-of-tinubus-n11-2trn-crude-oil-backed-loans.html) reported that Makinde's campaign group demanded that the federal government disclose lenders, amounts borrowed, interest rates, management fees, and repayment terms for Tinubu's N11.2trn crude oil-backed loans.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/account-for-n11-2-trillion-crude-oil-advance-sale-mdpco-challenges-tinubu/) reported that the Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation challenged President Bola Tinubu's administration to account for the N11.2 trillion crude oil advance sale.

reports.text: [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047533/seven-terrorists-killed-in-bannu-operation) reported that security forces killed seven terrorists during an intelligence-based operation in the Shoikhel area of Bakakhel tehsil in Bannu district.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1587623/sho-martyred-in-di-khan-firing-12-terrorists-killed-in-balochistan/) reported that Station House Officer Kamran Mehsud was killed in a firing incident in Dera Ismail Khan, and 12 terrorists were killed in Balochistan.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047181/security-forces-kill-12-india-sponsored-terrorists-in-multiple-ibos-in-balochistan-ispr) reported that security forces killed 12 India-sponsored terrorists in four separate intelligence-based operations in Balochistan between November 20 and 23.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pakistan-security-forces-kill-9-terrorists-in-separate-operations-in-bannu-and-lakki-marwat-101795597503171.html) reported that Pakistani security forces killed nine terrorists in separate operations in Bannu and Lakki Marwat.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641813/two-policemen-among-five-injured-in-lakki-marwat-ied-blast), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/five-injured-in-ied-blast-targeting-police-van-in-lakki-marwat/) reported that an IED blast targeting a police van in Lakki Marwat injured five people, including two police personnel.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585273/15-terrorists-killed-in-major-mastung-security-operations/) reported that security forces killed 15 terrorists in two intelligence-based operations in Balochistan's Mastung district under Operation Radd-ul-Fitna 3.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/blow-to-fitna-al-hindustan-as-pakistani-forces-gun-down-15-terrorists-in-balochistans-mastung/) reported that Pakistani security forces eliminated 15 Fitna al-Hindustan terrorists in two back-to-back operations in Balochistan’s Mastung district.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045905/police-foil-major-terror-attack-in-kps-lakki-marwat-claim-suspected-suicide-bomber-killed) reported that Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police stated they foiled a major terrorist attack in Lakki Marwat district and killed a suspected Afghan-origin suicide bomber.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/security-forces-kill-22-indian-proxy-terrorists-in-kp-operations/) reported that security forces killed 22 terrorists belonging to Fitna-Al-Khwarij in multiple engagements in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583633/another-cop-martyred-in-bannu-four-terrorists-killed-in-lakki-marwat/) reported that a constable was kidnapped and later killed by unknown armed men in the Bannu district on Wednesday.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640998/four-terrorists-killed-during-police-operation-in-lakki-marwat), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583393/four-terrorists-killed-in-lakki-marwat-police-operation/) reported that four suspected terrorists were killed during a police operation in Lakki Marwat after an exchange of fire.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/blow-to-ttp-as-pakistani-forces-gun-down-43-militants-in-kp-operations-ispr/) reported that Pakistan's security forces eliminated 43 militants in intelligence-based operations across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa according to ISPR.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640081/security-forces-kill-31-terrorists-in-balochistan-operations-ispr) reported that security forces killed 31 terrorists in a Balochistan operation according to ISPR.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044260/security-forces-kill-74-terrorists-during-ibos-in-khyber-pakhtunkhwa-balochistan-ispr) reported that ISPR stated security forces killed 74 terrorists during intelligence-based operations in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.

reports.text: [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/trabuco-chega-a-fazenda-felicissimo-e-acreditando-na-forca-da-relacao-com-lula.ghtml) reported that Luiz Carlos Trabuco arrived at the Finance Ministry expressing strong confidence in his relationship with Lula.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/miriam-leitao/post/2026/11/transicao-tranquila-deve-facilitar-chegada-de-trabuco-ao-comando-da-fazenda.ghtml) reported that the transition regarding Luiz Carlos Trabuco taking command of the Ministry of Finance is expected to be smooth.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxQU1lWSFNZVHRVSi1Dbm12NWtCT3RhaERTUnNHN3U1RHR2aHVXbzc5N2hCdGxIbkpINnRTZm85aElGWU1BOElob1p2cTd3anNkOGdlQ05rVktpX1F6RDM3WUxfZDg5czNCZi1wODMySzZsNlRULVBaN0RhOWlrSllDVHlvTERqV2F4eWxwYUc1Mm5VVm1kdVFZYVhMNXAzdHY0?oc=5) reported that Lula's choice of a Bradesco banker as Brazil's finance minister lifted markets.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/quien-es-luiz-carlos-trabuco-el-filosofo-que-estara-al-frente-de-la-economia-de-brasil-en-el-cuarto-nid27112026/) reported that 75-year-old banker Luiz Carlos Trabuco accepted the position of economy minister for Brazil's fourth term under Lula.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7326487-haddad-parabeniza-escolha-de-trabuco-para-o-ministerio-da-fazenda.html) reported that former minister Fernando Haddad congratulated Luiz Carlos Trabuco on his selection for the Ministry of Finance and emphasized combining fiscal adjustment with social rights.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/fabio-graner/post/2026/11/trabuco-e-durigan-devem-ir-juntos-a-almoco-anual-da-febraban-em-primeiro-ato-da-transicao-na-fazenda.ghtml) reported that current Finance Minister Dario Durigan and his designated successor Luiz Carlos Trabuco plan to attend the annual Febraban lunch together as part of the transition.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/sonar-a-escuta-das-redes/post/2026/11/flavio-e-nikolas-ironizam-lula-apos-acerto-com-trabuco-para-fazenda-virou-faria-limer.ghtml) reported that Senator Flavio Bolsonaro mocked Luiz Carlos Trabuco's selection to lead the Ministry of Finance.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/bela-megale/post/2026/11/a-reacao-de-palocci-a-escolha-de-trabuco-como-ministro-da-fazenda-do-lula-4.ghtml) reported that former Finance Minister Antonio Palocci and various productive and financial sectors praised Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's choice of Banco Bradesco chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco as Finance Minister.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/miriam-leitao/post/2026/11/como-o-mercado-deve-reagir-a-confirmacao-de-trabuco-na-fazenda.ghtml) reported that speculation about Luiz Carlos Trabuco's possible appointment to the Ministry of Finance caused the Ibovespa index to close with a 6.07% gain.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/27/trabuco-o-filosofo-banqueiro-veja-por-que-o-novo-ministro-da-fazenda-e-conhecido-assim-no-setor-financeiro.ghtml) reported that future Finance Minister Luiz Carlos Trabuco is known in the financial sector as the 'banker philosopher' after more than 50 years dedicated to Bradesco.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/euforia-brasil-bolsa-san-pablo-subio-6-expectativa-nuevo-ministro-hacienda-lula-poderoso-banquero_0_JgB35WDyTv.html), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/brazils-lula-appoints-private-banker-as-finance-minister/article71749184.ece), [MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/27/lula-picks-banker-luiz-carlos-trabuco-to-run-the-finance-ministry-in-his-fourth-term?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva appointed Banco Bradesco chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco as Finance Minister.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/miriam-leitao/post/2026/11/lula-ja-brincou-que-trabuco-preferiu-ficar-no-bradesco-a-assumir-pasta-no-governo-dilma-salario-de-ministro-nao-e-essas-coisas.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva recalled that Luiz Carlos Trabuco previously declined a ministerial post in Dilma Rousseff's government.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/26/alexandre-gluher-assume-presidencia-do-conselho-do-bradesco-apos-ida-de-trabuco-para-a-fazenda.ghtml) reported that Alexandre Glüher is expected to assume the chairmanship of Bradesco's board after Trabuco moves to the Ministry of Finance.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/26/ajuste-fiscal-endividamento-e-estatais-sao-desafios-de-novo-ministro-da-fazenda-de-lula.ghtml) reported that Luiz Trabuco faces challenges including fiscal adjustment, indebtedness, and state-owned enterprises as the new finance minister.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-25/chris-bowen-disappointed-at-cop31-result-geopolitics/107427460) reported that Australian Minister for Energy and Climate Change Chris Bowen discussed how disputes over the words fossil fuels derailed the UN Climate Summit.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/environment-and-climate-change/article-915941) reported that for the first time since 2009, the annual UN climate summit ended without an agreement after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked references to fossil fuels.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/the-collapse-of-un-climate-talks-over-fossil-fuels-was-years-in-the-making-101795378453783.html) reported that the collapse of UN climate talks over fossil fuels was years in the making.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532429/UN-climate-talks-break-down-over-bitter-disagreements-on-fossil), a state-media outlet, reported that the COP31 climate conference in Antalya collapsed after countries failed to agree to an overarching deal.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/21/climate-talks-stall-countries-mull-showdown-saudi-arabia-over-fossil-fuels), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/environment/2026/11/21/cop-31-climate-talks-stall-as-countries-mull-showdown-with-saudi-arabia-over-fossil-fuel-phase-out/) reported that the Cop31 climate talks reached a standstill as governments failed to agree on the transition to renewables, fossil fuel phaseouts, and aid.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/small-island-nations-demand-urgent-climate-action-at-un-talks-as-stakes-rise/articleshow/135952884.cms) reported that small island nations are calling for emissions cuts and seeking 700 million dollars for resilience at climate negotiations.
[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1113/1599060-climate-cop-funding/) reported that a group of small island states aims to create a climate fund backed by a charge on remittances from abroad.

reports.text: [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/28/2027-aro-mobilises-kogi-west-for-tinubus-re-election-cites-security-ajaokuta-revival-road-projects/) reported that APC senatorial candidate for Kogi West, Hon. [Punch](https://punchng.com/kwara-gov-fagbemi-others-meet-aggrieved-apc-members/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Kwara Governor Abdulrazaq, Lateef Fagbemi, and other APC chieftains met with aggrieved members to resolve internal rifts ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/lokpobiris-ministerial-role-strengthens-tinubus-2027-chances-in-bayelsa-deputy-gov/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Bayelsa Deputy Governor Peter Akpe stated Heineken Lokpobiri’s ministerial role and Federal Government ties will boost Tinubu’s re-election bid in the state.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611270172.html) reported that Kwara State Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq led the All Progressives Congress campaign train to Kwara South to flag off the campaign and roll out achievements.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/kwara-apc-flags-off-electioneering-urges-members-to-vote-for-all-its-candidates/) reported that the All Progressives Congress flagged off its 2027 campaign in Kwara South district.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/20/tinubu-2027-yari-urges-igbo-to-turn-economic-strength-into-political-influence/) reported that APC Presidential Campaign Council Director-General Senator Abdul'aziz Yari urged the Igbo people to turn economic strength into political influence.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742340-us-court-convict-popular-pastor-assassination-late-president/) reported that an ADC chieftain disclosed Atiku Abubakar's plan to speak on the controversial $16bn power funds and privatization under Olusegun Obasanjo.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742347-atiku-allegedly-sold-shares-intel-dubai-property-2027-election/) reported that President Bola Tinubu's camp disclosed a list of properties and investments Atiku Abubakar allegedly sold to fund his 2027 presidential election campaign.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kaduna-apc-flags-off-2027-campaign-inaugurates-council/) reported that the Kaduna State All Progressives Congress flagged off its presidential and gubernatorial campaign and inaugurated its campaign council.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/plateau-apc-campaign-council-moves-to-unite-party-ahead-of-2027-polls/) reported that the Plateau State chapter of the All Progressives Congress intensified preparations for the 2027 general election.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-apc-chieftain-urges-tinubu-yari-to-unite-kano-party/) reported that APC chieftain Aminu Shehu Sharada appealed to Tinubu and Yari to unite the party in Kano ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/atiku-cant-claim-25m-northern-votes-when-his-son-supports-tinubu-george/) reported that George questioned whether the African Democratic Congress could convince Nigerians it had a plan.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-anambra-apc-inaugurates-350-member-campaign-council/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Anambra APC inaugurated a 350-member campaign council led by Azuka Okwusa to mobilise support for Tinubu and party candidates ahead of the 2027 elections.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-apc-inaugurates-anambra-campaign-council-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that the Anambra State chapter of the All Progressives Congress inaugurated its campaign council for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's reelection bid.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741002-apc-support-group-targets-15-million-votes-tinubu-kano-2027/) reported that an APC support group inaugurated coordinators across Kano's 44 local government areas targeting votes for Tinubu and other candidates.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndc-campaign-council-fires-back-says-apc-spreading-agbero-politics-nationwide/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council accused the APC of exporting 'agbero' politics nationwide.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/december-15-for-hearing-in-kano-governors-divorce-suit/) reported that an Upper Area Court in Abuja fixed December 15 for a hearing in the divorce suit filed against Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf by his estranged wife.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741994-breaking-court-takes-action-gov-yusuf-kwankwasos-daughter/) reported that the Upper Area Court in Abuja issued a statement regarding the divorce saga of Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf and his wife Zainab.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741945-atiku-campaign-aide-reacts-kano-governor-divorce-controversy/) reported that an Atiku campaign aide criticised Kano Governor Abba Yusuf over his public divorce announcement and dismissed claims linking Kwankwaso to the marriage crisis.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/court-adjourns-kano-governors-divorce-case-to-december-15/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Upper Area Court in Gudu District, Abuja, adjourned the divorce case involving Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf and his second wife till December 15.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/c6zxvd27e9lvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-gov-confirms-divorce-from-kwankwasos-niece-hints-at-remarrying/) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf confirmed his divorce from Zainab Musa Kwankwaso and thanked citizens for advice regarding marriage.

reports.text: [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/27/by-putins-logic-russia-should-go-back-to-mongolia-belarus-lukashenka-says) reported that Belarusian leader Alexander Lukashenka stated medieval history cannot justify territorial claims since Russian lands were once under Mongol rule.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91306) reported that Ukraine received the bodies of 250 people whom Russia claims were Ukrainian servicemen.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/d90d6f1c0ad1), a state-media outlet, reported that the Kremlin stated European Union funding for Ukraine would make Kyiv less willing to engage in peace efforts.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2225171), a Russian state outlet, reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Russia and Ukraine may hold a prisoner swap soon without specifying a date or number of people.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/26/russia-and-ukraine-hold-first-exchange-of-war-dead-since-rebooted-peace-talks-a812378) reported that Russia returned 250 bodies to Ukraine and received 22 fallen Russian soldiers in exchange.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064711/) reported that US Special Envoy Jared Kushner stated an upcoming prisoner exchange between Ukraine and Russia will allow thousands of people to return home.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649364-kushner-ukraine-proxy-war-russia/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that US presidential envoy Jared Kushner described the Ukraine conflict as a proxy war between Europe and Russia.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224967) reported that according to Jared Kushner, it is important to focus on post-conflict security architecture.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91182) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated a European team will take part in the next round of negotiations to end the war in Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064649/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91197) reported that presidential chief of staff Kyrylo Budanov stated a prisoner of war exchange involving up to 1,000 people could take place in late November or early December.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223555), a Russian state outlet, reported that German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated a new round of Ukraine talks could take place in Abu Dhabi soon.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90507977) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged allies to convene four-party peace talks with Europe, the United States, and Russia.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/new-ukraine-talks-including-europe-to-be-held-soon-merz/a-79997961?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated European leaders could take part in fresh Ukraine talks on neutral ground.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90616) reported that the Kremlin stated a prisoner exchange with Ukraine is in its final stages of coordination.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/europe-expects-to-join-new-ukraine-peace-talks-soon-says-merz-101795114233588.html) reported that Friedrich Merz stated Europe expects to join new Ukraine peace talks soon.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063293/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90390) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine is preparing a major prisoner swap following US-mediated talks.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648830-europe-delegation-ukraine-talks/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that European leaders agreed on a delegation for potential Ukraine peace talks.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90125) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that US envoys brokered an agreement with Moscow to exchange 1,200 to 1,300 POWs.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90103) reported that US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner began preparing for what could become the largest prisoner exchange since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-12/Russia-Ukraine-agree-on-prisoner-swap-but-no-peace-breakthrough-1S0oBdFA3pm/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that trilateral talks involving Russia, the United States, and Ukraine ended in Abu Dhabi with an agreement on a prisoner swap but no peace breakthrough.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-13-kushner-says-us-working-toward-largest-prisoner-exchange-of-russias-war-in-ukraine/) reported that Jared Kushner stated Russia and Ukraine agreed to expand the next round toward the largest prisoner exchange of the war.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/kushner-largest-prisoner-exchange-russia-ukraine-war-nears) reported that Jared Kushner's remarks followed Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy welcoming news of European presence at US-brokered peace talks.

reports.text: [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1090178/video-snazno-nevrijeme-pogodilo-mostar-ulice-pod-vodom-moguc-nestanak-struje) reported that a severe storm hit Mostar, leaving streets underwater and risking power outages and structural damage.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Izdato-narandzasto-upozorenje-zbog-vjetra/993640), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/udari-vjetra-do-75-kilometara-na-sat-izdato-narandzasto-upozorenje/) reported that an orange weather warning was issued in Bosnia and Herzegovina due to southern winds with gusts from 55 to 75 kilometers per hour.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089372/snazno-nevrijeme-poharalo-bih-voda-preplavila-saobracajnice-vjetar-rusio-stabla-odroni-ugrozili-vozace-vise-gradova-ostalo-bez-struje), [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Nevrijeme-izazvalo-probleme-sirom-BiH-Vjetar-odnio-krov-drvo-palo-na-vozilo/993372) reported that a severe storm with strong winds and heavy rain caused floods, downed trees, power outages, and damage across parts of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/olujni-vjetar-poharao-dijelove-bi-h-mjesta-ostala-bez-struje-stizu-prvi-detalji/) reported that a stormy wind battered parts of Bosnia and Herzegovina, leaving places without power.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/banjaluka/Jako-nevrijeme-u-Banjaluci-Kisa-pljusti-olujni-vjetar-polomio-drvo/993305) reported that a severe storm accompanied by strong wind gusts and heavy rain struck Banja Luka.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vremenska-prognoza/rhmz-se-oglasio-novim-upozorenjem-uskoro-stize-orkanski-vetar-jacine-110kmh/tm86eyx) reported that Serbia issued an urgent warning for severe weather expected during evening hours, with the Republic Hydrometeorological Institute forecasting hurricane-force winds up to 110 kilometers per hour.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089219/olujni-vjetar-zahvata-bih-u-narednim-satima-ocekuju-se-olujni-i-orkanski-udari-vjetra-do-90-kilometara-na-sat) reported that stormy and hurricane-force wind gusts reaching up to 90 kilometers per hour are affecting Bosnia and Herzegovina, with heavier rain expected in Herzegovina and the south.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Stizu-pljuskovi-i-olujni-vjetar-RHMZ-izdao-upozorenje-za-Republiku-Srpsku/993168) reported that the Republic Hydrometeorological Institute issued a warning for the Republika Srpska regarding strong to stormy winds with powerful gusts in certain areas.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1088771/meteorolozi-upozorili-veceras-stizu-olujni-udari-juga-tokom-noci-ocekuje-se-kisa-sirom-bih) reported that meteorologists warned that stormy southern wind gusts will arrive, with rain expected across Bosnia and Herzegovina during the night.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/u-narednim-satima-u-bi-h-stizu-olujni-udari-vjetra-ocekuje-se-i-kisa/) reported that BH Meteo issued warnings for upcoming stormy wind gusts and rain in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/nauka-tehnologija/okolina/Toplo-ali-varljivo-Danas-u-BiH-udari-vjetra-do-70-kmh-uvece-stize-kisa/992743) reported that temperatures in Bosnia and Herzegovina would reach 19 degrees with southerly wind gusts up to 70 kilometers per hour, followed by evening rain.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/ekonomija/trziste/Ispunjeni-uslovi-da-gorivo-u-BiH-dodatno-pojeftini-Kada-stizu-nove-cijene/992635) reported that experts stated conditions are met for additional price drops for fuel in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1088468/olujni-udari-juga-stizu-u-bih-poznato-kada-ce-vjetar-biti-najjaci) reported that stormy southerly wind gusts are arriving in Bosnia and Herzegovina, with the strongest winds expected on Tuesday and Thursday.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/bi-h-ceka-velika-promjena-vremena-nakon-obilne-kise-i-olujnog-juga-stize-snijeg/) reported that Bosnia and Herzegovina is expecting a weather change from warm temperatures and stormy southerly winds to snow.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Nevrijeme-stize-u-BiH-Olujni-vjetar-do-90-kmh-obilna-kisa-i-snijeg/992176) reported that meteoalarm issued warnings for winds up to 90 km/h, heavy rain in Herzegovina, and snow in higher elevations.

reports.text: [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/cik-bi-h-ovjerio-kandidatske-liste-za-izbor-delegata-u-dom-naroda-pf-bi-h/) reported that Bosnia and Herzegovina's Central Election Commission verified candidate lists for the election of delegates to the House of Peoples of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina from five cantonal assemblies.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1091471/video-u-toku-sjednica-predsjednistva-sda-donosi-se-odluka-o-premijeru-federacije-bih) reported that a session of the SDA Presidency is underway to decide on the Prime Minister of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/skupstina-kantona-sarajevo-prekinula-sjednicu-sljedece-sedmice-o-izboru-delegata-za-dom-naroda-fbih/261127128) reported that the Sarajevo Canton Assembly suspended its session after electing new leadership, with the continuation expected next week.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/bih/sarajevo/1091423/davor-cicic-novi-predsjedavajuci-skupstine-kantona-sarajevo-institucije-drzave-bih-su-svetinja) reported that newly elected Sarajevo Canton Assembly chairman Davor Čičić stated that the institutions of the state of Bosnia and Herzegovina are sacred.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/danas-nastavak-sjednice-skupstine-kantona-sarajevo-bira-se-rukovodstvo/261127021) reported that the continuation of the constituent session of the Sarajevo Canton Assembly was scheduled to elect assembly leadership and delegates for the House of Peoples.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/poznato-je-16-od-23-delegata-u-klubu-srba-doma-naroda-fbih-nijedan-blok-nema-potrebnih-11-potpisa/261126252) reported that 16 of the 23 delegates in the Serb Caucus of the House of Peoples of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina Parliament are known before cantonal assemblies finished voting.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/iz-tuzlanskog-kantona-izabrano-9-delegata-za-dom-naroda-fbih-jednog-iz-reda-hrvata-odredit-ce-zrijeb/261126157), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1091204/skupstina-tk-izabrala-devet-delegata-za-dom-naroda-pfbih-izmedju-kandidatkinje-df-a-i-nip-a-ce-odlucivati-zrijeb) reported that the Tuzla Canton Assembly concluded voting procedures to elect delegates to the House of Peoples of the Parliament of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/da-li-je-postignut-dogovor-sutra-nastavak-sjednice-skupstine-kantona-sarajevo/261126179) reported that Democratic Front deputy Albin Zuhrić stated a agreement was reached at a meeting of parties represented in the Sarajevo Canton Assembly, with the session continuing tomorrow.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1091258/odrzan-nastavak-konstituirajuce-sjednice-skupstine-bpk-gorazde-izabrani-delegati-u-dom-naroda-parlamenta-fbih) reported that the continuation of the constituent session of the Bospod-Podrinje Canton Goražde Assembly was held, electing delegates to the House of Peoples of the Federation Parliament.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/djurdjevic-stamenkovski-vucic-ne-bi-izgubio-izbore-da-je-formirao-pokret-za-narod-i/vhnlyty) reported that technical Minister for Labour Milica Djurdjevic Stamenkovski stated Aleksandar VuciC should discover who in his ranks opposed a past move.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-za-informer-stigla-je-vest-na-koju-smo-upozoravali-dve-godine-dobili-smo/6yyfkvf) reported that Aleksandar Vučić gave an interview from the National Assembly after taking the function of head of the parliamentary group.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089532/cetiri-elektora-iz-reda-ostalih-naroda-izabrana-u-narodnoj-skupstini-rs) reported that four electors from the ranks of other peoples were elected in the National Assembly of the Republika Srpska following voting by municipal and city assembly councilors.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Izabrani-ad-hok-elektori-za-izbor-delegata-u-Vijece-naroda/993429), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/izabrani-elektori-iz-reda-ostalih-za-izbor-delegata-u-vijece-naroda-rs/261120190) reported that ad hoc electors were chosen in the National Assembly of the Republika Srpska to participate with national deputies in electing delegates to the Council of Peoples.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/zastupnici-skupstine-kantona-10-polozili-zakletvu-slijedi-izbor-rukovodstva/) reported that deputies of the Canton 10 Assembly took their oaths of office ahead of leadership elections.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/ovo-su-savjetnici-becirovica-cvijanovic-i-filipovic-u-predsjednistvu-bih/261118104) reported that the official website of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina published the names of cabinet chiefs and advisers for Denis Bećirović, Željka Cvijanović, and Željko Komšić.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/nenad-stevandic-ce-i-u-naredne-cetiri-godine-biti-predsjednik-narodne-skupstine-rs-a/261116117), [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Nenad-Stevandic-novi-stari-predsjednik-Narodne-skupstine-Republike-Srpske/992589) reported that Nenad Stevandić was re-elected as president of the National Assembly of Republica Srpska for another four-year term.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Pocela-konstitutivna-sjednica-Narodne-skupstine-Republike-Srpske/992561) reported that the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Republika Srpska began.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/u-ponedjeljak-konstituirajuca-sjednica-predsjednistva-bih-becirovic-cvijanovic-i-filipovic-zapocinju-mandat/261115077) reported that the constitutive session of the new convocation of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina is scheduled for Monday in Sarajevo.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1087725/konstituirana-skupstina-bpk-gorazde-za-predsjedavajuceg-izabran-muradif-kanlic-sbb-njegove-zamjenice-branka-cvijetic-perspektiva-i-berina-fejzic-bns), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/konstituisan-novi-saziv-skupstine-bpk-gorazde-kanlic-predsjedavajuci-fejzic-i-cvijetic-zamjenice/261113237) reported that the new convocation of the Bosnian Podrinje Canton Goražde Assembly was constituted, with Muradif Kanlić elected as chairman.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1087643/video-zastupnici-u-skupstini-usk-preuzeli-mandate-nastavak-sjednice-naredne-sedmice) reported that deputies in the Una-Sana Canton Assembly took over their mandates with the continuation of the session scheduled for next week.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/bih/sarajevo/1087577/pocela-konstituirajuca-sjednica-skupstine-ks), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/pocela-konstituirajuca-sjednica-skupstine-kantona-sarajevo-zastupnici-ce-preuzeti-certifikate-za-novi-mandat/261113033) reported that the constitutive session of the Sarajevo Canton Assembly began at the Center Municipality hall.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/bih/sarajevo/1087586/konstituisan-novi-saziv-skupstine-kantona-sarajevo-za-mandatni-period-2026-2030), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/konstituisan-novi-saziv-skupstine-kantona-sarajevo-zastupnici-preuzeli-mandate/261113040) reported that the new convocation of the Sarajevo Canton Assembly was constituted after deputies collected their mandate certificates.

reports.text: [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/une-grace-totale-absolue-et-inconditionnelle-les-images-de-donald-trump-graciant-freedom-et-feathers-pour-thanksgiving-20261125) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump pardoned two turkeys named Freedom and Feathers on November 24 at the White House for Thanksgiving.

[De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/deze-kalkoenen-krijgen-een-presidentieel-pardon-van-trump-freedom-en-feathers-ontsnappen-aan-braadpan/165063093.html) reported that Freedom and Feathers are the turkeys receiving a presidential Thanksgiving pardon from Donald Trump.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-melania-turkey-pardoning-thanksgiving-b3090991.html) reported that Donald Trump gave the Presidential Medal of Freedom to Rudy Giuliani in a closed-door ceremony.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOR1JmVGVGUE9ZaW9JMnNkLTZtbm9oSFhJZl9wY0RDM0VwUVhrNWNrWmhFZzNGVW9XazlVcFFoTkdGZjAxLXpYN1VSb1lhU01OSzc0czhMbXI4RDhJZW9JdXAtNGZXNW8yUU16M3N6VnBDWGIyUGFTcXFBZDh0RW1Qc0w3eEMtX3RzOE1DcWU5SjZWUXhxb1FDeTAxTQ?oc=5) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump will offer Thanksgiving pardons for turkeys Freedom and Feather at the White House.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/us-forms-special-team-to-stop-air-traffic-control-outages-before-thanksgiving-3725890) reported that the White House formed the Transportation Technology Transformation Tiger Team after a malfunction grounded flights across the country.

reports.text: [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/28/ogun-2027-senator-adeola-yayi-commends-judiciary-on-victory-over-hunye/) reported that Senator Solomon Adeola commended the judiciary on his victory over Hunye regarding his APC governorship candidacy in Ogun State.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-bauchi-apc-reps-candidate-promises-equitable-projects/) reported that Bauchi All Progressives Congress House of Representatives candidate Abdullahi Sirajo Jibrin promised equitable projects.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ogun-2027-court-dismisses-hunyes-suits-against-adeolas-apc-candidacy/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abeokuta dismissed two suits filed by Abayomi Semako Hunye challenging Senator Solomon Adeola's APC governorship candidacy.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/yayi-hails-judiciary-over-victory-in-ogun-apc-governorship-case/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ogun-2027-yaksco-hails-court-judgement-affirming-yayis-apc-guber-candidacy/) reported that Senator Solomon Adeola and the Yayi-Kudirat Students Campaign Organisation commended the judiciary after a Federal High Court in Abeokuta dismissed suits challenging his APC governorship candidacy.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/27/owo-ose-reps-seat-supreme-court-confirms-arobo-as-apc-candidate/) reported that the Supreme Court dismissed legal challenges against Abdulghani Arobo, confirming him as the All Progressives Congress candidate for the Owo/Ose House of Representatives seat.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-ebonyi-pdp-gov-candidate-promises-180000-jobs/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Ebonyi PDP governorship candidate Ifeanyi Odii promised to create over 180,000 jobs through agriculture, mining, and manufacturing if elected in 2027.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ondo-supreme-court-affirms-arobo-as-apc-reps-candidate-for-owo-ose/) reported that the Supreme Court affirmed the judgment directing the Independent National Electoral Commission to recognize Mr. Arobo as the APC House of Representatives candidate for Owo/Ose.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-pdps-odii-unveils-five-point-agenda-promises-180000-jobs-for-ebonyi/) reported that Ebonyi State PDP governorship candidate Chief Ifeanyi Chukwuma Odii promised 180,000 jobs under his newly unveiled agenda.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ebonyi-ndc-candidate-says-apc-defector-was-never-his-running-mate/) reported that the Ebonyi State Nigeria Democratic Party denied that Uka Chris Ndubuisi was ever its deputy governorship candidate.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-oyo-ndc-governorship-candidate-rules-out-stepping-down-for-other-parties/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress governorship candidate in Oyo State, Akim Yusuf, ruled out stepping down for other parties.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ypp-sues-inec-apc-over-farouk-mustaphas-eligibility-as-bauchi-deputy-guber-candidate/) reported that the Young Progressives Party filed a legal battle against Farouk Mustapha, the running mate in the Bauchi State gubernatorial election.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/courts-rule-on-adc-guber-candidacy-in-ogun-oyo/) reported that the Supreme Court affirmed Dr Biodun Collins Ogundipe as the governorship candidate of the African Democratic Congress in Ogun for the 2027 general elections.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/928050-nec-appeals-ruling-ordering-adebutua-inclusion-in-2027-ogun-governorship-election.html) reported that INEC filed a notice of appeal asking the Court of Appeal to review the ruling ordering the commission to recognize Adebutu as the PDP candidate.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/25/supreme-court-revelation-resign-now-or-be-impeached-adc-tells-tinubu/) reported that the African Democratic Congress called on President Bola Ahmed Tinubu to immediately resign from office or face impeachment.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/25/ogun-2027-supreme-court-affirms-collins-ogundipe-as-adc-governorship-candidate/) reported that the Supreme Court affirmed Dr. Bisi Collins Ogundipe, also known as BCO, as the African Democratic Congress governorship candidate.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/wike-saved-pdp-from-soothsayers-naysayers-bauchi-pdp-guber-candidate/) reported that the gubernatorial candidate of the Nyesom Wike-backed faction stated Wike saved the PDP.

[The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/2027-pdp-dissociates-self-from-opposition-coalition-warns-against-name-use/) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party dissociated itself from an opposition coalition and warned against using its name.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/namadi-flags-off-apc-campaign-in-27-jigawa-lgas/) reported that Jigawa State Governor Malam Umar Namadi flagged off the All Progressives Congress campaign across the state's 27 local government areas.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ogun-pdp-deputy-guber-candidate-installed-akinkanju-of-egbaland/) reported that Ogun State Peoples Democratic Party Deputy Governorship Candidate Hajia Yemi Sowunmi-Kolapo was installed as the Akinkanju of Egbaland.

reports.text: [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxNZWFVdkpOdEtyNFRuWXp6LS1YWHJRYWxWblotV29FdlJiMVlwcWJyUmVWM0lOTV9OemxJbzV5OWUyUmFEd1lDY0xsMTRfSVNqSG5qTGJGRG15NG9rVWZzQTl1UXdzZUtKeWtSamRfSi11ZUlUdlhQa2N6MkxZTkIwbEI1MEgzUWhZNHRtdEMtbTBoRFlVaTVvSkExT3d3S1ZPd2pybzdXMXVNMVU?oc=5) reported that Mexico's government slammed a DEA crime tip line as foreign interference.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/video/podcast/sheinbaum-acusa-injerencia-de-eu-por-lineas-de-denuncia-de-la-dea-tu-dia-con-el-universal/) reported that Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum accused the U.S. of interference over the DEA's creation of telephone and communication lines to report criminal activities.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/dea-responde-en-dos-minutos-mensajes-de-whatsapp-sobre-funcionarios-corruptos-en-mexico-periodista-de-sinaloa-usa-la-linea/) reported that the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration responded within two minutes to WhatsApp messages sent to its tip line regarding corrupt officials in Mexico.

reports.text: [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/banka-postanska-stedionica-objavila-koliko-trenutno-novca-ima-na-bankomatima/k71jfzg) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica carried out 139 ATM replenishments to ensure network functioning and cash availability ahead of the holiday.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/u-srbiji-novi-pritvori-u-slucaju-izvlacenja-novca-iz-alta-banke/) reported that new detentions were ordered in Serbia in connection with the extraction of money from Alta banka.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/oglasio-se-mup-o-hapsenju-brata-vlasnika-alta-banke/zl9yp1z) reported that the Ministry of Internal Affairs arrested Dubravko Macura for allegedly taking money from the treasury vault and giving it to the Alta bank owner.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Nova-hapsenja-u-slucaju-Alta-banke-MUP-otkrio-kako-je-navodno-izvlacen-novac/994442) reported that three more people were arrested in connection with abuses at Alta bank.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/isplata-depozita-alta-banke-postanska-stedionica-isplatila-185-miliona-evra/ew3067m) reported that Banka Postanska stedionica paid out about 185 million euros, which is more than half of the total insured funds of Alta banka in bankruptcy.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/postanska-stedionica-prodala-deo-drzavnih-obveznica-i-povecala-dinarsku-likvidnost/5pqkgbh) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica confirmed the acceptance of its bid to sell part of the government bonds of the Republic of Serbia at an early repurchase auction.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/dva-fonda-intesa-invest-izlozena-u-alta-banci-direktor-otkrio-sta-su-ga-prvo-pitali/14wn1n1) reported that Intesa Invest funds had a cumulative exposure of less than 1 percent toward Alta banka according to executive director Srdjan Maletic.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/isplata-depozita-alta-banke-slobodno-jos-14200-termina/5p87ptf) reported that over 25,000 depositors of bankrupt Alta banka scheduled an appointment through the Banka Poštanska štedionica portal to collect insured deposits.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/banka-postanska-stedionica-raspoloziva-gotovina-na-9872-odsto-bankomata/jb7rzys) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica announced available cash was confirmed on 98.72 percent of ATMs.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/postanska-stedionica-isplatila-vise-od-sedam-odsto-osiguranih-depozita-klijentima/6rqnc0h) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica continued the payout of insured deposits to Alta banka clients using funds provided by the Deposit Insurance Agency.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/rusi-cekaju-isplatu-novca-iz-alta-banke-kupili-smo-stanove-a-novac-stoji-na-racunu/5gz25z4) reported that the beginning of insured deposit payouts to bankrupt Alta banka clients brought relief to many savers while creating uncertainty for those with funds on accounts tied to apartments.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/postanska-stedionica-isplatila-sve-zakazane-klijente-alta-banke-prvog-dana-nastavak-i/6q0l3ml) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica announced it paid out all scheduled clients of Alta banka on the first day of insured deposit payouts despite a system failure.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/banka-postanska-stedionica-produzen-rad-zbog-isplate-depozita-alta-banke-termin/4mt6466) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica extended working hours for branches handling insured deposit payouts to Alta banka clients, with 16,450 clients having scheduled appointments.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/biznis/finansije/pocela-isplata-osiguranih-depozita-klijentima-alta-banke-u-srbiji/261113085) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica began paying out insured deposits to clients of Alta banka in Serbia after its operating license was revoked.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/pocela-isplata-osiguranih-depozita-u-alta-banci-prijavilo-se-14-419-klijenata/) reported that 14,419 clients applied for payouts up to 50,000 euros per depositor.
