reports.text: [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/poznato-ko-ce-sve-izaci-na-predsednicke-izbore-osim-radomira-saicica/9jlfqvq) reported that academic and Chemistry Faculty professor Radomir Sajcic will be the candidate of the student movement in the December 27 presidential elections.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Milanovic-razgovarao-sa-Cupicem-otkrio-da-je-pratio-sjednicu-Skupstine-Srbije/994595) reported that Croatian President Zoran Milanović stated after meeting acting Serbian National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić in Ohrid that he advocated for better relations.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/poznato-ime-kandidata-studentske-liste-za-predsjednika-srbije/), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/misteriozne-poruke-na-mrezama-otkrile-novog-moguceg-kandidata-za-predsednika/sy9yrzq) reported that social media messages indicated potential candidates for the Student List in the upcoming presidential elections in Serbia.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Mediji-Radomir-Saicic-kandidat-Studentske-liste-za-predsjednika-Srbije/994424) reported that National Assembly President Aleksandar Cupic scheduled presidential elections for December 27 and media indicated Radomir Sajcic is the Student List candidate.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/privreda/program-studentske-liste-za-turizam-nova-pravila-za-vaucere-stan-na-dan-i-subvencije/5e790bx) reported that the Student List program for tourism proposes new rules for vouchers, apartment rental taxes, and the suspension of state funds for hotels on Zlatibor and Kopaonik, focusing instead on eastern Serbia and the Danube.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-sam-sedi-u-poslanickim-klupama-opozicije-otkrio-razlog/byvw2em) reported that Serbian Progressive Party parliamentary group head Aleksandar Vučić remained sitting alone in opposition benches after a recess in the National Assembly.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-danas-se-raspravlja-samo-jedna-tacka-dnevnog-reda/h73jbdp) reported that the National Assembly continued its constitutive session with a discussion on parliamentary delegations while students observed from the gallery.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/studenti-usli-na-sjednicu-narodne-skupstine-srbije-i-dobili-gromoglasan-aplauz-vucic-ih-ogorceno-posmatrao/261124091) reported that representatives of the Student Movement entered the hall of the National Assembly of Serbia during its session.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/stanovi-aleksandra-cupica-vucic-spominje-milione-evo-sta-kaze-novi-predsednik/mxy5sqb) reported that Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić criticized the statement of National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić regarding property ownership.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/cupic-najavio-konsultacije-oko-formiranja-skupstinskih-odbora/s6ggxg7) reported that National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić announced consultations regarding the formation of parliamentary committees ahead of the continuation of the constitutive session.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/u-utorak-nastavak-konstitutivne-sednice-skupstine-srbije/m21fnxe) reported that the constitutive session of the National Assembly will continue on Tuesday, November 24.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/rastislav-dinic-i-zoran-lutovac-komentarisali-odluku-studentske-liste-o-skupstini/qrz2vqg) reported that the fact that the Student List did not give any parliamentary vice-president position to either the SNS or minority parties has been a topic of discussion for days.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-za-pevnicom-u-crkvi-u-raski-povodom-slave-arandjelovdan/qp0bsvm) reported that National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić attended a liturgy in Raška and sang church songs with believers.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-sastao-sa-sefom-delegacije-eu-u-srbiji-foto/64zqtng) reported that the EU Delegation's charge d'affaires in Serbia, Julian Vassallo, met with newly elected National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/kosta-cestitao-cupicu-imenovanje-za-predsednika-skupstine/txwtk3m) reported that European Council President António Costa congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his appointment as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/pogledajte-sta-je-aleksandar-cupic-radio-dan-nakon-izbora-za-predsednika-skupstine/4x82b6x) reported that newly elected National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić removed graffiti with students the morning after his election.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/nesvakidasnja-scena-ispred-skupstine-srbije-cupic-zapevao-sa-poslanicima/ryqtxrj) reported that the new president of the National Assembly of Serbia, Aleksandar Čupić, sang outside the parliament building with gathered citizens and deputies.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/studenti-odgovorili-na-dodikovu-cestitku-novom-predsjedniku-skupstine-srbije-sreca-pa-ne-zaboravljamo/261120039) reported that students from Serbia responded to Milorad Dodik's congratulatory message to the new president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089376/izglasano-sest-potpredsjednika-narodne-skupstine-republike-srbije) reported that six vice presidents of the National Assembly of Serbia were elected, with all functions going to deputies of the Student List "Students win".

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/obratili-se-predstavnici-studentske-liste-nakon-sednice-skupstine-medju-njima-i-cupic/86s66k5) reported that Student List representatives held a press conference after the constituent assembly session, where Čupić stated he would be the president of all deputies.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Cupic-objavio-imena-kandidata-za-potpredsjednike-Skupstine-Srbije/993285) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, president of the National Assembly of Serbia, read the names of candidates for six vice presidents during the continued constituent session.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/stevandic-prvi-cestitao-novom-predsjedniku-skupstine-srbije-pozvao-ga-da-dode-u-nsrs/261119159) reported that Republika Srpska National Assembly President Nenad Stevandic congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his election as president of the National Assembly of Serbia and invited him to visit.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089228/ko-je-aleksandar-cupic-profesor-koji-je-ugostio-studente-u-plasteniku-a-danas-vodi-skupstinu-srbije) reported that Aleksandar Čupić is a faculty assistant professor who was proposed by student representatives.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/zvanicnici-crne-gore-cestitali-cupicu-izbor-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/x5h5s39) reported that officials of Montenegro congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his election as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Aleksandar-Cupic-novi-predsjednik-Narodne-skupstine-Republike-Srbije/993241) reported that Aleksandar Čupić was elected as the new president of the National Assembly of the Republic of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/prvi-govor-aleksandra-cupica-kao-predsednika-skupstine/8d6lsk9), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089225/novi-predsjednik-skupstine-srbije-odrzao-prvi-govor-izvinio-se-pastoru-i-lidiji-vukicevic) reported that newly elected Serbia National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić delivered his first parliamentary speech and apologized to Lidija Vukićević and Bálint Pásztor.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089177/treci-dan-konstitutivne-sjednice-skupstine-srbije-zastupnici-biraju-predsjednika-parlamenta) reported that the National Assembly session continued for its third day to choose a parliament president.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sandzacka-demokratska-partija-podrzala-cupica-za-predsednika-skupstine/d8q6zev) reported that the Sandžačka demokratska partija announced that its deputy Dženan Palamar will support the candidate Studentski for the president of the Assembly in tomorrow's vote.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/zavrsen-i-drugi-dan-zasjedanja-skupstine-srbije-vucic-moze-pricati-jos-10-dana/) reported that the second day of the National Assembly session concluded without electing a parliamentary president and will continue on Thursday.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/potpuni-haos-na-kraju-dana-u-skupstini-srbije-vucic-pobjesnio-uslikaj-ih-sve-zapisi-ih-sve/261118290) reported that the session ended in uproar with Aleksandar Vučić demanding individuals be recorded and photographed.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucica-provocirao-novinar-pitanjem-o-bratu-andreju-dobio-zestok-odgovor-video/85h9d7t), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/tenzije-u-holu-skupstine-srbije-vucic-izgubio-nerve-nesreco-sram-te-bilo/) reported that tensions occurred in the lobby of the National Assembly involving Aleksandar Vučić and a journalist.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/vucic-rekao-da-ga-poslanik-studentske-liste-seksualno-uznemirava-ja-nisam-od-tih-imate-tu-kolega-drugih-koliko-hocete/261118157), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088957/video-vucic-tvrdi-da-ga-poslanik-studentske-liste-seksualno-uznemirava-nemam-nista-protiv-tih-ljudi-ali-nisam-od-njih) reported that Aleksandar Vučić told Studentska lista deputy Zlatko Kokanović during a session of the National Assembly not to send him kisses, alleging sexual harassment.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-o-sednici-skupstine-svojoj-imovini-i-vucicu/9tdz2vx) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, a candidate for president of the National Assembly from the Student List, announced plans to submit a property report following a parliamentary session where Aleksandar Vučić spoke for five hours.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/kamberi-sda-ce-glasati-za-aleksandra-cupica-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/0lg50wn) reported that MP Shaip Kamberi stated the SDA will vote for Aleksandar Čupić as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/oglasili-se-studenti-o-govoru-jugoslava-gasica-u-skupstini-srbije/wj1j0ls) reported that students from the Faculty of Media and Communications reacted on social media to criticism directed at Student List MP Jugoslav Gašić.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Skupstina-Srbije-nastavila-sjednicu-Minut-cutanja-za-pilota-Vucic-ponovo-govori/993001), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-bakic-sef-poslanicke-grupe-studentske-liste-bira-se-predsednik/dv39qz9) reported that the National Assembly of Serbia held a minute of silence for Serbian Air Force pilot Goran Bulajić during its constitutive session.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sara-valentik-studentska-lista-ocekujem-efikasniju-skupstinu-nakon-izbora-predsednika/4r7ggv4) reported that Student List youngest MP Sara Valentik stated she expects a more efficient National Assembly of Serbia following the election of a new parliament president.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Ko-je-Jovo-Bakic-novi-sef-poslanicke-grupe-Studentske-liste/992989) reported that Jovo Bakić, a 56-year-old sociology professor at the Faculty of Philosophy in Belgrade, became the head of the Student List parliamentary group in the new National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/nastavak-konstitutivne-sednice-novog-saziva-skupstine-srbije/dv39qz9) reported that members of the 15th parliamentary session of the National Assembly of Serbia continued their constitutive session with discussions on candidates for assembly president.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/jovo-bakic-otkrio-ko-je-kandidat-studentske-liste-za-potpredsednika-skupstine-srbije/lhpd4cq) reported that Jovo Bakić, head of the Student List parliamentary group, held a press conference to reveal the candidate for vice president of the National Assembly.

reports.text: [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/oyo-guber-makinde-picked-me-as-successor-out-of-love-for-oyo-adekanmbi-apm-candidate/) reported that Allied Peoples' Movement governorship candidate in Oyo State Bimbo Adekanmbi stated that Governor Seyi Makinde backed his emergence as a successor.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nafiu-bala-to-begin-presidential-campaign-news-week-eyes-atiku-for-dg/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-nafiu-bala-to-kick-off-campaign-wants-atiku-as-dg/) reported that former Deputy National Chairman of the African Democratic Congress Nafiu Bala announced he will begin his presidential campaign next week and expressed interest in having Atiku as director-general.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/nafiu-bala-to-begin-presidential-campaign-next-week-considers-atiku-for-dg/) reported that former African Democratic Congress deputy national chairman Nafiu Bala announced plans to begin his presidential campaign and consider Atiku Abubakar for director-general.
[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611260246.html) reported that a video from an APM event in Nigeria was falsely shared as a rally for ADC presidential aspirant Atiku Abubakar.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-atiku-appoints-bashir-adamu-as-jigawa-adc-campaign-coordinator/) reported that African Democratic Congress presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar appointed Bashir Adamu Kazaure as the Jigawa campaign coordinator.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928004-adc-postpones-jigawa-presidential-campaign-rally.html) reported that the ADC postponed its Jigawa presidential campaign rally to allow time to prepare for presidential candidate Atiku.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611250548.html) reported that Nigerian President Tinubu congratulated African Democratic Congress Presidential Candidate Atiku Abubakar on his 80th birthday.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/oyo-2027-i-wont-step-down-for-anyone-adc-guber-candidate-vows/) reported that African Democratic Congress governorship candidate in Oyo State Adegboyega Adegoke dismissed rumours that he plans to withdraw from the race.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-how-we-plan-to-present-a-common-front-adc-apm-ndc-sdp/) reported that major opposition parties pledged to present a common front to wrest power from the APC ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742472-breaking-drama-court-sacks-adc-governorship-candidate/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-court-sacks-adc-governorship-candidate-in-adamawa/) reported that a Federal High Court in Abuja ordered the removal of Tukur Ribadu as the ADC Adamawa governorship candidate.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-tinubu-atiku-obi-in-us-lobbying-controversies/) reported that a widening row over American lobbying activities embroiled President Bola Tinubu, Atiku Abubakar, and Peter Obi.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/us-strategist-denies-4-5m-payment-for-tinubu-interview/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that American political strategist Diana London denied receiving 4.5 million dollars from the Nigerian government or anyone else in the country.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nigeria-is-uss-greatest-ally-in-africa-american-strategist-says-as-tinubu-grants-interview-to-london/) reported that American political strategist Diana London described Nigeria as the United States' greatest ally in Africa.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-pcc-asks-inec-to-postpone-mock-accreditation-faults-irev-plan/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-faults-inec-over-short-notice-for-mock-accreditation-exercise/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/adc-pcc-demands-postponement-of-inecs-november-28-mock-accreditation-exercise-alleges-bias/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council asked the Independent National Electoral Commission to postpone its mock accreditation exercise, citing short notice and alleging bias.

reports.text: [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611230163.html) reported that Cape Verde's elections were loud while its voters are increasingly silent.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/21/jose-maria-neves-e-reeleito-presidente-de-cabo-verde-com-quase-64percent-dos-votos.ghtml) reported that Cape Verde's National Electoral Commission confirmed the re-election of President Jose Maria Neves for a second five-year term with nearly 64 percent of the vote.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Cape-Verde-s-incumbent-president-declares-re-election-victory-1S7pTVdY97q/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that Cape Verde's incumbent president received 80,018 votes, or 63.8 percent, with nearly 97 percent of polling stations reporting.

[Le Pays (Burkina Faso)](https://lepays.bf/victoire-du-president-sortant-au-cap-vert-ces-defis-qui-attendent-jose-maria-neves/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves was elected without surprise in the first round with nearly 64 percent of the vote.

[AMAP (Mali)](https://amap.ml/2026/11/16/cap-vert-le-president-sortant-jose-maria-neves-en-tete-avec-pres-de-64-des-voix/), [Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/international/infos-afrique/cap-vert-le-president-sortant-jose-maria-neves-reelu-pour-un-second-mandat/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves won re-election with 63.8 percent of the vote.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/16/cape-verdes-president-neves-projected-to-win-re-election-with-64-of-vote/) reported that preliminary results based on 98 percent of counted ballots showed incumbent President Jose Maria Neves won re-election with 64 percent of the vote.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNcWxnVEpfWXdSVkNERnExVXJGbFJzUW5MTFR3MEtGWHBYMFZWZkZHRldTal9oLS00VnJQdnM1MmNJVkhkRFlkVjJEYjVMLWo4Tk5xUzV1OG9Xa1BxYUdmZ3FSaVp5Q0htZGYwcFpZSFZCYnFrR0szX1FRRk1yNHcteXRWWkpvZkFvck5scnFydzRnME55WktPVngxTklNSWxwVUl5Z3B3TWJHZVQwNDY0NG5CbGNuNmphV0o4?oc=5), [Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/africa/cape-verde-president-neves-wins-second-term--5672296) reported that challenger Joana Rosa conceded defeat in the Cape Verde presidential election.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jos-maria-neves-re-elected-president-of-cape-verde-for-second-five-year-term-101794809266807.html) reported that José Maria Neves was re-elected for a second five-year term in a campaign focused on jobs for young people.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648895-cape-verde-president-wins-second-term/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that provisional results show Cape Verdean President Jose Maria Neves won a second presidential term.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261116-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-au-cap-vert-jos%C3%A9-mar%C3%ADa-neves-rempile-pour-un-second-mandat-de-cinq-ans) reported that provisional results from the presidential election in Cape Verde gave incumbent President Jose Maria Neves a victory for a second five-year term in the first round.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Istorijski-izbori-Zelenortska-Ostrva-dobijaju-prvu-predsjednicu/992509), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/zelenortska-ostrva-bi-mogla-dobiti-prvu-predsjednicu-od-nezavisnosti-1975/261115164) reported that presidential elections were held in Cape Verde, with former justice minister Joana Rosa running as a candidate to potentially become the first female head of state since independence in 1975.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cape-verde-election-jose-maria-neves-set-to-win-second-term/a-79952606?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/afrique/article/2026/11/16/au-cap-vert-jose-maria-neves-reelu-president-des-le-premier-tour_6811072_3212.html) reported that provisional results showed incumbent President Jose Maria Neves won a second term in office, winning over 63% of the vote in the first round.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/15/presidential-polls-open-in-cape-verde-with-first-female-candidate/) reported that presidential polls opened in Cape Verde with incumbent Jose Maria Neves favored to win a second term.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQUWI3OGxfWTRxVTVMY3diaEZFMWZmRlZGYnZ0dnJKSzZqYjN4U2xmMTIyMVJ4U3QxcnI1VEVSblhZck40NTZCaGVhamRFQ2l0VDZnNXhYLTRTRUNRSDNqVW9FQ2pHZXRfQzNQOUEzRG9vaU82Q094M2J0eGo4T3N3QWdadEVmQ3BJR3FPRGNHUXdmcWpWcWItVl9LVERRUQ?oc=5) reported that Cape Verde voted in an election with emigration in focus.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNNEZaaVg2di1CeGcyQlpLZjBmeHpaYXQ5YTRGMk8xM0NyZkVtSmFuX2d1ckFqOExOMVhmbzk4U0lEYk96VVd3OENPVTd6bERTNTJDQl8tR3ZxS2JZX2xER3JfSHdCRF9JQkxLMm11bnFTYmN1LUN4R3lfRy15MmJsSS04VUEzX183SDFYSVFDaHJIaTJFT1VQeHljX2FFbkYwV0hmY1VB?oc=5) reported that Cape Verde voted in an election that could yield its first woman president since independence in 1975.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/cabo-verde-polls-open-neves-favored-rosa-challenger/) reported that voting is underway in Cabo Verde with President José Maria Neves favored among six candidates, and a potential run-off scheduled for 29 November.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/cape-verde-heads-to-the-polls-in-presidential-election), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/polls-open-in-cape-verde-in-race-with-first-female-presidential-candidate?traffic_source=rss) reported that voters in Cape Verde went to the polls for a presidential election where incumbent President José Maria Neves faces opposition candidates including Joana Rosa.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261115-cape-verde-could-make-election-history-with-first-female-president), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cape-verde-could-elect-first-woman-president-since-gaining-independence-in-1975/article71704206.ece) reported that six candidates are competing in the presidential election, which could result in the nation's first female president.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-13-cape-verde-president-eyes-new-term-as-party-builds-on-legislative-win/) reported that Cape Verde President Jose Maria Neves is expected to win a second term in office.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/cape-verde-presidential-election-neves-seeks-second-term/) reported that the island nation off the coast of Senegal is regarded as one of Africa's strongest democracies.

reports.text: [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/morena-defiende-sobrerrepresentacion-legislativa-pide-aplicar-reglas-vigentes-de-cara-a-elecciones-del-2027/) reported that Morena defended calculating legislative overrepresentation limits by party rather than coalition.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/anaya-no-descarta-que-el-pan-se-abstenga-de-participar-en-eleccion-2027-pide-al-ine-resolver-contra-sobrerrepresentacion-de-morena/) reported that PAN legislators will await the electoral body's decision before announcing new measures against overrepresentation.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/el-nuevo-giro-por-la-orden-final-del-tps-venezolano-y-por-que-el-gobierno-retiro-su-pedido-de-nid24112026/) reported that the government withdrew its request for suspension before the Supreme Court regarding the final order for Venezuelan TPS, leaving Judge Chen's order suspended until seven days after the appeals court sentence.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/jucopo-en-san-lazaro-niega-retraso-en-convocatoria-para-renovar-presidencia-del-ine-pide-al-tribunal-desechar-demanda-del-pan/) reported that Jucopo in San Lázaro denied delays in the call to renew the INE presidency and asked the Tribunal to dismiss the PAN lawsuit.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/acusa-morena-presuntos-desvios-millonarios-en-gobierno-de-samuel-garcia-33279581) reported that Morena filed a complaint alleging millionaire embezzlements and irregularities in Samuel García's government in Nuevo León.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/monreal-niega-omision-legislativa-para-renovar-la-presidencia-del-ine-pide-esperar-fallo-del-tepjf/) reported that the president of Jucopo stated the Chamber of Deputies already responded to the appeal promoted by National Action and it is now up to the Tribunal to resolve the matter.

reports.text: [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191088/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%B7-%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%AC%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%A5%D9%84%D8%B2%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that Hamas called on mediators and concerned parties to intervene to stop Israeli crimes and bind the occupation government to implement the Gaza agreement.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204466/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%AB-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%84-%D8%A2%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%AE%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Hamas political bureau head Khalil al-Hayya stated the movement is holding discussions with Palestinian factions to examine mechanisms for handling Israeli violations in Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190998/%D8%B2%D9%82%D9%88%D8%AA-48-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%B6%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%87%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B3%D9%8A) reported that Gaza Medical Relief director Bassam Zaqout warned that 48 percent of illness cases in Gaza are caused by respiratory diseases due to winter and deteriorating health conditions.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190961/%D8%A8%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%BA%D8%B1%D9%82-1000-%D9%85%D9%88%D9%82%D8%B9-%D9%88%D9%85%D8%AE%D9%8A%D9%85-%D9%84%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B2%D8%AD%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%AE%D9%84-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A) reported that the Union of Gaza Strip Municipalities warned that approximately 1,000 locations, camps, and displaced persons' shelter centers face the risk of flooding and rainwater accumulation during the winter season, and demanded urgent international intervention.

[Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d9%85%d9%86%d8%b8%d9%85%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b5%d8%ad%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b9%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d8%aa%d8%ad%d8%b0%d9%91%d8%b1-4-%d9%81%d8%a6%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1) reported that the World Health Organization warned of seasonal influenza risks and serious health complications leading to death for vulnerable groups.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203937/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%82%D9%8A-%D9%88%D9%81%D8%AF-%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%AB-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin met with Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya in Istanbul to discuss developments in Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190673/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%AB-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B6%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin met with a high-level Hamas delegation led by Khalil al-Hayya to discuss the situation in Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190365/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%AE%D8%A7%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B6%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA) reported that the World Health Organization warned of an increase in antimicrobial resistance threatening routine surgeries and childbirth.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190375/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%AC%D8%A8-%D8%A3%D9%84%D8%A7-%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%88%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D9%8A-%D8%B7%D9%81%D9%84-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%B1%D8%AF-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated an 8-month-old infant died in the Gaza Strip due to the cold.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190322/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%AD%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D9%85%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B6%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%AE%D8%B7%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-) reported that Hamas welcomed a joint statement by the foreign ministers of Britain, Australia, Canada, and Italy regarding the humanitarian crisis in the Gaza Strip.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/202950/%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B8%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/), [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190139/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D9%87%D9%88%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B6%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the World Health Organization warned of an increase in respiratory illnesses among displaced people in Gaza living in flood-prone tent areas.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/lieberman-says-ousting-netanyahu-remains-his-main-goal-3725826) reported that Yisrael Beytenu leader Avigdor Lieberman stated removing caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu remains his priority and ruled out any government that re-elects him.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/eisenkot-netanyahu-must-leave-office/) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot demanded Benjamin Netanyahu's immediate departure and an investigation into allegations that his aides were involved in a school scheme.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-may-have-to-oust-security-chiefs-over-netanyahus-stolen-election-drive/000001a1-e623-d3ad-a5e3-e7fb6aa10000) reported that reports claimed the prime minister's office pushed allegations that Arab parties stole the vote and the Shin Bet chief sought to wiretap Joint List lawmakers.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045063/israeli-leaders-slam-netanyahus-attempted-election-coup) reported that Israeli leaders criticized Benjamin Netanyahu over reports that his office tried to frame Arab-Israeli party members ahead of polls.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/is-israels-opposition-less-right-wing-than-netanyahu?traffic_source=rss) reported that an Israeli government without Prime Minister Netanyahu may be close, but a government without his politics is far less certain.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/joint-list-calls-criminal-probe-netanyahu-after-expose) reported that the Joint List called for a criminal probe into caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following allegations of attempting to falsely incriminate Arab officials ahead of the election.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-17/benjamin-netanyahu-gadi-eisenkot-call-for-investigation/107392590) reported that Gadi Eisenkot demanded an investigation into the Israeli Prime Minister's Office over election fraud claims.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-lapid-accuses-netanyahu-of-attempted-coup-through-targeting-arab-parties-in-israel/) reported that Israeli opposition figure Yair Lapid accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of seeking to stage an attempted coup by targeting Arab parties.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/16/israel-party-chiefs-say-netanyahus-election-fraud-claims-a-coup-attempt/) reported that party chiefs stated Netanyahu's election fraud claims were a coup attempt, while his Likud party denied the claims.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/netanyahu-allies-open-to-unity-government-without-ben-gvirs-party-3725611), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-netanyahu-allies-open-door-to-unity-government-without-ben-gvirs-party-report/) reported that associates of caretaker Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told Gadi Eisenkot's team that Likud would accept a unity government without Itamar Ben-Gvir's party.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/tibi-seeks-criminal-probe-of-netanyahu-over-alleged-election-interference-3725628) reported that Ahmad Tibi called for an immediate police probe into Netanyahu and his office following a Channel 12 investigation.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/16/eisenkot-calls-for-inquiry-into-alleged-netanyahu-role-in-election-day-arrests-of-arab-israeli-activists/), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-calls-for-probe-into-alleged-netanyahu-election-interference-3725614), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-eisenkot-says-netanyahu-threatens-democracy-pledges-probe-into-pms-office-role-in-election/) reported that opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot called for an inquiry into Benjamin Netanyahu's alleged role in election-day arrests of Arab Israeli activists.

[Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/la-corrupcion-en-el-ine-morena-y-su-prisa-por-deslindarse-de-taddei/) reported that presidential approval in Mexico has suffered from wear according to Polls MX data.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/oposicion-israeli-pide-investigar-presunta-manipulacion-electoral-por-oficina-de-netanyahu-33152148), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/eisenkot-acuso-a-netanyahu-de-amenazar-la-democracia-y-pidio-investigar-una-presunta-maniobra-nid15112026/) reported that Israeli opposition figures, including Eisenkot, called for an investigation into alleged electoral manipulation by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office regarding the arrest of Arab activists during elections.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/pan-exige-investigar-presuntas-irregularidades-en-gestion-de-taddei-pide-un-ine-independiente-de-morena/) reported that the PAN party in Mexico presented a factual complaint to the FGR to investigate potential offenses related to public fund management under Taddei.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/oficina-netanyahu-planeo-detener-miembros-partidos-arabes-acusarlos-falsamente-fraude-electoral_202611166afabd97ea8d89799786fb0c.html) reported that a popular Israeli media outlet published information regarding a plan by Netanyahu's office to arrest Arab party members to falsely accuse them of electoral fraud.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-914926) reported that Naftali Bennett urged Gadi Eisenkot's bloc to pressure Haredi parties rather than beg them to join the government.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/netanyahu-ofrece-gobierno-unidad-iran-partidos-arabes-eisenkot-tacha-farol_202611146af8b8ccd3bddc0868b1f4c7.html) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot dismissed Benjamin Netanyahu's offer of a unity government without Arab parties as a bluff.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/netanyahu-pide-a-eisenkot-un-gobierno-de-unidad-ante-iran-que-excluya-a-los-arabes-llama-a-negociar-sin-condiciones/) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu asked Gadi Eisenkot to join a unity government that excludes Arab parties, while the opposition leader dismissed the offer as a bluff.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/mossad-chief-in-washington-as-israel-presses-trump-to-resume-iran-war-report-3725565) reported that Mossad Director Roman Gofman held talks with CIA Director John Ratcliffe in Washington.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/mossad-and-cia-discuss-iran-strategy-in-washington/), a state-run outlet, reported that representatives of Israeli and U.S. intelligence agencies met in Washington to evaluate scenarios regarding a new escalation against Iran.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/eisenkot-acusa-netanyahu-de-promover-racismo-contra-os-partidos-arabes.shtml) reported that Gadi Eisenkot accused Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu of promoting racism against Arab parties.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/eisenkot-accuses-netanyahu-of-racist-campaign-against-israels-arab-minority), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/14/eisenkot-accuses-netanyahu-of-racist-campaign-against-arab-israelis/) reported that prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot accused Benjamin Netanyahu of conducting a racist campaign against Israel's Arab minority.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640257/netanyahu-discusses-possible-resumption-of-attacks-on-iran-with-eisenkot-israeli-media), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/netanyahu-talks-possible-resumption-of-iran-attacks-with-eisenkot-israeli-media-3725556) reported that Israeli media outlets stated Benjamin Netanyahu discussed the possible resumption of attacks on Iran with Gadi Eisenkot.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640178/mossad-chief-visits-washington-as-israel-presses-trump-to-resume-iran-war-report) reported that Mossad chief Roman Gofman met with CIA Director Ratcliffe in Washington and is expected to hold talks with US envoy Witkoff in Miami.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/mossad-chief-visits-us-fears-grow-netanyahu-could-strike-iran-block-eisenkot) reported that Israeli opposition leaders fear Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu could exploit the transition period to reignite the Iran conflict.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217953), a Russian state outlet, reported that Mossad chief Gofman arrived in Washington for consultations on Iran and will meet with CIA Director John Ratcliffe.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/mossad-chief-meets-u-s-officials-to-discuss-iran-as-netanyahu-pushes-for-war/000001a1-d57c-da30-a7fb-ddfd4a810000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914818) reported that Mossad Director Gofman visited Washington, meeting the CIA director while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushed to resume fighting against Iran.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eisenkot-netanyahus-campaign-against-arabs-is-racist-he-says/) reported that prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot accused caretaker Netanyahu of running a racist campaign against Arabs.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/israel-gadi-eisenkot-accuse-benyamin-netanyahou-de-mener-une-campagne-raciste-contre-la-minorite-arabe-20261113), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/13/israel-gadi-eisenkot-denonce-une-campagne-raciste-de-benyamin-netanyahou-contre-la-minorite-arabe_6809358_3210.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot accused Benjamin Netanyahu of conducting a racist campaign against the Arab minority.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/world/middleeast/eisenkot-netanyahu-racism-arabs.html) reported that Eisenkot criticized Netanyahu days after the Israeli leader attacked Arab lawmakers in a speech.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-israels-eisenkot-denounces-racist-hostile-campaign-against-arab-citizens-cites-progress-in-coalition-talks/) reported that Eisenkot cited progress in coalition talks while denouncing the campaign.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914820) reported that Gadi Eisenkot backed MK Elisaf Peretz amid tensions over Arab party involvement in future coalitions.

reports.text: [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1091418/avdo-avdic-iznio-insajderske-informacije-o-akciji-emisar-i-hapsenju-nasera-orica-je-li-zdrale-upozoren-da-se-ne-predaje) reported that Avdo Avdic provided insider information regarding the Emisar action and the arrest of Naser Oric.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/predlozen-pritvor-za-orica-i-ostale-uhapsene-u-akciji-emisar-ceka-se-odluka-suda/) reported that a detention hearing was concluded and a decision is awaited on the prosecution's request for detention for Naser Orić and others arrested in the Emisar action.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Tuzilastvo-trazi-pritvor-za-Dragana-J-Vucicevica-Ceka-se-odluka-suda/994412) reported that the Second Basic Public Prosecution in Belgrade proposed the court order detention for Informer editor-in-chief Dragan J. Vučićević.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/vladimiru-volkovu-bivsem-fudbaleru-partizana-odredjen-kucni-pritvor-sa-nanogicom/j3wjht3) reported that the High Court in Belgrade ordered house arrest with electronic monitoring for former Partizan football player Vladimir Volkov on charges of unauthorized possession of weapons and drugs.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/bratu-vlasnika-alta-banke-odredjen-pritvor-dubravko-macura-ostaje-iza-resetaka/nwbm470) reported that the Higher Court in Belgrade ordered up to 30 days of detention for Dubravko Macura, brother of Alta bank responsible party Davor Macura, on suspicion of abuse of official position.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/hronika/Zatrazen-pritvor-za-Nasera-Orica-Nikolinu-Sljivic-i-druge-uhapsene-u-akciji-Emisar/994246) reported that the prosecution proposed a one-month detention for Naser Orić, Nikolina Šljivić, Mesud and Mustafa Mustafić, and Siniša Derganc.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/zabava/oglasila-se-pevacica-marijana-simonovic-devojka-pavla-bihalija-nakon-hapsenja/cb5w846) reported that singer Marijana Simonović posted on social media following the arrest of her boyfriend Pavle Bihali, leader of the Levijatan movement.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/objavljen-snimak-hapsenja-pavla-bihalija-ostetio-budzet-za-225-miliona-dinara/g8b40g2) reported that Levijatan movement leader Pavle Bihali was led out of a building in a luxury residential complex in Belgrade in handcuffs after being accused of damaging the budget by 22.5 million dinars.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/advanu-kosaricu-odreden-jednomjesecni-pritvor-zbog-sumnje-na-iskoristavanje-djeteta-radi-pornografije/261119166) reported that the Cantonal Court in Sarajevo ordered a one-month detention for Advan Košarić due to suspicion of child pornography.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/sarajevo/tuzilastvo-trazi-pritvor-za-advana-kosarica-zbog-sumnje-na-djeciju-pornografiju/) reported that the prosecutor's office requested detention for Advan Košarić due to suspicion of child pornography.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/patriku-dridu-i-nebojsi-maksimovicu-odredjen-pritvor-do-30-dana/6mrlwdp) reported that the Higher Court in Novi Sad ordered up to 30 days of detention for Patrik Drid and Nebojša Maksimović due to suspected abuse of official position.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/tuzilastvo-trazi-pritvor-za-dekana-patrika-drida-evo-koji-su-razlozi/elrwsh0) reported that the Higher Public Prosecutor's Office in Novi Sad proposed detention for Faculty of Sport and Physical Education dean Patrik Drid and N.M., who are suspected of abuse of official position.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/marko-kricak-saslusan-zbog-sumnje-da-je-mucio-deset-osoba-u-garazi-vlade-srbije/604mwfl) reported that a public prosecutor in Belgrade interrogated Marko Kričak, who is suspected of abusing and torturing ten individuals in a garage belonging to the Serbian government, while the prosecution requested custody.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/slucaj-ubistva-na-dolac-malti-tuzilastvo-ks-trazi-pritvor-za-emila-semira-tahirovica-i-njegovog-oca/261115055), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/za-emila-semira-tahirovica-i-njegovog-oca-zatrazeno-odredivanje-pritvora/), [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/hronika/Traze-pritvor-za-sina-i-oca-nakon-ubistva-u-Sarajevu/992464) reported that the Canton Sarajevo Prosecutor's Office requested a one-month detention order from the Canton Court in Sarajevo for Emil Semir Tahirović and his father.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/osumnjiceni-za-ubistvo-na-dolac-malti-emil-semir-tahirovic-i-njegov-otac-predati-tuzilastvu-ks/261114085) reported that Emil Semir Tahirović, suspected of murdering security guard Mehmed Smječanina, and his father were handed over to the Canton Sarajevo Prosecutor's Office.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/tuzilastvo-trazi-pritvor-za-radeta-bastu/m54g0jf) reported that the Higher Public Prosecution Office in Belgrade proposed a detention period of up to 30 days for Rade Basta, who is suspected of damaging Belgrade power utility JKP Beogradske elektrane by 14 million.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/opcinski-sud-u-zenici-petorici-tehnicara-kb-zenica-odreden-pritvor/), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/odreden-pritvor-za-pet-tehnicara-osumnjicenih-za-nasilje-nad-pacijentom/261114046) reported that the Municipal Court in Zenica ordered up to 30 days of detention for five psychiatric technicians from the Zenica Cantonal Hospital suspected of violence against a patient.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/saslusana-gradonacelnica-smedereva-jasmina-vojinovic-tuzilastvo-trazi-pritvor/j5rhmr9) reported that the prosecutor's office requested detention for Smederevo Mayor Jasmina Vojinović, who was interrogated alongside two other individuals.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/pet-tehnicara-psihijatrije-u-zenici-iza-resetaka-tuzilastvo-trazi-pritvor/), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1087719/tuzilastvo-zdk-trazi-pritvor-za-svih-pet-uhapsenih-tehnicara-sa-psihijatrije-kbz-a) reported that the prosecutor's office requested detention for five arrested psychiatric technicians in Zenica following patient abuse.

reports.text: [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/nigeria-targets-africas-maritime-crown-moves-to-reclaim-cargo-lost-to-rival-ports-dantsoho-npa-md/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubus-reforms-transforming-nigerias-ports-dantsoho-npa-md/) reported that Nigerian Ports Authority MD Dantsoho stated Nigeria is stepping up efforts to reclaim cargo passing through neighbouring countries and position itself as Africa’s leading maritime hub.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/28/bakassi-deep-seaport-and-promise-of-new-economic-frontier-for-nigeria/) reported on the Bakassi Deep Seaport and its potential impact on Nigeria's maritime trade beyond the Lagos ports.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/26/nigeria-moves-to-reclaim-maritime-hub-status-with-%e2%82%a61-45trn-lagos-ports-upgrade/), [The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/fg-commences-n1-45trn-port-upgrade-targets-20000-jobs/) reported that the Federal Government commenced a 1.45 trillion naira modernization of the Lagos Port Complex and Tin Can Island Port targeting 20,000 jobs.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/aisce-2026-tinubu-seeks-ai-integration-in-occupational-health-pledges-500m-research-fund/) reported that President Bola Tinubu announced the federal government will unlock a minimum of $500 million annually for research and development.

reports.text: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/17/new-orleans-boat-crash-rescue) reported that first responders and mariners pulled more than 100 people from the Mississippi River following a boat crash in New Orleans.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/15/audio-new-orleans-mississippi-river-cruise-tanker-crash) reported that federal safety investigators recovered audio from the crash and noted the tank vessel suffered sudden steering failure two minutes before the collision.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/new-orleans-boat-crash-captain-b3085338.html) reported that Captain Leonard Stewart of the American Heritage called for help as his ship capsized in the Mississippi River with nearly 200 passengers and crew members.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914927) reported that the Port of New Orleans sued the Chinese-owned tanker Atlantic Asphalt for over $1 million in damages.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwe89y2r5j20o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the New Orleans port filed a $1m lawsuit requesting that the tanker involved in the collision be seized and sold.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/dozens-rescued-from-water-after-cruise-ship-sinks-20261115-p61e7f.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that dozens of people were rescued from the water after a cruise ship sank following a collision with a tanker in New Orleans.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/14/new-orleans-mississippi-river-tanker-crash-lawsuit) reported that New Orleans port officials filed a lawsuit seeking $1 million and succeeded in seizing the tanker Atlantic Asphalt.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/cruise-ship-lists-and-partially-sinks-after-tanker-collision-near-new-orleans-bridge/) reported that the cruise ship American Heritage carried about 129 passengers and was struck on the Mississippi River near the Port of New Orleans.

[El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-13/un-buque-choca-contra-un-crucero-con-129-personas-a-bordo-en-el-rio-misisipi.html), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/petrolero-choca-crucero-129-pasajeros-bordo-rio-misisipi_202611136af76fcbea8d89799784c51f.html), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/petrolero-choca-contra-crucero-en-el-puerto-de-nueva-orleans-autoridades-atienden-incidente/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/buque-colisiona-con-crucero-y-lo-deja-parcialmente-sumergido-en-el-rio-misisipi_0_5sjCxZkkBS.html), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/emergencia-en-ee-uu-tras-choque-de-buque-contra-crucero-con-129-personas-a-bordo-videos-muestran-pasajeros-aferrados-a-la-embarcacion-inclinada-3600929) reported that emergency services and authorities responded to the collision between a tanker and the American Heritage cruise ship in New Orleans.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Climb-as-Middle-East-Supply-Risks-Overshadow-Glut-Fears.html), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/27/oil-set-to-post-weekly-gain-as-middle-east-attacks-stoke-supply-concerns/) reported that crude oil prices were set to post a weekly gain as Middle East attacks stoked supply concerns.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/business/markets/asx-set-for-gains-global-stocks-rise-20261127-p61hqd.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the Australian sharemarket was set for a positive start and global stocks advanced while Wall Street was closed for Thanksgiving.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-soaring-jet-fuel-prices-erode-global-airline-profits-amid-middle-east-conflict/) reported that global airline profits came under pressure from surging fuel costs and airspace restrictions since the war in the Middle East began.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/global-stocks-rebound-after-ai-sell-off-as-investors-assess-trumps-tariffs-oil-prices-and-inflation-risks-101795689444252.html) reported that global stocks recovered after the artificial intelligence sell-off as investors assessed new tariffs, rising oil prices, inflation risks, and potential trade retaliation.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/Oil-Prices-Rebound-as-Middle-East-Supply-Fears-Return.html) reported that January WTI crude oil futures recovered from a three-month low as renewed concern over Middle East supply brought buyers back into the market.
[TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2225021) reported that Brent oil prices gained 1.5% to reach $96.03 a barrel on London's ICE.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642232/oil-slips-over-1-as-supply-glut-prospect-offsets-middle-east-disruption-fears) reported that Brent crude futures dropped 1.35 dollars, or 1.5 percent, to 90.05 dollars a barrel as supply glut prospects offset Middle East disruption fears.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/qatari-pm-warns-middle-east-cannot-afford-more-us-iran-tensions-3725917) reported that Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani warned that the Middle East cannot afford another round of tensions between the United States and Iran.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642028/oil-prices-near-three-month-lows-as-rising-supply-offsets-hormuz-threat), [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Hold-Near-Three-Month-Lows-Despite-Hormuz-Mine-Claims.html) reported that oil prices traded near three-month lows as rising supplies offset Hormuz threat claims.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/oil-prices-fall-as-rising-supplies-offset-middle-east-tensions/) reported that oil prices fell due to rising supplies and the reopening of a Libyan oil pipeline.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/oil-prices-slip-as-iran-war-middle-east-shipping-attacks-support-brent-crude-and-wti-despite-weekly-losses-101795431644052.html) reported that Brent crude and WTI oil prices slipped despite support from Middle East shipping attacks and Strait of Hormuz tensions.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585610/trump-claims-iran-launched-highest-number-of-drone-and-missile-attacks-in-a-year/) reported that Donald Trump stated Iranian aggression surged following recent midterm results and that Iran launched the highest number of drone and missile attacks in a year.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915744), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-warns-iran-of-fresh-attacks-after-new-year-if-negotiations-fail-to-produce-a-deal-101795389992076.html) reported that Donald Trump warned Iran of fresh attacks after the new year if negotiations fail and threatened to sink vessels.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223073), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-trump-inclined-to-resume-strikes-on-iran-after-new-year-if-no-deal-reached/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he is inclined to resume military strikes against Iran after the New Year if negotiations fail to produce an agreement.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/21/iran-war-live-iran-targets-us-military-in-bahrain-houthi-strikes-continue?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bahrain condemned Iran's strikes on US military assets in the country while Houthi strikes continue.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/how-war-has-shifted-irans-missile-ambitions-beyond-middle-east) reported that the conflict has battered Iran's military capabilities and shifted its leadership's missile ambitions beyond the Middle East.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328605/Iran-will-take-all-necessary-measures-to-break-US-blockade-Deputy) reported that Iran's deputy foreign minister stated the country considers the US economic blockade an act of war and will take all necessary measures to break it.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/trump-dice-que-iran-quiere-un-acuerdo-y-mas-noticias-de-oriente-medio_0_6NgQglcy32.html) reported that President Donald Trump stated Iran wants a real deal while responding with attacks in Kuwait and Bahrain, intensifying regional tension.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/explosion-irans-qeshm-island-linked-disposal-unexploded-munitions-tasnim-reports) reported that an explosion and smoke on Iran's Qeshm Island were linked to the disposal of unexploded munitions.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915601) reported that local sources indicated a blast heard over Qeshm Island was possibly caused by air defenses intercepting an enemy aircraft.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2221047) reported that Iranian strikes damaged 15 hangars, warehouses, and at least ten other facilities at a US air base in Kuwait.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cw4gn9jeqjq7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Kuwait and Bahrain stated they were attacked by Iran following a US air strike on Qeshm island.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/gulf-nations-attacked-after-us-strikes-iranian-island), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/iran-allies-hit-gulf-countries-after-us-attack-on-island/) reported that Bahrain and Kuwait said they repelled air attacks launched against them after US strikes on an Iranian island.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iran-fires-kuwait-widening-strikes-after-us-hit-iranian-island) reported that Iran stated it targeted US drone and missile sites in Kuwait overnight.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/17/paises-do-golfo-entram-em-alerta-apos-ataques-dos-eua-a-ilha-do-ira.ghtml) reported that Kuwait announced it repelled drone attacks following United States bombings against an island in Iran.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941167) reported that the United States struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz after Tehran's Revolutionary Guards launched actions.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/paises-del-golfo-en-alerta-tras-ataques-de-eeuu-en-la-isla-irani-de-qeshm_0_TBK6HJ0Dve.html) reported that Kuwait detained drone attacks after US bombings on a base in Qeshm Island, and Bahrain alerted its population.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/iran-strikes-gulf-neighbors-following-us-attack-on-qeshm-island/) reported that missiles and drones crossed Gulf skies as regional militaries reported interceptions linked to Iran and Houthi allies following a US attack on Qeshm Island.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-us-strikes-iranian-island-after-tehran-targets-bahrain) reported that the US and Iran exchanged fire, with the US striking an Iranian missile launch site after Iran targeted a US military radar system in Bahrain.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532307/Iran-reports-strikes-on-US-military-assets-in-Kuwait-and-Bahrain), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's military targeted US military assets at a base in Kuwait and shot down an American drone east of the Strait of Hormuz.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1118/1599631-iran-us/) reported that Gulf countries intercepted missiles and drones from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen after the United States struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249501/Iran-army-attacks-U-S-Patriot-launch-sites-in-Kuwait), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army stated its combat drones targeted U.S. Patriot defense systems and launch platforms at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait.
[Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/iran-attacks-kuwait-and-bahrain-overnight-with-drones/) reported that Iran fired drones at a U.S. air base in Kuwait and launched attacks on Bahrain overnight.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640955/iranian-army-says-drone-strikes-targeted-us-installations-at-kuwait-air-base) reported that the Iranian army stated drone strikes targeted US installations at a Kuwait air base.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86325322/Iranian-Army-targets-US-Patriot-systems-at-Kuwait-s-Ali-Al-Salem), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/irans-army-says-drones-targeted-us-systems-at-kuwait-air-base-3725711) reported that the Iranian army targeted US Patriot air defense systems and drone and missile launch platforms at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374869/bahrain-and-kuwait-repel-drone-attacks-after-us-strikes-iranian-island) reported that Bahrain and Kuwait stated they repelled air attacks launched against them following US strikes on an Iranian island.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQVkpMQk5Ha1FZNG45Vmt6WWxWeUtMS3lSU0hON0F0b0ItSHlWY0NnUHFyQ1JTWFBPSWViZTFVZHpKNWI3V3R1TjM0b25HWTNEZGZ2Q1ItZG5hdXNGcG03M3FjZlJKNmE5SC1lYTJERmRETERvdGJOUGlsMG9pQjVVU2dEWkJxOEY2eXJYd1RtVmNlN2pIcGlLcHJlaw?oc=5), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/after-us-hits-qeshm-iran-targets-us-bases-kuwait-and-bahrain) reported that Iran targeted US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain following US strikes.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/iran-army-says-it-targeted-us-military-base-in-kuwait/article71715048.ece) reported that the Iranian army claimed it targeted air defense systems and drone and missile launch platforms in Kuwait.

reports.text: [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611270323.html) reported that former Migori Governor Okoth Obado's lawyers announced plans to appeal his 25-year prison sentence over the murder of Sharon Otieno.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/a-new-york-mother-transferred-four-plots-of-land-to-her-daughter-during-financial-trouble-in-2012-then-sought-three-of-them-back-when-her-daughter-planned-to-sell-an-appeals-court-upheld-the-daughters-ownership/articleshow/136182825.cms) reported that an appeals court upheld a daughter's ownership of four land parcels after a New York mother attempted to reclaim three properties following a 2012 transfer.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/a-federal-appeals-court-gives-donald-trump-a-new-route-to-challenge-his-34-count-new-york-criminal-conviction-sending-the-case-back-to-a-judge-and-putting-his-separate-state-appeal-on-hold/articleshow/136171686.cms) reported that a federal appeals court afforded Donald Trump's legal team a fresh opportunity to challenge his criminal conviction.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204397/%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%85%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%83-%D8%AA%D8%A4%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%85%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%AA%D8%AC%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA/) reported that a New York state judge upheld a rent freeze decision supported by New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's administration after dismissing a lawsuit filed by landlords.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/trump-gets-another-shot-in-his-quest-to-overturn-hush-money-conviction/) reported that President Donald Trump has been given another chance to try to move the appeal of his conviction on state charges tied to hush money payments before a federal court.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/appeals-court-renews-trump-bid-for-federal-jurisdiction-in-hush-money-case?traffic_source=rss) reported that the ruling could clear the way for Trump to argue prosecutors relied on evidence protected by presidential immunity.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611240413.html) reported that the Director of Public Prosecutions urged the Supreme Court to dismiss appeals filed by a former Venezuelan Embassy first secretary and a Kenyan over an ambassador's murder.

[Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/dpp-urges-supreme-court-to-uphold-20-year-jail-term-in-venezuelan-envoy-murder-5683036) reported that the state wants the Supreme Court to uphold a 20-year jail term and find that the appeals disclose no constitutional violation.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/a-new-york-mans-family-won-a-100-million-jury-verdict-over-his-death-in-county-jail-later-reduced-to-20-million-appeals-judges-have-now-erased-the-damages-and-ordered-a-new-trial-on-the-amount/articleshow/136092980.cms) reported that a New York appeals court overturned a $20 million damages award to the family of a man who died after being restrained at an Erie County jail.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/us-appeals-court-lets-trump-end-tps-deportation-protections-for-venezuelans?traffic_source=rss) reported that a US appeals court ruling prevented a lower-court decision from taking effect that would block Trump from lifting TPS deportation protections for Venezuelans.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/trump-makes-third-supreme-court-bid-to-end-venezuelan-migrant-protections?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Trump administration made a third Supreme Court bid to end Venezuelan migrant protections following a California judge's ruling.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/trump-administration-asks-supreme-court-end-venezuela-tps/) reported that the Trump administration filed an emergency appeal to the Supreme Court over deportation protections for Venezuelans before a court pause expires.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/us/politics/supreme-court-trump-deportation-venezuelans.html), [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOb3oySmt4WDNyUnNPN1QzRXJpcDZ1OWFUUkFZMXlJX3dfQXYxWkFSaDNuN2hLb1NpM3hpQWowSVlLQmVMd1c3MUM5RnY0ck9DMXh0TDNOTmc0cFMyeS1ZX0dHSDRJQzdmMGhodHRCSFF6VThMb24yem4zSG0wd3hRbE1oa19Ubk55T1R5RXdGN1NSaXpNSzkzTkNaR3I2VXNxdGlPdFNaeGFXbjlTS1c4Tm1OelIwVm8?oc=5) reported that the Trump administration appealed to the Supreme Court over legal protections for Venezuelan migrants.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/court-blocks-pentagon-from-discharging-27-transgender-troops-under-trump-hegseth-policy) reported that a federal appeals court blocked the Pentagon from discharging transgender plaintiffs under Department of Defense policy while the Supreme Court weighs the case.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE56V2VNbVlEYTFSc1lTQXUxOG9YVzFKTl9CaW5wU1RBX19mcWpCbUJsdEZNZXEzQ1ZwbDZ5UWV2SEl1MjlrTThKTzVmMjZ4MWFVdjc2RUhGQmc5RjhmdlBxMlRyN0RVMURlSmROTWpISFNjcDMxWWlCOGJPZXBjdw?oc=5) reported that an appeals court blocked the Pentagon from forcing transgender troops out of the U.S. army.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/transgender-troops-hegseth-blocked-discharging-trump-b3086797.html) reported that a federal appeals court blocked the Trump administration from firing transgender troops.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNdWJBZk0xU3paZmpwZno3aGY1ZWdBVE9wTkE1UDNsTkNoZzA0NlZMNUhHMFZnVmNpZUZDWEV4Z2NPWHZWV3Q0Z21iQ21zckdzUXo2M1RTbHZUYUE5ckxjcGs1STRpZmFDS3g2OXJKb25heU5CaFNFZm0xVFR1RXdVaXB5OGdHMklQNjhsSUFnUjl1b0ZBOG9hNGVVNy1Mc00?oc=5) reported that the Supreme Court rebuffed a Trump administration appeal over diversity, equity, and inclusion funding cuts.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOalBTLXlQMGN3UEt5X1ZDYVZRa3JMTDRqaDNpeVRwN3dlOHRNVFQxMFFOdUFQb2ZLcmxJT2tZaXo1UG1VUFkySTM4U1ktQjVQTWVEU0wwRVdpaFp3SENHZ2lmdFk4S1dubmtadFo5N0FpT2l2NHVrbF8yZmhVbGUtMHA1RVItdVBKMG05ZmlWSEc5U2h0Vm43QW50ODhrT05S?oc=5), [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxOZUZ0Z2FBQXd1dE1DYzFpN1Z6U2ZfRENHZmQyVk4zR0FqNldXSlh3SDZBbGRSODgxZEExOHJnOVNTaHZ6UlhnS090Qld0OW00bmE2aGR2bjd2aXVfdVJpakswV00zalVGQXJ0ZWs2VEQxTUhVVElIQUhnTnhVd3IxZnVDTjkxWTUxRVlvbjRFdnM4djNJR1FyUlhsRFdnNnNXWWxHUGoxVXY5c0dTRkVMeEdB?oc=5), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-new-york-highway-funds-court-ruling-licenses-b3084815.html) reported that a federal appeals court ruled against the Trump administration in a legal battle involving New York transportation funds and driver's licenses for immigrants.
