reports.text: [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/dalli-disappointed-cop31-outcome-hits-oil-industry-lobbying.1137671) reported that Maltese Minister Miriam Dalli expressed disappointment over the COP31 outcome and criticized oil industry lobbying.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/preocupante-leon-xiv-cuestiono-fracaso-cop31-advirtio-crisis-climatica-compromete-generaciones-futuras_0_YMCAumBO2v.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV questioned the failure of COP31 and warned that the climate crisis compromises future generations.

[Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/jefe-de-onu-expresa-decepcion-por-resultado-de-cop31/) reported that UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres expressed disappointment with the result of the 31st UN Climate Change Conference.
[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/24/mundo/023n3mun?partner=rss) reported that China expressed disappointment over the failure of the UN climate conference to reach an agreement.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa-disappointed-with-cop31-outcome), [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/24/caricom-disappointed-outcome-cop31/) reported that the COP31 climate summit in Turkey failed to reach an agreement, exposing divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fracaso-de-la-cop31-desata-criticas-y-reclamos-de-reforma-de-las-negociaciones-climaticas-33278860) reported that the COP31 climate summit's failure sparked criticism and calls to reform climate negotiations over petrostate vetoes on fossil fuel references.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/is-no-deal-better-than-a-bad-deal-why-some-see-hope-in-cop31s-collapse), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/spotlight/20261124-collapse-of-cop31-this-deal-was-a-bad-deal-and-better-no-deal-than-a-bad-deal) reported that COP31 collapsed after the EU, UK, and small nations rejected a pact that promoted carbon capture and omitted fossil fuel phase-outs.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/turkeys-erdogan-says-cop31-laid-groundwork-more-climate-talks-despite-lack-deal) reported that Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan stated the COP31 climate summit established a valuable foundation for more climate talks despite lacking a deal.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/audio/2026/nov/23/cop31-collapses-why-did-climate-talks-fall-apart-the-latest) reported that countries at the COP31 climate summit failed to reach a keystone agreement for the first time in 17 years.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/science/video/2026/nov/23/cop31-failed-what-happens-now-video) reported that the longest ever COP climate talks ended in failure with the key sticking point being the omission of fossil fuels.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/23/cop31-ends-without-agreement-as-divisions-deepen-over-fossil-fuels/) reported that UN climate chief Simon Stiell expressed disappointment over the outcome.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/cop31-ends-without-deal-on-fossil-fuel-transition/) reported that nearly 40 countries rejected the proposed outcome over fossil fuel commitments and climate finance.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/cop31-ends-deal-eu-not-endorse-text-omitting-fossil-fuels.1137494), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/eu-will-not-endorse-climate-deal-throwing-cop31-outcome-into-doubt/article71731355.ece) reported that Ireland's Climate and Energy Minister Darragh O'Brien stated that the EU and its member states object to the pact because it omits fossil fuels.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/23/cop31-ends-in-deadlock-as-guterres-blasts-fossil-fuel-interests-demands-urgent-climate-action-2/) reported that United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres expressed deep disappointment over the failure of the climate change conference.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/cop31-president-closes-climate-summit-without-deal-blames-some-countries-3725882) reported that COP31 President Murat Kurum closed the summit without a deal and stated that some countries failed to show the required effort and flexibility.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/europe-today-cop31-talks-collapsed-over-omission-of-fossil-fuels) reported that the COP31 meeting in Antalya ended without reaching consensus after talks collapsed over the omission of fossil fuels.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/environment/20261121-latest-cop31-deal-sidesteps-fossil-fuels-amid-growing-divisions) reported that COP31 ended without a deal as the EU rejected the text for omitting any mention of fossil fuels.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cop31-turkiyes-final-draft-doesnt-mention-the-words-fossil-fuels-that-cause-global-warming/article71730648.ece), a local outlet, reported that COP31 President Murat Kurum gave negotiators about three hours to make objections or ask for changes before the wording goes before the conference plenary.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261122-cop31-draft-deal-sparks-backlash-as-france-warns-of-step-backward) reported that France warned the last-ditch agreement at the Cop31 climate summit was a step backward.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261123-cop31-climate-talks-collapse) reported that EU member states objected to adopting an 11th-hour deal that omitted explicit references to fossil fuels.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/la-cumbre-climatica-cop31-fracasa-y-refleja-las-fisuras-del-multilateralismo-33263826) reported that the COP31 climate summit concluded without a global pact and revived debate over reforming consensus.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/mas-regiones/la-cop31-fracasa-por-falta-de-cosenso-sobre-combustibles-fosiles-en-un-duro-golpe-para-la-lucha-contra-el-cambio-climatico-muy-decepcionante-3603138) reported that Climate Change Summit co-president Chris Bowen assumed his quota of responsibility after COP31 failed due to a lack of consensus on fossil fuels.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fracasa-cumbre-climatica-cop31-financiamiento-clave-en-el-estancamiento/) reported that leaders failed to agree on measures to combat global warming, leading to the failure of the COP31 climate summit.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/cumbre-clima-borde-fracaso-union-europea-rechaza-acuerdo-menciona-salida-combustibles-fosiles_0_iKvfHaF62A.html) reported that the European Union rejected the COP31 draft agreement in Turkey because it did not mention the exit from fossil fuels.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/reino-unido-puede-revertir-el-brexit-y-regresar-a-la-union-europea-3602883) reported that Prime Minister Andy Burnham raised the debate on whether it is convenient for the United Kingdom to reverse Brexit and return to the European Union.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/d3d58f2cabbb), a state-run outlet, reported that COP31 chief Murat Kurum stated Türkiye exhausted all possibilities to secure consensus during two weeks of negotiations at the Antalya summit.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/climate-conference-ends-without-agreement-20261123-p61gcg.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the COP31 climate conference ended in Turkey with no agreement reached.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq7827z2841zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the UN COP31 meeting in Turkey entered a second day of overtime as countries struggled to reach an agreement.
[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/22/new-cop31-draft-deal-tabled-as-countries-scramble-to-salvage-climate-talks) reported that the latest draft again failed to mention fossil fuels.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/countries-react-after-cop31-climate-talks-end-in-collapse?traffic_source=rss) reported that oil-producing countries opposed the term 'fossil fuels' in the draft text.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cop31-fails-to-agree-on-climate-deal-in-chaotic-finale/article71731651.ece) reported that COP31 President Murat Kurum announced there was no agreement on the text and the decisions were not adopted.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/climate-deal-collapses-chaotic-end-cop31), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261122-cop31-climate-talks-collapse-as-eu-rejects-deal-that-omits-fossil-fuels), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/22/climate-talks-collapse-without-deal-at-cop31-in-turkey/), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/article/3375393/cop31-climate-talks-collapse-eu-and-others-reject-deal), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/environment-and-climate-change/article-915721) reported that the COP31 climate talks collapsed after the European Union and several other countries rejected a proposed global agreement that failed to mention fossil fuels.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/climat/article/2026/11/22/climat-l-ue-et-ses-membres-s-opposent-a-l-adoption-de-la-decision-finale-proposee-a-la-cop31_6814199_1652613.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/sciences/cop31-l-union-europeenne-s-oppose-frontalement-au-dernier-projet-de-declaration-finale-20261122) reported that Turkey's COP31 presidency announced the rejection of the final decision draft because it omitted the phaseout of fossil fuels.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/22/climate/cop31-climate-summit-ends-climate.html), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10945295) reported that European and vulnerable nations rejected a proposed agreement after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked mention of phasing out fossil fuels.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-climate-deal-not-adopted-summit-president-says/live-79999516?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/cop31-summit-becomes-longest-ever-un-climate-conference-as-eu-rejects-cover-decision-agreement-omitting-fossil-fuels-101795345916381.html) reported that COP31 became the longest-running UN climate summit as nations failed to reach an agreement.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/environment/20261121-latest-cop31-deal-sidesteps-fossil-fuels-amid-growing-divisions), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/cop31-ends-deal-eu-not-endorse-text-omitting-fossil-fuels.1137494) reported that the EU and its member states rejected and refused to endorse the COP31 text for omitting mentions of fossil fuels.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/cop31-ends-deal-eu-not-endorse-text-omitting-fossil-fuels.1137494) reported that Ireland's Climate and Energy Minister Darragh O'Brien stated the EU objects to the pact.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261122-cop31-draft-deal-sparks-backlash-as-france-warns-of-step-backward) reported that the latest COP31 agreement at the summit in Turkey drew criticism from France for failing to explicitly address fossil fuels.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-22/cop31-at-odds-over-fossil-fuels/107414330), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-fossil-fuels-still-missing-from-draft-deal-at-un-climate-summit/live-79999516?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/fossil-fuels-still-missing-latest-cop31-draft-deal.1137485), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cop31-turkiyes-final-draft-doesnt-mention-the-words-fossil-fuels-that-cause-global-warming/article71730648.ece), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/cop31-faces-collapse-threat-as-latest-draft-fails-to-mention-fossil-fuels/) reported that the latest COP31 draft text released by Turkey and Australia omits explicit references to fossil fuels as negotiations extend past the deadline.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/no-headway-even-in-overtime-cop-chief-seeks-compromise-101795312540164.html) reported that the second draft of the summit dropped both proposed fossil fuel references and the annual adaptation finance target.

reports.text: [Punch](https://punchng.com/ogun-police-rescue-stolen-baby-sold-for-n1-5m-arrest-three/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Ogun police rescued a stolen baby sold for N1.5m and arrested three female suspects at Ifo market.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/alleged-sexual-assault-katsina-govt-sets-up-panel-to-probe-emir-of-daura/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/katsina-sets-up-committee-to-probe-daura-emir-over-sexual-misconduct-allegations/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/katsina-sets-up-panel-to-probe-daura-emir-over-sexual-assault-allegation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Katsina State government constituted a nine-member committee to investigate sexual assault allegations involving the Emir of Daura.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/25/katsina-suspends-emir-of-daura-over-sexual-harassment-allegation/) reported that the Katsina State government suspended the Emir of Daura over sexual harassment allegations involving a foreign tourist, while Governor Radda set up a committee to probe the claims.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/daura-emir-suspended-tourist-assault-claim-nigeria/) reported that Katsina State suspended the Emir of Daura's engagements and opened a committee probe after a tourist's allegation, which the palace disputes.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmglrz462nn6o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the Emir of Daura, a 92-year-old monarch, was suspended after sexual assault claims.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/katsina-suspends-emir-of-dauras-engagements-over-assault-allegation-launches-investigation/) reported that the Katsina State Government constituted an investigative committee to probe allegations involving Alhaji Umar Faruk Umar.
[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/katsina-suspends-daura-emir-over-sexual-assault-allegations-by-polish-tourist/) reported that the allegations were made by a Polish tourist.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927384-daura-emirate-examines-tourists-assault-video-police-deny-knowledge-of-incident.html) reported that the Daura emirate is examining whether the footage accompanying a tourist's sexual assault allegation is genuine or manipulated.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/instagram-removes-polish-tourists-video-accusing-daura-emir-of-sexual-assault/) reported that Instagram removed a video posted by a Polish tourist accusing the Emir of Daura of sexual assault.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/police-arrest-11-suspected-yahoo-boys-in-ogun-recover-charms/) reported that the Police Special Fraud Unit under FCID Alagbon arrested 11 suspected internet fraudsters during an intelligence-led operation in Ogun and recovered charms.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927767-police-arrest-11-in-ogun-yahoo-academy-raid-official.html) reported that police stated investigations are ongoing to establish the identity of suspected human remains found in the Ogun raid or whether they connect to any reported murder case.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/police-bust-ogun-yahoo-academy-uncover-human-remains/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ogun-police-bust-yahoo-academy-recover-human-remains/) reported that the Police Special Fraud Unit arrested 11 suspected internet fraudsters at an alleged Yahoo academy in Abeokuta and recovered human remains.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/morning-recap-157-nigerians-face-us-deportation-police-bust-ogun-yahoo-academy-other-top-stories/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that 157 Nigerians now face US deportation after 24 more were added, and Ogun police arrested 11 suspects at a cybercrime academy.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/amnesty-international-condemns-death-threats-against-tourist-over-daura-emir-video/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Amnesty International condemned death threats against a tourist who alleged sexual assault by the Emir of Daura and urged police to investigate impartially.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742869-just-katsina-governor-told-suspend-emir-daura-sexual-misconduct-allegations/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/ex-kaduna-gov-demands-daura-emirs-suspension-over-sexual-assault-allegation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that former Kaduna governor Abubakar Dangiwa Umar called on Katsina State Governor Dikko Radda to suspend the Emir of Daura over allegations involving a female tourist.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742942-instagram-removes-foreign-tourists-video-accusing-daura-emir-sexual-assault/) reported that Instagram removed a video uploaded by a foreign tourist accusing the Emir of Daura of sexual assault at a palace in Katsina state.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/instagram-removes-video-of-alleged-sexual-assault-by-emir-of-daura/) reported that Instagram removed a viral video of a tourist accusing the Emir of Daura of sexual assault.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/927381-dangiwa-umar-gumi-demand-suspension-of-emir-of-daura-over-alleged-sexual-misconduct.html) reported that former Military Governor Abubakar Dangiwa Umar called on Katsina State Governor Dikko Radda to suspend the Emir of Daura.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/daura-emirate-probes-viral-video-as-tourist-insists-on-assault-claim/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Daura Emirate Council commenced a review of a viral video involving assault claims against the Emir of Daura.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/daura-emir-faces-sexual-assault-allegation-amnesty-seeks-probe/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Amnesty International Nigeria called for a probe after a female tourist accused the Emir of Daura of sexual assault while a palace source denied it.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/morning-recap-opposition-challenges-tinubu-daura-emir-faces-sexual-assault-allegation-other-top-stories/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that opposition parties challenged Tinubu's endorsement of APC candidates.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/gumi-calls-for-removal-of-emirs-guilty-of-immoral-conduct/) reported that Islamic cleric Sheikh Ahmad Gumi called for the immediate removal of any Emir found guilty of immoral conduct.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/any-emir-guilty-of-immorality-should-be-dethroned-gumi/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Sheikh Ahmad Gumi stated any emir guilty of immorality should be dethroned amidst a tourist harassment allegation against the Emir of Daura.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/927263-tourist-alleges-sexual-assault-against-daura-emir-amnesty-demands-probe.html) reported that Amnesty International demanded an investigation after a foreign tourist accused the Emir of Daura of sexual assault during a palace visit.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742749-sheikh-gumi-calls-immediate-removal-emir-sexual-harassment-allegation/) reported that Sheikh Ahmad Gumi called for the immediate removal of any Emir found guilty of misconduct following the sexual harassment allegation.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/amnesty-international-demands-probe-of-emir-of-daura-over-sexual-assault-allegations/) reported that Amnesty International Nigeria called on authorities to immediately investigate allegations of sexual assault against the Emir of Daura.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/emir-of-daura-trends-on-x-after-tourists-inappropriate-touching-allegation/) reported that a female tourist who uses the online identifier 'beduina' alleged inappropriate touching by the Emir of Daura after completing a 30-day trip across Nigeria.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/sexual-assault-allegation-rocks-daura-emirate-as-tourist-accuses-emir-of-groping/) reported that a tourist posting under the Instagram handle @beduinqa accused the Emir of Daura of groping in a video following a tour of Nigeria.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/full-list-fg-announces-19-international-job-vacancies/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Federal Government announced 19 international job vacancies for Nigerians at the African Space Agency and OIC.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/petrol-imports-jump-47-despite-local-refining/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Nigeria's petrol imports rose 47% to 15 million litres per day in October according to NMDPRA data.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fg-suspends-lagos-ibadan-bridge-work-after-20-hour-gridlock/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Nigerian Federal Government suspended construction on the pedestrian bridge at Aseese along the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway following a severe gridlock.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926362-2027-politics-watch-from-apcs-benue-ticket-setback-to-tinubus-state-police-bill.html) reported that a court invalidated the APC's substitution of Gabriel Suswam in Benue North-East, while President Bola Tinubu received a constitutional amendment bill on state police.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/at-last-senate-sends-state-police-bill-to-president-demands-operational-guidelines/) reported that the Senate sent the State Police Bill to the President and demanded operational guidelines while lawmakers warned against abuse.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/state-police-on-verge-of-reality-operational-guidelines-bill-submitted-to-justice-ministry/) reported that an operational guidelines bill for state police was submitted to the Justice Ministry.
[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-senate-demands-safeguards-against-abuse/) reported that the Senate demanded safeguards against the abuse of state police.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-why-constitutional-amendment-is-just-the-first-step-omole/) reported that a constitutional amendment allowing states to establish their own police services is considered the first step in decentralising policing in Nigeria.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/state-police-senate-clears-final-hurdle-sends-constitutional-amendment/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/state-police-bill-forwarded-by-senate-to-tinubu-for-assent/) reported that the Senate cleared the final hurdle and directed the Clerk to transmit the constitutional amendment bill seeking to establish state police for presidential assent.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-seeks-decriminalisation-of-attempted-suicide-proposes-support-for-victims/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-seeks-reps-approval-to-decriminalise-attempted-suicide/) reported that President Bola Tinubu transmitted the National Mental Health (Amendment) Bill, 2026, to the House of Representatives seeking to decriminalise attempted suicide.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-receives-state-police-bill-to-consult-agf-before-assent/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu will consult the Attorney-General before giving assent to the state police bill.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/senate-sends-state-police-bill-to-tinubu-demands-operational-guidelines/) reported that Senator Akpabio stated the new policing structure could tackle 70% of insecurity.

reports.text: [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/elon-musk-to-give-18bn-spacex-shares-to-american-children/), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/epoca/noticia/2026/11/27/elon-musk-promete-duas-acoes-da-spacex-a-cada-crianca-dos-eua-em-doacao-que-pode-chegar-a-r-100-bilhoes.ghtml) reported that Elon Musk announced plans to give two shares of SpaceX to every child in the United States in an initiative valued at $18 billion.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/elon-musk-expands-spacex-giveaway-with-promise-of-another-share-for-every-us-child-annually-101795733705916.html) reported that Elon Musk pledged to give every child in America another SpaceX share each year, expanding his stock giveaway.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-26/elon-musk-to-give-two-shares-of-spacex-to-every-child-in-the-us-in-a-deal-worth-18-billion.html) reported that the US Federal Communications Commission authorized SpaceX to launch one million rockets into space, alongside Elon Musk's pledge of two SpaceX shares to every child in the US in a deal worth $18 billion.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/26/elon-musk-promet-d-offrir-deux-actions-de-spacex-a-chaque-enfant-aux-etats-unis_6815531_3210.html) reported that according to the billionaire, a share from SpaceX will be transferred next month following his prior October pledge of one share to every child in the US.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/spacex-to-give-one-share-to-every-active-trump-account-as-elon-musk-matches-companys-contribution-101795692559882.html) reported that SpaceX will give one share to every active Trump Account, with Elon Musk matching the contribution and Gwynne Shotwell pledging over 2 million shares.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/musk-says-will-give-two-spacex-shares-to-every-child-in-america/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/musk-pledges-two-spacex-shares-to-every-american-child/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that tech billionaire Elon Musk pledged to give every child in the United States two shares in his SpaceX company as part of a Trump Accounts scheme.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/26/elon-musk-pledges-to-give-two-spacex-shares-to-every-child-in-the-us) reported that Elon Musk pledged to give two SpaceX shares to every child in the US.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/elon-musk-promises-two-spacex-shares-for-every-us-child-including-one-from-his-own-stake-101795667287360.html) reported that SpaceX will contribute one newly issued share of its Class A stock to each active Trump Account, with Elon Musk matching the gift.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/eu-autoriza-a-spacex-a-lanzar-un-millon-de-satelites-y-crear-centros-de-datos-espaciales-33311703), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/tecnologia/autoriza-elon-musk-desplegar-millon-satelites-llevar-centros-datos-espacio_202611256b07526af6da642efefb215f.html) reported that the US authorized SpaceX to deploy one million satellites and create space-based data centers.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/business/companies/elon-musk-s-tesla-turns-to-friendly-robots-to-save-its-australian-chairwoman-20261126-p61gxc.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Robyn Denholm became a billionaire and senior technology executive through her close alliance with Elon Musk as Tesla turned to friendly robots to save its Australian chairwoman.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/house-democrats-congress-seats-record-b3090952.html) reported that three House contests remain unresolved with one seat in Minnesota and two in Louisiana headed to a December runoff.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/us/politics/tennessee-house-election-results-broderick-wins.html) reported that Democrat Victoria Broderick won a Tennessee House race, giving Democrats their largest majority in 30 years after defeating an eight-term Republican.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/24/democrat-victoria-broderick-election-win-tennesee-midterms) reported that Democrat Victoria Broderick won Tennessee’s fourth congressional district election.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90896) reported that Democrats secured at least 258 seats in the US House of Representatives after Chuck Hubbard defeated a Republican representative.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/democrats-clinch-a-historic-house-majority-of-at-least-258-seats-largest-since-1992/article71733328.ece) reported that Democrats clinched a House majority of at least 258 seats, with Republicans holding at least 173 seats.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/us-midterms-democrats-secure-biggest-house-majority-in-34-years/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Democrats won the largest majority in the US House of Representatives in more than three decades after Chuck Hubbard defeated Representative Vi.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/democrats-reach-largest-us-house-majority-since-1992-on-course-to-break-bill-clinton-era-record-101795396941360.html) reported that Democrats won at least 258 House seats after flipping 44 Republican districts, reaching their largest US House majority since 1992.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-blames-democrats-midterms-victory-for-stock-market-wipeout-claims-he-predicted-it-101795390890202.html) reported that President Donald Trump blamed Democrats' midterm wins for a 6 trillion dollar stock market drop in posts on Truth Social.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/democrats-win-largest-house-majority-since-1992-with-north-carolina-seat?traffic_source=rss) reported that at least 258 U.S. House seats are under Democratic control with four midterm races yet to be decided.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/elon-musk-warns-ai-boom-may-face-hundreds-of-billions-in-cash-crunch-as-chip-demand-soars-101795312429566.html) reported that Tesla CEO Elon Musk stated the artificial intelligence infrastructure race faces major challenges in powering, cooling, and operating massive computing systems.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261122-democrat-hubbard-wins-north-carolina-recount-clinching-historic-house-majority), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/f8748cdb83ef) reported that Democrat Chuck Hubbard won the North Carolina recount after defeating veteran Republican Virginia Foxx.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxNN0ZaSUxXY2RGTWZBcXdNRjV0eWhIZUdfWjFBSmI1OHBGZy1qRWFpNnJxZDJVOC14dVFGZGdSS3NfeFNsQm1IcmJIWGs4M0l5alZQZVhDek80S1lnQ3plUkRrbm9uaE44RWtNMTBDTWRLUmdGLWVVUDRJZ1J5TmR4QU5vWW5qT2NvOHB3dklzcFZ2ZFltMy1SYVdJQnNRZFBiaURJN2t0bjExaE0?oc=5) reported that Democrats clinched a historic House majority of at least 258 seats, the largest since 1992.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/house-seats-democrats-historic-congress-b3089490.html) reported that in the 100-member Senate, Democrats captured a 56-seat majority.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/elon-musk-spacex-investigation-democrat-b3089261.html) reported that a top Democrat warned Elon Musk that government funding for SpaceX is on the line following reported Starlink disruptions in Ukraine.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/autos/tesla-llego-a-la-argentina-la-trastienda-del-lanzamiento-de-la-marca-de-elon-musk-en-el-pais-nid21112026/) reported that an event in La Boca featured the presence of President Javier Milei and the exhibition of cars that Tesla will sell in the country.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/elon-musk-dejo-un-confuso-mensaje-por-videollamada-tras-el-discurso-de-milei-en-el-lanzamiento-de-nid21112026/) reported that Elon Musk participated via video call following Javier Milei's speech at the launch of Tesla in Argentina.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045812/musk-feels-pretty-foolish-over-spending-on-republicans) reported that Elon Musk said he felt 'pretty foolish' about the amount of money he spent on this year's US midterm elections after Republicans suffered losses.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/lauren-boebert-trump-midterms) reported that Lauren Boebert stated Donald Trump did some things to hurt her constituents, though she is not mad at the president.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/lauren-boebert-colorado-congress-loss-b3088539.html) reported that Lauren Boebert discussed her midterm election defeat in an interview from a U-Haul van.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/i-feel-pretty-foolish-musk-regrets-446m-gamble-on-republicans-as-democrats-seize-control-of-us-congress/) reported that Tesla and SpaceX owner Elon Musk admitted feeling foolish about his financial investment in Republicans after Democrats gained control of the U.S. Congress.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3375109/elon-musk-vows-raise-output-teslas-shanghai-gigafactory-despite-sales-plunge) reported that Tesla CEO Elon Musk pledged to increase output at the company's Shanghai Gigafactory despite a sales decline in mainland China.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/us/politics/alaska-nick-begich-wins-house-race.html) reported that Representative Nick Begich III defeated an independent challenger in Alaska.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915197) reported that Germany's far-right AfD appealed to Elon Musk to invest and establish a Tesla presence in Saxony-Anhalt.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/negocios/2026/11/elon-musk-quer-fundir-tesla-e-spacex-e-negocios-de-ambas-ja-se-sobrepoem.shtml) reported that Elon Musk previously tasked Tesla's design team with building a flying sports car as the businesses of Tesla and SpaceX overlap.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/16/mamdani-democrats-midterms) reported that New York mayor Zohran Mamdani's cost-of-living message influenced progressives and centrists in red states during affordability elections.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6j9mlldgpgjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Lauren Boebert will not serve a fourth term in Congress after losing her Colorado seat.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/lauren-boebert-midterms-concession-video-b3084998.html) reported that Lauren Boebert faced criticism over Christian messaging in a concession video following her defeat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trumpbacked-lauren-boebert-concedes-colorado-house-race-after-narrow-defeat-to-democrat-eileen-laubacher-101794630214410.html) reported that Lauren Boebert accepted defeat in Colorado's 4th Congressional District after losing by less than 1 percentage point to Democrat Eileen Laubacher.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/elon-musk-tesla-florida-texas-b3084462.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/rep-carlos-gimenez-invites-elon-musk-to-relocate-tesla-headquarters-from-texas-to-florida-101794577280272.html) reported that Republican Congressman Carlos Gimenez invited Elon Musk to relocate Tesla's headquarters from Texas to Florida.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/13/trump-maga-lauren-boebert-colorado) reported that US congresswoman Lauren Boebert lost her re-election bid in Colorado to Democrat Eileen Laubacher.

reports.text: [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/27/qatar-lng-exports-hit-highest-level-since-war-began-despite-disruption-in-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that Qatar LNG exports hit their highest level since the war began despite disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/27/egypts-president-sisi-welcomes-qatars-sheikh-tamim-to-cairo-for-talks/) reported that Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad al Thani arrived in Cairo for talks with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi regarding Palestine and regional stability.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-qatars-lng-shipments-reach-highest-pace-since-start-of-us-iran-war-report/) reported that Qatar's LNG shipments reached their highest pace since the start of the US-Iran war according to Bloomberg data.
[TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2225397) reported that Qatar deployed at least 34 tankers to transport fuel through the Strait of Hormuz.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/qatari-egyptian-leaders-discuss-gaza-ceasefire-and-regional-security?traffic_source=rss) reported that Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani visited Cairo for official talks with Egyptian leaders aimed at strengthening bilateral relations and discussing the Gaza ceasefire and regional security.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/egypts-sisi-qatari-emir-discuss-regional-tensions-gaza-ceasefire-3726031) reported that Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi and Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani held talks in Cairo on regional tensions and efforts to implement the Gaza ceasefire.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/egyptian-qatari-fms-discuss-bilateral-ties-regional-developments/) reported that Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty received Qatari Prime Minister for talks on bilateral ties and regional developments.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/egypt-iraq-fms-discuss-bilateral-ties-ahead-of-iraqi-pms-cairo-visit/) reported that Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and Iraqi counterpart Fuad Hussein discussed bilateral cooperation ahead of the Iraqi prime minister's Cairo visit.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261123-iraqi-premier-egyptian-president-discuss-bilateral-ties-regional-coordination-in-cairo/) reported that Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi met Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi in Cairo on Monday to discuss strengthening bilateral relations.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249621/Rubio-Qatari-prime-minister-to-hold-talks-in-Washington-DC), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/qatar-pm-meet-rubio-washington-talks-us-iran-war) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is scheduled to meet Qatar's Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim in Washington for talks regarding the US-Iran war.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/egyptian-saudi-fms-discuss-regional-developments-de-escalation-efforts/) reported that Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and Saudi counterpart Prince Faisal bin Farhan discussed bilateral developments and de-escalation efforts.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/fidan-talks-regional-issues-with-egyptian-saudi-and-krg-officials-3725898) reported that Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan discussed regional issues in separate phone calls with his Egyptian and Saudi counterparts and the KRG prime minister.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261123-qatari-egyptian-top-diplomats-discuss-regional-de-escalation-efforts/) reported that Qatari Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani and Egyptian counterpart Badr Abdelatty discussed efforts to de-escalate regionally over the phone.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641689/dar-saudi-fm-discuss-possible-r4-meeting-on-regional-developments) reported that Dar and the Saudi Foreign Minister discussed a possible R4 meeting on regional developments and agreed to remain in close contact.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249509/Egypt-and-Oman-s-Foreign-Ministers-discuss-regional-de-escala), a state-media outlet, reported that Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and Omani counterpart Sayyid Badr Albusaidi discussed regional de-escalation.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86324848/Iran-Oman-and-Uzbekistan-discuss-maritime-freedom-and-transit), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249494/Iran-Oman-Uzbekistan-FMs-hold-trilateral-meeting-in-Muscat) reported that the foreign ministers of Iran, Oman, and Uzbekistan held a trilateral meeting in Muscat to discuss transit cooperation.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532269/Araghchi-meets-Sultan-of-Oman-in-Muscat-on-bilateral-ties-regional), a state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi met with Sultan Haitham bin Tariq Al Said in Muscat.
[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249495/Araghchi-meets-Qatari-delegation-in-Muscat), a state-media outlet, reported that Abbas Araghchi met with a Qatari government delegation in Muscat.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582774/iranian-fm-meets-cdf-munir-over-regional-security/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Asim Munir in Rawalpindi to discuss regional security.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86324340/Iran-Oman-FMs-meet-discuss-regional-developments) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Omani counterpart Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi met in Tehran to discuss bilateral ties and regional developments.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249470/Iran-China-discuss-regional-stability-cooperation) reported that Iran's deputy foreign minister for legal and international affairs discussed international developments, regional peace, and stability with China.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249475/Iran-Oman-FMs-discuss-regional-stability-in-Muscat) reported that the foreign ministers of Iran and Oman discussed bilateral relations and regional stability in Muscat.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323759/Araghchi-meets-Pakistan-s-Army-chief-to-discuss-regional-security), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249456/Araghchi-meets-Pakistan-s-Army-chief-to-discuss-reg-security) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met with Pakistan Army Chief Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir to discuss regional security.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249454/ECO-FMs-support-Iran-s-initiative-to-permanently-end-war), [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532222/ECO-Backs-Iran-Plan-to-End-Imposed-War) reported that the Council of Foreign Ministers of the Economic Cooperation Organization concluded in Islamabad with the adoption of support for Iran's initiative to end the war.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249453/Araghchi-and-Pakistani-counterpart-hold-talks-in-Islamabad), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323679/Iranian-and-Pakistani-foreign-ministers-hold-talks-in-Islamabad) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Pakistani counterpart Ishaq Dar held a bilateral meeting in Islamabad.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323628/Iran-Russia-FMs-hold-phone-talks-to-discuss-regional-developments), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249452/Araghchi-Lavrov-hold-call-to-discuss-regional-developments) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held a phone conversation to discuss regional developments.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323743/Araghchi-other-ECO-foreign-ministers-meet-Pakistani-PM), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249457/Araghchi-meets-with-Pakistani-PM-on-sidelines-of-ECO-meeting) reported that Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif held a joint meeting with the heads of delegations attending the 30th ECO Council of Ministers, including Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323837/Foreign-Minister-Araghchi-leaves-Islamabad-for-Tehran) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi departed Islamabad for Tehran after concluding the ECO meeting.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323316/Iran-Pakistan-foreign-ministry-spokespersons-meet-in-Islamabad) reported that the foreign ministry spokespersons and foreign ministers of Iran and Pakistan met on the sidelines of the ECO summit in Islamabad.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323353/ECO-members-back-Iran-s-proposal-to-end-war-Foreign-Minister), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249448/ECO-members-throw-weights-behind-Iran-s-proposal-to-end-war) reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Economic Cooperation Organization member states backed Tehran's proposal to end the war.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-iran-committed-to-diplomacy-us-chose-different-path-foreign-minister-araghchi/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi stated Iran remains committed to diplomacy while the US chose a path of aggression and economic pressure.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86322845/Araghchi-arrives-in-Islamabad-to-attend-ECO-summit), an Iranian state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi arrived in Islamabad at the head of a political-economic delegation to attend the 30th ECO summit.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249415/Iran-s-top-diplomat-to-travel-to-Pakistan-for-ECO-meeting), [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/araghchi-travels-to-pakistan-to-attend-eco-meeting/), including a state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi departed for Pakistan to attend the 30th Meeting of the ECO.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/araghchi-arrives-in-pakistan-set-to-visit-oman-on-tuesday/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in Pakistan to participate in the 30th session of the Economic Cooperation Organization.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/iran-foreign-minister-abbas-aragchi-to-visit-muscat-hold-talks-with-omani-counterpart-101794748995709.html) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will hold talks with his Omani counterpart during a visit to Muscat on Tuesday.
[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86322588/Araghchi-set-to-visit-Pakistan-and-Oman-Foreign-Ministry) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will visit Pakistan and Oman.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-914945) reported that Iranian state news agency IRNA announced Araghchi's upcoming visit to Oman.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/iran-accuses-us-violating-international-law/) reported that Gholam-Hossein Darzi, Iran's representative to the United Nations, accused the United States of violating international law and the United Nations Charter.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/22/14-people-missing-after-russian-drone-strike-on-kyiv-region) reported that two people were recovered dead and at least four injured following a Russian drone strike on the Kyiv region.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90071) reported that Ukraine's Defense Forces shot down a Russian jet-powered Geran-5 drone over the Kyiv region using a Swedish RBS-70 man-portable air defense system for the first time.

reports.text: [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189177-war-update-136-clashes-on-front-line-over-past-day-two-sectors-see-fiercest-fighting.html) reported that 136 combat engagements occurred along the front line over the past day, with the heaviest Russian pressure concentrated in two sectors.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188741-167-clashes-reported-along-front-line-in-past-24-hours-with-pokrovsk-sector-remaining-hottest-spot.html) reported that 167 combat engagements were recorded along the front line over the past 24 hours, with the Pokrovsk sector remaining the hottest spot.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064755/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188814-russias-november-losses-in-ukraine-already-top-55000-setting-new-wartime-record-general-staff.html) reported that Ukraine's General Staff stated Russian forces suffered 55,629 personnel losses in the first 25 days of November, marking the highest monthly figure of the war.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/general-staff-russia-has-lost-1-645-899-troops-in-ukraine-since-feb-24-2022/) reported that the General Staff stated Russian forces suffered 2,319 casualties over the past day, bringing total reported losses since Feb. 24, 2022, to 1,645,899.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/general-staff-russia-has-lost-1-643-580-troops-in-ukraine-since-feb-24-2022/) reported that the General Staff stated Russia has lost 1,643,580 troops in Ukraine since February 24, 2022, including 2,091 casualties suffered over the past day.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-breaks-yearly-troop-losses-record-in-ukraine-at-432-519-casualties-general-staff-says/) reported that the General Staff stated Russia broke its yearly troop losses record in Ukraine with 432,519 casualties.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187920-war-update-161-combat-clashes-reported-on-front-line-over-past-day.html) reported that 161 combat engagements between Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian troops were recorded along the front line on November 23.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187894-lithuania-provides-ukraine-with-over-usd-1b-in-military-aid-since-2022-general-staff.html) reported that Lithuania has provided Ukraine with over $1 billion in military assistance since 2022.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187530-war-update-149-clashes-on-front-lines-over-past-day-heaviest-fighting-on-kostiantynivka-pokrovsk-axes.html) reported that Ukraine's Defense Forces engaged in 149 combat clashes with Russian troops along the front line on November 22, with the heaviest fighting on the Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk axes.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187253-war-update-116-clashes-on-front-line-russian-forces-pressing-hardest-in-pokrovsk-kostiantynivka-sectors.html) reported that 116 combat engagements took place along the front line, with Russian forces launching nearly 25 assaults in the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka sectors.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/general-staff-russia-has-lost-1-633-130-troops-in-ukraine-since-feb-24-2022/) reported that total Russian troop losses reached 1,633,130, including 2,150 casualties over the past day.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186670-war-update-278-clashes-on-front-line-over-past-day-pokrovsk-sector-hottest.html) reported that 278 combat engagements were recorded along the front line on November 19, with the highest number in the Pokrovsk sector.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186183-war-update-205-clashes-on-front-line-80-russian-troops-neutralized-on-pokrovsk-axis.html) reported that 205 combat engagements were recorded along the frontline on November 18, with 80 Russian troops neutralized on the Pokrovsk axis.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185400-war-update-135-combat-engagements-on-front-line-over-past-day.html) reported that 135 combat engagements were recorded along the frontline between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invading forces on November 16.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185350-war-update-133-combat-engagements-on-front-line.html) reported that 133 combat engagements were recorded along the front line, with Russian forces attacking Ukrainian positions 13 times in the Pokrovsk sector.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185037-war-update-141-clashes-on-front-lines-over-past-day-kostiantynivka-axis-hottest.html) reported that 141 combat engagements were recorded on the front line, with the Kostiantynivka axis being the most active.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062929/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff recorded 171 combat clashes on November 14, with the Pokrovsk front experiencing the highest number of attacks.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184540-war-update-243-clashes-on-front-line-fiercest-fighting-in-pokrovsk-sector.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062835/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff recorded hundreds of combat clashes along the front line over the past day, with the heaviest fighting in the Pokrovsk sector.

reports.text: [UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/trump-and-nato-chief-urge-russia-not-to-widen-the-war/) reported that Donald Trump and NATO chief Mark Rutte stressed the importance of Russia avoiding any action that intentionally or unintentionally expands the war.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649422-trump-ukraine-responsiblity-escalation/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte was surprised by U.S. President Donald Trump unilaterally amending a joint statement to urge Kyiv to show restraint.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/27/8064894/) reported that US President Donald Trump criticized Russia's removal from the G8 and stated he would like to see Vladimir Putin attend the G20 summit in Florida.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4189083-trump-adds-ukraine-to-joint-statement-with-nato-chief-urging-restraint-in-war-escalation.html) reported that US President Donald Trump amended the wording of a joint statement with NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte regarding war escalation.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNUjY3Sm9MUkZXUEQyNDc3MFdwRlFBaWcyWkpxbDRYT21RVFYySkgtUm9WeFNFb1lZUU9lM1BqbDBWLW5VLW9PR1ZvMjFxVHZNX2Q2b01rNXdVQUJIYmZ5ZHd4eEI1RkI3dlctelgwODgwczQta2ZWZEpDU2Jwa29MT21ZMlJ1clVNMkM0?oc=5), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/id-like-to-have-him-trump-says-putin-welcome-at-g20-summit-in-us-doubts-russian-leader-will-attend/articleshow/136207731.cms) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump stated that Russian President Vladimir Putin can attend the G20 summit if he chooses to do so.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91339) reported that US President Donald Trump altered the wording of a joint statement with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte to add Ukraine to an escalation warning.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/donald-trump-diverges-from-nato-statement-emphasizing-ukraine-mustnt-expand-war/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/trump-and-nato-secretary-general-discuss-ukraine-war-and-iran-conflicts/) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump emphasized that Ukraine must not expand the war during discussions with NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte that also covered Iran conflicts and NATO defense spending.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064852/) reported that Donald Trump's version of a joint statement with NATO chief Mark Rutte urges both Russia and Ukraine to avoid actions that could expand the war.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188805-trump-and-rutte-urge-putin-not-to-expand-war-in-ukraine.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte issued a joint statement following their meeting in Florida calling on Russia not to expand its war in Ukraine.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261126-live-eu-leaders-face-showdown-over-ukraine-funding-as-divisions-deepen), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1126/1600710-trump-nato-ukraine/) reported that US President Donald Trump and NATO chief Mark Rutte urged Russia not to expand its war with Ukraine.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/c642559300f1) reported that Rutte stated Trump is testing Putin on his willingness to negotiate.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1586845/kremlin-accuses-estonia-of-aiding-ukrainian-drone-strikes/) reported that the Kremlin accused Estonia of supporting Ukrainian drone strikes, warning that the actions could bring both countries closer to open war.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/ukraine-tells-putin-to-stop-complaining-over-oil-refinery-strikes-says-ending-war-can-stop-attacks-101795611179460.html) reported that Ukraine's Andrii Sybiha told Vladimir Putin to end the war instead of complaining about attacks on Russian oil refineries.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91134) reported that the Kremlin accused Estonia of aiding Ukrainian drone strikes and warned that the countries were brought to the brink of open war.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-tax-increases-putin-ukraine-b3091143.html) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin has increasingly sought to squeeze tax revenue out of businesses and consumers to support his war in Ukraine.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90696711) reported that Moscow's Foreign Ministry accused Estonia of a series of hostile actions that are on the verge of triggering an open war, according to Reuters.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-nato-estonia-warship-casualties-map-b3090337.html) reported that Estonia decided to close its border with Russia for six months starting from December 1.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Geopolitics/Europe/US-Weighs-NATO-Style-Security-Guarantees-for-Ukraine-as-Russia-Pushes-Back.html) reported that US President Donald Trump may consider offering Ukraine security guarantees modeled on NATO's collective-defense commitments.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/cards/putin-is-reportedly-open-to-article-5-style-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-but-what-does-article-5-actually-say-would-the-guarantees-require-nato-members-to-go-to-war-if-russia-attacks-again) reported that sources close to the U.S. negotiating team stated Putin is open to Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/russia-warns-estonias-moves-are-close-to-spark-an-open-war/) reported that rhetoric between Moscow and Tallinn spiked sharply after Estonia moved to shut down key border crossings.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90370831), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187592-kushner-says-trump-ready-to-back-article-5like-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-only-if-they-serve-us-interests.html) reported that U.S. presidential envoy Jared Kushner stated that President Donald Trump would approve NATO Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine only if they serve American national interests.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/kushner-trump-nato-ukraine-russia-security/33903834.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064102/) reported that US presidential envoy Jared Kushner stated that US President Donald Trump would consider NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine if they served American national interests and wider European security.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223081), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that U.S. presidential envoy Kushner shared his vision for future relations between Russia and the North Atlantic Alliance.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/putin-prelomio-uz-jedan-uslov-pristaje-na-garancije-u-stilu-nato-a-za-ukrajinu/), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/putin-navodno-pristao-na-snazne-bezbednosne-garancije-za-ukrajinu-po-ugledu-na-nato/xfb82pn) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin has privately agreed to the idea of post-war security guarantees for Ukraine from the United States and Europe under certain conditions.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187146-zelensky-ukraines-nato-membership-being-discussed.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Ukraine's membership in NATO would be the best security guarantee for the country.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187167-zelensky-says-ukraine-not-yet-received-official-security-guarantees-equivalent-to-nato-article-5.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has not yet officially been offered security guarantees equivalent to NATO Article 5.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/internationalrussia-ukraine-war/article-915627) reported that according to The Wall Street Journal, Jared Kushner discussed offering Ukraine NATO membership if it cedes Donbas to Russia during peace talks.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/us-zelensky-ukraine-russia-land-swap-b3088764.html) reported that Donald Trump previously ruled out NATO membership for Ukraine while struggling to reach a breakthrough in mediated talks.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90709) reported that the Wall Street Journal stated Washington discussed giving Ukraine full NATO membership if it relinquished part of its territory.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222305) reported that Finnish politician Armando Mema stated the EU pushes Ukraine's NATO membership while ignoring Russia's concerns.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/c8f00a762b65) reported that Washington is exploring alternative peace arrangements involving territorial concessions or front-line freezes coupled with NATO membership or international security guarantees.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222153) reported that lawmaker Alexander Dubinsky stated Zelensky lied about coalition support for Ukraine's NATO membership, noting Germany's statement mentioned only security guarantees and continued support.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90651) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner said President Donald Trump wants Europe involved in any Ukraine peace agreement rather than imposing a unilateral settlement.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/the-debate/20261116-should-ukraine-trade-donbas-for-nato-membership) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the United States asked him about a swap where Russia gets the Donbas and the rest of Ukraine gets NATO membership.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/zelenskyy-us-proposal-donbas-withdrawal-nato-membership/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated US negotiators raised the possibility of Ukraine withdrawing from the eastern Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-volodymyr-zelensky-annonce-la-preparation-d-une-reunion-de-la-coalition-des-volontaires-qui-pourrait-s-averer-historique_6810982_3210.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced the preparation of a coalition of volunteers meeting to define the European position in future talks with Moscow.

reports.text: [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642245/pm-shehbaz-lauds-musadik-maliks-diplomacy-at-delhi-sco-forum), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1586763/shehbaz-lauds-maliks-representation-at-sco-dialogue/), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pm-shehbaz-praises-musadik-maliks-diplomatic-performance-at-delhi-sco-forum/) reported that Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif praised Federal Minister Musadik Masood Malik for his representation and diplomacy at an SCO cultural dialogue in Delhi.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223759), a state-run outlet, reported that Pakistan's ambassador to Russia Faisal Niaz Tirmizi stated Pakistan hopes President Vladimir Putin will attend the 2027 SCO summit.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-offers-evidence-based-talks-with-india-on-terrorism/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046343/any-talks-with-india-on-terrorism-must-be-evidence-based-says-musadik-malik) reported that Pakistani Federal Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik stated in New Delhi that any bilateral talks on terrorism with India must be based on evidence.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585180/climate-change-enemy-of-civilisations-pakistan-tells-sco-moot-in-india/) reported that Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik declared climate change an enemy of civilisations at the SCO moot in India.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641524/malik-warns-of-climate-threat-to-civilisation-heritage-at-sco-forum-in-new-delhi) reported that Musadik Malik warned of climate threats at the SCO forum in New Delhi and met Tajik and Iranian officials.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/musadik-malik-calls-for-dialogue-to-resolve-issues-during-india-visit/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584860/musadik-malik-urges-evidence-based-solutions-in-delhi/) reported that Pakistani Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr Musadik Malik called for resolving regional issues through evidence-based solutions rather than mutual accusations during his visit to India.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/no-cultural-diplomacy-in-india-as-pakistani-minister-malik-blocked-from-visiting-historic-sites/) reported that Pakistani Federal Minister for Climate Change Musadik Malik was blocked from visiting historic sites in New Delhi.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-to-promote-shared-heritage-through-sco-civilisational-dialogue/) reported that Pakistan's participation in the SCO Civilizational Dialogue in New Delhi offers an opportunity to promote shared heritage.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584347/musadik-malik-arrives-in-india-for-sco-dialogue/) reported that Federal Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/india-pakistani-minister-visits-delhi-for-sco-forum-amid-frozen-ties/live-79999264?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/776aabd4c635) reported that Pakistan Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in the first high-level visit since 2023.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641334/musadik-malik-arrives-in-new-delhi-to-lead-pakistan-delegation-at-sco-forum), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045878/musadik-malik-arrives-in-new-delhi-to-attend-sco-dialogue-forum), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/musadik-malik-arrives-in-india-to-lead-pakistans-delegation-at-sco-forum/) reported that Pakistan's Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Malik arrived in New Delhi to lead a delegation at the SCO forum.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584154/musadik-to-lead-delelgation-for-sco-forum-in-india/) reported that Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Masood Malik will lead the Pakistan delegation to the first Shanghai Cooperation Organisation forum in India.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583771/pakistani-delegation-led-by-musadik-malik-to-attend-sco-civilizations-dialogue-forum-in-india/) reported that Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Masood Malik will lead a Pakistani delegation to India for the SCO Civilizations Dialogue Forum.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641093/musadik-malik-set-for-delhi-visit) reported that Musadik Malik's visit to Delhi will be the first by a Pakistani federal minister to India since May 2023.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-confirms-first-federal-ministerial-visit-to-india-in-over-three-years-for-sco-moot/) reported that Federal Minister Dr. Musadik Malik will visit New Delhi for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in the first ministerial visit in over three years.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640294/musadik-malik-to-represent-pakistan-at-new-delhi-sco-dialogue-fo), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044492/fo-says-climate-minister-musadik-malik-nominated-to-represent-pakistan-at-sco-moot-in-new-delhi) reported that Pakistan's Foreign Office announced that Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik has been nominated to represent Pakistan at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation dialogue in New Delhi.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581453/pakistan-to-attend-sco-meeting-in-india/) reported that Pakistan has decided to participate in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation meeting in New Delhi.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/pakistan-climate-minister-sco-summit-india-visit-new-delhi/article71701699.ece) reported that the upcoming visit marks the first high-level visit by a Pakistani minister to India in three years.

reports.text: [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/27/estonia-will-close-border-with-russia-to-secure-europe-foreign-minister-says-during-baku-v) reported that Estonia opened its embassies in Baku and Yerevan to strengthen its strategic ties with the South Caucasus and that Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna confirmed Estonia will close its border with Russia.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/democrats-want-to-end-trumps-iran-war-but-how-different-are-they?traffic_source=rss) reported that decades of bipartisan pressure on Tehran raise questions about how far Democrats are willing to change US policy on the war.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/27/estonia-closing-land-borders-with-russia-to-keep-out-spies?traffic_source=rss) reported that Estonia is set to close its land border crossings to Russia by December 1.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649357-americans-want-iran-war-end-poll/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that a University of Maryland-Ipsos poll found 55% of Americans want an immediate end to the Iran war while 18% back escalation.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249684/Most-Americans-want-Iran-conflict-to-end-Poll), a state-media outlet, reported that a survey conducted by the University of Maryland and Ipsos found that 55 percent of Americans want to end the war on Iran immediately.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/poll-finds-us-voters-want-government-to-end-iran-war-regardless-of-terms?traffic_source=rss), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/24/iran-war-poll-democrats-funding/) reported that a survey found 55 percent of US voters want the war with Iran ended immediately regardless of terms.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/ukraine-takes-war-russia-far-from-borders/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Kyiv admitted to striking Russian ships far from its borders.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/24/estonia-s-interior-minister-suggests-petitioning-putin-to-end-war-in-ukraine-after-narva-resident-launches-petition-to-keep-border-with-russia-open-for-family-visits) reported that an Estonian resident launched a petition asking Estonia to keep its border with Russia open for family visits.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532392/Araghchi-Iran-s-enriched-uranium-to-be-used-solely-in-line-with), a state-media outlet, reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi reaffirmed that Iran's enriched uranium stockpiles will remain under the country's control and be used in accordance with national needs.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iran-wants-diplomacy-end-war-trump-says-terms-unacceptable) reported that Abbas Araghchi stated Tehran still hoped diplomacy could end its war with the United States, while Donald Trump said Iran's terms were unacceptable.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249560/Any-deal-must-be-honorable-lasting-prevent-a-return-to-war), a state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated Iran's uranium reserves are consumed in compatibility with the country's needs.
