[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/27/jared-kushner-interview-peril-putin-corporate-rival) reported that Jared Kushner gave a 70-minute interview discussing the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2225973), a Russian state outlet, reported that Kirill Dmitriev praised the top two US negotiators as peacekeepers, advocated dialogue, and stressed the importance of maintaining contacts between Russia and the United States.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91855566) reported that White House envoy Jared Kushner stated Russian President Vladimir Putin showed restraint by not resorting to nuclear weapons in Ukraine.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/putin-showed-restraint-by-not-using-nuclear-weapons-kushner-says/) reported that White House envoy Jared Kushner stated Russian President Vladimir Putin showed restraint by not using nuclear weapons.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/26/jared-kushner-says-putin-has-shown-restraint-in-ukraine-and-promised-not-to-use-nuclear-weapons) reported that Jared Kushner claimed Vladimir Putin promised not to use nuclear weapons in Ukraine during an interview.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/grandmaster-of-politics-who-wants-peace-jared-kushner-interview-reveals-how-trumps-envoy-sees-putin-2/) reported that US President Donald Trump's envoy and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, praised Russian President Vladimir Putin and repeated Kremlin claims about the war during an interview.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649384-kushner-putin-dmitriev-ukraine/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Jared Kushner stated Russian leader Vladimir Putin is a grandmaster of politics with a deep understanding of issues.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/26/trump-envoy-jared-kushner-calls-putin-a-historic-figure-and-a-grandmaster-of-politics-praises-his-deep-understanding-of-the-issues) reported that US presidential envoy Jared Kushner called Vladimir Putin a historic figure and a grandmaster of politics.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/kushner-putin-witkoff-ukraine-war-b3091967.html) reported that Donald Trump's peace envoy accused European countries of having no plan to end the war in Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064710/), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/26/kushner-blames-stalled-peace-talks-on-alleged-ukrainian-attack-on-putin-s-residence-an-attack-both-u-s-intelligence-and-trump-say-did-not-happen) reported that US Special Envoy Jared Kushner claimed an alleged Ukrainian attack on Vladimir Putin's residence in December 2025 hindered peace negotiations.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064714/) reported that Kushner praised Vladimir Putin's approach to negotiations and his assurances that he has no intention of using nuclear weapons.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064720/) reported that Kushner described the war in Ukraine as Europe's proxy war, claiming Europe is funding and arming Ukraine.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/22/intelligence-chief-jay-clayton-trump-putin-my-friend) reported that US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton was pressed on Trump's characterization of Putin during media appearances on Sunday.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-intelligence-chief-jay-clayton-says-putin-is-not-americas-friend-amid-trumps-friend-remark-101795375469720.html) reported that Jay Clayton stated Putin is 'not America's friend in Ukraine.'
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915743) reported that US intelligence chief Clayton stated Putin is not America's friend in Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063962/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Ukraine needs security guarantees for decades rather than just for Donald Trump's term.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063891/) reported that US President Donald Trump declined to outline security guarantees for Kyiv, stating an agreement must come first.

[Jamaica Gleaner](http://jamaica-gleaner.com/article/world-news/20261121/takeaways-historic-summit-among-trump-xi-and-putin) reported that United States President Donald Trump, China's Xi Jinping, and Russia's Vladimir Putin held their first-ever meeting in Shenzhen.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-claims-friend-putin-told-him-ukraine-war-wouldnt-have-started-if-he-were-potus-then-101795198522163.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90774) reported that US President Donald Trump claimed Vladimir Putin told him the Ukraine war would not have started if he were president and expressed a desire for peace.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/trump-cites-good-talks-putin-ukraine-holds-back-security-guarantees) reported that US President Donald Trump said he and Russian leader Vladimir Putin held very good talks on Ukraine but held back on security guarantees.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90735) reported that Russia has rejected proposals for NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine, calling arrangements resembling membership unacceptable.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/us-says-russia-open-to-nato-style-security-guarantees-for-ukraine) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated Russia appears willing to accept NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine after the war.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90681) reported that Jared Kushner stated Russia is becoming comfortable with security guarantees modeled on NATO's collective defense clause.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063771/), [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/russia-pushes-back-against-us-idea-of-nato-style-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-a94326) reported that Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov called US ideas for NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine unacceptable and demanded acknowledgment that Ukraine will not join the alliance, while confirming discussions on a potential visit to Moscow by British, German, and French representatives.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063712/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met with Steve Witkoff, Jared Kushner, and European advisers to discuss security guarantees.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89357897) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner stated the United States is willing to offer Ukraine NATO-style security guarantees.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/20/kushner-trump-open-to-nato-like-security-guarantees-for-ukraine?traffic_source=rss) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner stated President Donald Trump is open to offering NATO-like security guarantees to Ukraine.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/european-leaders-unite-in-berlin-to-reaffirm-support-for-ukraine?traffic_source=rss) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin vowed to retaliate for Kerch Bridge strikes.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/ukraine-war-briefing-trump-open-to-kyiv-getting-nato-like-mutual-defence-guarantee-says-kushner) reported that France called for a fresh look at Ukraine joining NATO.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249555/Shenzhen-summit-proved-US-can-no-longer-rally-states-on-Iran), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86327535/Shenzhen-summit-proved-US-no-longer-able-to-forge-alliance-against), state-media outlets, reported that senior Iranian leader adviser Mohammad Mokhber stated the Shenzhen summit proved the US is no longer able to forge an alliance or rally states against Iran.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/trump-admite-que-reducir-arsenal-nuclear-sumamente-dificil-pese-acuerdo-rusia-china_202611206b00990c5cb1082f89b0ff45.html) reported that US President Trump described his relationship with the leaders of China and Russia as fantastic following the first trilateral meeting between the three powers.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/19/world/europe/trump-xi-putin-nuclear-weapons-ukraine.html) reported that after their summit, the leaders of Russia, the United States, and China agreed that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNdERQSHBUWVRvbktIZEo4ZDFTS2FKNzZjRUwzamQ5VjkwUE9RQl9KSkoxdmJ2QmNnT2tzNkdKc2dYNjNNQ2Q3RVNERlB3X1NOa3FUTU5XdmNocGtRdWdSSzIyelZhd3Mwc0JEd0t6dXhicEd4TVRPclNPcy1TTkQwcFE5OVV1WFBrUmNEcWFRenA0TGJYMDh2OWMtaV9PZmd1LXJWa0hUMWU1bE5JSjcwTw?oc=5), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045885/trumps-personalised-diplomacy-hits-its-limits-with-3-way-summit) reported that US President Donald Trump's personalized diplomacy has hit its limits with a 3-way summit.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/f493945e3c26) reported that President Trump stated a deal with Xi and Putin to limit nuclear weapons will be difficult but he will keep pushing, and that President Xi agreed on limiting nuclear weapons.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxPX3RYQ05XU192RjlmR2lPUTdzYTEwVHdETC0xdklDNF9kUm5VYzl6ckgzMHN6SHU1RlJPOUFqNUxBQWZYajJvbTFDX0ZSX3NHZllNSVBhLUtEbER2OU40WWpHZzcwajh4eEdFbEl1VGk4djZkR3MzWDU2LUM0WjBFU2tSbEZzaHZBMkJSVmIySURqMjhLM0M1ZmxoT01KSjl0RF9R?oc=5), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584282/trump-xi-and-putin-sign-symbolic-peace-declaration-at-unprecedented-shenzhen-summit/) reported that China published a 4-point peace declaration after the meeting between Xi, Putin, and Trump.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/xi-jinping-calls-for-total-elimination-of-nuclear-weapons-at-meeting-with-trump-and-putin) reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping called for nuclear weapons to be banned and destroyed entirely during a meeting with Trump and Putin.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/asia-pacific/trump-xi-putin-peace-declaration-unprecedented-summit/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/trump-xi-putin-hold-historic-3-way-summit-pledge-peaceful-use-of-nuclear-weapons/) reported that China, the U.S., and Russia issued a symbolic peace declaration emphasizing that nuclear war should never be fought.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2221925), a Russian state outlet, reported that Vladimir Putin stated Russia did not start the war in Ukraine and is trying to end it.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/19/u-s-warns-russia-it-should-make-peace-with-ukraine-now-while-trump-still-has-room-to-negotiate-the-kyiv-independent-reports) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner told Russian and Ukrainian negotiators that current talks may be the last chance.

reports.text: [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-will-not-offer-equal-tuition-fees-for-eu-students-says-andy-burnham/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/25/eu-nationals-will-pay-higher-tuition-fees-than-uk-students-burnham-indicates) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham indicated that equal tuition fees for EU and UK students will not be put on the table during ongoing negotiations with the European bloc.
[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/24/farage-preaches-the-brexit-gospel-according-to-st-nige) reported that Reform UK leader Nigel Farage engaged in anti-EU commentary.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/23/kemi-is-beside-herself-that-burnham-is-trying-to-salvage-a-brexit-deal-cant-we-all-stop-talking-about-it) reported that Kemi Badenoch concluded an anti-EU speech by designating herself the leader of common sense.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/2026/11/23/ireland-and-uk-in-a-better-space-after-uk-eu-brexit-reset-deal-helen-mcentee-says/) reported that Ireland's Minister for Foreign Affairs stated PM Andy Burnham’s deal with Brussels shows a massive change in approach by the UK.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/ex-uk-pm-theresa-may-tells-successor-to-move-on-from-brexit/article71732109.ece) reported that former British Prime Minister Theresa May stated she was aghast that successor Andy Burnham could consider rejoining the European Union.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/brexit-is-done-theresa-may-tells-burnham-move-on/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that former British Prime Minister Theresa May told Andy Burnham that Brexit is done and to move on.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2026/nov/22/andy-burnham-brexit-theresa-may-michael-gove-latest-news-updates) reported that the issue dominated the Sunday broadcast round following Friday's deals on trade and youth mobility.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/a-decade-after-brexit-vote-uk-strikes-sweeping-deal-to-rebuild-ties-with-eu/) reported that Britain and the European Union reached an agreement to rebuild economic, trade, educational, and security relations ten years after the Brexit vote.
[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/eu-uk-reach-reset-deal-after-brexit) reported that the UK and the EU signed three agreements in Brussels marking a new effort to reset post-Brexit relations.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/uk-european-union-summit-meeting-on-november-20-2026/article71723782.ece) reported that the U.K. and E.U. are expected to announce a youth mobility scheme for 100,000 individuals aged 18 to 32 to live and work across borders.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/20/uk-and-eu-sign-their-biggest-deal-since-brexit-in-brussels?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and European Council President António Costa signed three agreements in Brussels.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/uk-and-eu-agree-deals-on-trade-and-youth-movement-pledging-to-rebuild-ties-after-brexit-20261121-p61g38.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham touted the agreement as a win for the UK's cost of living.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/eu-and-uk-strike-landmark-deal-to-strengthen-ties-after-brexit/a-80001076?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the European Union and the United Kingdom agreed on landmark deals on youth mobility and trade.
[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-uk-and-eu-strike-landmark-deal-to-rebuild-ties-after-brexit) reported that leaders reached the agreement following a summit in Brussels.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/dix-ans-apres-le-brexit-le-royaume-uni-s-enflamme-autour-d-un-hypothetique-retour-vers-l-europe-20261120) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham's remarks sparked debate over a hypothetical return to Europe ten years after Brexit.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxPMFZfOXJRS2RFTTlMenB0cXUxNG1mNnVFaThZUGVfM0J0cnY5ckZmRTZDbWZGVWtWSFBhR3lHMF9ZZWVMOHpOSFNMZjNROTc0Z3JFSkJzaUdXYVpQWmg2T1E5ckIyYk82bXpHUzUzTTRkc1dTX2hzYi12RHVVYUxPM0ExbDRNb29tcVhPdEJaZ3RrUQ?oc=5), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2026/1120/1599959-eu-uk-summit/) reported that Downing Street announced that an EU-UK reset deal has been agreed during British Prime Minister Andy Burnham's visit to Brussels.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-burnham-hails-landmark-eu-uk-deal-as-good-day-for-britain-europe) reported that Britain and the European Union agreed deals on trade, carbon emissions, and youth movement at a Brussels summit, with Prime Minister Andy Burnham hailing the agreement as a landmark turning point.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/burnham-drew-a-line-under-brexit-at-the-eu-uk-summit-but-where-does-britain-go-next) reported that Burnham drew a line under Brexit at the EU-UK summit, which exposed the limits of negotiating one deal at a time as Brussels signaled its positions.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOdHA4czl2OVhoMVN6dURzVWJSVFBpRlhNOS1kYllMMm54RkNKTFBpM1ZVaG5jUE1yYzBlT0Q0Nk1YYlBFVFBQWC1MQW15WERjMWpZWEJ5QU1xaVFjbXRodUxuclNHVFNsWnE5WF9uY1pzcEMyRGk2MEVvRnhBUzMxRXpSeHlQV3Z4ZjlQSENjd0MySnFXbkVrZWVpY19XNjZZSklEYjJVOEgxTmZRM0NzbDdXU3A?oc=5), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/20/burnham-trade-youth-mobility-deals-biggest-step-towards-eu-since-brexit), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375289/uk-eu-seal-food-and-youth-deals-are-stuck-tuition-fees) reported that Britain and the European Union sealed deals on food trade and youth mobility at a summit in Brussels.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261120-eu-and-uk-agree-landmark-deal-at-burnham-s-brussels-summit) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and EU officials sealed deals to ease trade and youth mobility at a summit in Brussels.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/20/uk-eu-european-union-brexit-deal-andy-burnham-latest-news-updates), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/20/the-deal-is-done-uk-says-brexit-reset-deal-with-eu-is-agreed/) reported that the EU stated the reset deal will not take effect without an agreement on tuition fees for European students.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-rare-eu-uk-summit-as-andy-burnham-seeks-to-mend-brexit-damage) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and EU top officials were set to announce deals to ease trade and youth mobility at a Brussels summit.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261120-eu-and-uk-set-to-sign-deals-on-trade-energy-youth-mobility-at-brussels-summit), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/c6lymr5x4ye5o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the UK and the EU are set to agree on new deals concerning trade, energy, and youth mobility at a Brussels summit.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/andy-burnham-brussels-antonio-costa-brexit-ursula-von-der-leyen-b3088477.html), [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/20/g-s1-154576/uk-eu-summit) reported that top EU officials met with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham in a rare summit to strengthen ties and mend Brexit damage a decade after the leave vote.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/royaume-uni-andy-burnham-a-bruxelles-pour-concretiser-son-rapprochement-avec-l-union-europeenne-20261120) reported that London and Brussels reached a common understanding on youth mobility ten years after the Brexit referendum.
[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/can-andy-burnham-bring-british-brio-back-to-brussels) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham is in Brussels for an EU-UK summit.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/20/au-royaume-uni-andy-burnham-ravive-le-debat-sur-le-brexit-plus-de-cinq-ans-apres-sa-mise-en-uvre-effective_6813589_3210.html) reported that Andy Burnham revived the debate on Brexit in the United Kingdom ahead of discussions between Europeans and the UK.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/podcast/brussels-playbook-podcast/what-does-europe-want-from-andy-burnhams-reconciliation-bid/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that negotiators completed a final squeeze ahead of the EU-UK reset summit.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/as-burnham-heads-to-brussels-are-new-brexit-wars-about-to-begin?traffic_source=rss) reported that the UK premier is heading to Brussels for the second round of EU talks aimed at deepening post-Brexit cooperation.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/uk/2026/11/19/zombie-nation-burnhams-britain-ponders-its-brexit-woes-as-eu-uk-summit-set-to-begin/) reported that senior EU officials remain unsure whether the UK premier's positive rhetoric is backed by entrenched belief or is a warm-up act ahead of talks.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/audio/2026/nov/19/brejoin-is-andy-burnham-going-to-reverse-brexit-podcast) reported that Jessica Elgot and David McAllister discussed the prospect of the UK rejoining the European Union ahead of a UK-EU summit.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/19/andy-burnham-will-sign-a-brexit-reset-deal-tomorrow-the-real-battle-comes-next/) reported that Brussels remains wary of letting Britain cherry-pick the benefits of EU membership from outside the club as Andy Burnham prepares to sign a Brexit reset deal.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/andy-burnham-eu-uk-brexit-reset/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that POLITICO spoke to more than 30 politicians, officials, and campaigners in the UK and Brussels regarding Andy Burnham's grand strategy on Europe.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/18/david-lammy-andy-burnham-campaign-rejoining-eu-election-brexit) reported that former foreign secretary David Lammy urged Prime Minister Andy Burnham to fight the next election on rejoining the EU ahead of a summit in Brussels.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/invest-international-rail-services-boost-uk-eu-reset-andy-burnham) reported that campaigners urged investments in international rail services to boost the UK-EU reset.

reports.text: [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743694-2027-apc-wont-repeat-peter-obis-lagos-presidential-victory-fashola-declares/) reported that former Lagos Governor Babatunde Fashola stated the APC was blindsided by Peter Obi’s 2023 Lagos election victory and vowed the party will prevent a repeat in 2027.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-peter-obi-wont-win-lagos-again-says-fashola/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/it-wont-happen-again-fashola-on-peter-obis-2023-victory-in-lagos/) reported that Babatunde Fashola stated that Peter Obi will not win Lagos in the 2027 elections as he did in 2023.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/why-nigerians-should-look-beyond-economic-hardship-vote-tinubu-senator-arise/) reported that former Senator Ayo Arise defended the economic reforms of President Bola Tinubu and urged Nigerians to look beyond current economic hardship.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/opposition-alliances-wont-succeed-in-2027-says-fashola/) reported that Babatunde Fashola predicted that emerging opposition coalitions will fail in the 2027 general elections.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-opposition-alliances-ll-fail-again-fashola-declares-at-apc-lagos-rally/) reported that Babatunde Fashola declared at an APC Lagos rally that emerging opposition coalitions will fail.
[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/adelabu-oni-seek-ekiti-support-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that an APC stalwart in Ekiti State sought support for President Bola Tinubu's re-election.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/hardship-insecurity-fuelling-nigerians-anger-against-tinubu-acf-spokesman/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that ACF spokesman Tukur Mohammed-Baba stated that hardship, poverty, and insecurity are fuelling Nigerians' anger against President Bola Tinubu.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/eie-faults-apc-absence-as-lagos-senate-reps-candidates-unveil-manifestos/) reported that candidates contesting seats in the Senate and House of Representatives in Lagos State outlined plans to address challenges in education, healthcare, and unemployment.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/sani-abbas-rally-zaria-religious-leaders-for-tinubus-re-election/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Governor Uba Sani and Speaker Tajudeen Abbas urged Zaria Christian and Muslim leaders to back Tinubu's 2027 re-election.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-has-earned-ndigbos-support-says-kalu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Deputy Speaker Benjamin Kalu urged Abia voters to re-elect President Bola Tinubu in 2027, citing the South-East Development Commission and key federal appointments.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-tinubu-takes-re-election-battle-to-ndigbo-secures-lagos-endorsement/), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/24/tinubu-woos-ndigbo-in-lagos-seeks-support-for-2027-re-election/) reported that President Bola Tinubu secured an endorsement from Ndigbo leaders and traders in Lagos during his re-election campaign visit.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-sanwo-olu-apc-leaders-rally-lagos-voters-for-tinubu-hamzat/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/24/2027-renew-tinubus-mandate-support-hamzat-sanwo-olu-urges-lagos-electorate/) reported that Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu urged voters to support President Bola Tinubu and state party candidates.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-tinubu-woos-ndigbo-in-lagos-seeks-support-for-second-term-apc-candidates/) reported that President Bola Tinubu appealed to the Igbo community in Lagos State to support his re-election bid in 2027.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/23/adalabu-political-family-pledges-ekitis-support-for-tinubus-re-election/) reported that the Modupe Adelabu Political Family pledged to mobilize supporters from Ekiti State for a re-election support rally for Tinubu.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adelabu-political-family-to-rally-ekiti-for-tinubu-shettimas-2027-re-election/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/adelabu-group-to-launch-tinubu-shettima-rally-in-ekiti/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Modupe Adelabu Political Family is set to launch the Tinubu-Shettima re-election rally in Ekiti State.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-pcc-slams-tinubu-over-fuel-subsidy-comment/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council faulted President Bola Ahmed Tinubu over his fuel subsidy comments.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/subsidy-removal-you-cant-wish-away-nigerians-hardship-adc-pcc-tells-tinubu/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council tackled President Bola Tinubu over his stance on the hardship faced by Nigerians following subsidy removal.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/2027-peter-obi-is-nigerias-only-hope-says-ndc-chairman/) reported that NDC National Chairman urged Nigerians to vote out Tinubu in 2027 and described Peter Obi as the country's only hope.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/2027-aisha-buhari-throws-weight-behind-tinubu-radda-son/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742664-tinubu-atiku-aisha-buhari-signatory-announcement-2027/) reported that former First Lady Aisha Buhari threw her weight behind President Bola Tinubu and other political figures ahead of the elections.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/927103-2027-peter-obi-is-nigerias-hope-says-ndc-national-chairman.html) reported that Moses Cleopas said Peter Obi, if elected, would prioritise protecting lives, repositioning the economy, and providing the leadership needed to rebuild the country.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/nigerians-cant-endure-another-tinubu-term-obi-is-our-hope-ndc-chairman/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-peter-obi-only-hope-for-nigeria-says-ndc-chairman/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-obi-nigerias-only-hope-says-ndc-chairman/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-peter-obi-is-only-hope-nigeria-has-this-time-cleopas/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress national chairman Senator Moses Zuwoghe urged Nigerians to vote out President Bola Tinubu in 2027 and described Peter Obi as the country's only hope.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/stop-recycling-falsehoods-against-tinubu-lagos-apc-tells-pearse/) reported that the Lagos State chapter of the All Progressives Congress slammed Dr. Adetokunbo Pearse over media interviews.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/lagos-apc-faults-pearse-over-comments-on-tinubus-academic-records/) reported that the Lagos State chapter of the All Progressives Congress faulted Dr. Adetokunbo Pearse over his comments on Bola Tinubu's academic records.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/anthem-row-fashola-faults-obis-handling-of-supporters/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that former Lagos State Governor Babatunde Fashola questioned the leadership capacity of Nigeria Democratic Congress presidential candidate Peter Obi.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/singing-old-national-anthem-not-a-crime-apc-chieftain/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that APC chieftain Dr Josef Onoh stated neither the 1999 Constitution nor the National Anthem Act 2024 criminalises singing the old national anthem.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/15/keyamo-insists-ndc-erred-in-singing-old-national-anthem-during-townhall-meeting-in-lagos/) reported that Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development Festus Keyamo stated that the Nigeria Democratic Congress erred in singing the old national anthem at a town hall meeting in Lagos.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/lagos-apc-faults-obi-ndc-over-singing-old-national-anthem/) reported that the Lagos State chapter of the All Progressives Congress criticized Peter Obi and the Nigeria Democratic Congress over the singing of the old national anthem.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/keyamo-says-no-one-sings-on-your-mandate-in-place-of-national-anthem/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/ndcs-use-of-old-anthem-suggests-secessionism-keyamo/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo accused the Nigeria Democratic Congress of promoting secessionist tendencies by singing the old national anthem.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/15/ndc-keyamo-in-war-of-words-over-singing-of-old-national-anthem-at-lagos-meeting/) reported that the minister accused Obi of planning secession and that the NDC stated the APC is sponsoring political attacks.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/old-national-anthem-keyamo-gives-dickson-48-hours-to-clarify-ndcs-position/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/keyamo-gives-dickson-48-hours-to-clarify-ndcs-anthem-position/) reported that Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo gave Seriake Dickson 48 hours to clarify the NDC's position on the old national anthem.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/trump-cambia-de-postura-frente-a-putin-y-le-pide-que-detenga-toda-agresion-militar-contra-europa-para-facilitar-el-fin-de-la-guerra-en-ucrania-3604609) reported that Donald Trump stated he had asked Russian President Vladimir Putin to halt all military aggression against Europe to facilitate the end of the war in Ukraine during their meeting last week in China.

reports.text: [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/migraciones/adios-al-sueno-americano-el-caso-del-salvadoreno-que-gano-us1-millon-en-la-loteria-y-fue-arrestado-nid26112026/) reported that ICE arrested Ariel Velasquez-Morales in Boston after he won $1 million in the Massachusetts lottery.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/suerte-le-termino-migrante-fue-detenido-ice-ee-uu-dias-despues-ganar-loteria_1795714392) reported that a Salvadoran man who won a lottery was detained by ICE agents in the United States.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/gano-un-millon-de-dolares-en-la-loteria-de-estados-unidos-y-fue-detenido-por-el-ice-parece-que-se-le-acabo-la-suerte-3604488) reported that an individual who won a million dollars in a United States lottery was detained by ICE to be deported.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/periodista-colombiana-estefany-rodriguez-quien-estuvo-16-dias-detenida-por-ice-en-estados-unidos-recibio-premio-internacional-del-cpj-en-nueva-york-3602665) reported that Colombian journalist Estefany Rodríguez received an international CPJ award in New York after being detained for 16 days by ICE.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/washington/kirsten-davies-llega-a-la-direccion-nacional-de-ciberseguridad-tras-una-serie-de-fallas-en-eeuu-nid20112026/) reported that Kirsten Davies will replace Sean Cairncross as national cybersecurity director following failures affecting services in the United States.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/jefe-de-ciberseguridad-de-la-casa-blanca-dejara-su-cargo-en-medio-de-fallas-tecnologicas-que-afectaron-a-empresas-y-agencias-de-estados-unidos-3602610) reported that Kirsten Davies will assume the national cybersecurity directorship following her appointment by Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/casa-blanca-despide-al-jefe-de-ciberseguridad-tras-una-serie-de-fallos-tecnologicos-33221131) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the appointment of Kirsten Davies.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/reportan-despido-del-jefe-de-ciberseguridad-de-la-casa-blanca-tras-serie-de-fallas-tecnologicas-kirsten-davies-asume-sus-funciones/) reported that the removal of Sean Cairncross follows disruptions affecting air traffic, automated teller machines, emails, and alert services.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/avion-hercules-c130-colombia-estados-unidos-fuerza-aerea-donacion-fac-1019-BH43770166) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth delivered a C-130 Hercules aircraft to Colombia, restoring its fleet to six such planes.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/captura-trillizos-colombianos-ee-uu-ice-advierte-tener-solicitud-pendiente-no-da-estatus-legal-FD43738904) reported that U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement issued a warning after detaining 19-year-old Colombian triplets, stating that a pending application grants no legal status.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/esta-es-la-enfermedad-que-padece-la-mama-de-los-trillizos-colombianos-detenidos-por-ice-en-ee-uu-fue-sometida-a-una-cirugia-y-esta-en-recuperacion-3602082) reported that family testimony indicated the 19-year-old individuals arrived in the United States to provide financial support for their recovering mother.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/que-hay-detras-de-la-inquietante-ola-de-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-nid18112026/) reported that a succession of technology disruptions in airlines, banks, and intelligence networks exposed digital vulnerabilities in the United States.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/marco-rubio-hablo-sobre-las-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-y-descarto-interferencia-extranjera-no-estamos-bajo-un-ataque-cibernetico-3601898) reported that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that technology outages affecting Microsoft, Chase, airlines, and the NSA were unrelated and not caused by a foreign cyberattack.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/la-caida-de-la-red-secreta-de-la-nsa-se-suma-a-una-ola-de-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-coincidencia-o-amenaza-cibernetica-3601808) reported that disruptions in bank and technology platform services coincided with cyberattacks affecting approximately 200 websites.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-hit-sudden-system-outage/) reported that United Airlines suffered a widespread system outage that left planes unable to take off.
[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2219263) reported that a major outage hit United Airlines affecting a system related to flight departures.
[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/drama-na-americkim-aerodromima-pao-sistem-united-airlinesa/npgmhe1) reported that United Airlines confirmed a system failure occurred on Monday afternoon.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/jpmorgan-chase-atribuye-los-fallos-a-un-error-de-software-y-descarta-un-ciberataque-33166828) reported that JPMorgan Chase attributed banking service outages affecting thousands of customers to a software error and ruled out a cyberattack.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/united-airlines-reporta-interrupcion-generalizada-sus-sistemas_202611176afb8b9903bbf30bb04e2f1a.html) reported that United Airlines experienced a widespread system disruption in the United States attributed to instability in communications and radar systems.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/united-airlines-restablece-sistema-tras-falla-tecnologica-interrupcion-provoco-retrasos-en-vuelos/) reported that on November 13 the FAA ordered flights to remain on the ground because a new router failed and saturated the system.
[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-system-outage) reported that United Airlines acknowledged a technology issue that delayed flight departures.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/united-airlines-hit-by-widespread-system-outage-days-after-faa-ground-stop-disrupted-us-air-travel-101794867751137.html) reported that the carrier clarified the issue was not affecting flights already in the air or services operated by United Express.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/united-airlines-reports-widespread-outage-just-days-after-nationwide-ground-stop/CHU2RQYJERCJNHQAEB4INTZEGY/) reported that old network equipment was overloaded, disrupting 17 of 22 major control centres.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/united-airlines-resolves-tech-outage-that-delayed-flights/a-79964387?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that United Airlines said a system outage that delayed departures has been resolved.
[TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219271), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that there was no indication that the United Airlines electronic system outage was a cybersecurity-related issue.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/article-915107) reported that there was no indication that United's outage was connected to the Federal Aviation Administration shutdown.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/united-airlines-relata-falha-generalizada-dias-depois-da-suspensao-de-voos-nos-eua.ghtml) reported that United Airlines reported a widespread system outage days after nationwide flight cancellations due to technical problems.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-recupera-la-normalidad-aerea-tras-miles-de-cancelaciones-y-una-falla-en-el-sistema-de-nid16112026/) reported that more than 18,000 flights were canceled and 28,000 suffered delays over three days due to an FAA router issue before normal operations resumed.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/estados-unidos-united-airlines-reporta-falla-generalizada-sistemas_0_H77eHnDPQG.html) reported that United Airlines reported a generalized failure in its systems days after the national flight suspension.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/sitios-de-bancos-en-eeuu-presentan-fallos-pero-no-hay-ciberataque-segun-jpmorgan-chase_0_gtsuRx0yIe.html) reported that JPMorgan Chase stated there was no ciberattack despite users reporting banking app failures.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/bancos-de-eu-reportan-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso/) reported that Zelle also registered interruptions in its transfer services alongside bank platform issues.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/se-desploman-las-acciones-de-grandes-bancos-en-wall-street-tras-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-en-estados-unidos-3601471) reported that shares of JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Capital One registered losses on Wall Street following digital platform failures.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/chase-bank-of-america-us-bank-and-wells-fargo-among-banks-down-today-users-report-mobile-banking-outages-101794855031957.html), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/caida-de-bancos-en-estados-unidos-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo-presentan-fallas-en-sus-servicios-digitales-3601448), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso-a-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo_0_giCFGzhtEk.html) reported that users of Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and US Bank experienced digital service outages and difficulties accessing online accounts.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/aeroportos-dos-eua-comecam-a-voltar-a-normalidade-apos-caos-aereo-mas-ainda-ha-atrasos.shtml) reported that the US aviation sector began returning to normality following three days of cancellations and delays caused by a system outage.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/15/voos-nos-eua-devem-ser-normalizados-ate-o-fim-de-domingo-promete-faa-passageiros-ainda-devem-enfrentar-transtornos.ghtml) reported that the FAA administrator promised US flights would be normalized by Sunday evening.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/14/caos-nos-eua-mais-de-12-mil-voos-foram-cancelados-entre-sexta-feira-e-sabado.ghtml) reported that official FlightAware data showed more than 12,000 flights were cancelled between Friday and Saturday in the United States.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/troca-de-cabos-causou-suspensao-que-cancelou-mais-de-16-mil-voos-nos-eua.shtml) reported that a cable swap caused a suspension that cancelled more than 16,000 flights in the United States.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7322457-anac-sete-voos-previstos-para-os-eua-foram-cancelados-e-14-atrasaram.html) reported that the head of the US Federal Aviation Administration forecasted between 4,000 and 5,000 flight cancellations on Saturday.

reports.text: [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/25/iraqs-national-security-service-reports-two-more-oil-smuggling-operations/) reported that Iraq's National Security Service reported two additional oil smuggling operations.

[Long War Journal](https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2026/11/iraqi-forces-enter-jurf-al-sakhar-militia-stronghold-as-pm-seeks-to-consolidate-power.php) reported that Iraqi security forces entered Jurf al Sakhar on November 20 following an investigation.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532383/Iraq-s-government-and-Kataib-Hezbollah-agree-on-middle-ground), a state-media outlet, reported that the Iraqi government and Kataib Hezbollah reached a middle ground and the government backed down from threats to deploy the army and forcibly remove Kataib Hezbollah members from a town near Baghdad.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/21/iraqi-governments-control-of-jurf-al-sakhar-marks-rare-success-but-key-issues-remain/) reported that the Iraqi government's control of Jurf Al Sakhar marks a rare success while key issues remain.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261121-iraq-reopens-key-road-linking-jurf-al-nasr-to-karbala/) reported that Iraq reopened a key road linking the Latifiya area, Jurf al-Nasr district, and Karbala.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/will-iraqs-return-jurf-al-sakhar-weaken-iran-backed-kataib-hezbollah) reported that the town of Jurf al-Sakhar and surrounding agricultural areas had been under the control of Iran-backed armed factions since 2014.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-iraq-opens-security-command-headquarters-in-jurf-al-nasr-as-troops-redeploy/) reported that Iraq's Federal Police announced the opening of a headquarters for security and army forces in the Jurf al-Nasr area of Babil province.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-iraqi-forces-strike-compromise-with-powerful-pro-iran-militia) reported that three senior security officials stated Iraq reached a compromise with the Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/iraqi-forces-enter-iran-backed-kataeb-hezbollah-stronghold-3725803) reported that Iraqi government forces moved into Jurf al-Sakher, the main base of Kataeb Hezbollah.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261120-iraqi-security-forces-to-deploy-in-hezbollah-stronghold-under-compromise-deal), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/20/iraqi-security-forces-move-into-iran-backed-militia-stronghold-of-jurf-al-sakhar/) reported that Iraqi security forces deployed in the Kataib Hezbollah stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhar under a compromise deal.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqi-security-forces-deploy-iran-backed-militia-stronghold-security-officials) reported that Iraqi security forces will deploy in Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/20/world/middleeast/iraq-militia-iran-kataib-hezbollah.html) reported that Iraqi army and police units were deployed into territory controlled by Kataib Hezbollah for the first time in over a decade.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqi-forces-strike-compromise-powerful-pro-iran-militia-security-officials-say) reported that Iraq has reached a compromise with the Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah according to security officials.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-forces-enter-militia-stronghold-jurf-al-sakhr-friday) reported that Iraqi forces will begin deploying on Friday in the main stronghold of Kataeb Hezbollah as Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi steps up efforts to rein in the faction.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-pm-delays-lebanon-visit-amid-jurf-al-sakhr-standoff) reported that Iraq's prime minister delayed a visit to Lebanon amid a standoff over Kataib Hezbollah vacating Jurf al-Sakhr.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/18/nx-s1-6043167/iraq-environmentalist-marshes-iran-backed-militia-kidnapped) reported that an Iraqi environmentalist was kidnapped and tortured by Iran-backed militias while working to save the marshes.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/18/iraqi-pm-delays-lebanon-visit-amid-standoff-with-iran-backed-militia/) reported that Iraq's Prime Minister delayed a visit to Lebanon amid a standoff with an Iran-backed militia.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-iraqs-kataib-hezbollah-rejects-government-ultimatum-to-withdraw-from-jurf-al-sakhr/) reported that Iraq's Kata'ib Hezbollah stated it would not withdraw from its stronghold in Jurf al-Sakhr despite a government ultimatum.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648958-iraq-militia-oil-smuggling/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Iraq ordered troops into a militia-controlled area over alleged oil smuggling.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraq-moves-reclaim-jurf-al-sakhr-militias-after-12-years) reported that Iraq deployed tanks and troops ahead of a planned operation to retake Jurf Al-Sakhr from Kataib Hezbollah.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-iraq-establishes-special-security-force-to-combat-oil-smuggling-protect-pipelines/) reported that Iraq established a specialized security force to combat oil smuggling and protect its pipeline network.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/iraq-pm-sacks-officials-over-oil-smuggling-in-pro-iran-group-bastion-3011926) reported that the Iraqi Prime Minister dismissed nine officials following an investigation into oil smuggling linked to Kataeb Hezbollah.

reports.text: [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/28/again-bandits-raid-niger-community-kill-three-villagers/) reported that bandits raided a Niger State community in Borgu Local Government Area, killing three villagers and burning village houses.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611230141.html) reported that at least 64 people were killed in a reprisal attack by suspected vigilantes in Wawa and Gada Oli, Borgu Local Government Area of Niger State.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/niger-bandits-kill-village-head-wife-worshippers-in-fresh-attacks/) reported that armed men killed a village head, his wife, and several worshippers in separate attacks on two communities in Borgu Local Government Area of Niger State.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/horror-in-niger-as-bandits-invade-community-behead-village-head-burn-his-household/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/bandits-behead-niger-village-head-kill-five-others/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that suspected bandits invaded a community in Borgu Local Government Area of Niger State, beheading the village head, killing five other residents, and burning houses.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/shehu-sani-warns-northerners-against-celebrating-attacks-on-southern-leaders/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Shehu Sani warned northerners against celebrating attacks on southern leaders to prevent ethnic hostility.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/bandits-abduct-six-rustle-livestock-in-sokoto/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that bandits abducted six people and rustled livestock in Dukkuma, Sabon Birni, Sokoto.
[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bandits-kill-zamfara-govs-aide-abduct-worshippers/) reported that suspected bandits killed Nasiru Sani Kaura during an attack in Kaura Namoda, Zamfara State.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/925368-shehu-sani-calls-zamfara-mosque-attack-genocide-decries-public-silence.html) reported that Shehu Sani called the Zamfara mosque attack genocide and expressed outrage over public silence.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/zamfara-mosque-attack-kaura-namoda-party-official/) reported that a dawn raid on a mosque in Kaura Namoda killed a ruling-party registration supervisor and left worshippers abducted.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/bandits-kill-three-abduct-residents-in-sokoto/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that bandits killed at least three people, abducted residents, and rustled livestock in an attack on the Yartsakuwa community.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925372-three-killed-many-abducted-in-sokoto-attack-police.html) reported that the police confirmed three deaths from the attack in Sokoto State, while residents reported four fatalities.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925270-bandits-attack-zamfara-mosque-kill-apc-e-registration-supervisor-abduct-worshippers.html) reported that attackers stormed the Lowcost Mosque in Kaura Namoda town, killing an APC e-registration supervisor and abducting worshippers.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/over-40-killed-as-vigilantes-clash-with-bandits-in-zamfara/) reported that over 40 people, including suspected bandits and local vigilantes, were killed in a gun battle in Zamfara.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/over-50-killed-in-clashes-between-bandits-vigilantes-in-nigeria) reported that at least 53 people were killed in clashes between criminal gangs and local vigilantes in Zamfara state.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/clashes-between-gangs-vigilantes-kill-over-50-in-zamfara-report/), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/clashes-between-gangs-vigilantes-kill-over-50-in-northern-nigeria-residents-3011866) reported that clashes between criminal gangs and local vigilantes left more than 50 people dead in northwestern Nigeria's Zamfara state.

reports.text: [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/27/israel-says-it-killed-alleged-hamas-members-despite-gaza-ceasefire/) reported that Israel stated it killed alleged Hamas members despite the Gaza ceasefire.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-27/ty-article/.premium/israeli-defense-minister-likens-arab-party-leader-to-slain-hamas-commanders/000001a2-1c94-d62f-a5ff-dfdd2fe70000) reported that the Israeli defense minister likened an Arab party leader to slain Hamas commanders and warned of Arab infiltration of government.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532588/Israel-threatens-to-displace-one-million-Gazans), a state-media outlet, reported that Israel's interim war minister threatened to displace one million Palestinians in Gaza unless Hamas surrenders its weapons.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israels-katz-threatens-displace-one-million-gaza) reported that Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz stated the clearing of areas in Gaza would follow the Rafah and Beit Hanoun model.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-hamas-chief-says-continued-killings-and-siege-in-gaza-are-unacceptable-under-ceasefire/) reported that Hamas political bureau head Khalil al-Hayya stated that Israel's continued killing of Palestinians and its siege of Gaza are unacceptable under a ceasefire.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-hamas-says-katzs-displacement-threats-undermine-gaza-ceasefire-criticises-board-of-peaces-silence/) reported that Hamas stated Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz's displacement threats undermine the Gaza ceasefire.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2225621), a state-run outlet, reported that Israeli Minister Israel Katz threatened to displace 1 million Gaza residents if Hamas refuses to disarm.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-26/news-1SnTCsxOXcI/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that an Israeli strike killed a Hamas official overseeing economy and education.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/katz-warns-1-million-in-gaza-could-be-displaced-if-hamas-refuses-disarmament/) reported that Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz warned that up to 1 million Palestinians could be displaced in Gaza unless Hamas agrees to disarm.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/26/gaza-ministry-schoolchildren-killed-this-month-israel-strikes) reported that the Gaza ministry stated Israeli strikes have killed at least 16 schoolchildren this month.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1587390/israeli-strikes-kill-nine-palestinians-in-gaza/) reported that Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed at least nine Palestinians in Gaza overnight, including a deputy education minister.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/culture/le-prix-rory-peck-recompense-a-titre-posthume-une-photojournaliste-palestinienne-tuee-a-gaza-en-2025-20261126) reported that the Associated Press stated it remains determined to obtain answers regarding the circumstances of the death of Palestinian photojournalist Mariam Dagga.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/media/2026/nov/25/palestinian-journalist-killed-by-israel-in-gaza-wins-rory-peck-prize), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/palestinian-journalist-killed-israel-gaza-wins-prestigious-rory-peck-prize), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/mariam-dagga-killed-israel-gaza-wins-rory-peck-prize), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/5b945621523f) reported that Palestinian journalist Mariam Dagga, who was killed in Gaza, posthumously won the Rory Peck prize.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/israel-intensifica-ataques-em-gaza-e-mata-3o-chefe-do-hamas-em-3-dias.shtml), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/26/israel-intensifica-ataques-contra-lideres-do-hamas-e-ameaca-deslocar-mais-1-milhao-em-gaza-eua-cobram-avanco-do-plano-de-paz.ghtml) reported that Israel intensified its attacks against Hamas leaders and commanders in the Gaza Strip, with Israeli strikes killing nine Palestinians according to the local health ministry.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-katz-says-israel-intends-to-keep-70-of-gaza-under-military-control-and-devoid-of-residents/) reported that Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz stated government policy calls for maintaining military control over approximately 70 percent of the Gaza Strip.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israel-targets-gaza-governance-third-hamas-official-killed) reported that Israel has assassinated three senior Hamas officials in three days amid reports of a new strategy aimed at dismantling Gaza's governing institutions.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-916264) reported that Hamas official Al-Hayya stated the group was weighing its response to Israeli targeted killings of senior officials in Gaza.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/katz-threatens-new-gaza-operation-displacing-1-million-palestinians-3726023) reported that Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz threatened to launch a new military operation in the Gaza Strip and renewed calls for Palestinians to leave the territory.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/8853843aa8ad) reported that Israeli forces blew up Palestinian homes and structures near the Maghazi refugee camp in central Gaza.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/israel-kills-hamas-appointed-minister-with-eight-others-in-gaza/) reported that at least nine Palestinians, including a senior Hamas-appointed education official, were killed in Israeli airstrikes and gunfire across Gaza.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/israeli-attacks-on-gaza-kill-senior-education-official-seven-other-people?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the killing of Khaled Abu Nada, the undersecretary of the Education Ministry.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261126-israel-threatens-to-displace-one-million-palestinians-in-gaza-unless-hamas-disarms), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/d6b2e2a0c6ff), [Punch](https://punchng.com/israel-threatens-to-displace-one-million-gazans-unless-hamas-disarms/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Defence Minister Israel Katz threatened to forcibly displace one million Palestinians in Gaza unless Hamas disarms.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/middle-east/2026/11/26/israeli-strikes-kill-nine-in-gaza-including-hamas-appointed-deputy-education-minister-officials-say/) reported that at least 1,600 Palestinians and five Israeli soldiers have been killed since the 2025 ceasefire agreement.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-crime/2026-11-26/ty-article/.premium/arab-israeli-detained-for-foreign-election-interference-released-after-10-days/000001a2-16a4-ded0-a5b6-d6a4a0220000) reported that the Shin Bet security service freed Arab Israeli Professor Ibrahim Abu Jaber after 10 days in detention following an arrest for alleged election interference.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hamas-weighs-response-after-israel-kills-10-people-gaza) reported that Hamas chief Khalil Al-Hayya stated the group was not prepared to withstand continued Israeli attacks.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israel-kills-another-gaza-security-chief-his-family) reported that Israel killed a senior Gaza security official and his family less than 24 hours after an earlier strike.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-916167) reported that the IDF and Shin Bet killed a Hamas economy and education chief in a Gaza strike.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2047123/israeli-strike-kills-hamas-official-wife-and-daughters) reported that Amnesty International stated Israeli actions are preventing births in Gaza and sought a probe into the commission of genocide.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532501/Does-Gaza-s-Board-of-Peace-engineer-Israel-s-war-machine), a state-media outlet, reported that it remains unclear whether Board of Peace adviser Josh Greenbaum intended his remarks to Israeli media to distance the board from Zionism.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/ataque-aereo-israelense-em-gaza-mata-diretor-da-seguranca-interna-do-hamas.shtml) reported that the Israeli Armed Forces killed a high-ranking Hamas security official in an airstrike in the Gaza Strip.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7325859-ataque-israelense-mata-dirigente-de-seguranca-do-hamas-e-sua-familia.html) reported according to Gaza authorities that the bombardment hit a residential building in the Al-Shati refugee camp, killing the official and his family, and injuring 12 others.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642252/israeli-airstrike-kills-four-members-of-palestinian-family-in-latest-gaza-ceasefire-violation), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-airstrike-kills-4-members-of-palestinian-family-in-gaza-3725978), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-israeli-airstrike-kills-4-members-of-palestinian-family-in-latest-gaza-ceasefire-violation/) reported that an Israeli airstrike hit a home in the al-Shati refugee camp, killing four members of a Palestinian family.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261124-gaza-authorities-record-6405-israeli-violations-of-ceasefire-in-410-days/) reported that Gaza's Government Media Office stated Israel committed 6,405 ceasefire violations over 410 days, resulting in 1,690 deaths.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/israel-kills-hamas-internal-security-chief-gaza/) reported that the Israeli military killed the head of Hamas's internal security apparatus in an airstrike in Gaza City.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/25/jerusalem-daily-israel-kills-hamass-gaza-security-chief?traffic_source=rss), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649343-israel-gaza-hamas-security-chief-ceasefire/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that an Israeli strike assassinated Hamas's internal security chief in Gaza City, killing him and six others.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israeli-strike-kills-family-of-4-in-fresh-test-of-gazas-fragile-truce), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/90fecff6fc7c) reported that an Israeli airstrike killed four members of a Palestinian family in the al-Shati refugee camp in western Gaza City.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3375752/israeli-strike-gaza-kills-hamas-security-chief-wife-and-teenage-daughters) reported that an Israeli strike killed a Gaza security official, his wife, and their two daughters.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmd718zydz9qo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/israeli-strike-kills-hamas-official-his-wife-and-children-3013963), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1125/1600580-mohammad-abuelouf-killed-gaza/) reported that an Israeli airstrike killed Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, head of Hamas's internal security service in northern Gaza, alongside his wife and children.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-916053) reported that a second Hamas internal security chief was killed in an IDF strike in northern Gaza.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/25/israeli-strike-kills-four-people-in-gaza?traffic_source=rss), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249681/Family-of-four-killed-in-Israeli-strike-on-their-apartment) reported that an Israeli airstrike on an apartment building in the Shati refugee camp in Gaza killed four people from the same family.

reports.text: [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/turkiye/cop31-adopts-46-climate-decisions-as-turkiye-secures-26b/news) reported that countries at COP31 adopted 46 decisions on climate finance, adaptation, and carbon markets, while Turkey secured more than $26 billion in investment and financing.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/EU-to-Seek-Overhaul-of-UN-Climate-Consensus-Decisions-After-COP31-Failure.html) reported that the European Union will propose to the UN a review of the COP climate conferences' consensus decision-making model following the summit's failure.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/business-news/927413-cop31-african-climate-coalition-says-no-deal-better-than-empty-text-sets-demands-for-cop32.html) reported that the Pan African Climate Justice Alliance stated that no deal is better than an empty text and set demands for COP32.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/cop31-african-trade-unions-reject-climate-loans-demand-debt-relief/) reported that African trade unions rejected climate loans and demanded debt relief and increased grant-based funding.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/from-cop31-antalya-to-copenhagen-un-climate-summits-where-no-agreement-was-reached) reported that UN climate summits since 1995 have often experienced deadlock and delays.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/23/failure-cop31-calls-urgent-reform-un-climate-summits) reported that the failure at Cop31 prompted former US vice-president Al Gore and other climate leaders to demand a change to the consensus rule.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/cop31-in-antalya-hosts-joint-declaration-press-conference-3725812) reported that ministers and officials from multiple countries attended a joint declaration press conference at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/20/turkey-activists-chant-shame-as-cop31-negotiations-falter) reported that climate activists denounced the proposed outcome of COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, accusing governments of failing to deliver meaningful measures.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/at-cop31-conflict-over-climate-science-slows-action-on-global-warming/a-80004894?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that attacks on climate science and disinformation risk delaying key measures at COP31 in Antalya.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/cop31-global-climate-challenge-imperative-of-intl-action/) reported that the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference is being held in Antalya, Turkiye, from 9 to 20 November 2026.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/20/african-negotiators-at-cop31-demand-concrete-measures-on-climate-justice/) reported that the African Group of Negotiators called for concrete measures on climate justice at COP31 as UN climate talks went into overtime.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/cop31-african-workers-declare-no-more-empty-promises-as-unions-demand-climate-justice-decent-jobs-2/) reported that ITUC-Africa represented 18 million organized workers across 52 African countries at the COP31 summit to demand climate justice and decent jobs.
[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/antalya-climate-talks-halfway-mark-cop31-march/) reported that over 7,000 people marched in Antalya as the COP31 climate talks reached their midpoint.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/turkiye/cop31-brings-climate-education-to-life-for-children-in-antalya/news) reported that children and young people attending the COP31 climate summit in Antalya are participating in hands-on climate education activities.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/podcasts/international-report/20261114-turkey-talks-green-at-cop31-while-cracking-down-on-activists) reported that Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan addressed the COP31 climate conference in Antalya while cracking down on activists.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/14/lgbtq-protesters-defy-crackdown-in-turkey-to-march-with-cop31-activists) reported that LGBTQ+ protesters defied a crackdown in Turkey to march with COP31 activists.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044520/thousands-rally-in-antalya-to-demand-climate-justice-as-cop31-talks-hit-midpoint) reported that thousands of protesters took to the streets in Antalya to accuse COP31 of failing those bearing the brunt of environmental destruction.

reports.text: [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204520/%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%8A%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A9/) reported that Yesh Atid party leader Gadi Eisenkot neared forming a new government after a preliminary agreement with the leftist Democrats party.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191063/%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%88%D8%A8-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD%D9%87%D8%A7-%D9%86%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%87%D9%88-%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%BA%D9%8A%D9%8A%D8%B1) reported that Yisrael Beytenu party leader Avigdor Liberman warned against a rotation maneuver proposed by Benjamin Netanyahu to obstruct the change government.

[Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d9%86%d8%aa%d9%86%d9%8a%d8%a7%d9%87%d9%88-%d9%8a%d8%b3%d8%aa%d9%86%d8%ac%d8%af-%d8%a8%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%b9%d8%ac%d8%b2%d8%a9-%d9%88%d8%a2%d9%8a%d8%b2%d9%86%d9%83%d9%88%d8%aa-%d9%8a%d9%86/) reported that pessimism is growing within the Likud party regarding Benjamin Netanyahu's chances of retaining power while Gadi Eisenkot advances negotiations.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7193649) reported that the party of designated Israeli Prime Minister Gadi Eisenkot announced it agreed to sign a coalition agreement with an opposition right-wing party.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203870/%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%87%D8%AF-%D8%A8-%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%B7%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A6-%D8%A5%D8%B0%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%81/) reported that Israeli Yisrael Beytenu party leader and designated government formation leader Gadi Eisenkot stated he would move to form a national emergency government if efforts to build a broad coalition fail.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190594/%D9%86%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%87%D9%88-%D9%8A%D8%AC%D8%AF%D8%AF-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B6%D9%87-%D8%B6%D8%AF-%D8%AC%D9%87%D9%88%D8%AF-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AC%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A9) reported that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stepped up incitement against the formation of a government led by Yisrael Beytenu party leader Gadi Eisenkot backed by Arab parties.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190287/%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%B3%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%AB%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%86%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%87) reported that Yisrael Beytenu party leader and designated government former Gadi Eisenkot held secret contacts with ultra-Orthodox leadership to explore forming a coalition excluding Benjamin Netanyahu.
