reports.text: [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10950541) reported that police raided the home of the deceased first-ever perfect scorer on South Korea's law school entrance exam as part of an escalating investigation.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261126006100315) reported that police raided the home of the late LEET top scorer as part of a cheating probe.

[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261126011900315), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10950986) reported that South Korean police filed for an arrest warrant for Han Won-seok, the 34-year-old top scorer of the tax accountant exam accused of AI-assisted cheating.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-26/asia-exams-and-ai-smart-glasses-cheating/107419882) reported that wearable devices have emerged as aids to cheaters across Asia in exams that determine people's life trajectories.

[The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/south-korea-cannot-police-its-way-out-of-ai-cheating/) reported that the top scorer on the tax exam confessed to AI cheating and 111 more alleged cases surfaced at the college entrance exam.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3375480/south-koreas-education-chief-has-gone-its-ai-exam-headache-has-not) reported that South Korea's education minister resigned days after the national university entrance exam.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641688/south-korean-education-minister-offers-to-resign-amid-ai-assisted-cheating-controversy) reported that South Korean Education Minister Kyo-jin offered to resign and took responsibility for last-minute anti-cheating measures that caused confusion.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cw3dgk29d37no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin admitted last-minute measures to stop AI-assisted cheating during the college entrance exam caused chaos.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/22/south-korea-education-minister-resigns-after-ai-cheating-scandal-engulfs-university-exams), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/south-korea-education-minister-choi-kyo-jin-resigns-amid-ai-cheating-scandal-101795322293412.html), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10945089), [Punch](https://punchng.com/south-korea-education-minister-resigns-over-ai-cheating-scandal/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261122001051315), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3375362/south-koreas-education-minister-quits-amid-backlash-over-anti-cheating-exam-checks) reported that South Korean Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned following an AI-assisted cheating scandal and last-minute exam rule changes.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261120004800315) reported that officials found no signs of foul play in the autopsy of the LEET top scorer.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm3vgw1xevvwo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that 111 students were caught with banned smart devices while taking the high-stakes Suneung exam in South Korea.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10944168) reported that 111 test-takers were caught possessing or using smart devices during South Korea's annual college entrance exam.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261120005100315) reported that South Korean President Lee Jae Myung called for a complete overhaul of the state exam system to combat AI-assisted cheating.
[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/south-korea-university-exams-ai-cheating-6566301) reported that South Koreans are sitting for the annual nine-hour Suneung college exam.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261119005352315) reported that the top scorer on the law school entrance exam suspected of AI cheating was found dead and police will continue the probe.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10942721) reported that the top scorer on this year's Legal Education Eligibility Test facing AI-assisted cheating allegations was found in cardiac arrest at a Seoul motel.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3375021/south-koreas-top-law-exam-scorer-found-cardiac-arrest-amid-ai-fraud-scandal) reported that Lee Jin-woo is a Seoul National University dental student.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/man-accused-of-ai-assisted-exam-cheating-found-dead-in-seoul/) reported that a South Korean man suspected of using artificial intelligence to achieve a perfect score on the law school entrance examination was found dead in Seoul.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/man-accused-of-ai-cheating-in-south-korean-exam-found-dead/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Lee Jin-woo, a 32-year-old accused of using AI to cheat in South Korea's LEET law school exam, was found dead in a Seoul motel.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261119010100315) reported that 98 test-takers were caught cheating on the college entrance exam, including 5 using smart devices.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/south-korea-tightens-security-for-national-exam-over-ai-cheating-scandal) reported that over 550,000 candidates sat South Korea's Suneung university entrance exam under extraordinary security following an AI cheating scandal.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/lifestyle-culture/article/3375067/glasses-buttons-south-koreas-anti-cheating-exam-checks-raise-eyebrows) reported that students in South Korea faced strict anti-cheating checks on items such as glasses and clothing buttons during the annual college entrance exam.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/19/asia-pacific/society/south-korea-college-exam-cheating/) reported that South Korea held its annual nine-hour college entrance exam with strict curbs following a cheating scandal.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261119001152315) reported that twenty-two test-takers were caught possessing smartphones at the college entrance exam through disaster alert messages.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/world/asia/south-korea-cheating-college-exam-suneung.html) reported that South Korea is sending emergency alerts to every phone in the country as part of an anti-cheating campaign during the college entrance exam.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/south-korea-to-send-disaster-alert-during-exam-to-catch-ai-cheating-3725739) reported that South Korea's Interior Ministry announced it will issue a disaster alert during the annual college entrance exam to detect AI cheating.

[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261118003900315) reported that Prime Minister Han Seong-sook asked for the public's understanding regarding alert messages to be sent during college entrance exams, while police raise their alert level to guard against AI cheating.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940994) reported that recent AI-assisted exam cheating scandals in South Korea reveal a growing willingness to bend the rules, with psychologists stating technology is making dishonesty easier.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009880/south-korea-tightens-exam-security-after-ai-cheating-scandal/story/) reported that South Korea will deploy thousands of extra personnel to prevent cheating on college entrance exam sites this week.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPNGE1NWg5RXYzeVZBS3VzUGptS2I4ODBKd1FaUjF1R0hpVHpXeEpkcFF2U1lpWU42QmZGYzZYZ2NZV05QRVVfXy04T1dpeGpKM0lXNmVnMHhOc05abFZ6NEZUYjIxTTFybk5zcFRUVWdmeHM4TGp5QV83OVZVVjE0cmtjY1RYbHJERVJLeDV2ZXdhTWR2SkRGYVVHQjFxLXkwalJMNGk0YnVwd1RIcnI3VDJwSDg1Q1VQRmM0RA?oc=5) reported that South Korea tightened university exam checks to screen for hidden cameras.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940334) reported that an unusually sharp increase in candidates scoring 90 or higher in an accounting subject on this year's tax accountant qualification exam raised cheating suspicions.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/south-korea-cheating-scandal-are-ai-smart-glasses-a-threat-to-exams?traffic_source=rss) reported that a student with near-perfect scores on two tests confessed to using artificial intelligence.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117006200315) reported that an education ministry official reaffirmed that the government ruled out postponing the college entrance exam.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940048), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/lifestyle-culture/article/3374703/south-korea-checks-glasses-and-collars-hidden-ai-university-exam) reported that South Korean education officials and Prime Minister Han Seong-sook took measures to prevent artificial intelligence-assisted cheating ahead of the nationwide college entrance exam.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117003600315) reported that the leader of the ruling Democratic Party stated the party will push for a 10-year exam ban for AI-assisted cheating.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117003200315), a local outlet, reported that Prime Minister Han Seong-sook vowed again to root out AI cheating in this week's college entrance exam.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117003100315) reported that the top scorer of this year's certified tax accountant exam apologized for cheating before police questioning.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/glasses-worn-by-exam-candidates-come-under-scanner-in-south-korea-after-ai-cheating-scandal-101794803535654.html), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/south-korea-national-exam-ai-cheating-scandal-6554101) reported that South Korea's Education Minister announced the ministry will inspect all glasses worn by candidates in the college entrance exam following an AI cheating scandal.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQTGplSkhGeTJ3YnFIQkF5S21vemk1MFNZaGx1SmpvWmtVajFhdGw5REpGSGVJSWJ0a1pzTjEzWnV2WDRDVHNQbzdNc0tpODVfYThGXzNNZmxYbVAyMm5QYWJudkVmMUJKUnhfSHMtQ3d1dVFuZnRhcllkUkJvbHJLR2p1ODBlMjdmWmhIUExJNU5lOE13N0piMjZPeXhYQUtRUWNadUdxVFo?oc=5) reported that AI cheating fears are affecting South Korea ahead of college entrance exams.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3374538/south-korea-cracks-down-online-exam-pill-sales-ahead-national-college-exam) reported that South Korea's drug safety agency flagged online posts illegally selling prescription drugs under study-enhancing labels.

reports.text: [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/aviao-de-carga-ultrapassa-a-pista-de-aeroporto-em-miami.shtml) reported that a cargo plane overpassed the limits of the runway at Miami International Airport on Wednesday night, causing the temporary closure of tracks.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cwr5gv5387r8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/fedex-plane-overshoots-runway-at-miami-airport-on-thanksgiving-eve/a-80056541?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a FedEx plane coming from Memphis ran past the end of a runway at Miami International Airport, sending dirt flying and halting flights on Thanksgiving eve.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/un-avion-de-carga-de-la-empresa-fedex-se-despisto-en-el-aeropuerto-de-miami-nid26112026/) reported that a FedEx cargo plane went off the runway at Miami Airport, causing the temporary closure of all tracks except one without any reported injuries.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/26/us/fedex-plane-miami-airport.html) reported that a FedEx cargo plane overran a runway after landing at Miami International Airport and stopped near a fence with no injuries reported.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/avion-de-carga-provoca-suspension-de-vuelos-en-miami-faa-detiene-las-salidas-del-aeropuerto/) reported that a FedEx cargo plane went off the runway and paralyzed operations at the Miami airport, leading the FAA to suspend flights.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/eeuu-levanta-suspension-de-vuelos-con-destino-a-miami-tras-incidente-de-un-avion-de-fedex_0_k5PwkdAjLt.html) reported that the FAA lifted the flight suspension to Miami following the incident involving a FedEx cargo plane that overran the runway without causing injuries.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3375859/fedex-cargo-plane-overshoots-runway-miami-airport) reported that a FedEx cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport on Wednesday night, forcing all but one runway to temporarily close the day before Thanksgiving.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/el-ice-se-pronuncio-sobre-el-arresto-a-dos-ciudadanos-mexicanos-cuando-estaban-a-punto-de-abordar-un-vuelo-en-el-aeropuerto-de-seattle-estados-unidos-3603276) reported that airline Alaska Airlines stated it had not received prior notification regarding the immigration entity's operation at the airport terminal.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/migraciones/el-dhs-revelo-que-paso-con-los-mexicanos-detenidos-por-ice-en-el-aeropuerto-de-seattle-son-nid23112026/) reported that the US Department of Homeland Security stated that Mexican citizens detained by ICE at the Seattle airport were immigrants who exceeded their visas, while their lawyer stated they were processing asylum.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/agentes-ice-desatan-panico-aeropuerto-seattle-detencion-dos-migrantes-mexicanos-embarque_202611236b03ed82ff6fec2921989cb0.html) reported that two migrants detained by ICE at the Seattle airport were on their way to a baptism and had lived in the US since 2015, and that agents were hooded and unidentified.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/mexicanos-detenidos-por-el-ice-viajaban-a-un-bautizo-abogada-niega-que-hija-agrediera-a-agentes/) reported that an attorney denied that a detained Mexican citizen's daughter assaulted agents during an ICE detention.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/abogada-dos-mexicanos-detenidos-por-el-ice-en-el-aeropuerto-de-seattle-iban-a-un-bautizo-familiar_0_9iGkDYd7Xj.html) reported that masked ICE agents detained two Mexican citizens at Seattle airport as they traveled to a family baptism.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/california/redadas-en-aeropuertos-el-dramatico-arresto-migratorio-del-ice-en-la-puerta-de-un-avion-que-iba-de-nid22112026/) reported that an ICE immigration arrest procedure on an airplane boarding bridge from Seattle to California delayed an Alaska Airlines flight as local authorities questioned the actions of masked agents.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/florida/el-ice-lo-arresto-en-el-aeropuerto-de-miami-justo-antes-de-abordar-el-vuelo-para-su-luna-de-miel-le-nid16112026/) reported that an employee of Carbone was arrested by ICE at the Miami airport before his honeymoon.

reports.text: [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/planete/article/2026/11/25/vigilance-orange-dans-le-var-et-les-alpes-maritimes-reprise-attendue-des-pluies-apres-une-accalmie_6815053_3245.html) reported that Var and Alpes-Maritimes remained on orange rain-flood alert while expected precipitation resumed after a lull.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/meteo/verglas-dans-le-nord-pluies-orageuses-dans-le-sud-est-decouvrez-la-meteo-du-mercredi-25-novembre-20261124) reported that Météo-France placed the Alpes-Maritimes and Var departments on orange alert for rain and floods.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/climat/article/2026/11/22/la-corse-placee-en-vigilance-orange-pour-des-vents-violents-a-partir-de-lundi-l-ain-et-le-jura-touches-par-de-fortes-pluies-et-face-a-des-risques-d-inondations_6814193_1652613.html) reported that Corsica was placed on orange alert for violent winds with gusts up to 170 km/h, while Ain and Jura faced heavy rains and flood risks.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/climat/article/2026/11/22/l-ain-et-le-jura-places-en-en-vigilance-orange-pluies-inondations-dimanche-soir-la-canche-a-des-niveaux-toujours-eleves-dans-le-pas-de-calais_6814193_1652612.html) reported that the Ain and Jura departments were placed on orange alert for rain and floods, and the Canche remained at high levels in Pas-de-Calais.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/planete/article/2026/11/21/inondations-dans-le-pas-de-calais-la-canche-reste-en-vigilance-orange-pres-de-800-evacuations-depuis-jeudi-selon-la-prefecture_6813953_3244.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/inondations-dans-le-pas-de-calais-le-niveau-de-la-canche-a-atteint-son-maximum-pres-de-800-personnes-evacuees-20261121) reported that nearly 800 people have been evacuated due to floods in Pas-de-Calais, and Vigicrues warned that the Vire in Calvados and Manche would reach first overflow thresholds.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/planete/article/2026/11/17/pluie-et-inondations-le-pas-de-calais-et-la-somme-places-en-vigilance-orange-mardi-a-partir-de-23-heures_6813028_3244.html) reported that Pas-de-Calais and Somme were placed on orange weather alert for rain and floods, and several rail links in Hauts-de-France were suspended due to strong winds.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/planete/article/2026/11/14/pluie-et-inondations-les-departements-du-gard-de-l-herault-et-des-bouches-du-rhone-places-en-vigilance-orange-a-partir-de-samedi-soir_6810050_3245.html) reported that Gard, Hérault, and Bouches-du-Rhône were placed on orange weather alert for rain and floods.

reports.text: [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/society/article/3376121/about-200-evacuated-scaffolding-catches-fire-hong-kong-industrial-building) reported that about 200 people were evacuated after exterior scaffolding caught fire at an industrial building in Hong Kong's Tuen Mun.

[RTHK Local](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1879584-20261128.htm) reported that Acting Housing Secretary Michael Wong stated that a decision on the long-term future of the Wang Fuk Court site could take years to finalize.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/26/hong-kong-mourns-victims-of-deadly-wang-fuk-court-fire-one-year-on) reported that Hong Kong residents laid flowers and paid tribute to the 168 victims of the Wang Fuk Court fire one year after the disaster.

[RTHK Local](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1879235-20261125.htm), a state media outlet, reported that Chief Executive John Lee pledged his full support for homeowners undertaking estate maintenance work as he visited residents of Wang Fuk Court.

[RTHK Local](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1879336-20261126.htm), a state media outlet, reported that Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong vowed that government support for displaced Wang Fuk Court residents will continue.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010871/mourners-mark-hong-kong-fire-anniversary-authorities-warn-against-disorder/story/) reported that mourners laid flowers at the site of an apartment complex fire in Hong Kong that killed 168 people a year ago, while authorities warned against disorder.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/26/world/asia/hong-kong-fire-wang-fuk-court-anniversary.html) reported that residents quietly mourned the 168 lives lost in a high-rise complex blaze a year ago while officials warned against using the disaster to sow division.

[RTHK Local](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1879360-20261126.htm), a state-media outlet, reported that former residents and members of the public gathered in Tai Po to lay flowers and observe a moment of silence marking one year since the deadly Wang Fuk Court fire.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/society/article/3375926/tai-po-fire-remembering-victims) reported that Hong Kong is continuing to heal a year after the inferno at the residential complex, with survivors trying to move forward.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/flowers-prayers-and-a-government-warning-hong-kong-marks-one-year-of-wang-fuk-court-fire-that-killed-168-101795673919151.html) reported that residents laid flowers, snacks, and toys near the apartment complex in Tai Po to mark one year since the Wang Fuk court fire.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/hong-kong-tai-po-fire-wang-fuk-court-survivors-rebuild-lives-one-year-6581561) reported that on the first anniversary of Hong Kong's Tai Po fire, displaced residents and schoolchildren are coping with the lasting impact.

[Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/economy/fires/hong-kong-fire-survivors-and-families-mark-anniversary-as-questions-linger) reported that Hong Kong fire survivors and families marked the anniversary as questions linger.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/26/asia-pacific/society/hong-kong-fire-victims/) reported that authorities in Hong Kong appear wary of commemorations for a housing complex fire taking on a political tone and plan no official memorial.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/society/article/3375794/hong-kongs-pakistani-community-mourns-philanthropist-killed-tsim-sha-tsui-crash) reported that Hong Kong's Pakistani community is mourning the loss of businessman Javaid Mehmood, who was killed in a Tsim Sha Tsui drink-driving crash.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxQa3B6MmRMTWJzRXQtb2d5YjFDWWt2eW1ERDhJWXQ1VzU3WFgwdk1XZHVOcW5ySy1wMmg5VnZPYnJ2cDU4MzRNOUZBd3VrVEdUT2N2cERrNzk2Y3BoOGpscTdiZWtZU1lCYVMwX2tpdFMwYXNUdzBCWldGOG4tYkpZRWZKTnZ2aXRqcnc1dzlVZFYtS3duVl84YnFCcWVfQUpB?oc=5) reported that a year after Hong Kong's deadly fire, survivors struggle with loss and a lingering sense of injustice.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/society/article/3375699/hong-kong-take-risk-based-approach-monitoring-tai-po-fire-memorials) reported that Hong Kong's security chief stated authorities will take a risk-based approach to monitoring memorial events marking the first anniversary of the Wang Fuk Court fire.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/society/article/3375683/after-tai-po-fire-will-hong-kongs-renovation-industry-overhaul-crush-triad-activity) reported that promised reforms to wipe out bid-rigging and prevent another Tai Po fire tragedy are in the works for the building maintenance and renovation industry.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/politics/article/3375659/beijing-warns-against-exploiting-tai-po-fire-destabilise-hong-kong) reported that Beijing urged Hong Kong to remain vigilant against attempts to exploit disasters to destabilise the city ahead of the first anniversary of the Tai Po fire.

[RTHK Local](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1879026-20261124.htm), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/society/article/3375545/hong-kongs-wang-fuk-court-fire-victims-receive-new-cash-grant-hk300000) reported that the Hong Kong government announced two new beginning support grants, providing cash up to HK$300,000 for residents of Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/society/article/3375408/tai-po-fire-survivors-battle-grief-fear-and-trauma-first-anniversary-nears) reported that a survivor of the Wang Fuk Court blaze has developed certain habits nearly a year after the tragedy.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/society/article/3375377/welfare-chief-pledges-long-term-social-worker-support-tai-po-fire-victims) reported that Hong Kong's welfare chief pledged long-term social worker support and trauma care for victims of the Wang Fuk Court fire.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/society/article/3375278/hong-kong-proposes-tougher-building-safety-penalties-after-deadly-tai-po-blaze) reported that Hong Kong authorities proposed tripling the maximum fine for using defective construction materials.

[RTHK Local](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1877883-20261115.htm), a state-run outlet, reported that a fire at a public housing unit in Wong Tai Sin on Sunday resulted in the death of one elderly resident and the evacuation of about 300 people.

reports.text: [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/politika/2026/11/26/4984762_radev_niama_da_otstupi_ot_sredstvata_za_cherno_more_i/?ref=rss) reported that Bulgarian Prime Minister Rosen Radev stated in Brussels that Bulgaria will not back down from cohesion funds during negotiations for the long-term EU budget.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223387), a state-media outlet, reported that a NATO Bombardier Artemis II reconnaissance aircraft conducted 79 multi-hour flights over the Black Sea since the start of the year.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/india-bulgaria-discuss-bilateral-ties-imec-black-sea-situation/article71729472.ece) reported that India and Bulgaria discussed bilateral ties, IMEC, and the Black Sea situation.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/20/4982175_poslednite_dva_udareni_koraba_v_bulgarskata/?ref=rss) reported that the last two ships struck in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea have not yet sunk, according to specialized publication Maritime.

[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/23958440) reported that Bulgarian President Rumen Radev stated the Black Sea must become a zone of shared security, noting its importance as a transport, energy, and digital corridor.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/lpg-tanker-that-sank-off-bulgaria-was-hit-by-projectiles-official/article71715541.ece) reported that an official stated the LPG tanker Gas Husky that sank off Bulgaria was hit by projectiles.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOU1RDM185endranZkZ1d1eF83NmxqSnNad2RzWGlrZU9UazRUaE83TlNpUjZ1SHowbURaWkpUSGJKeWhZQTFUV3c1NnNYSjNPaDlaaFFUaWdMN1BiOEpoMk5pYWtoN3ZhNTlnZzlpWmFpLXMtdDFlaWJFakRURVV4RFIta01EeWtMVDB2MHZEN3ljVWVWdUtEdVFZc3oyREFXMmZEWERUblo1VDg?oc=5) reported that a merchant ship sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast for a second consecutive day.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/19-people-rescued-after-gas-carrier-struck-in-black-sea) reported that 19 people were rescued after a gas carrier was struck in the Black Sea in an incident linked to Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

[Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/drones-have-hit-15-ships-in-natos-black-sea-waters-since-october/) reported that Russian drones have struck 15 merchant ships in the Black Sea off NATO members Romania and Bulgaria since October 5 according to a tally by The Defence Blog.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90372) reported that the cargo ship BETUL 8 sank in the Black Sea off Bulgaria after an attack by two naval drones, according to a Bulgarian maritime outlet.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009860/lpg-tanker-reported-to-have-sunk-off-bulgaria-s-black-sea-coast/story/) reported that a liquefied petroleum gas tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast a few dozen miles from a previous incident, according to the country's defense ministry.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/second-tanker-in-two-days-sinks-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast-search-operation-under-way) reported that a second tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/17/4980766_gazovoz_potuna_v_bulgarskata_ikonomicheska_zona_na/?ref=rss) reported that the tanker Gas Husky sank following a drone attack in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/leinster/2026/1117/1599491-vessel-wexford/), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/2026/11/17/six-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-vessel-ran-aground-off-coast-of-wexford/) reported that six crew members were rescued after an 88-metre cargo vessel ran aground off Roney Point on the Wexford coast.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/12-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgaria-following-suspected-drone-s), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast?traffic_source=rss) reported that all 12 crew members of a cargo ship that capsized off Bulgaria were rescued.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/12-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgaria-following-suspected-drone-s), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009728/crew-rescued-from-capsized-wheat-ship-in-black-sea-drone-strike-suspected/story/), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/cargo-ship-sinks-in-bulgarias-black-sea-after-reported-drone-attack-all-12-crew-rescued/) reported that authorities suspected a drone strike caused the vessel to capsize.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009728/crew-rescued-from-capsized-wheat-ship-in-black-sea-drone-strike-suspected/story/) reported that the ship was carrying 3,000 metric tons of wheat.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/16/4980351_turgovski_korab_potuva_v_bulgarskata_ikonomicheska/?ref=rss) reported that a merchant ship was sinking in the Bulgarian economic zone in the Black Sea near Kaliakra, according to the Ministry of Transport.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/sviat/voinata_v_ukraina/2026/11/15/4980175_dronove_udariha_tri_koraba_v_rumunski_vodi_v_cherno/?ref=rss) reported that Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated drones struck three commercial vessels in Romanian waters in the Black Sea near the Sulina canal.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90153) reported that an unidentified drone attacked the Palau-flagged commercial vessel Larissa 1 inside Romanian territorial waters.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90181) reported that Romanian Prime Minister Luca Niculescu condemned the drone attack on three commercial vessels near the Danube Delta.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/three-commercial-vessels-struck-by-drones-near-romanias-black-sea-pm-says) reported that Romania's Prime Minister called the drone strikes on three commercial vessels near Romania's Black Sea unacceptable and a violation of international law.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009606/3-ships-struck-by-drones-in-black-sea-near-romanian-shipping-canal/story/) reported that Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated drones struck three commercial ships in the Black Sea near Romania's Sulina canal and armed forces scrambled aircraft.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/romanian-pm-condemns-unacceptable-drone-strikes-black-sea-ships/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/three-commercial-ships-struck-by-drones-near-romanias-black-sea-coast-over-two-days/) reported that Romanian Defense Minister Ștefan-Radu Oprea confirmed the strikes on three commercial vessels near Constanța.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585276/mustafa-kamal-says-december-key-to-new-provinces-movement/) reported that Federal Minister Mustafa Kamal declared December a crucial month for advancing the demand for new provinces in Pakistan.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584344/atta-tarar-supports-public-vote-on-new-provinces/) reported that Federal Information Minister Atta Tarar stated new provinces should emerge if supported by a public vote and that people should decide their future.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641183/mqm-renews-demand-for-new-provinces-says-administrative-units-cannot-be-treated-as-personal-estates) reported that MQM-P postponed its November 29 rally for new provinces while reiterating demands for administrative division and criticizing the PPP.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/mqm-p-accuses-bilawal-of-threatening-pakistan-seeks-action-over-bloodshed-remarks/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583816/mqm-p-demands-action-over-bilawals-bloodshed-remarks-amid-debate-on-new-provinces/) reported that MQM-P leader Khalid Maqbool Siddiqui accused PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari of threatening Pakistan and demanded action over bloodshed remarks.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044577/creating-new-smaller-provinces-a-national-necessity-kamal), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581857/mustafa-kamal-says-referendum-will-decide-new-provinces/) reported that Federal Health Minister and MQM-P leader Syed Mustafa Kamal called the creation of smaller provinces a national necessity and stated a referendum would determine the decision.

reports.text: [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/27/estonia-prepares-to-close-all-five-road-border-crossings-with-russia) reported that long queues formed at Estonia's border with Russia ahead of its planned closure of five road border crossings on December 1.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2225421), a state-run outlet, reported that Estonian Interior Minister Igor Taro stated that part of the freed-up resources resulting from the closure of border checkpoints with Russia will be directed toward strengthening surveillance of the land border.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649355-baltic-states-divided-estonian-border-closure/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs criticized Estonia's decision to close its border with Russia.

[Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/estonian-prime-minister-closing-the-railway-border-crossing-with-russia-could-be-the-next-step-ca83bu9) reported that Estonia's prime minister indicated that closing the railway border crossing with Russia could be the next step in response to threats from Moscow.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/estonia-closing-border-russia-attacks-b3090839.html) reported that Estonia is closing its border with Russia on December 1 and urging Europe to take Vladimir Putin's aggression more seriously.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91102) reported that Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Tallinn could suspend railway traffic with Russia as a further response to Moscow's hostile activities.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/24/latvia-mulls-possible-border-closure-with-russia-a94359) reported that Latvia is discussing a possible border closure with Russia as neighboring Estonia prepares to shutter its checkpoints in response to an alleged Russian sabotage plot.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/estonia-foreign-minister-margus-tsahkna-close-border-russia/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/24/why-is-estonia-closing-its-border-with-russia-estonian-foreign-minister-margus-tsahkna-explains-in-a-column-for-politico) reported that Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna explained that Estonia is closing its land border crossings with Russia starting December 1 in response to an attempted arson attack.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064254/) reported that Russia summoned Estonia's chargé d'affaires to protest Tallinn's decision to close border crossings from December 1 following an attempted arson attack.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064275/) reported that Russia's Foreign Ministry claimed Estonia is deliberately allowing Ukrainian drones to use its airspace to target north-western Russia.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/24/russia-protests-estonia-s-planned-land-border-closure-and-again-accuses-it-of-letting-ukrainian-drones-use-its-airspace) reported that Russia summoned Estonia's acting chargé d'affaires Marek Juhtegi to lodge a strong protest over border closures and airspace accusations.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/649254-estonia-border-closure-plan/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state media outlet, reported that Moscow summoned Estonia's chargé d'affaires in protest of the looming border closure announced by Tallinn.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90373426) reported that Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova reacted to Estonia's decision to close road border crossings with Russia starting December 1.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/russia-complains-of-new-iron-curtain-as-estonia-shuts-its-borders?traffic_source=rss) reported that Russia complained of a new Iron Curtain after Estonia shut road border crossings following an attack on a drone manufacturer.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/estonia-to-close-all-road-crossings-with-russia) reported that Estonia's government decided to temporarily close its road border crossings with Russia starting December 1 citing national security.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/estonia-to-shut-border-with-russia-over-gru-linked-sabotage-attack) reported that Estonia will close five checkpoints on the border with Russia from 1 December with a possible review in six months after an attempted arson at a defence facility near Tallinn.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/estonia-to-close-border-with-russia-moscow-decries-new-iron-curtain/article71725791.ece) reported that Estonia accused Russian security services of staging an attempted arson attack on an Estonian defense company prior to closing its border.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/narva-mayor-calls-for-humanitarian-corridors-for-emergency-trips-to-russia-as-estonia-prepares-to-close-the-border-december-1) reported that Narva's mayor called for humanitarian corridors for emergency trips to Russia as Estonia prepares to close the border.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/internationalrussia-ukraine-war/article-915583) reported that Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova accused Estonia of planning to erect a new Iron Curtain and stated Moscow would respond.

[Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/estonia/estonia-to-close-all-land-border-crossings-with-russia-epak7xr) reported that Estonia will close all land border crossings with Russia from December 1, citing security threats and Russian-linked sabotage attacks.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-estonia-iron-curtain-border-closure-b3088663.html) reported that Moscow accused Estonia of erecting a new Iron Curtain after Tallinn announced plans to close road crossings with Russia.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375264/estonia-close-border-russia-least-6-months-over-foiled-sabotage) reported that Estonia will close its road border crossings with Russia on security grounds from December 1.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222377), a Russian state outlet, reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal noted the government will be able to reassess the situation and decide on further actions regarding the border closure in six months.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185798-moldova-temporarily-closes-six-border-crossing-points-with-ukraine-following-russian-drone-attack.html) reported that Moldova temporarily closed six border crossing points with Ukraine following a Russian drone attack.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/estonia-s-president-urges-government-to-weigh-consequences-of-closing-russian-border) reported that Estonian President Ülle Madise urged the government to weigh the consequences of closing the border with Russia and avoid letting emotions drive the decision.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261117-estonia-closes-its-border-with-russia-but-can-it-keep-moscow-out), [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87486196) reported that Estonia will close border crossing points with Russia starting December 1 for national security reasons.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87330337) reported that Estonia will close its border with Russia on December 1 and that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda warned Lithuania is not ruling out similar measures.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-estonia-to-close-russian-border-crossings-after-attempted-arson-attack-on-drone-maker), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/16/estonia-is-closing-its-border-with-russia-after-an-alleged-sabotage-attempt-and-preparing-to-move-government-services-to-the-cloud-in-case-of-invasion) reported that Estonia will close all border crossings with Russia starting December 1 following a suspected sabotage attack at Threod Systems.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063116/) reported that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda stated Lithuania may consider closing all border crossings with Russia if destabilisation efforts continue.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/estonia-to-close-russia-border-after-sabotage-bid-on-drone-maker-foreign-minister-says), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90202) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal stated the GRU ordered a sabotage attempt at defense company Threod Systems.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063038/) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha praised Estonian security services for thwarting the attack.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/estonia-russia-border-sabotage-bid/) reported that Estonia's decision to close its border with Russia marked an escalation in regional tensions linked to Moscow's war against Ukraine.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-crime/4184944-eight-people-detained-in-estonia-over-attempted-arson-attack-on-defense-industry-plant-allegedly-commissioned-by-russia.html) reported that the Estonian Prosecutor General's Office stated eight people were detained over an attempted arson attack on a Threod defense industry building in Viimsi commissioned by Russia.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218361) reported that Interior Minister Igor Taro stated Estonia will decide on closing its border with Russia next week on a temporary or permanent basis.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOVkhQYlBYSGp1OG16aUlIS0JBcWpXQnpYbDlDaVFqb0V4cG04dm9wbnptbW1WRnI1bmh2ck0tTmM2Vl9pYVN2dG5NVmpTM2liUG9JWDNkVTZPVUxQc0swQ3FuN3UyZ2tyanRHVENpeUQtbTl0Z3RYSlIzVFB3QnFtdzVvWURCWDlCVjhlclpUTlpWaVhxektwaEFtY2Z2ZGRUYmJ1Z0ozUW9jY0lSOURycDkxSktlRnc?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/estonia-to-close-border-crossings-with-russia-after-alleged-arson-attack?traffic_source=rss), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/estonia-to-close-border-with-russia-after-moscow-linked-sabotage-attempt-on-drone-maker/) reported that Estonia is closing its border crossings with Russia following an alleged or attempted arson attack on a drone manufacturer.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218399), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian diplomat Maria Zakharova stated Moscow will check information about Estonia's plans and view it as Russophobia if confirmed.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/estonian-drone-maker-targeted-by-gru-ordered-sabotage-attempt-pm-says) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Estonia was preparing to potentially close its border with Russia.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/estonia-accuses-russia-of-attempted-arson-attack-on-drone-maker/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Estonia will close its border with Russia after Tallinn's Internal Security Service stated an attempted arson attack on a defense firm was commissioned by Russia's GRU military intelligence agency.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90184) reported that Estonian security authorities thwarted an attempted explosion and arson attack against drone manufacturer Threod Systems and detained suspects.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218363), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna announced Estonia will close all Estonian-Russian border crossing points as of December 1.

reports.text: [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/23/une-enquete-ouverte-dans-une-ecole-de-police-de-seine-et-marne-apres-des-accusations-de-racisme-de-salut-nazi-et-d-agression-sexuelle_6814447_3224.html) reported that an investigation was opened at a police school in Seine-et-Marne after accusations of racism, a Nazi salute, and sexual assault following a report by the establishment's commander.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222941), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that at least 144 people were detained across France during protests against rising prices.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/faits-divers/ca-va-etre-fun-y-a-pas-de-camera-dans-la-bagnole-enquete-ouverte-contre-des-policiers-pour-violences-et-agression-sexuelle-lors-d-une-manifestation-20261121) reported that an investigation was opened against police officers for violence and sexual assault during an October 31 demonstration in Paris.

reports.text: [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/27/birmanie-le-dictateur-birman-min-aung-hlaing-fait-peu-de-cas-du-verdict-de-la-cij_6815834_3210.html) reported that Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing dismissed the International Court of Justice genocide verdict against the country's Muslim minority.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-wont-fully-comply-with-icjs-rohingya-genocide-verdict) reported that Myanmar's military-backed leader stated the government will refuse to comply with parts of the ICJ genocide ruling.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c61wr87wyg5wo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the International Court of Justice issued a landmark ruling convicting Myanmar of genocide against its Rohingya minority.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/myanmar-says-it-will-not-comply-with-inappropriate-icj-genocide-orders-13616762) reported that Myanmar's leader stated the government will not comply with all measures ordered by the international court.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/uk-wont-say-if-it-will-enforce-icj-ruling-genocide-gaza) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has previously resisted political and parliamentary pressure to recognise that Israel has committed genocide in Gaza.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/myanmar-rejects-inappropriate-elements-of-genocide-court-ruling/) reported that Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing stated his government will refuse to follow parts of a United Nations court judgment he deems inappropriate.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/myanmar-says-it-will-not-fully-comply-with-icj-orders-on-rohingya-genocide-verdict-101795679521134.html), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/05ec3dec0e08) reported that Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing stated the country will not fully comply with International Court of Justice orders regarding the Rohingya genocide verdict, adding that the ruling seriously affected the country's reputation.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1126/1600718-myanmar-genocide/) reported that Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing stated his government will not comply with inappropriate aspects of a UN genocide ruling.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-icjs-myanmar-genocide-ruling-is-terrible-news-for-israel-palestine-this-week/) reported that the International Court of Justice found a state responsible for committing genocide for the first time in its ruling against Myanmar over the Rohingya.

[The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/uk-announces-fresh-myanmar-sanctions-following-icj-genocide-ruling/) reported that London announced fresh sanctions against Myanmar following the ICJ genocide ruling and stated it will work with international partners to ensure meaningful action.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/myanmar-anwar-ibrahim-malaysia-kuala-lumpur-min-aung-hlaing-b3090485.html) reported that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim stated Malaysia plans to repatriate another 6,803 Myanmar nationals next month.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/mfa-singapore-icj-myanmar-rohingya-genocide-judgment-6577611) reported that Singapore's Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated the country is studying the implications after the ICJ found Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/myanmar-urged-to-comply-with-international-law-after-icj-genocide-ruling-3725925) reported that foreign ministers of 14 countries urged Myanmar to comply with international law following the ICJ judgment.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6wy4ng1rznxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the UK joined several other nations in sanctioning top Myanmar military leaders following the ICJ genocide ruling.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261123-14-countries-acknowledge-icj-ruling-of-genocide-against-rohingya) reported that 14 countries from Europe, Africa, and Oceania acknowledged the ICJ ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.
[Aravot](https://en.aravot.am/2026/11/23/383020/) reported that Armenians in Armenia and the diaspora have a particular stake in welcoming affirmations of international justice regarding genocide.

[Global New Light of Myanmar](https://www.gnlm.com.mm/president-u-min-aung-hlaing-and-spouse-daw-kyu-kyu-hla-open-2026-tazaungdine-mathoe-lotus-robe-weaving-contest/) reported that Myanmar President U Min Aung Hlaing and his wife opened the 2026 Tazaungdine Mathoe lotus robe-weaving contest.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375529/uk-sanctions-myanmar-president-military-figures-after-genocide-ruling) reported that Britain announced sanctions against five people under its Myanmar and global human rights sanctions regimes, including senior members of the military government, following the genocide ruling.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3375454/how-will-chinas-ties-myanmar-change-icjs-genocide-ruling) reported that an international court genocide ruling against Myanmar might complicate Beijing's diplomatic engagement with Naypyidaw and cast a shadow over Belt and Road Initiative projects.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/law/2026/nov/23/icj-ruling-duty-to-prevent-genocide-international-court-of-justice) reported that experts stated the ICJ ruling on the duty to prevent genocide closes an incoherent gap and has implications for countries such as the UK and Germany regarding arming Israel.

[The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/how-asean-responded-to-the-icjs-myanmar-genocide-ruling/) reported that the region's response to the November 19 judgment against Naypyidaw has been muted.

[Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/actualites/genocide-des-rohingyas-la-cij-condamne-le-myanmar-a-linitiative-de-la-gambie/) reported that the International Court of Justice recognized that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya in Rakhine State, following an initiative by Gambia.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/malaysia-to-engage-un-oic-asean-after-icj-myanmar-genocide-ruling-3725855) reported that Malaysia's Foreign Ministry stated that Kuala Lumpur respects the International Court of Justice judgment holding Myanmar responsible for genocide.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/rohingya-groups-urge-global-action-after-icj-genocide-ruling-on-myanmar-3725837) reported that Rohingya organizations worldwide, in a statement endorsed by 64 groups, demanded immediate international action to enforce the International Court of Justice ruling.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/3358955/ties-with-myanmar-stay-despite-icj-ruling-pm) reported that Thailand's Prime Minister stated relations with Myanmar will be maintained despite the ICJ ruling.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915642) reported that France stated it would seek UN Security Council action after Myanmar refused to accept an ICJ ruling finding that its military committed atrocities against the Rohingya.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/azhar-welcomes-historic-international-court-of-justice-ruling-on-genocide-against-rohingya-muslims/) reported that Al-Azhar welcomed the historic International Court of Justice ruling regarding Myanmar's genocide against Rohingya Muslims.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/suljagic-nakon-presude-mijanmaru-sud-u-hagu-ne-bi-dosudio-u-korist-bih-ni-da-su-nas-sve-pobili/261121059) reported that Srebrenica Memorial Center Director Emir Suljagic stated the International Court of Justice would not have ruled in favor of Bosnia and Herzegovina against Serbia.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/sta-bi-icj-danas-odlucio-o-genocidu-i-predmetu-bi-h-protiv-srbije/), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/slucaj-mijanmar-otvorio-pitanje-drukcijeg-ishoda-tuzbe-bih-protiv-srbije-mozda-bi-genocid-bio-utvrden-i-u-prijedoru/261121040) reported that the International Court of Justice ruling holding Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya raised questions about a different potential outcome in Bosnia's lawsuit against Serbia.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/rohingya-who-escaped-myanmars-genocide-tell-their-stories) reported that Rohingya survivors who escaped Myanmar's genocide recounted rivers red with blood and burning nearby villages.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/analysis-myanmar-genocide-judgment-may-bolster-gaza-case-against-israel) reported that the International Court of Justice's ruling that Myanmar committed genocide may bolster the Gaza case against Israel.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/world-news/asia-and-australia/2026-11-20/ty-article-magazine/.premium/the-icj-has-found-a-country-guilty-of-genocide-israel-should-be-worried/000001a1-f85f-d5b4-a3bd-f97f72a30000) reported that the International Court of Justice has found a state responsible for genocide for the first time in history, worsening Israel's legal standing.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6ly58ndgd0no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the BBC's international editor wrote that the Myanmar genocide verdict is historic and could have far-reaching implications.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/myanmar-rohingya-genocide-un-icj-6568711), [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168853) reported that UN General Assembly President Khalilur Rahman told Rohingya refugees that a judgment on paper must be given effect.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/what-does-the-icjs-rohingya-genocide-ruling-mean-for-gaza?traffic_source=rss) reported that the ICJ Rohingya genocide case sets a precedent for establishing a state's intent to commit genocide beyond explicitly written orders.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/a9cd79db6b18) reported that Dhaka stated Rohingyas must be able to return safely and demanded reparations from Myanmar.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-genocide-ruling-rohingya-say-struggle-for-justice-not-over/a-80003365?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the ICJ held Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya and ordered restitution and reparations.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/turkiye-welcomes-landmark-icj-ruling-on-myanmars-rohingya-genocide/news), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/turkiye-welcomes-icj-ruling-holding-myanmar-responsible-for-genocide-3725800) reported that Türkiye's Foreign Ministry welcomed the ICJ ruling holding Myanmar responsible for genocide against Rohingya Muslims.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQLTNLWmdYdncxbDRfcFZhVlRFeVRfN3Jic2JSb252SkQ4djE0ckRoaGpqcnZKWDU5Wm4tUXdjTHdPZVNtWkVRWVNSN29EcFNQQkhVeVF6WWQ5NFB2WUFURVFyWjI3dmRGeEJNSDJrMk1HYTdMMXVTMkZqZl9ZVjlJMVlhSWRTR0Nha0NJZ3J0TVBpVndia25nVXNDZi1GcnVxYTFtdklydElZQy1FMHo5TGhJcUpjcG5rWDZJaQ?oc=5) reported that rights groups urged sanctions after the top UN court found Myanmar committed genocide.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/83475e748a6f) reported that Israeli legal scholars stated the International Court of Justice's approach to assessing genocidal intent in the Rohingya ruling could influence proceedings concerning Israel's war in Gaza.

reports.text: [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/elon-musk-women-afghanistan-taliban-restrictions/) reported that Elon Musk described the situation of women and girls in Afghanistan under Taliban rule as very concerning.

[Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-detain-four-female-journalists-and-two-radio-staff-members-in-eastern-afghanistan-ifj-says/) reported that the International Federation of Journalists stated Taliban morality police officials raided the office of Kawoon Ghazh Radio in eastern Afghanistan and detained four female journalists and two radio staff members.

[Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/how-the-taliban-use-the-law-to-take-land-a-legal-scholar-reads-the-omid-sabz-rulings/) reported that a Taliban court declared Kabul's Omid Sabz township state property, placing about 80,000 people at risk of losing their homes.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/taliban-arrest-several-social-media-activists-in-nangarhar/), [Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-detains-24-social-media-users-in-eastern-afghanistan-amid-intensified-crackdown/) reported that Taliban authorities in eastern Nangarhar province detained 24 young people over their social media activities, particularly on TikTok.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/taliban-arrest-torture-former-military-officer-nimroz/) reported that Taliban intelligence officials arrested and beat a former military officer in Nimroz Province after his deportation from Iran.

[Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-detain-four-young-women-in-daikundi-central-afghanistan-for-not-wearing-burqas/), [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/sources-taliban-arrest-around-10-women-in-sang-e-takht-and-bandar-district-of-daikundi/) reported that Taliban morality police detained approximately 10 women in the Sangtakht-o-Bandar district of Daikundi province for not wearing burqas.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/sources-two-omid-sabz-township-representatives-remain-in-taliban-custody-after-10-days/) reported that two representatives of Omid Sabz Township in western Kabul remain in Taliban custody nearly 10 days after their arrest.

[Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-arrest-two-shia-clerics-in-afghanistans-herat-province/) reported that Taliban authorities arrested two Shia clerics in Herat province following a mourning ceremony.

[Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-detains-four-shia-clerics-in-bamyan-amid-growing-pressure-on-community/) reported that Taliban intelligence authorities detained four Shia clerics in Bamyan province.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/kabul-new-city-land-grab-taliban/) reported that Kabul residents said a businessman from Khost province claimed ownership of 20 hectares of land in Parcel 2.2 of Kabul New City and demolished structures.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/omid-e-sabz-township-taliban-detain-representatives/) reported that two community representatives of Omid-e Sabz Township in western Kabul were detained for about a week after being summoned by the Taliban.

[Kabul Now](https://kabulnow.com/2026/11/taliban-pressure-residents-to-vacate-township-in-western-kabul-two-community-representatives-detained-for-a-week/) reported that two community representatives from Omid Sabz Township in western Kabul were detained by the Taliban's Ministry of Justice.

reports.text: [Punch](https://punchng.com/nafdac-shuts-abuja-market-seizes-n300m-fake-products/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that NAFDAC shut Zuba International Market in Abuja after screening over 160 shops and seizing counterfeit and unwholesome products worth over N300m.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1743674-nafdac-shuts-zuba-international-market-christmas-fake-products/) reported that NAFDAC shut down the Zuba International Market in Abuja after uncovering counterfeit and unwholesome products worth over N300 million during a raid.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nafdac-destroys-n22-73bn-fake-unsafe-products-records-52-arrests/) reported that NAFDAC destroyed fake and unsafe products worth N22.73 billion and recorded 52 arrests.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926899-nafdac-destroys-n100bn-counterfeit-products-uncovers-illegal-drug-and-cosmetics-factories.html) reported that NAFDAC destroyed counterfeit drugs, banned alcoholic beverages, and other unsafe products worth N100 billion in Ogun State.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/customs-hands-over-n22-3m-seized-illicit-drugs-to-nafdac-ndlea/) reported that the Northern Western Marine Command of the Nigeria Customs Service handed over seized illicit drugs worth over N22.3 million to NAFDAC and NDLEA.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kebbi-customs-marine-command-hands-over-seized-illicit-drugs-to-ndlea-nafdac/) reported that the Nigeria Customs Service North Western Marine Command handed over seized cannabis sativa and pharmaceutical products to the NDLEA and NAFDAC.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nafdac-destroys-fake-expired-drugs-drinks-worth-n100bn/) reported that NAFDAC destroyed fake, counterfeit, expired, banned, and substandard drugs and alcoholic drinks worth N100bn.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/nafdac-and-the-menace-of-fake-drugs/) reported that the growing menace of fake, substandard, and adulterated drugs in Nigeria has become a national emergency.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/drug-smuggling-scare-at-apapa-port-as-nafdac-uncovers-suspected-tramadol-hidden-in-corn-starch/) reported that NAFDAC officers uncovered suspected Tramadol hidden in corn starch at Apapa Port.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648912-us-basketball-player-arrested-nigeria-drug-bust/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Nigerian anti-narcotics authorities arrested a US basketball player over nearly 34 kilograms of cannabis found at Lagos airport.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/greene-damonte-khiree-arrest-cannabis-nigeria-b3085704.html), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-basketball-player-arrested-in-nigeria-with-34kg-cannabis-in-airport-luggage/articleshow/135898109.cms), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-basketball-player-greene-da-monte-khiree-arrested-in-nigeria-with-34kg-of-cannabis-101794853127626.html) reported that an American basketball player named Greene Da’monte Khiree was arrested in Nigeria with 34 kilograms of cannabis in airport luggage.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj93rggenq4xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that an American basketball player was arrested at a Nigerian airport with 34 kilograms of cannabis.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ndlea-arrests-american-basketballer-over-34kg-cannabis-consignment/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/ndlea-arrests-us-basketball-player-with-33-95kg-cannabis-in-lagos/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndlea-american-basketballer-arrested-with-32-parcels-of-loud-in-lagos/) reported that the NDLEA arrested an American basketball player in Lagos over a cannabis and Loud consignment.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/major-blow-to-drug-traffickers-as-ndlea-uncovers-25kg-meth-hidden-in-cereal-packs-arrests-us-basketball-player-with-34kg-loud/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741477-ndlea-arrests-american-basketballer-illict-drugs-lagos-airport/) reported that the agency also uncovered methamphetamine hidden in cereal packs at the Lagos airport.

reports.text: [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/trump-backs-iraqi-prime-ministers-drive-to-assert-state-authority-3726067), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-trump-voices-support-for-iraqi-premiers-efforts-to-assert-state-authority/), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/trump-backs-iraqi-leaders-efforts-assert-more-state-authority) reported that US President Donald Trump voiced support for Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi's efforts to assert state authority, end corruption, and curb oil smuggling.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-916332) reported that Iraq closed border crossings in the Kurdistan region, one with Syria and one with Iran, after Zaidi ordered authorities to take control of crossings run by the.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/trump-backs-iraqi-pms-oil-smuggling-crackdown?traffic_source=rss) reported that Donald Trump backed Iraqi Prime Minister's oil smuggling crackdown as Baghdad closed border crossings and Kurdish authorities warned of constitutional violations.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/462837/) reported that Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi stated the government will not allow the oil smuggling crisis to be turned into a conflict with the Kurds.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/26/iraqi-court-jails-11-for-oil-smuggling-in-nationwide-crackdown/) reported that an Iraqi court jailed 11 individuals for oil smuggling in a nationwide crackdown.
[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/462319/) reported that the Al-Anbar Provincial Council discussed mechanisms for returning displaced persons to areas including Jurf al-Sakhr and Al-Uweisat.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204117/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%87%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A8%D8%AD-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D9%86%D9%85%D9%88%D8%B0%D8%AC%D8%A7-%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD-%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9/) reported that government forces entering Jurf al-Sakhr reflect institutional shifts in state control over security.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204020/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A5%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A8%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%B9-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD/) reported that the spokesperson for the Commander-in-Chief of the Iraqi Armed Forces stated that security formations in Jurf al-Sakhor are subject to unified command and control to accelerate weapons containment.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203998/%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%A8-%D9%83%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%A8-%D8%AD%D8%B2%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%87/) reported an Iraqi security redeployment and the withdrawal of Kataib Hezbollah battalions from Jurf al-Sakhor in Babylon province to prepare for the return of displaced persons.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461932/) reported that the director of the Ministry of Migration and Displaced branch in Anbar Governorate stated that 1430 displaced families from Jurf al-Sakhor are currently residing in informal settlements in the Bzeebiz camp.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203816/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1/), [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461886/) reported that the spokesperson for the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces announced the establishment of a controlling headquarters in Jurf al-Sakhor north of Babylon province, subordinate to the Federal Police forces command.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461856/) reported that energy police commenced procedures to secure oil pipeline bundles in the Jurf al-Nasr area. [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203815/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B3/) reported that Prime Minister Ali al-Zeidi asked security forces entering Jurf al-Sakhor to exercise self-restraint.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/20/kataib-hezbollah-faces-deadline-to-leave-iraqi-stronghold?traffic_source=rss) reported that Kataib Hezbollah faces a deadline to leave an Iraqi stronghold.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461787/), [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203784/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that Iraqi authorities opened a controlling headquarters in the Jurf al-Sakhr area north of Babylon province.
[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461830/) reported that security forces began implementing a plan to reorganize the security file in Jurf al-Sakhr.
[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461835/) reported that energy police commenced duties to secure the oil pipeline in Jurf al-Nasr.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203610/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D8%B2%D8%B2-%D8%AD%D8%B6%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that Iraqi authorities initiated security procedures to reorganize military deployment in Jurf al-Sakhr north of Babylon province, with the Popular Mobilization Forces starting a troop rotation process.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/iraq-s-risky-standoff-the-state-vs-iran-allied-militias/a-79995757?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Iraqi security forces surrounded an area run by the Kataib Hezbollah militia in what onlookers described as a dangerous confrontation.
[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461820/) reported that a spokesperson for Kataib Hezbollah confirmed the group's refusal to surrender its weapons or leave the Jurf al-Sakhr area.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461813/) reported that Iraq's Ministry of Interior announced the participation of its security formations in redeployment arrangements in the Jurf al-Sakhr area.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/iraq-reaches-compromise-with-kataib-hezbollah-over-armed-group-stronghold?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iraq reached a compromise with Kataib Hezbollah to station forces including Popular Mobilisation Forces brigades in the armed group's stronghold.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/whats-behind-iraqs-standoff-kataib-hezbollah-militia) reported that the dispute over the Iran-backed group's presence in Jurf al-Sakhr tested Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi's efforts to rein in proxy groups.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/19/irgcs-esmail-qaani-holds-talks-with-kataib-hezbollah-as-showdown-with-iraqi-forces-averted/) reported that top IRGC commander Esmail Qaani held talks with Kataib Hezbollah while a showdown with Iraqi forces was averted.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461801/) reported that authorities arrested Ali Abdul Karim al-Moussawi, general manager of the Oil Pipelines Company, following judicial confessions regarding oil smuggling in Jurf al-Sakhar.
[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461733/) reported that Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi directed joint forces to deploy to Jurf al-Sakhar as the deadline approaches.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203578/%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B3%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%87%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%BA%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%87-%D9%86%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B0-%D8%AD%D8%B2%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%87-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that the Iraqi government is facing the Jurf al-Sakhar file between withdrawal deadlines and oil smuggling investigations through political settlement, military confrontation, or temporary containment.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/explainer-what-iraqs-kataib-hezbollah-militia) reported that Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi made his riskiest move since coming to power six months ago, targeting Kataib Hezbollah.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915335) reported that pro-Iranian militias including Kataib Hezbollah enjoy a semi-official status in Iraq.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461639/) reported that Prime Minister Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi approved joint forces of the army, police, and Popular Mobilization Forces to take control of Jurf al-Sakhar.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461501/) reported that economic researcher Ahmed Hadhal warned of continuing structural imbalances in Iraq's public finances as current expenditures in the 2027 draft budget absorb oil revenues.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/top-irgc-commander-in-iraq-for-talks-amid-kataib-hezbollah-tensions?traffic_source=rss) reported that the head of Iran's IRGC Quds Force attended meetings in Iraq over alleged oil smuggling linked to pro-Iranian armed groups.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203449/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%82%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A8-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%81%D8%B1%D8%B6-%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9/) reported that oil smuggling investigations in Jurf al-Sakhar led to broader Iraqi security measures and force deployments to assume security responsibility.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461590/) reported that Prime Minister Mohammed Shia' al-Sudani decided to enter the Jurf al-Sakhar area despite mediation efforts by Shiite leaders to dissuade him.

reports.text: [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-at-least-14-killed-in-rsf-attacks-on-east-darfur-west-kordofan-sudan-rights-group/) reported that a Sudanese rights group stated at least 14 people were killed in attacks by the Rapid Support Forces in Sudan’s East Darfur and West Kordofan states.
[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/at-least-14-killed-in-rsf-attacks-on-sudans-east-darfur-west-kordofan-3726065) reported that 12 of the 14 deaths occurred in East Darfur.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/25/sudan-war-grinds-on-with-rsf-seeking-to-stretch-safs-resources-thin/) reported that the Sudan conflict continues as the RSF seeks to stretch the SAF's resources thin.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQUFl6aC1QT2ozUEthZ0V6aGJXcnRHek1YYWt4OXZCU2otdGxqanpDTHdtY090MUNYVEV6NFlXdHowV0tDSUpWWlpaaE1EWWFCRlgxNDMtRWRKUW1WemlJZ2ozWExFR2p2ZzhZeWRuQllURFdHekpZNkpKVWh5bnpwSVN2U3piTTFnYms1OEpjVVdGeHpZaTMzU2E4VC1XaXJQZ3QxMmJrYnFuamRUNUl0WGtPSk85ZV82?oc=5) reported that drone strikes killed 19 civilians in southeastern Sudan, according to a rights group.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261125-rsf-defector-says-israelis-training-hemedtis-forces-in-darfur/) reported that a former commander who defected from Sudan's Rapid Support Forces revealed that Israeli experts are currently training Hemedti's forces in Darfur.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/sudan-rsf-commander-defects-says-israelis-training-militia) reported that a senior Sudanese RSF commander defected to the army and alleged that Israeli experts are training militia officers in Darfur.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/new-group-defects-from-rsf-and-joins-sudanese-army-in-khartoum-3725942), a Turkish state outlet, reported that a group that defected from the Rapid Support Forces arrived at Khartoum airport and joined the Sudanese army due to atrocities against civilians.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/82011abbd620), a Turkish state outlet, reported that Major General Ammar Mohammed Zein Rabih cited massacres, killings, and looting of civilians in Khartoum, Darfur, and Gezira as reasons for breaking away from the RSF to join the Sudanese army.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611230154.html) reported from Geneva that the UN stated armed drones have become a defining feature of the conflict in Sudan, expanding impacts beyond active frontlines.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/sudanese-aid-group-accuses-rsf-of-looting-shops-and-livestock-in-west-kordofan-3725887) reported that a Sudanese aid group accused the Rapid Support Forces of looting shops and livestock during a two-day attack on the village of Abu Qalb.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/22/civilians-killed-in-rsf-drone-strikes-in-sudan?traffic_source=rss) reported that several civilians were killed and buildings damaged in drone strikes by Sudan’s Rapid Support Forces.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611200102.html) reported that Amnesty International called for an investigation into possible war crimes after documenting nine Rapid Support Forces drone strikes on civilians in North Kordofan.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611200101.html) reported that Sudanese women's rights group The No to Oppression against Women Initiative condemned the continuation of the war and drone strikes.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-17/Drones-account-for-nearly-three-quarters-of-Sudan-war-deaths-this-year-1S9peiQ9zy0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that the UN human rights office verified over 2,230 civilian deaths in Sudan's war between January and October 2026, with drone strikes accounting for nearly three-quarters.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648986-drone-strikes-cause-nearly-three-quarters-verified-sudan-civilian-deaths/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that the UN stated drone strikes caused nearly three-quarters of verified civilian deaths in Sudan, killing over 1,630 civilians between January and October.
