[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/drones-behind-nearly-75-civilian-deaths-year-sudan) reported that the war between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces erupted in April 2023 and is estimated to have killed more than 200,000.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170440.html), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261117-over-2230-civilians-killed-in-sudan-in-10-months-most-by-drone-strikes-un-rights-office/) reported that a UN Human Rights Office report stated over 2,230 civilians were killed in Sudan between January and October 2026, with over 1,630 killed in drone strikes.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/sudanese-army-air-attack-kills-13-in-western-sudan-rights-group?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Sudanese army air attack killed 13 people in West Kordofan according to the Emergency Lawyers rights group.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/sudan-army-strike-kills-15-including-children-says-rights-group-survivor/article71707212.ece) reported that a rights monitor stated a double-tap strike on November 15 in the village of Abu Qalb killed 15 people and burned homes.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxObWZuRk5ZOHl1UjItOGw2MXZmMWt4ekZJYWtVXzgzaHpFUlVzbmdMQ01LdDZ1S1VvUTdCSmpLRzNjT1NVRnA3c3FSNTZMZG1xaDlpQWQ1M05DLUZCZExaeUJ0ZFJ2M2NSMElJUGFHMHlOMHJ3bDF1d09PS0RiZGFVMmNKM2dLRDVCSVFrMkNVWm03bnQ3TlpGSlV1QQ?oc=5) reported that a rights group stated an army airstrike killed at least 13 people in West Kordofan.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/rsf-commander-defects-army-makes-ground-kordofan) reported that RSF commander Al-Rasoul defected as the army made ground in Kordofan.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-sudanese-army-says-it-seized-5-areas-from-rsf-in-west-kordofan/) reported that the Sudanese army said it seized five areas in West Kordofan, including Al-Saatat, and advanced toward the strategic town of Abu Zabad.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/sudanese-army-seizes-3-areas-in-west-kordofan-military-sources-say-3725583), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/sudanese-army-offensive-west-kordofan-captures-al-khuwai) reported that the Sudanese army seized areas in West Kordofan, capturing locations including Al-Khuwai as part of an offensive towards Darfur.

reports.text: [Buenos Aires Times](https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/economy/mileis-overhaul-of-argentinas-central-bank-wins-final-approval-in-congress.phtml) reported that President Javier Milei's overhauled charter for the Central Bank won final congressional approval.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/27/milei-wins-senate-approval-to-suspend-primaries-with-debates-mandatory-only-in-a-run-off?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Argentina's Senate approved the political reform promoted by Javier Milei's government that suspends open, simultaneous, and mandatory primaries.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/la-iglesia-celebro-la-aprobacion-de-la-ley-de-ludopatia-en-el-senado-es-un-triunfo-colectivo-de-toda-nid27112026/) reported that the Episcopal Commission of Social Pastoral highlighted the Senate vote approving the ludopathy law as a collective triumph.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxOME12Z2hWeXJDdjhYQll0TW9vYWFaMzgwdWdBQ05BR3k4ckdrdFo3SkdfOXZrOGVXU1VUOTNtYXRXWEJBYlExUllERjdYRGxqR3lCelZyQTJxd0o2Q1VacWw0Sk5QajJWbGlDaDV1Y2hjWDE4dEVjNFpSQXdhQWg4MmFydGdDMEhmQjI2TjNiMUliZ1hBX1lXaDBoRlN0RHoxeUpxV3JuMkU2TmFncHhfWXdyOFNaUlVrUC1NZnlSS0NoRFE?oc=5) reported that the Argentine Senate approved the suspension of primaries, boosting President Javier Milei's reelection bid.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/politica/iglesia-celebro-aprobacion-ley-ludopatia-califico-triunfo-colectivo_0_Wpxdn7UTht.html) reported that the Episcopal Commission of Social Pastoral care released a statement celebrating the approval of the ludopathy law as a collective triumph.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/el-senado-se-apresta-a-aprobar-la-ley-de-ludopatia-tras-un-fuerte-reclamo-de-la-iglesia-nid26112026/) reported that the Argentine Senate is set to approve a ludopathy law following a strong claim by the Church, with La Libertad Avanza and the PJ agreeing to vote on the project.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/es-oficial-el-senado-aprobo-la-suspension-de-las-paso-para-las-elecciones-de-argentina-2027-nid26112026/) reported that the Argentine Senate approved the suspension of PASO primaries for the 2027 elections with 43 affirmative votes.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/mayans-insinuo-que-el-gobierno-busca-suspender-las-paso-para-eliminar-una-eventual-candidatura-de-nid26112026/) reported that opposition figure Mayans insinuated the government seeks to suspend the PASO primaries to eliminate an eventual candidacy by Patricia Bullrich.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/el-poroteo-final-del-gobierno-los-40-votos-que-la-casa-rosada-da-por-confirmados-para-lograr-la-nid26112026/) reported that Casa Rosada counts on 40 confirmed votes to achieve the suspension of PASO primaries, with Victoria Villarruel unable to exercise the presidency of the Senate due to Javier Milei's trip to Paraguay.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/el-gobierno-defiende-el-rumbo-economico-pese-a-los-numeros-oficiales-los-salarios-estan-por-arriba-nid26112026/) reported that Chief of Cabinet Diego Santilli stated the government has the numbers to suspend the PASO primaries.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/en-un-gesto-para-descomprimir-la-interna-jorge-macri-desplazo-a-tres-funcionarios-que-estaban-en-la-nid25112026/) reported that Buenos Aires City government chief Jorge Macri redesigned his cabinet and removed Ignacio Baistrocchi, César Torres, and Karina Burijson.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/jorge-macri-anuncio-cambios-en-la-estructura-del-gobierno-porteno-y-reconocio-el-aporte-de-una-nid25112026/) reported that Buenos Aires Mayor Jorge Macri announced the elimination of the Ministry of Public Space, the Media Secretariat, and 118 hierarchical positions.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/politica/achica-estructura-gobierno-porteno-desaparece-espacio-publico-senal-libertarios-mauricio-macri_0_52XUVB8A2Q.html) reported that the government structure of Buenos Aires is being reduced with the disappearance of the Public Space ministry and positions being absorbed by the Ministry of Government and the Chief of Cabinet.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/politica/gobierno-enfrenta-duras-batallas-congreso-final-incierto-presupuesto-suspension-paso_0_LpmS501yaI.html) reported that the Argentine government faces congressional battles over the national budget and the suspension of the PASO primaries.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/politica/sombras-fin-paso-riesgo-voto-felipe-dudas-llegara-milei-definicion-electoral_0_gQehmKFrdV.html) reported that the Argentine government expects the Senate to grant preliminary approval this week to the suspension of the PASO primaries.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/se-profundiza-la-interna-macrista-en-la-capital-de-andreis-desafia-a-jorge-macri-y-ritondo-respalda-nid22112026/) reported that the internal rift among macri supporters in the Capital deepened as De Andreis challenges Jorge Macri while Ritondo backs the head of government.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/el-gobierno-admite-que-tiene-los-votos-justos-para-aprobar-la-suspension-de-las-paso-en-el-senado-nid21112026/) reported that the Argentine government admitted it has 38 assured votes out of the 37 needed to approve the suspension of the PASO primaries in the Senate.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/la-libertad-avanza-presiona-para-suspender-las-paso-en-la-capital-y-tensiona-el-vinculo-con-jorge-nid19112026/) reported that La Libertad Avanza is pushing to suspend the PASO primaries in the Capital, creating tension with Jorge Macri's government.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/politica/mauricio-macri-definio-pro-acompanara-iniciativa-gobierno-eliminar-paso_0_Ao4gU9Zz3E.html) reported that Mauricio Macri decided the PRO will support the government's initiative to suspend the PASO.

reports.text: [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/extradicion-de-el-chapo-isidro-sera-decision-de-mexico-no-de-eu-sheinbaum-33335893) reported that President Claudia Sheinbaum stated that the extradition of El Chapo Isidro will be a decision for Mexico's Security Cabinet based on what suits Mexico.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/ice-destaca-colaboracion-con-mexico-para-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-resalta-investigacion-del-departamento-de-seguridad/) reported that Immigration and Customs Enforcement highlighted collaboration with Mexico for the capture of El Chapo Isidro.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/director-de-servicios-publicos-de-ahome-sinaloa-permanecera-en-el-cargo-su-hermano-fue-detenido-junto-a-el-chapo-isidro/) reported that Ahome public services director Iván Gálvez Meza will remain in his position despite his brother being detained alongside El Chapo Isidro.
[InSight Crime](https://insightcrime.org/news/chapo-isidro-arrest-chapitos-mayiza-war/) reported that the capture of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores shook up the Sinaloa Cartel war.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/asignan-elementos-de-seguridad-a-alcaldesa-de-guasave-tras-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-proteccion-fue-ordenada-por-gobernadora/) reported that Guasave Mayor Cecilia Ramírez Montoya announced security elements were assigned to her following the capture of Chapo Isidro.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/operativo-contra-el-chapo-isidro-para-el-publico-de-eu-analizan-operativo-con-los-de-casa/) reported that specialists questioned whether the criminal leader's capture should be valued for its visual display rather than results in combating organized crime.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/exjefe-de-la-dea-pide-enviar-a-rocha-moya-y-al-chapo-isidro-a-estados-unidos-33314185) reported that former DEA chief Derek Maltz requested President Claudia Sheinbaum to transfer the licensed governor of Sinaloa and Chapo Isidro to the United States.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/empresarios-piden-rescate-economico-federal-para-sinaloa-ante-violencia-tras-la-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-33308222) reported that Coparmex requested federal economic rescue and extra security for Sinaloa following violence after the capture of Chapo Isidro.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/mexico/el-chapo-isidro-sera-extraditado-a-estados-unidos-la-respuesta-del-gobierno-de-mexico-al-pedido-de-donald-trump-3604123) reported that Mexico's Attorney General's Office confirmed that cartel leader Chapo Isidro will face a domestic judicial process in Mexico rather than immediate extradition.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/ricardo-anaya-exige-extraditar-a-chapo-isidro-a-eu-advierte-conflicto-de-interes-con-gobiernos-de-morena/) reported that Mexican lawmaker Ricardo Anaya demanded the extradition of Chapo Isidro to the United States and warned of potential conflicts of interest.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/al-caer-la-noche-calles-vacias-y-temor-en-guasave-tras-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-violencia-cambia-rutina-de-sus-habitantes/) reported that nighttime activities and routines in Guasave have been disrupted following the capture of narcotics trafficker Chapo Isidro.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/chapo-isidro-permanecera-en-mexico-mientras-se-define-su-situacion-juridica-y-la-solicitud-de-extradicion-a-eu-33297994) reported that the FGR stated Fausto Isidro Meza Flores will not be expelled to the United States and his extradition process will be carried out.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/senado-rinde-homenaje-a-militares-caidos-en-operativo-contra-el-chapo-isidro-guardan-un-minuto-de-silencio/) reported that the Senate held a moment of silence and paid tribute to military personnel who died in the operation against Chapo Isidro.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/americas/mexico-defies-us-extradition-bid-for-drug-lord-el-chapo-isidro) reported that a senior Mexican official stated Mexico will prosecute alleged drug lord Fausto Isidro Meza despite a U.S. extradition request.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/mexico-oo-maxkamadeyn-doonta-el-chapo-isidro-inkastoo-mareykanka-uu-codsaday-in-la-soo-dhiibo/) reported that Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro, will be tried in Mexico despite a US extradition request.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/despiden-a-militares-caidos-en-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-veracruz-honra-su-servicio/) reported that Veracruz held a farewell ceremony for two military personnel killed in the operation in Guasave, Sinaloa, to capture Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261124-us-flew-surveillance-drone-over-mexico-to-help-capture-top-drug-lord) reported that Mexican officials stated the United States flew a surveillance drone over Mexican territory to help locate and capture a drug trafficker.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/mexico-took-down-a-top-drug-kingpin-can-it-dismantle-his-cartel-101795490045058.html) reported that U.S.-backed raids are delivering tactical victories against crime groups that remain deeply embedded in Mexican politics, society, and the local economy.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/mexico-to-try-el-chapo-isidro-despite-us-extradition-request?traffic_source=rss), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10947449) reported that Mexico will try alleged drug lord Fausto Isidro Meza, known as 'El Chapo Isidro', at home despite a US extradition request.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/mire-la-bala-cruzar-con-un-destello-amarillo-reportero-de-meganoticias-relata-como-vivio-la-violencia-en-guasave-tras-la-detencion-de-chapo-isidro/) reported that Meganoticias reporter Jesús Adrián Ibarra recounted experiencing violence and gunfire spreading in Guasave following the arrest.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/asi-ingresaron-fuerzas-especiales-al-escondite-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-guasave-lo-encontraron-sentado-en-un-sillon-y-sin-resistirse/) reported that the Secretary of Defense presented a video showing special forces entering the hideout of El Chapo Isidro in Guasave, where he was found sitting in a chair without resisting.

[El País](https://elpais.com/mexico/2026-11-23/361-militares-operaron-el-ataque-al-bunker-del-chapo-isidro.html) reported that 361 military personnel operated the three-month planned attack using US drones to capture cartel leader El Chapo Isidro.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5rmgkv2lk73o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that eight suspects were arrested after firing on soldiers attempting to re-establish order following the arrest of El Chapo Isidro.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/fgr-descarta-extradicion-del-chapo-isidro-por-el-momento-sera-juzgado-en-mexico-dice-godoy-33278626) reported that the FGR dismissed the extradition of Chapo Isidro for the moment and stated he will be tried in Mexico.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/mexico-juzgara-chapo-isidro-pese-solicitud-extradicion-estados-unidos_1795477374) reported that Meza Flores was detained on November 20 during a federal operation in the municipality of Guasave in Sinaloa.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/garcia-harfuch-corrupcion-y-omision-de-autoridades-permitieron-operar-al-chapo-isidro-33275613) reported that SSPC head García Harfuch stated that corruption and official omission allowed El Chapo Isidro to operate, and announced reinforced security in Sinaloa.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/capture-of-drug-trafficker-chapo-isidro-leaves-20-dead-in-sinaloa/) reported that Operation Centella involved three months of intelligence sharing with the United States and was carried out by 371 Mexican personnel, leading to the capture of 'Chapo Isidro'.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-flew-drone-over-mexican-territory-to-help-capture-drug-lord-in-sinaloa) reported that the United States flew a drone over Mexican territory to help capture Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/mexico/helicopteros-artillados-fuerzas-especiales-y-un-despliegue-de-361-militares-asi-fue-la-operacion-para-capturar-a-el-chapo-isidro-en-mexico-3603443) reported that the intervention ended with 16 alleged members of the criminal organization dead and four military personnel dead.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/cronologia-del-operativo-centella-para-capturar-al-chapo-isidro-sedena-detalla-fase-a-fase-la-caida-del-capo-en-guasave/) reported that General Ricardo Trevilla stated the operation involved 361 elements and 14 aircraft.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/la-caceria-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-guasave-se-preparo-con-eu-senala-nyt/) reported that the New York Times stated the operation to hunt 'El Chapo Isidro' in Guasave was prepared with the US, sharing intelligence and using reconnaissance drones for weeks.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/23/mexico-prende-oito-suspeitos-de-integrar-quadrilha-de-el-chapo-isidro-apos-onda-de-violencia.ghtml) reported that the Mexican Army captured eight suspected members of Fausto Isidro Meza's gang following violence in Sinaloa.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/caen-ocho-presuntos-integrantes-del-grupo-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-sinaloa-militares-son-atacados-a-balazos/) reported that according to the Secretariat of National Defense, eight suspected members of the group of 'El Chapo Isidro' were arrested in Sinaloa after participating in roadblocks on November 20 and military elements were attacked with gunfire.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/suman-17-muertos-tras-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-sinaloa-investigan-actuacion-de-fuerzas-federales/) reported that the death toll rose to 17 following the capture of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores in Sinaloa, with ten military elements treated for gunshot wounds.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/video-viral-capta-el-fuego-cruzado-en-el-cielo-nocturno-de-guasave-vecinos-registran-los-disparos-tras-el-operativo-contra-el-chapo-isidro/) reported that viral video captured crossfire in the night sky of Guasave as neighbors recorded gunfire following the operation against Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/dea-expresa-condolencias-a-familiares-de-militares-muertos-en-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-su-sacrificio-no-sera-olvidado/) reported that the DEA expressed condolences to the families and colleagues of four Mexican army elements killed during the operation in Guasave.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2026/nov/22/vehicles-burn-on-mexican-highway-after-capture-of-el-chapo-isidro-video) reported that footage showed burnt-out cars and trucks on roads in Sinaloa state following the capture of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261121-mexico-captures-drug-cartel-boss-el-chapo-isidro-after-deadly-firefight) reported that Mexico's military forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores following a deadly firefight.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/mexican-special-forces-arrest-drug-kingpin-chapo-isidro/a-80010745?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the alleged leader of the Beltran Leyva gang and one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, known as Chapo Isidro, was captured by the Mexican military following an operation.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/tras-captura-del-chapo-isidro-localizan-4-hombres-asesinados-en-guasave-investigan-posible-vinculo-con-operativo/) reported that following the capture of Chapo Isidro, four dead men were located in Guasave and authorities are investigating a possible link to the operation.

reports.text: [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191100/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%A7%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B7%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%84) reported that the World Health Organization warned that meningitis cases among children in the Gaza Strip have been rising rapidly since mid-October amidst deteriorating conditions.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191077/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A4%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%B9%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%82%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%B9%D9%89-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%AF) reported that Hisham Abu Mahfouz stated Israel is reneging on the ceasefire and seeking to establish permanent occupation in Gaza.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204409/%D9%83%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%B1-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%AB-%D9%86%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%87%D9%88-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B2%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%87-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D8%A3%D9%86-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Jared Kushner urged Netanyahu to implement the Trump plan regarding Gaza amidst US dissatisfaction with stalled progress.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7194618) reported that Israeli Channel 12 revealed that US presidential adviser Jared Kushner urged Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to implement Donald Trump's Gaza peace plan.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190950/%D8%B3%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%AA%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A5) reported that Democratic US Senators Jeanne Shaheen and Brian Schatz urged President Donald Trump's administration to pressure the Israeli government to facilitate the entry of humanitarian aid and supplies into Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190919/1690-%D8%B4%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%AA%D9%83%D8%A8-6405-%D8%AE%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%84%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the government media office stated that Israeli forces committed 6,405 violations of the Gaza ceasefire agreement over 410 days, resulting in 1,690 deaths.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204157/%D9%85%D9%84%D9%83-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%BA%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%B9-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A2%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A5%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1/), [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190867/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%87%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%BA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AB%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%B1%D8%BA%D9%85-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1) reported that Moroccan King Mohammed VI stated that the situation in Gaza does not meet expectations despite the ceasefire agreement.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190923/%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A5%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the Qatari Ministry of Foreign Affairs held Israel responsible for implementing its obligations under the Gaza Strip ceasefire agreement and called for pressure on Israel to fulfill its commitments.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190890/%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%AD-%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%B6-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AB%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that an exhibition documenting the genocide in the Gaza Strip was opened at United Nations headquarters in New York.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190892/%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%A7%D8%A8-%D9%84%D9%81%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A5%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%84%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D9%88%D9%87%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%B3%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%87%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2) reported that Islamic Jihad leader Dawood Shehab stated that the Peace Council is a framework for managing the war and engineering its continuation in Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190703/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85%C2%A0-%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AD%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D9%85%D9%86%D8%AD%D9%87-%D8%BA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AE%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-) reported that Palestinian authorities stated the Peace Council policy has displayed complete bias toward the Israeli occupation over a year of the ceasefire agreement.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190634/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AB%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine held the Israeli occupation government directly and fully responsible for the ongoing humanitarian catastrophe in the Gaza Strip.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203866/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Hamas called on the Peace Council to stop overlooking Israeli violations and hold Israel responsible for obstructing the Gaza ceasefire agreement.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7188394) reported that Jens Laerke, spokesperson for the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, stated that humanitarian convoy trips and distribution in the Gaza Strip face numerous procedures.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190549/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AB%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%84%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that the Gaza Strip Union of Municipalities, the Engineers Syndicate, and the Ministry of Public Works and Housing called for opening crossings, breaking the siege, and allowing humanitarian aid.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190531/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%B6%D9%84%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%82-%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%81%D8%B1-%D8%BA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%B9) reported that Hamas accused the Peace Council's report to the UN Security Council of distorting facts and providing cover for continued aggression.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203611/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B2%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA/) reported that the Peace Council warned of a possible collapse of the Gaza ceasefire agreement unless Israel and Hamas renew commitments.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190407/53-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%B1-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B3%D9%87%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9) reported that 53 countries, led by Qatar, Jordan, and the United Kingdom, demanded the opening of all Gaza crossings and land routes alongside the facilitation of humanitarian corridors.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190312/4-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%BA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A8%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that Australia, Canada, Italy, and Britain demanded that the Israeli occupation government immediately end delays in entering humanitarian aid into the Gaza Strip and open crossings.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7182304) reported that the foreign ministers of Australia, Canada, Italy, and Britain called on Israel to immediately and without hindrance allow humanitarian aid into the Gaza Strip.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190268/%D9%87%D8%A2%D8%B1%D8%AA%D8%B3-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%84%D9%85-%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B2%D9%85-%D8%A8%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D9%81%D9%82-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%87%D8%A7-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that Haaretz revealed Israeli data showing a wide gap between promised and actual aid truck entries into Gaza under ceasefire agreements.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203178/4-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%AF%D8%AE%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Canada, Britain, Italy, and Australia called on Israel to immediately and without hindrance allow humanitarian aid into Gaza.

narratives.label: Mexico Fair Rent Law Amendments

reports.text: [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/maestros-de-seccion-22-del-snte-levantan-bloqueos-sin-lograr-avances-en-sus-demandas-rompen-mesa-de-dialogo-con-gobiernos-federal-y-estatal/) reported that teachers from Section 22 of the SNTE lifted blocks without achieving demands and broke off dialogue tables with federal and state governments.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/congreso-argentino-aprueba-ley-para-combatir-la-ludopatia-restringir-las-apuestas-virtuales-y-prohibir-los-patrocinios-a-clubes-de-futbol-3604824) reported that the Argentine Congress approved a law to combat gambling addiction, restrict virtual betting, and prohibit sports club sponsorships with minimum standards for gaming platforms.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/las-nuevas-prohibiciones-que-regiran-para-las-apuestas-online-tras-la-sancion-de-la-ley-de-ludopatia-nid27112026/) reported that the Argentine Senate unanimously approved an initiative restricting online gambling advertising and sports sponsorships with increased controls to prevent minor access.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/congreso-de-sinaloa-aprueba-ley-de-voluntad-anticipada-pacientes-terminales-podran-rechazar-tratamientos/) reported that the Congress of Sinaloa approved an Advanced Will Law allowing terminally ill patients to reject treatments.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/que-es-la-nueva-ley-de-bienestar-animal-que-se-impulsa-en-cdmx-abarca-tanto-el-bienestar-fisico-como-el-mental/) reported that a new animal welfare law being promoted in Mexico City covers both physical and mental well-being.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/diputada-del-pan-busca-incorporar-a-administradores-de-condominios-al-debate-sobre-ley-de-rentas-en-cdmx-plantea-ajustes-a-la-iniciativa/) reported that PAN deputy Lizzette Salgado received proposals from COPLAC to precise obligations, update rents, and strengthen legal security for owners and tenants in Mexico City.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/ley-de-rentas-justas-dara-certeza-juridica-a-inquilinos-pero-no-resolvera-la-crisis-de-vivienda-asegura-especialista-33222412) reported that specialists stated the fair rent law will provide legal certainty to tenants but will not solve the underlying housing crisis.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/jubilados-de-la-camara-de-diputados-liberan-san-lazaro-tras-dialogo-con-mesa-directiva-reagendan-reunion-para-atender-demandas/) reported that Chamber of Deputies retirees released San Lazaro after dialogue with the Board of Directors and rescheduled a meeting to address their demands.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/19/politica/004n2pol?partner=rss) reported that the Chamber of Deputies approved the creation of the General Law on Animal Welfare, Care, and Protection.

[Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/congreso-aprueba-historica-ley-de-bienestar-animal/) reported that Congress approved an animal protection law to regulate animal welfare and homogenize concepts of welfare, mistreatment, and cruelty nationwide.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/ley-de-bienestar-animal-que-sanciones-y-medidas-de-proteccion-implica-esta-iniciativa/) reported that the animal welfare regulation represents an important tool in advancing fauna protection.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/diputados-aprueban-ley-de-proteccion-animal-crea-padron-de-infractores-y-establece-multas-de-hasta-234-mil-pesos/) reported that Mexican lawmakers approved an animal protection law establishing a register of offenders and fines of up to 234,000 pesos with 470 votes in favor and two abstentions.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/debaten-ley-de-rentas-en-cdmx-especialistas-cuestionan-si-construir-mas-viviendas-garantiza-el-acceso/) reported that lawmakers and activists stated that expanding housing supply must be accompanied by rental market regulation and construction cost reductions.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/denuncian-influencers-ser-buscados-por-inmobiliarias-para-desinformar-sobre-ley-de-rentas-justas-33175917) reported that influencers denounced being contacted by real estate agencies to spread disinformation regarding the Fair Rent Law, while ADI rejected being behind the campaign.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/proponen-inmobiliarias-ley-de-rentas-justas-solo-para-rentas-menores-a-15-mil-pesos-33183439) reported that ADI and Canadevi proposed that rents below 15,000 pesos cannot rise above inflation.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/ley-de-rentas-justas-iniactiva-privada-propone-diferenciar-aumentos-en-arrendamientos-buscan-proteger-a-las-familias-aseguran/) reported that business organizations suggested rents higher than 15,000 pesos be adjusted with each change of tenant or every three years.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/terminan-mesas-de-dialogo-sobre-ley-de-rentas-justas-en-congreso-de-cdmx-objetivo-es-evitar-aumentos-desproporcionados-insiste-diputado/) reported that dialogue tables on the Fair Rent Law concluded in the CDMX Congress.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/16/capital/035n2cap?partner=rss) reported that Morena in the Mexico City Congress will correct the fair rent initiative sent by the head of government to maintain certain rights.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/reconoce-morena-retrocesos-en-ley-de-rentas-justas-proponen-cambios-33149913), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/grupo-parlamentario-de-morena-realizara-ajustes-a-la-ley-de-rentas-justas-buscan-proteger-a-las-y-los-inquilinos-cumplidos/) reported that Morena's parliamentary group acknowledged retrogressive measures in the Fair Rent Law initiative and proposed changes to protect compliant tenants and preserve their right to extend contracts for a year.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/asia-pacific/progress-based-myanmar-return-asean-summit-november-2026/) reported that Philippine Foreign Secretary Maria Theresa Lazaro stated that the bloc wants to see how Myanmar responds as it weighs restoring political representation.

reports.text: [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91965365) reported that Promo-Lex identified networks of accounts with videos supporting and opposing candidates in the election campaign in Gagauzia.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91971576) reported that the second round of elections for the position of governor and the People's Assembly of Gagauzia is to be held on Sunday.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91852405) reported that the Central Electoral Commission and law enforcement agencies are monitoring the possible reactivation of a local coordinator network linked to Ilan Shor ahead of the runoff.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91535830) reported that Moldova's Central Electoral Commission and law enforcement institutions are coordinating actions to prevent and document possible cases of illegal financing and voter bribery ahead of the runoff election in Gagauzia.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89346959) reported that former activists in Ilan Sor's network were preparing for the second round of elections in Gagauzia.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87339698) reported that the Central Election Commission of Gagauzia approved the report on the tabulation of voting results for the election of the autonomy's governor.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87303047) reported that a deputy prime minister stated that whoever wins the second round of elections in Gagauzia must serve the interests of the autonomy's residents and prioritize development.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86782148) reported that the minimum voter turnout required for the Gagauzia election to be declared valid was reached after 32,372 voters cast ballots.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86522761) reported that Alexandr Stoianoglo and Socialist Party representative Fiodor Gagauz will face each other in the second round of elections.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86314643) reported that Moldova's Central Electoral Commission urged citizens to follow regional elections in the Autonomous Territorial Unit of Gagauzia exclusively through official sources due to the risk of false information.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86369962) reported that the voter turnout exceeded the 25 percent threshold in 29 of the 35 electoral districts in Gagauzia.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86287996) reported that Moldova's Promo-LEX association identified numerous incidents and irregularities during the elections in the Autonomous Territorial Unit of Gagauzia.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218421) reported that candidates favoring ties with Russia advanced to the Gagauzia election runoff in Moldova, with Alexandr Stoianoglo securing 38% of the vote and Fiodor Gagauz receiving 25%.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86303142) reported that election officials in Tomai opened regional elections by singing the national anthem.

reports.text: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/27/beau-lamarre-condon-service-weapon-murder-police-recruiters-ntwnfb) reported on video footage showing convicted double murderer Beau Lamarre-Condon deploying a Taser in 2020 at close range to an Indigenous man's face, chest, and neck.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/what-the-jury-wasn-t-told-about-beau-lamarre-condon-20261126-p61hlh.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported on details of Beau Lamarre-Condon's double-murder case that the jury was not allowed to hear.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/he-would-lose-his-composure-lamarre-condon-red-flags-face-scrutiny-20261126-p61h1x.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that an internal investigation by the state's policing watchdog is examining whether concerns about the officer's suitability to serve were addressed.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/what-the-jury-wasn-t-told-about-beau-lamarre-condon-s-previous-relationship-20261126-p613cd.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the double murderer's allegedly troubling behavior with an ex-partner was at the center of legal arguments in his criminal trial.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-26/beau-lamarre-condon-domestic-violence-red-flags-double-murder/107329010) reported that the double murder trial exposed Beau Lamarre-Condon as a controlling figure who stalked and terrified a former partner.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-25/nsw-beau-lamarre-condon-court-verdict-jesse-baird-luke-davies/107344850) reported that former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon's trial hinged on whether the jury believed his version of events regarding the morning Jesse Baird and Luke Davies were shot dead.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/ex-police-officer-beau-lamarre-condon-guilty-of-murdering-jesse-baird-and-luke-davies/JLADZ5W2ZRFWTOMCONLSKZ45BI/) reported that the jury found former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon guilty of murdering Jesse Baird and Luke Davies after just over two hours of deliberation.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/thousands-of-hours-of-cctv-footage-this-is-when-beau-lamarre-condon-knew-police-were-onto-him-20261125-p61gq2.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the former police officer said he was panicking after Jesse Baird and Luke Davies were killed, while security camera footage captured a calm and methodical man.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/25/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-jury-considers-verdict-ntwnfb), [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-25/beau-lamarre-condon-murder-trial-jury-retires-consider-verdict/107423638) reported that the jury retired to consider verdicts in the double-murder trial of former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon over the deaths of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/lamarre-condon-found-guilty-of-murdering-sydney-couple-20261125-p61ezk.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that gasps and sobs broke the silence in the NSW Supreme Court as the verdict was delivered.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/jury-set-to-retire-in-beau-lamarre-condon-murder-trial-20261124-p61gyg.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the jury is set to retire to decide a verdict in the murder trial of former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-live-updates-judge-to-deliver-summing-up-to-jury-after-defence-closing-20261124-p61gn1.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Justice Natalie Adams told the jury they are likely to start deliberations on Wednesday in the former police officer's double murder trial.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/24/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-barrister-closing-statement-ntwnfb) reported that former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon's barrister told the court his client chose to enter the witness box rather than remain silent in his murder trial.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/beau-lamarre-condon-s-lawyer-calls-him-fool-but-not-a-murderer-court-hears-20261123-p61glf.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Beau Lamarre-Condon's lawyer told the jury that the ex-cop may have been foolish, but insisted he is not a murderer.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/love-makes-fools-of-us-all-defence-closing-address-in-lamarre-condon-trial-20261123-p61gjg.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that defence barrister John Stratton told the NSW Supreme Court jury that the fate of the accused is in their hands.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/23/beau-lamarre-condon-trail-executed-jesse-baird-prosecution-argues-ntwnfb) reported that the crown urged the jury to reject the accused's claim of self-defence and find him guilty of murdering Jesse Baird and Luke Davies.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-live-updates-defence-closing-address-set-to-start-after-crown-address-concludes-20261123-p61gbd.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the defence barrister stated during the closing address that love makes fools of us all in the double murder trial.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/watch-the-bag-uber-eats-cctv-footage-played-in-final-days-of-lamarre-condon-murder-trial-20261120-p61fx4.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Beau Lamarre-Condon stated he was carrying an empty Uber Eats bag minutes before Jesse Baird and Luke Davies died, while the Crown alleged it held a gun.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/prosecution-begins-closing-arguments-in-lamarre-condon-trial-20261119-p61fsj.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the prosecution began closing arguments in the double murder trial of Beau Lamarre-Condon.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/19/beau-lamarre-condon-jesse-baird-luke-davies-ntwnfb), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-live-updates-crown-prosecutor-delivers-closing-address-ahead-of-jury-deliberations-20261119-p61fi2.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the crown prosecutor delivered closing addresses in the double murder trial of former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/reconstruction-videos-played-in-lamarre-condon-s-double-murder-trial-20261117-p61f18.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the Crown played two computer-generated reconstruction videos of Jesse Baird's Paddington home to the jury during the trial.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-16/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-live-blog-defence-re-examination/107388966) reported that Beau Lamarre-Condon's defense team prepared to re-examine him after over a week in the witness box during his double murder trial.

reports.text: [Foreign Policy](https://foreignpolicy.com/2026/11/25/bangladesh-india-china-modi-shah-visit-flood-reconstruction-aid/) reported that Nepali leader Balendra Shah's first foreign trip to India reaffirmed ties and demonstrated New Delhi's regional sway.

[The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/why-nepali-prime-minister-balendra-shahs-india-visit-was-a-success/) reported that Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah secured support from India for post-disaster rebuilding and an air-entry route via Bhairahawa during his bilateral visit.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-24/China-will-actively-support-Nepal-s-post-disaster-reconstruction-1Sk7cmoU6Xu/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=China) reported that China stated it will actively support Nepal's post-disaster reconstruction efforts and help residents rebuild homes.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwx2ervemj4ko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that India pledged $1.6 billion to Nepal in a reset of ties as Nepal rebuilds after deadly floods.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/nepal-s-new-pm-eyes-closer-ties-with-india-amid-lingering-disputes/a-80021769?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah sought deeper ties with India on his first foreign bilateral visit.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQSWpDakZzTzdkdDFwdmNHcHlTc0Q0SDBxWEN3Uk5ZcmZaZXJzdzV3RXNtZkUzZzk1RlJKVFdkNkp5aVI2cVNaeVBBMFRBcXZ5S00xVVRvN3JuNXJUcXpvaVdrTnZPRmVhTUhuNHNEdDZtQmF4bFEyRVB4NG93c19Ub3hsQnJZNUJURGZjcndld1ZTVGViQnFDaGFzeExYaGVxZkE0SXdR?oc=5) reported that India announced a $1.62 billion package to bolster ties with flood-hit Nepal.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/india/649242-india-nepal-flood-aid/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that India signed eight bilateral agreements with Nepal.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/india-pledges-14bn-to-help-nepal-rebuild-after-deadly-glacier-flood) reported that Prime Minister Balendra Shah's visit also brought agreements on a railway, a hydropower plant and fuel infrastructure.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046531/india-to-give-162bn-economic-package-to-flood-hit-nepal) reported that Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced an economic package worth 240 billion Nepalese rupees after talks with Nepal's prime minister.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/uk/prince-william-may-let-daughter-princess-charlotte-give-up-royal-titles-11-year-old-dreams-of-pursuing-a-career-on-stage-already-earning-admiration-for-acting-and-singing-talents/articleshow/136075746.cms) reported that Princess Charlotte could pursue a career in the performing arts.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/uk/prince-william-plans-to-strip-prince-harry-meghan-markle-and-their-children-of-royal-titles-when-he-becomes-king-report/articleshow/136080342.cms) reported that Prince William plans to strip Prince Harry and Meghan of their royal titles.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/india-nepal-pm-balendra-shah-heads-to-delhi-for-first-bilateral-visit/live-80008104?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah arrived in New Delhi for his first foreign bilateral trip since taking office.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6jre8xd83qgo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that trade, connectivity, and regional cooperation will top the agenda when Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah meets his Indian counterpart.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPeWFBbWZpV0haLUdMd1N5UmRDa3JKcGtDamx2NUxfa3RmeHNEYTR5V1E1YW43VFNIV1FVMTVmRkxhNkI1S2N4YVZLX0FKVzNpVVhGbXV5MVRySnJEX01rUUN0MTlYOU1TX2p3ajcwUzhqRHA1NkhrSUxqMzFKdlozU05aRG1VbFlHZ1RfM1VhUjFpMElGWEpQel9GWGpnX3B4?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/nepal-pm-balendra-shah-to-visit-india-on-november-2223/article71723493.ece) reported that Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah will visit India on November 22-23 to meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Droupadi Murmu, and inaugurate energy-related projects.

[Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/international-relations/nepal-s-shah-to-meet-modi-for-indian-flood-aid-and-connectivity) reported that Nepal's Shah was set to meet Modi for Indian flood aid and connectivity.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/india-canada-eye-defence-pact-during-modi-visit-in-december/article71716898.ece) reported that India's High Commissioner to Ottawa stated India and Canada cannot afford to let fringe issues derail their mutual interests during a Modi visit in December.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/prince-william-and-kate-meet-indias-pm-narendra-modi-as-they-wrap-up-royal-visit-13613699) reported that the Prince and Princess of Wales met India's prime minister to discuss trade and bilateral ties at the end of their three-day visit.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq62ped2ypy4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOejBsNXhaOERnME82SG44d1pjcUx4NW83WjYxM28yY0pWWlVPaFg0NjdXOGc0Sml3ZllDMVFsYVd3dmZLWHQ5MlFHQ05aLTFxcU1ZOGZUbThGRDhlS2V6ekxVWjhVU042YnZFc0Y0WEhxMnl1a1VxVkRtLTdFZDRQWEJHRjhtVnpDc18wNW1Qb3MwRXZ3UmQyYjRGUmVMTVRNQVZNNnlBQUY2QThH?oc=5) reported that Britain's Prince William and Kate met Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi at the end of their royal visit.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPWkc3ZGFYRXREU3BPNVJ0bHhKQUFkdklCZ0pnM0ZYOXMzMU0yU05ZV1lZdzZWdWlKNmVoTHFXam1MWDJVdGNwYXUtN2xSYTFkdnNJRUg0ZllaWk9jcjF6RXlxOEpPVHNyVnNESVVTR0MwYzRPTmlmeDVPSXA2Y3VjUWdYOGdXTTZuWGkxRWxqa2hPZENMOGZfakQyQWpkWEhfX3VIbkxJVVoxRTB2ME03c19iai1mR0RpUGc?oc=5) reported that Britain's Prince William stated the world must act urgently on climate at an Indian awards ceremony.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqlykve012d1o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the Prince and Princess of Wales were joined by sporting and acting stars for the annual Earthshot Prize ceremony in Mumbai.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/asia/prince-william-climate-prize-india-rickshaw.html) reported that British Prince William used an electric rickshaw made by an Earthshot Prize finalist during his visit to India.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/prince-william-india-bhutan-france-narendra-modi-b3086653.html) reported that five innovators and organizations were awarded $1.3 million each at the Earthshot Prize ceremony in Mumbai.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQcVdWd0JJX0wwOExoZzZ0STVSdnRWR2tPMXoyZHd2cU5wdU42bnNfRGwzRzRtaUloQjd3NWp2bUt3dlNOUzRTUTFaTTBCUkVkanZDa3RWWjFRajJNWkRweFJYUE1LaHVkSlRRRXVoNWRzaTRwN0FRMWttRC1RbkdwdnBQQjdPZVNxYW5MeFVVbU14bkdE?oc=5) reported that William and Kate are in India for their first overseas trip together since her cancer diagnosis.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPZGJkRHhDVG91MUl0X1JlRkdvUHdyVWF6WUQ1Vmt4TXNEZkhOTzZaLUtiQmJQQlJVV3NSRWpoRGhoVVB1UFVRNmgtdmdZT2l0X2lyUDBiemdOczg4Mi1lMTh4RjF6R3RfRFpwbXd4NzU3Y2Q3aDJ1RGFzZVBQV05VNUpEbmlmaFNTR0VRVlRUT3pVYXliV3o4UFYzWEcyNFh3YjcwOU1YVk5LSUR5Z1ZKb09zNA?oc=5) reported that British royal couple Prince William and Princess Catherine arrived in India for a three-day visit.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/crkgvnl51w1vo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the Prince and Princess of Wales started their Mumbai visit with street cricket and a metro ride.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/william-and-kate-land-in-mumbai-for-earthshot-prize-trip-13612656) reported that the Prince and Princess of Wales arrived in Mumbai for the Earthshot Prize awards on their first official overseas trip in nearly four years.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-16-uks-prince-william-princess-kate-begin-india-visit-with-street-cricket/) reported that Britain's Prince William and Kate Middleton took part in a street cricket game in Mumbai on the first day of their three-day trip.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/photogallery/primopiano/2026/11/16/william-e-kate-in-visita-di-tre-giorni-in-india_b1a79362-fb2a-4425-bc0b-089f618eae12.html) reported that William and Kate participate in events including the Earthshot Prize ceremony.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5lyk0e3n1jxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the Prince and Princess of Wales arrived in India ahead of a meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, with most engagements related to the Earthshot Prize.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/uk/prince-william-kate-to-meet-pm-modi-in-delhi-during-three-day-india-visit/articleshow/135860567.cms) reported that Prince William and Kate are scheduled to meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Delhi during their three-day visit.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/le-prince-william-et-kate-en-inde-pour-la-remise-de-son-prix-environnemental-20261116) reported that the Earthshot Prize rewards promoters of original solutions to combat global warming, ocean protection, and other environmental challenges.

reports.text: [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1011041/house-prosecutors-ready-to-cross-examine-sara-duterte-if-she-takes-witness-stand/story/) reported that the House prosecution panel is prepared to cross-examine Vice President Sara Duterte if she decides to take the witness stand in her Senate impeachment trial.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/philippines-photographers-reflect-duterte-drug-war-6586721) reported that former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte goes on trial at the International Criminal Court for the crime against humanity of murder over killings in his drug war.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/international-criminal-court-philippines-duterte-b3092528.html) reported that former Philippine leader Rodrigo Duterte went on trial at the International Criminal Court for alleged crimes against humanity over his war on drugs.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010906/rodrigo-duterte-camp-discloses-63-item-evidence-batch-ahead-of-icc-trial/story/) reported that Rodrigo Duterte's defense submitted 63 items of evidence ahead of the ICC trial.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010899/sara-duterte-can-best-answer-allegations-says-house-prosecutor/story/) reported that House lead impeachment prosecutor Representative Gerville Luistro stated she was left wanting more after the defense panel submitted only two names of witnesses.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/former-cale88-co-owner-boc-official-testify-sara-duterte-impeachment-trial/) reported that Dr. Lourdes Tingson-Lebosada is expected to testify in the Sara Duterte impeachment trial regarding Cale88's organizational structure.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010897/mother-of-drug-war-victims-set-to-observe-duterte-s-icc-proceedings-in-the-hague/story/) reported that the mother of two drug war victims will observe former President Rodrigo Duterte's trial proceedings at the International Criminal Court in The Hague.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010903/icc-trial-chamber-iii-sets-conduct-for-duterte-trial-proceedings/story/) reported that ICC Trial Chamber III set the conduct of proceedings for the trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010854/defense-lawyer-brings-up-duterte-s-cognitive-impairment-anew-ahead-of-icc-trial/story/) reported that Rodrigo Duterte's defense lawyer stated he has a cognitive impairment affecting his understanding of crimes against humanity charges before the ICC.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010809/rodrigo-duterte-camp-link-to-alleged-crimes-against-humanity-untenable/story/) reported that Rodrigo Duterte's defense team questioned the Office of the Prosecutor's evidence linking him to alleged crimes against humanity in a 77-page pre-trial brief.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010792/justice-leonen-concurs-with-dismissal-but-says-sc-should-have-ruled-on-duterte-arrest/story/) reported that Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen concurred with the Supreme Court's dismissal of habeas corpus petitions while stating the court should have ruled on the arrest.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010704/kitty-duterte-to-appeal-sc-dismissal-of-petitions-challenging-father-s-arrest-lawyer/story/) reported that the camp of Veronica “Kitty” Duterte will appeal the Supreme Court decision dismissing the habeas corpus petitions challenging her father's arrest.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010638/icc-prosecution-to-present-100-witnesses-protective-measures-may-be-implemented/story/) reported that the International Criminal Court spokesperson stated the prosecution team is expected to present over 100 witnesses during the trial.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/expectations-opening-rodrigo-duterte-international-criminal-court-trial/) reported that more than 500 victims of extrajudicial killings in the drug war are authorized to participate in the trial through their legal representatives.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010631/sara-duterte-the-best-defense-witness-in-impeachment-trial-says-prosecutor-luistro/story/) reported that House Lead Impeachment Prosecutor Gerville Luistro stated that Vice President Sara Duterte is the best witness the defense panel can present.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010604/sc-junks-petitions-challenging-ex-president-duterte-s-arrest/story/), [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/supreme-court-dismisses-petition-rodrigo-duterte-icc-arrest/) reported that the Philippine Supreme Court dismissed habeas corpus petitions challenging the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010558/icc-sets-procedure-for-external-submissions-in-rodrigo-duterte-drug-war-probe/story/) reported that the International Criminal Court Pre-Trial Chamber I is setting a standard procedure to process submissions from external entities in the Rodrigo Duterte drug war probe.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010560/rodrigo-duterte-camp-opposes-sweeping-closed-sessions-for-icc-prosecution-witnesses/story/) reported that former President Rodrigo Duterte's defense team opposed the ICC prosecution's request for sweeping closed sessions for prosecution witnesses.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010495/pnp-considering-to-visit-sara-duterte-over-alleged-threats/story/) reported that the Philippine National Police stated on Monday that it is willing to visit Vice President Sara Duterte to gather details regarding reported threats against her.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010457/pnp-preparing-for-the-worst-ahead-of-sara-duterte-impeachment-trial-verdict-jonvic-remulla/story/) reported that Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla urged the Philippine National Police to remain impartial and prepare for possible scenarios ahead of the verdict.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/rodrigo-duterte-icc-trial-hearing-schedule-key-dates/) reported that the ICC set November 30 as the start of Rodrigo Duterte's trial, with hearings resuming on January 11.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010417/prosecution-ready-should-vp-sara-mans-carpio-testify-in-impeachment-court-joel-chua/story/) reported that House lead prosecutor Joel Chua stated the prosecution is ready should Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband Manases Carpio testify before the impeachment court.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010362/prosecution-asks-icc-chamber-to-reject-rodrigo-duterte-defense-request-on-evidence/story/) reported that prosecutors asked the International Criminal Court Trial Chamber III to dismiss a request of former president Rodrigo Duterte's defense team regarding evidence.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/agnes-callamard-us-sanctions-vs-icc-jeopardize-rodrigo-duterte-case/) reported that Agnes Callamard stated that US sanctions against the ICC could jeopardize the Rodrigo Duterte case.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010404/sara-duterte-spox-given-until-nov-23-to-respond-to-senate-show-cause-order/story/) reported that Vice President Sara Duterte's spokesperson Paolo Panelo was given until Monday, November 23, to respond to a show-cause order issued by the Senate impeachment court.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010302/adiong-on-questions-to-vp-sara-s-tree-planting-link-with-cale88-don-t-be-onion-skinned/story/) reported that House prosecution spokesperson Zia Adiong responded to criticism from the Office of the Vice President regarding questions on tree planting.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010288/ovp-tree-planting-campaign-not-associated-with-cale88-boi-compliance/story/) reported that the Office of the Vice President denied that its tree planting campaign is related to Cale88 Foods Corporation's compliance with the Board of Investments.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010253/sara-duterte-impeachment-trial-day-45-cale88-seen-as-small-time-despite-millions-in-money-flows/story/) reported that the 45th day of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial began with the Senate impeachment court ordering OVP spokesperson Paolo Panelo to explain money flows related to Cale88.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010254/rodrigo-duterte-camp-asks-icc-to-reject-ex-davao-cop-s-prior-recorded-testimony/story/) reported that former President Rodrigo Duterte's defense team asked the International Criminal Court to reject an ex-Davao City police officer's prior recorded testimony.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/defense-witness-cannot-explain-discrepancy-cale88-sales-cash-inflows/) reported that DTI Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo's testimony on Cale88 raises suspicions about the banana chips exporter's inward remittances from China.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010235/sara-duterte-trial-dates-on-nov-26-and-27-reset-over-defense-witnesses-unavailability/story/) reported that trial dates on November 26 and 27 were reset over the unavailability of defense witnesses.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010193/cale88-reduced-employees-due-to-non-operation-change-of-management-dti-witness/story/) reported that a Department of Trade and Industry defense witness stated Cale88 reduced its number of employees from 2024 to 2025 due to non-operation and a change in management.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010214/sara-duterte-s-tree-planting-connection-to-calle88-questioned-in-impeachment-trial/story/) reported that the House prosecution panel raised questions regarding the alleged possible connection of Vice President Sara Duterte's tree planting activities with Cale88 during her impeachment trial.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/impeachment-court-orders-sara-duterte-spokesman-paolo-panel-explain-comments-judges/) reported that Sara Duterte's spokesperson Paolo Panelo was told to explain after being accused of bias by senators, and defense lawyer Michael Poa stated a contempt citation would not affect the defense's strategy.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010175/paolo-panelo-issued-show-cause-order-by-senate-impeachment-court/story/) reported that the Philippine Senate impeachment court issued a show cause order against Vice President Sara Duterte's spokesperson, lawyer Paolo Panelo, over comments regarding the trial.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010147/sara-duterte-impeachment-trial-day-45-what-to-expect/story/) reported that Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial continues with her defense team expected to present its last three witnesses for the week.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010114/sara-duterte-s-financial-transactions-need-further-investigation-says-witness/story/) reported that a witness stated Vice President Sara Duterte's financial transactions need further investigation based on Anti-Money Laundering Council data.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010151/victim-s-lawyers-back-closed-testimony-stronger-protection-for-duterte-icc-trial-witnesses/story/) reported that lawyers for victims backed closed testimony and stronger protection for witnesses in former President Rodrigo Duterte's International Criminal Court case.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010120/sara-duterte-defense-presents-salns-of-marcos-leni-robredo/story/) reported that Vice President Sara Duterte's defense counsel presented the statements of assets, liabilities, and net worth of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010122/sara-duterte-s-defense-fails-to-challenge-evidence-in-impeachment-trial/story/) reported that the House prosecution stated the defense team has yet to debunk evidence at the conclusion of the 44th day of the impeachment trial.

reports.text: [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611250226.html) reported that offshore deportation deals risk producing opacity, shielding authoritarian governments, and acting as political signalling rather than reducing migration pressures.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261117-five-eu-member-states-open-talks-with-rwanda-on-deportation-centre) reported that Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and Greece are jointly spearheading a project to open talks with Rwanda on a deportation centre.

[The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/436787/rwanda-migrant-deportation-centre-what-we-know-about-europes-five-nation-plan/) reported that the plan involves an open welcome centre, residence permits, and a path into Rwandan society, though NGOs expressed fears.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/migration-partnership-with-rwanda-sparks-eu-backlash-over-human-rights-record) reported that Rwanda's interior minister rejected criticism regarding the country's human rights record as it prepares to host the first EU return hubs outside the bloc.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seekers-migrants-eu-uk-b3086442.html) reported that Rwanda's interior minister positioned the East African nation as a welcoming country for refugees and migrants.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-5-european-countries-aim-to-send-rejected-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda), [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648950-eu-states-seek-deport-asylum-seekers-rwanda/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that five European countries announced plans to establish a return hub in Rwanda starting in 2027 to send rejected asylum seekers.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-news-plans-for-rwanda-migrant-hub-come-under-fire/live-79965639?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/why-are-five-eu-countries-reviving-plans-to-deport-migrants-to-rwanda?traffic_source=rss) reported that human rights groups slammed plans by Germany and four other EU states to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda as a return hub.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170105.html), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eu-countries-present-rwanda-agreement-to-create-migrant-return-center-hub/) reported that Rwanda and five European Union member states announced a partnership to establish a migrant return hub in Rwanda.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/world/politics/european-nations-rwanda-hub-migrants/) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands planned a Rwanda migrant hub despite human rights protests and a UNHCR warning.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-eu-states-open-talks-on-rwanda-deportation-scheme/a-79959158?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Germany joined four other EU states to open talks on establishing a migrant deportation hub in Rwanda following the approval of EU regulations easing deportations.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/rwanda-to-host-hub-for-rejected-eu-migrants) reported that five European countries are negotiating a deal to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda to host a hub.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/rwanda-to-create-return-center-for-asylum-seekers/), a state-media outlet, reported that Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker announced the plan aims to avoid human trafficking networks and reduce deaths on migration routes.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxOZFh2TV8xR3JSejFkM0c0RjBIVmVsWXhkZUtTWHlsLTY4WEI0Q0hVZDJFQURQaWdpM3JtRFdocXFpcW85RTJGeVgzaGhyODNTTUxIcHc5YUl4SWVQU0dwb0d3XzRzZFB0QjBrY2VGQWFSUVRWLTZNeUZZd1dSdnNJTG1zRzI2VXN3TGFTM092MEhRMjRkblBmeXZJSVhacS1aQXg5cG5tOEw2T2MxTjNkdjVOSUtLR1dELUtSdlYwWQ?oc=5) reported that Austria stated five EU countries are starting talks with Rwanda on a deportation hub.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90286) reported that Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen defended the plan.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/cinq-pays-de-l-union-europeenne-devoilent-leur-projet-de-centre-pour-migrants-au-rwanda-20261116) reported that the project aims to facilitate the return of individuals whose asylum applications were rejected or who lack the right to stay in the European Union.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2026/1116/1599373-eu-migrant-hub-deal/), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/5-eu-nations-present-plan-for-1st-migrant-return-hub-in-rwanda) reported that five EU nations presented a plan alongside Rwandan officials to establish the first migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-unveil-rwanda-deportation-plan-in-migration-crackdown), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/5-countries-announce-plan-to-deport-failed-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands aim to begin deporting rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda in 2027.
[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/world/1741658-5-eu-countries-plan-open-migrant-deportation-centre-rwanda-2027/) reported that rights groups raised concerns over detention and DR Congo.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-to-announce-first-ever-return-hub-for-migrants-in-rwanda), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261116-eu-nations-to-unveil-rwanda-deal-for-migrant-return-hub) reported that Denmark, Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, and Greece are set to announce a deal to establish a migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seeker-deportation-eu-scheme-b3085455.html) reported that two lawmakers were shown facilities earmarked for Britain's abandoned Rwanda scheme.
