reports.text: [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064615/) reported that Svitlana Kuropiatnik, who was injured in a Russian attack on central Kryvyi Rih on November 20, died in hospital.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064376/) reported that 33-year-old Kateryna Bovtunenko and her 11-year-old daughter Kira were killed in Dymer when a Russian drone struck a multi-storey residential building.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064333/) reported that a 79-year-old woman rescued from under the rubble of a residential building in Dymer died in the hospital, bringing the death toll to 12.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90969) reported that search and rescue operations at a destroyed residential building in Dymer concluded with 11 dead following a Russian drone strike.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90456346) reported that a Russian drone strike on an apartment building in Dymer killed at least 11 people.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064241/) reported that rescue workers found a cat completely buried under the rubble of a building destroyed in Dymer.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187821-russian-strike-on-dymer-claims-11-lives-emergency-rescue-operations-completed.html) reported that emergency rescue operations in Dymer have been completed.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/23/ukraine-dramatic-night-rescue-pulls-woman-from-rubble-after-22-hours) reported that an elderly woman was rescued alive after spending 22 hours trapped beneath concrete slabs in Dymer.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187563-death-toll-from-russian-strike-on-apartment-building-in-kyiv-regions-dymer-rises-to-11.html), [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-23-russian-attack-on-ukraines-dymer-in-kyiv-region-kills-11-official-says/) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on an apartment building in the town of Dymer in the Kyiv region has risen to 11.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187609-two-people-still-missing-after-russian-strike-on-dymer-zelensky-says.html) reported that two people are still missing after the strike on Dymer.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-kyiv-dymer-russian-strike-b3089574.html) reported that a seven-year-old boy was pulled alive from rubble 14 hours after a Russian strike killed 11 in a residential building, and that Ukraine's interior minister reported over 70 strikes across 10 regions over the weekend.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russian-attack-on-ukraine-dymer-in-kyiv-region-kills-11-amid-escalating-tensions-101795416493879.html) reported that a Russian attack on Dymer in the Kyiv region killed 11.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/russian-air-strikes-kill-at-least-15-people-across-kyiv-region-ukraine-says), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1123/1600244-russian-strike-ukraine/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90880) reported that Russian air strikes killed at least 15 people across the Kyiv region.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/apartment-building-destroyed-in-kyiv-oblast-following-russian-drone-attack/) reported that a five-story residential building was damaged in the Vyshhorod district of Kyiv Oblast following a Russian drone attack, leaving at least 2 injured.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1123/1600244-russian-attack/) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack rose to 14 in Ukraine as rescuers search for residents trapped under the rubble of a block of flats.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187483-russia-tries-to-cut-off-odesa-and-dnipropetrovsk-regions-from-energy-sources-zelensky.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russian forces are attempting to disconnect the Odesa and Dnipropetrovsk regions from their energy sources.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187471-death-toll-from-russian-strike-on-supermarket-in-vyshneve-rises-to-three.html) reported that the death toll from the Russian attack on a store in Vyshneve rose to three, with fifteen people injured.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187474-death-toll-from-russian-attack-in-dymer-rises-to-four-zelensky.html) reported that the death toll from the Russian attack in Dymer rose to four as rescue operations continue.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187456-death-toll-from-russian-attack-on-supermarket-in-vyshneve-rises-to-two.html) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on a store in Vyshneve in the Bucha district rose to two.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187437-body-of-third-victim-recovered-from-rubble-of-building-in-dymer-kyiv-region.html) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on Dymer in the Kyiv region rose to three after the body of a third victim was recovered from the rubble.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-dymer-russian-strike-apartment-building/33903592.html) reported that rescuers searched for victims after Russian drone strikes destroyed a residential building in the town of Dymer, leaving at least two dead.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064074/) reported that Tymur Tkachenko stated one person was killed and three were injured after a Russian strike damaged a store in Vyshneve.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187442-russian-forces-pound-dnipropetrovsk-region-with-over-40-attacks-one-killed-several-injured.html) reported that a woman was killed and several other people were injured in Russian attacks on the Dnipropetrovsk region.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064090/) reported that following a strike on a store in Vyshneve, Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported three dead and 13 injured while Mayor Illia Dikov noted 15 injured.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064075/) reported that Tymur Tkachenko confirmed a third body was recovered from a partially destroyed five-storey apartment building in Dymer following a Russian drone strike.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-ukraine-apartment-survivors-attack-war/33903536.html) reported that rescuers pulled a second body from the rubble of a Kyiv-region apartment building battered by Russian drones.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187424-woman-injured-in-russian-drone-attack-on-bila-tserkva-district-in-kyiv-region.html) reported that a woman was injured in an attack by Russian drones in the Bila Tserkva district of the Kyiv region.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/22/at-least-4-killed-in-russian-drone-attacks-on-kyiv-region-officials-say-a94345) reported that at least four people were killed in Russian drone attacks on Ukraine's Kyiv region.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187354-body-of-person-killed-in-russian-drone-attack-recovered-from-rubble-of-apartment-building-in-dymer.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064040/) reported that the body of a person killed in a Russian drone attack was recovered from the rubble of an apartment building in Dymer, Kyiv region.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064047/) reported that a 10-storey apartment building in the Peremoha residential area of Dnipro was damaged in a Russian drone attack.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064040/) reported that four people have been injured in the attack on Dymer.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187322-russians-attack-energy-infrastructure-in-zhytomyr-region-four-times-in-one-day.html) reported that Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure facilities in the Zhytomyr region four times over the past 24 hours.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064022/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated 14 people may be trapped under the rubble of a five-storey building in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast, hit by a Russian drone.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-across-ukraine-injure-30-over-past-day-as-rescue-operation-continues-near-kyiv-after-drone-strike/) reported that Ukraine's Air Force said Russian troops launched 186 attack drones overnight, of which 161 were shot down.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/apartment-building-destroyed-in-kyiv-oblast-following-russian-drone-attack/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187278-residential-building-damaged-in-russian-drone-attack-in-vyshhorod-district-residents-evacuated.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90829), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064011/) reported that a Russian drone attack destroyed part of a five-story residential building in the Vyshhorod district of Kyiv Oblast.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064009/) reported that Russian forces struck 22 settlements in Sumy Oblast, injuring nine people in drone attacks.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064014/) reported that Russian strikes injured five people in Sloviansk and six in Kherson Oblast.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063987/) reported that Russian drone, artillery, and air strikes injured 11 people in Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson oblasts.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187232-russian-forces-launch-nearly-30-attacks-on-dnipropetrovsk-region-injuring-five.html) reported that Russian forces launched nearly 30 attacks on six districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring five civilians.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063945/) reported that President Zelenskyy confirmed a Russian attack on a railway station in Krolevets, Sumy Oblast, that injured three people.

reports.text: [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/trump-descarta-que-jensen-huang-represente-una-amenaza-asegura-tener-informacion-suficiente-sobre-el/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/trump-dice-tener-informacion-que-descarta-que-ceo-de-nvidia-sea-una-amenaza-para-la-seguridad_0_dk9w7nipMi.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump dismissed concerns that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is a security threat following an espionage scandal.

[El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-23/que-sigue-para-el-futuro-politico-de-cuba-ataque-de-trump-antes-de-fin-de-ano-o-giro-democrata.html) reported that Washington has not succeeded in getting the Cuban government to cede in negotiations.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/que-es-una-bomba-sucia-el-arma-con-material-radioactivo-que-estados-unidos-teme-que-iran-pueda-utilizar-en-washington-3602056) reported on an alleged plan by Iran against Donald Trump's officials involving a dirty bomb containing radioactive material.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/bomba-sucia-washington-que-sabe-supuestos-planes-iran_202611186afdfd7d21e74551e81e9b10.html) reported that U.S. intelligence services warned of possible Iranian assassination plots against senior Trump administration officials.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/pescadores-ecuatorianos-que-sobrevivieron-a-un-ataque-atribuido-a-estados-unidos-contra-su-embarcacion-demandaron-al-gobierno-de-donald-trump-3601890) reported that Ecuadorian fishermen who survived an attack attributed to the United States against their vessel sued Donald Trump's government in a federal court in Pennsylvania to claim compensation for events in March.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/eu-detecta-planes-de-iran-para-atacar-con-una-bomba-sucia-a-funcionarios-segun-cnn-33167557) reported that a CNN investigation based on US intelligence sources and officials indicated that Iran planned to attack officials with a dirty bomb.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/iran-bajo-sospecha-de-preparar-atentados-contra-ee-uu-y-europa-amenazas-a-funcionarios-de-trump-hackeos-y-una-red-de-operaciones-clandestinas-3600883) reported that experts view recent incidents as an interest by Iran to punish Washington for the war.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/eu-alerta-de-presunto-plan-de-iran-para-atacar-con-bomba-sucia-a-funcionarios-de-trump-segun-cnn-portavoz-descarta-amenaza/) reported that US intelligence sources and seven officials outlined a supposed Iranian plan to attack Trump officials with a dirty bomb, though a spokesperson dismissed the threat.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/estados-unidos-descubrio-un-plan-de-iran-para-atacar-con-armas-quimicas-a-funcionarios-en-washington-nid17112026/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/estados-unidos-alerto-presunto-plan-iran-atacar-funcionarios-donald-trump-armas-quimicas_0_GSkrCFkOqt.html) reported that U.S. intelligence and CNN revealed plans by Iran to target Donald Trump administration officials in Washington with a radioactive bomb or chemical weapons.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/15/mundo/022n3mun?partner=rss) reported that Cuban President Miguel Díaz-Canel demanded that the United States stop collective punishment and lift the economic and energy blockade against the island.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/washington/donald-trump-presidente-de-estados-unidos-quiero-resolver-lo-de-cuba-antes-de-irme-nid16112026/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he wants to resolve the situation regarding Cuba before leaving office and did not rule out a brief military operation.

reports.text: [Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d8%af%d8%b9%d9%85-%d9%85%d8%aa%d9%88%d8%b3%d8%b7%d9%8a-%d9%84%d8%a5%d8%b9%d9%85%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d8%b3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d9%88%d8%b9%d9%88%d8%af%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%ac%d8%a6%d9%8a/) reported that the Union for the Mediterranean affirmed its support for the Syrian government's efforts toward reconstruction and creating conditions for the voluntary, safe, and sustainable return of refugees.

[Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%b9%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%81-%d8%a7%d8%aa%d9%81%d8%a7%d9%82-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b4%d8%b1%d8%a7%d9%83%d8%a9-%d9%85%d8%b9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%aa%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%88%d8%a8) reported that Algerian Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Ahmed Attaf stated that the association agreement with the European Union suffers from deep imbalances and that its review has become a necessity.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7188184) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated the new agreement with the European Union aims to expand opportunities for British youth.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203751/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B3%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A8%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B2-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B6%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1/) reported that Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi and Abdul Hamid Dbeibeh discussed enhancing cooperation and signed several memorandums of understanding, with Sisi emphasizing Egypt's keenness on Libya's security and stability.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203400/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%AB-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A/) reported that European Union defense ministers discussed U.S. troop withdrawal and repositioning plans in Europe with a U.S. Department of War official.

[Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%aa%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%88%d8%a8%d9%8a-%d8%a7%d8%b3%d8%aa%d9%82%d8%b1%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d8%b3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d9%85%d9%87%d9%85-%d9%84%d8%a3/) reported that European Union Mediterranean commissioner Dubravka Šuica emphasized the importance of Syria's stability for regional security.

[Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d9%83%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%b3-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%aa%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%88%d8%a8%d9%8a-%d9%8a%d9%88%d8%a7%d9%81%d9%82-%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%89-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%b6/) reported that EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas announced that foreign ministers of the 27 EU member states agreed to move forward with a partnership agreement with Syria.

[Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d9%82%d8%a7%d8%af%d9%8a%d8%b4-%d9%88%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%b5%d8%b7%d9%81%d9%89-%d9%8a%d8%a8%d8%ad%d8%ab%d8%a7%d9%86-%d9%85%d8%b9-%d9%85%d8%b3%d8%a4%d9%88%d9%84-%d8%a3%d9%85%d9%85%d9%8a-%d9%88%d8%a7/) reported that Syrian Deputy Foreign Minister Qutaiba Qadish discussed international cooperation and refugee returns with a UN official and the Spanish ambassador.

reports.text: [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/27/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-la-russie-a-frappe-des-infrastructures-civiles-et-energetiques-dans-neuf-oblasts-pendant-la-nuit-deplore-le-premier-ministre-ukrainien_6814183_3210.html) reported that Russian forces struck civilian and energy infrastructure in nine Ukrainian oblasts overnight, killing one person in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/navires-russes-attaques-dans-les-eaux-libyennes-deux-militaires-libyens-succombent-a-leurs-blessures-20261125) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claimed responsibility for attacks near Benghazi in which a corvette sank and a cargo ship was hit.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/24/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-navires-russes-pris-pour-cibles-en-libye-l-italie-exprime-son-inquietude-a-l-ukraine_6814183_3210.html) reported that Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani expressed concern to Ukraine over Russian ships targeted in Libya and emphasized the importance of avoiding the extension of the conflict to the Mediterranean.

[Al Wihda (Chad)](https://www.alwihdainfo.com/libye-lunion-africaine-met-en-garde-contre-les-ingerences-exterieures/) reported that the African Union Commission president demanded an independent investigation and called for restraint following recent attacks signaled in the port of Benghazi.

[La Presse (Tunisia)](https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/24/suite-aux-attaques-aux-drones-contre-le-port-de-benghazi-le-gouvernement-libyen-refuse-que-la-libye-soit-entrainee-dans-des-conflits-exterieurs/) reported that the Libyan government will file an official complaint with the United Nations and Security Council following the attacks against the port of Benghazi.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-19/melbourne-cups-caulfield-cup-theft-court/107405116), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/pair-charged-after-four-melbourne-cups-one-caulfield-cup-stolen-20261119-p61fr6.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that police charged two men after four Melbourne Cups and one Caulfield Cup were stolen.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/arrest-made-as-search-for-makybe-diva-s-melbourne-cups-continues-20261117-p61f0f.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that police made an arrest in connection with the theft of Makybe Diva's three Melbourne Cups from Flemington Racecourse.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/police-searching-for-three-stolen-melbourne-cup-trophies-worth-500k-each-13613066) reported that police are searching for three Melbourne Cup trophies collectively worth more than £1.5m after they were stolen from a display cabinet at a racecourse in Melbourne.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/business/consumer-affairs/good-luck-to-police-on-this-one-what-thieves-could-do-with-three-stolen-melbourne-cups-20261117-p61esf.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that experts stated criminals looking to cash in on the theft of three stolen Melbourne Cups could make the gold from the trophies totally untraceable in a short time.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/victoria/man-arrested-cars-seized-but-no-makybe-diva-melbourne-cup-trophies-found-in-3m-heist-investigation-20261117-p61ep9.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that police are interviewing a man and searching vehicles in connection with the theft, though the three trophies won by Makybe Diva have not been recovered.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-16/makybe-diva-melbourne-cup-trophies-stolen/107391010), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/victoria/thieves-steal-three-melbourne-cups-won-by-makybe-diva-owner-says-20261116-p61el2.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that three Melbourne Cups won by Makybe Diva, valued at $3 million, were stolen from Flemington in a daylight robbery.

reports.text: [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/24/aje-onl-nf_russian-jets-spark-air-raid-alert-in-south-korea-241126?traffic_source=rss) reported that South Korean residents were urged to seek shelter as Russian military jets approached airspace.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-war-latest-evacuation-air-raid-russian-military-aircraft-approach-south-korean-island-trigger-alert/) reported that Russian military aircraft approached a South Korean island and triggered an air raid alert.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/south-korea-tells-island-residents-to-take-shelter-as-russian-warplanes-near-its-airspace) reported that South Korea issued a rare shelter warning for an inhabited island as Russian warplanes neared its airspace.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/24/south-korea-says-russian-military-planes-entered-its-air-defense-zone-a94358) reported that Russian aircraft left the defense zone after South Korean forces took military measures, including deploying fighter jets.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/south-korea-says-russian-jets-entered-air-defence-zone/WV7XJTSF6VGBVLY3JQOVCRGCNM/) reported that the Russian aircraft entered South Korea's defence zone but did not breach its airspace.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223801), a Russian state outlet, reported that South Korea lodged a protest with the Russian military attache over aircraft overflights.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/why-s-korea-issued-air-raid-alert-after-russian-jets-flew-near-its-airspace?traffic_source=rss) reported that South Korean authorities issued air raid warnings after several Russian jets approached its airspace.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/evacuation-air-raid-russian-aircraft-approach-south-korean-island-trigger-air-raid-alert-2/) reported that the alert was the first time South Korea's military issued a preliminary air raid alert over a possible airspace intrusion by Russian warplanes.

[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124002252315) reported that several Russian warplanes briefly flew into South Korea's air defense identification zone, prompting a brief alert on an eastern island.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10946997), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124002251315) reported that several Russian military aircraft entered South Korea's air defense identification zone over the East Sea and approached Ulleungdo Island.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/24/south-korea-tells-island-residents-to-take-shelter-after-russian-military-aircraft-approach) reported that South Korea told island residents to take shelter after Russian military aircraft approached.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223663) reported that South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff acknowledged that the Russian planes did not violate South Korean airspace.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxPVnMyeTNTLWNPT1JoWVRGdTZmb2hnVi1USk9WNldKUVNfVWkzRk5RSjI5UlVIYkprbnEtOFplWGdpd2JoWmtZeEVZQTF6TGJJU0tEZXhsYVVNaHl1OVlfOF9sc3lHUUdzNXBpeHNqUTF0ZXY2VTcxbHEwbHluRF9sR3N0WnR1T3R1cmRKa1FDSnpOeGJwVVIyN0NhYmF4QmlyZHZjT2JNXzB4ZlY1cTJRNVZtTTluY3lYbmd0TEtlXzA3WUZwTVk3Uw?oc=5) reported that South Korea briefly scrambled fighter jets and issued a warning after Russian aircraft flew off its coast.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/south-korea-says-russian-aircraft-entered-air-defence-zone-fighter-jets-scrambled-101795481448953.html) reported that South Korea stated Russian aircraft flew into the air defense identification zone over waters between the Korean Peninsula and Japan before withdrawing.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124001300315) reported that multiple Russian warplanes entered South Korea's air defense zone without notice according to the South Korean military.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/35dea481821c) reported that the air defense zone extends beyond sovereign airspace and is not defined under international law as territorial airspace.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxPSS12cWZyNHNoNWpmOTNnVWhuWWQwSmY1SDU5SjR5YXdxOWJtakJSVGl1RlZlZ09tbDdEUWVXTVc4dHhmN3RnVzFVRDVQSnR5UnBoTjNMOXJqLWxPUWJpSGdTZDQ2VldRVGd2LWN5bEZuYmoxQVdPcnNxemZGQXNya2p3RkpBVlFhWDlvYzJSWmtuZXFXSWxLYkRxSGpRSTJINjlCRFNpR3BDU1lpTVpJ?oc=5) reported that South Korea stated a suspected North Korean aircraft breached an island's airspace.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88771253) reported that a Defence Ministry representative in Moldova stated protecting people's lives is a priority when drones fly over airspace and decisions to shoot them down follow extensive analysis.
[Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/taiwan-f-16-intercepts-russian-tu-95-strategic-bomber/) reported that a Taiwanese F-16 intercepted and photographed a Russian Tu-95 strategic bomber.

[Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/japan-scrambles-jets-to-intercept-russian-tu-95-bombers/) reported that Japan scrambled jets after two Russian Tu-95 bombers flew between Taiwan and Japan's westernmost island before entering the Sea of Japan.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87975090) reported that Moldovan Prime Minister Vasile Tofan warned that frequent Russian drone incursions into Moldova's airspace could lead to tragedy and urged the accelerated adoption of defense industry legislation.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3374750/taiwan-tracks-2-russian-warplanes-eastern-coast-ahead-apec-summit) reported that Taiwan's military monitored two Russian warplanes flying near the island.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxOU3NFVmZBSmlQWklpSEpQenktMkVsQ3BRbndZVno0MzZmRHdpdkpOMHlyTTI1X0g5Z2wteEdkQ0d3MG11ZjFwckFzQ0VVbGx4cnFuWXBTZzhDNWM3T2ctdEc4UThLT2FpMVhBcWtBejZ4Q1ExOF9BNXctLUNCLTZjODJkWTBRRVFtSm05V0NGTTlad0doejF1MGxVLUM?oc=5) reported that Tokyo lodged a protest after two suspected Russian aircraft violated Japanese airspace in southwestern Japan.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-17-taiwan-japan-flag-incursions-by-russian-aircraft-as-putin-set-to-arrive-in-china/) reported that Taiwan stated it detected two Russian military aircraft flying off its east coast.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/japan-scrambles-jets-to-counter-suspected-russian-aircraft/a-79964537?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/completely-unacceptable-japan-lodges-very-stern-protest-after-russian-aircraft-enter-its-airspace/articleshow/135907668.cms) reported that Japan lodged a very stern protest with Moscow after two suspected Russian aircraft violated Japanese airspace.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219281) reported that Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara stated Tokyo lodged a diplomatic protest with Moscow after two Russian aircraft violated Japan's airspace.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/tokyo-lodges-protest-after-aircraft-believed-to-be-russian-violate-japan-airspace/article71710315.ece) reported that according to the Defence Ministry, the last confirmed violation of Japan's airspace by Russian aircraft was off Rebun Island, Hokkaido, in September 2024.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10939841) reported that several Russian military aircraft entered South Korea's air defense identification zone over the East Sea without prior notice, prompting Seoul to deploy fighter jets.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/japan-scrambles-jets-after-suspected-russian-planes-enter-airspace-tokyo-says), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/tokyo-protests-after-two-suspected-russian-aircraft-violate-japanese-airspace-101794900379072.html) reported that Japan scrambled fighter jets and lodged an extremely stern protest after suspected Russian military aircraft violated Japanese airspace.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90302) reported that Japan scrambled fighter jets after suspected Russian aircraft violated its airspace, prompting a diplomatic protest, while South Korea also deployed jets.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/seoul-deploys-fighter-jets-russian-aircraft-enters-air-defence-zone-6557236) reported that Seoul deployed fighter jets after an unspecified number of Russian aircraft entered and later exited the Korea Air Defence Identification Zone over the Eastern Sea.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/iran-allegedly-plotting-to-target-trump-officials-in-washington-with-dirty-bomb/QMOGIIJGTJGGVCEOCJGKH4PW2E/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/iran-developing-plans-for-possible-dirty-bomb-attack-in-washington-says-us-intelligence/) reported that United States intelligence agencies uncovered information that Iran is developing plans to potentially attack senior Trump administration officials in Washington with a dirty bomb.

reports.text: [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188662-zelensky-no-word-yet-from-us-on-accelerating-air-defense-missile-deliveries.html), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/no-good-news-from-us-on-accelerating-air-defense-missile-deliveries-zelensky-says/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated there is no word or good news yet from the United States regarding the acceleration of air defense missile deliveries.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91220) reported that the Pentagon stated it is working with European partners and Ukraine to expand Patriot production while neither confirming nor denying reports of delayed interceptor deliveries.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91079113) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has yet to approve the transfer of around 60 interceptor missiles for Patriot air defense systems to Ukraine.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91107) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated an agreement to deliver 48 Patriot interceptors remains unsigned on US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's desk.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224311) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the Pentagon is holding up the delivery of 48 Patriot missiles.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188232-zelensky-says-comprehensive-solution-to-counter-russian-glide-bombs-will-be-found.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated a comprehensive solution to counter guided aerial bombs will be found.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064335/) reported that deliveries of PAC-2 and PAC-3 interceptor missiles allocated to Ukraine are awaiting Pentagon approval, according to the Financial Times.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187966-hegseth-yet-to-approve-transfer-of-patriot-missiles-already-allocated-to-ukraine-ft.html) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has yet to authorize the transfer of around 60 Patriot interceptor missiles.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223699), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that the Pentagon delayed PAC-2 and PAC-3 Patriot missile deliveries to Ukraine.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/hegseth-pentagon-patriot-missiles-ukraine-b3090496.html) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth delayed shipments of Patriot missiles to Ukraine, holding up interceptors paid for by European allies.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91035) reported that the Pentagon is delaying the transfer of around 60 Patriot interceptor missiles already purchased by Ukraine's Western allies.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064201/) reported that Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara stated Russia launched over 4,000 jet-powered drones and 153 ballistic missiles in October.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-war-latest-us-delays-on-patriot-missiles-difficult-to-understand-as-russia-fires-165-missiles-in-single-week-zelensky-says/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated Russia fired 165 missiles in a single week and criticized US delays on Patriot missiles.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/14-missing-after-russian-strike-zelenskyy-presses-us-patriot-missiles/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that following an attack near Kyiv, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged Washington to authorize air defense missiles financed by allies.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/zelenskyy-urges-us-to-release-patriot-missiles?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Russian drone attack killed at least two people near Kyiv while Russian shelling killed one person in Zaporizhzhia.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-says-us-delays-on-patriot-missiles-are-difficult-to-understand-as-russia-fires-165-missiles-in-a-week/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky urged Washington to authorize the transfer of Patriot missiles.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90844) reported that Russian forces launched approximately 2,700 strike drones, nearly 1,460 guided aerial bombs, and 165 missiles.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064012/) reported that Ukraine's air defence shot down or jammed 161 out of 186 Russian drones overnight, with hits recorded at 18 locations.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063914/) reported that Russia launched three ballistic missiles and 148 drones against Ukraine overnight, with strikes recorded at 19 locations.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90720) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky urged the Pentagon to release expected PAC-2 and PAC-3 Patriot missile deliveries.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFBVVzZGZEdDYjRKSW93bXh0dGlWbFM2Yld3dDJxSXZ2M21lY1kySXVYZGxaTVVQSEFrNXdaZG43bm5iV2ZLM1JBcFBEUDhDWHg5bHM2UktJbjVzYzNHVFFMWEd1eFZ3TlU1Q0xkSUJDSl8?oc=5) reported that Russia fired hundreds of missiles and drones at Ukraine and allegedly into Poland.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90693) reported that the Ukrainian Air Force stated Russia attacked Kyiv and nine Ukrainian regions with 84 cruise missiles, 404 drones, and additional ballistic and Zircon missiles overnight into Friday.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/russia-fired-more-than-110-missiles-in-one-of-wars-largest-attacks-zelensky-says-3725804), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/compensating-with-terror-russia-hits-ukraine-with-400-drones-110-missiles-in-one-of-wars-largest-attacks/articleshow/136025133.cms) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russia fired more than 110 missiles and over 400 drones in one of the largest attacks of the war, killing at least eight people.

[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/19/ukraine-plans-to-double-drone-supplies-triple-deep-strikes/) reported that Ukraine is moving forward with its long-range strike campaign with European partner support despite Washington's request to prioritize front-line defense.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063389/) reported that at the 37th Ramstein meeting in Brussels, Ukraine's partners outlined new air defence funding, drone procurement, and ammunition deliveries, with Belgium pledging ten F-16s and two Mirage jets by year-end.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-us-hits-out-at-ukraine-s-deep-strikes-against-russia-in-rift-with-eu-over-war-tactics) reported that top US defense official Elbridge Colby criticized Ukraine's deep strikes against Russia.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90419) reported that Ukraine announced plans to more than triple its deep-strike capabilities in 2027 and that Britain and Germany defended Kyiv's actions.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219895) reported that Moscow stated that arming the Kiev regime only prolongs the conflict in Ukraine.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185731-ramstein-zelensky-proposes-swapping-partners-patriot-and-irist-missile-stockpiles-for-future-deliveries.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90407) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky proposed swapping partner countries' Patriot and IRIS-T missile stockpiles for future deliveries and requested 40 more F-16 jets at Ramstein.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/ukraine-aims-1300-drones-at-russia-in-one-of-wars-largest-attacks) reported that Russia's Defense Ministry stated it intercepted 1,336 Ukrainian drones in one of the war's largest aerial attacks.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219401), a Russian state outlet, reported that the Moscow Mayor stated approximately 800 UAVs headed toward the Moscow region during an overnight attack.

reports.text: [The Cipher Brief](https://www.thecipherbrief.com/the-navys-problems-come-into-focus-at-hung-caos-confirmation-hearing) reported that a confirmation hearing for Hung Cao focused on a historic drop in the retention of advanced fighter aircraft pilots.

[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/video/2026/11/23/acting-navy-secretary-hung-cao-heads-to-the-hill-and-the-pentagon-fails-an-audit-headlines/) reported that acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao faced questions from senators during a confirmation hearing while the Pentagon failed an audit.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/21/trump-class-warships), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/trumpclass-battleships-add-to-us-navys-cost-burden-as-iran-war-stretches-fleet-report-101795324400149.html) reported that a report warned that the US pursuit of Trump-class warships has increased the fleet's cost by billions while the Iran war stretches naval capacity.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/americas/us-iran-war-costs-reach-483b-excluding-damaged-base-repairs) reported that a Pentagon official told lawmakers that the U.S. military campaign against Iran has cost approximately $48.3 billion since February, excluding damaged base repairs.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/trumps-48-3-billion-iran-war-bill-excludes-damaged-us-bases-democrats-press-for-tally/articleshow/136013206.cms) reported that the financial cost of the US war against Iran reached an estimated $48.3 billion, excluding damaged US bases, and that lawmakers are urging the Pentagon to provide damage assessments.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649008-pentagon-expired-munitions-iran/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/newsletters/daily-news-roundup/2026/11/18/us-navy-used-expired-munitions-during-iran-war-cao-says/) reported that acting US Navy Secretary Hung Cao told lawmakers during a Senate confirmation hearing that US forces used expired munitions during the war against Iran and that the service is recoding and firing them off.

[Defense One](https://www.defenseone.com/defense-systems/2026/11/senate-grills-acting-navy-secretary-iran-war-costs-extended-deployments/417307/) reported that Senate Democrats bristled at acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao's description of unsuccessful suicide attempts as mitigations during a confirmation hearing covering Iran war costs and extended deployments.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/video/2026/nov/17/hung-cao-acting-us-navy-secretary-refers-to-eight-suicide-attempts-as-suicide-mitigations-video) reported that acting US navy secretary Hung Cao referred to eight suicide attempts as suicide mitigations during his confirmation hearing.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/us-navy-chief-says-iran-war-has-put-strain-on-maritime-forces?traffic_source=rss), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hearing-us-navy-chief-blasted-over-iran-war-and-its-toll-sailors) reported that acting US Navy head Hung Cao faced sharp questioning from Democratic lawmakers at a confirmation hearing regarding the war with Iran and maritime forces.

reports.text: [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/25/russian-billionaire-and-senator-suleiman-kerimov-moved-1-16-billion-from-russia-to-switzerland-through-deutsche-bank-in-2020-investigation-finds) reported that an investigation found Russian senator Suleiman Kerimov moved more than a billion euros from Russia to Switzerland through Deutsche Bank in 2020.

[The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/437231/deutsche-bank-leaks-how-ecobank-got-caught-in-the-crossfire/) reported that fifteen million internal files revealed lax checks on African clients at Deutsche Bank.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/periodismo-de-investigacion/documentos-filtrados-revelan-como-deutsche-bank-dio-la-espalda-a-sus-promesas-climaticas/) reported that leaked documents revealed Deutsche Bank turned its back on climate promises regarding emissions reduction.

[Der Spiegel International](https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/epstein-and-deutsche-bank-the-filings-identfied-payments-made-to-women-a-e8f529f6-c583-4c99-a432-d0684c6697d7#ref=rss) reported that documents from Deutsche Bank show the financial institution processed many more payments for Jeffrey Epstein than previously known.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88667080) reported that Deutsche Bank is at the center of a scandal following an investigation based on millions of internal documents leaked to the press involving Russian oligarchs, Epstein, and Trump.

[Der Spiegel International](https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/the-bank-and-the-oligarchs-how-deutsche-bank-continued-expanding-in-russia-despite-the-warning-signs-a-668c08a5-0383-4d66-86b5-671b3c348774#ref=rss) reported that Deutsche Bank decided to continue expanding operations in Russia despite Putin's aggression following the Donbas, Crimea, and European attacks.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/financas/2026/11/deutsche-bank-autorizou-transacoes-potencialmente-ilicitas-na-colombia-mostram-documentos.shtml) reported that documents show Deutsche Bank authorized thousands of potentially illicit transactions in Colombia.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/deutsche-bank-chair-backs-ceo-after-reports-expose-past-lapses-trump-calls-tax-leak-illegal/article71715150.ece) reported that the Deutsche Bank chair backed the CEO after leaked records exposed past financial lapses, and the German Finance Minister called for an investigation.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/los-papeles-del-deutsche-bank-exponen-operaciones-que-vinculan-a-trump-con-rusia-y-us5819-millones-nid18112026/) reported that the leaked Deutsche Bank papers exposed operations linking Donald Trump to Russia and millions related to Jeffrey Epstein.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/el-banco-aleman-deutsche-bank-es-senalado-de-procesar-transacciones-sospechosas-por-casi-600-millones-de-dolares-vinculadas-a-epstein-y-donald-trump-3601659) reported that Deutsche Bank faces accusations of allowing corruption and ignoring internal controls after being signaled for processing nearly $600 million in suspicious transactions linked to Jeffrey Epstein.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/deutsche-bank-acusada-de-permitir-corrupcion-vinculada-a-epstein-trump-y-oligarcas-rusos-33175792) reported that an international investigation led by CLIP and Barracuda Media documented Deutsche Bank links with high-risk clients and suspicious transactions based on a leak of 15 million files.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/financas/2026/11/deutsche-bank-falhou-em-controle-e-prevencao-a-lavagem-de-dinheiro-mostram-documentos-vazados.shtml), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-falhou-na-prevencao-a-lavagem-de-dinheiro-apesar-de-alertas-internos-revela-investigacao.ghtml) reported that an investigation based on more than 15 million leaked documents revealed that Deutsche Bank maintained serious flaws in its anti-money laundering controls and compliance.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20261117-deutsche-bank-shares-drop-after-reports-on-mass-data-leak) reported that Deutsche Bank shares plunged after international media published reports based on millions of leaked emails and documents.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-shares-fall-as-leak-reveals-trump-tax-document-error) reported that Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% after reports based on 15 million leaked records shed light on dealings with clients including Donald Trump and revealed a tax document error.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/deutsche-bank-dimissed-warnings-risky-clients-reports-claim) reported that an international investigation using leaked internal data claimed the German bank overlooked compliance concerns regarding risky clients to safeguard profits.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-deutsche-bank-shares-drop-after-reports-exposing-epstein-payments-russia-dealings) reported that Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% following media reports detailing dealings with Jeffrey Epstein and Russian oligarchs.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532266/Deutsche-Bank-processed-582-million-for-Epstein-despite-explicit), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648963-whistleblowers-expose-deutsche-bank-dealings-epstein/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that leaked internal documents indicate Deutsche Bank processed nearly $600 million in suspicious payments linked to Jeffrey Epstein.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-deutsche-bank-leaks-german-lender-s-dealings-with-russian-oligarchs-under-scrutiny) reported that Germany's finance minister urged full transparency from Deutsche Bank following the leaked records.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/europe/deutsche-bank-russia-oligarchs-leaked-documents.html) reported that leaked records showed Deutsche Bank courting wealthy Russian clients while bracing for sanctions.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-moved-wealthy-russian-clients-to-switzerland-and-luxembourg-before-the-full-scale-war-helping-shield-their-financial-records-from-the-doj) reported that Deutsche Bank moved wealthy Russian clients to Switzerland and Luxembourg after 2014 to protect banking secrecy and avoid disclosing information to the Department of Justice.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/deutsche-bank-under-fire-after-internal-documents-made-public/a-79974543?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/les-decodeurs/article/2026/11/17/inside-deutsche-bank-les-documents-secrets-qui-lient-donald-trump-a-l-argent-sale-azerbaidjanais_6812989_4355770.html) reported that an international journalistic investigation published internal records detailing Deutsche Bank's dealings with Jeffrey Epstein, Donald Trump, and Azerbaijani and Russian figures.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044722/inside-deutsche-bank-leak-of-15-million-files-exposes-secrets-scandals-and-double-standards-of-global-financial-giant), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/les-decodeurs/article/2026/11/17/inside-deutsche-bank-les-secrets-inavouables-du-geant-bancaire-reveles-par-15-millions-de-documents-confidentiels_6812911_4355770.html) reported that an international journalistic investigation leaked over 15 million internal files from Deutsche Bank detailing scandals, suspicious transactions, sanctioned Russian oligarchs, and Jeffrey Epstein links.

reports.text: [Punch](https://punchng.com/police-speak-on-jimmy-odukoyas-arrest-warrant/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Lagos police stated they have not yet confirmed receipt of the bench warrant for Pastor Jimmy Odukoya's arrest.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/international-arrest-warrant-former-steward-ceo-ralph-de-la-torre.1137798) reported that a court ruled there was no reasonable basis to conclude that Ralph de la Torre's right to a fair hearing was likely to be breached, and an international arrest warrant was issued for the former Steward CEO.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1587815/court-cancels-arrest-warrants-for-ali-amin-gandapur/) reported that an Islamabad court cancelled non-bailable arrest warrants issued against former Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister Ali Amin Gandapur.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/jimmy-odukoya-bench-warrant-fountain-of-life-church/) reported that a Lagos judge issued a bench warrant for Pastor Jimmy Odukoya in a dispute over leadership of The Fountain of Life Church.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-crisis-court-orders-jimmy-odukoyas-arrest-despite-appeal/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a Lagos High Court issued a bench warrant against Fountain of Life Church pastor Jimmy Odukoya for failing to appear in contempt proceedings.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1743515-fountain-life-church-faults-bench-warrant-jimmy-odukoya-cites-due-process-breach/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-church-faults-bench-warrant-against-jimmy-odukoya/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-church-challenges-bench-warrant-against-pastor-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that the Fountain of Life Church challenged a bench warrant issued against its Senior Pastor, Jimmy Odukoya, citing a breach of due process.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-church-faults-arrest-warrant-against-jimmy-odukoya/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Fountain of Life Church faulted the issuance of a bench warrant against its Senior Pastor, Jimmy Odukoya, claiming he was not served with the restraining order.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/breaking-court-issues-bench-warrant-against-odukoya-for-disobeying-order-transfers-case/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/jimmy-odukoyas-arrest-ordered-by-court-amid-fountain-of-life-crisis/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/leadership-crisis-jimmy-odukoya-faces-arrest-as-court-issues-bench-warrant/) reported that a Lagos State High Court issued a bench warrant against Pastor Jimmy Odukoya for failing to attend a hearing.
[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/just-in-lagos-court-orders-jimmy-odukoyas-arrest/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya stated he had not seen or been legally served with the warrant.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611240340.html) reported that pastor Jimmy Odukoya faces jail risks over alleged disobedience of a court order and was directed by the court to appear on November 26.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/court-orders-jimmy-odukoya-to-appear-thursday-over-church-dispute/) reported that the Lagos State High Court directed Senior Pastor Jimmy Odukoya to appear before it on Thursday, November 26, over a church dispute.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-trustees-file-contempt-proceedings-against-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that the Incorporated Trustees of The Fountain of Life Church instituted contempt proceedings against Pastor Jimmy Odukoya over alleged disobedience of a Lagos court order.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742936-breaking-court-summons-jimmy-odukoya-fountain-life-church-saga-reason/) reported that the Lagos State High Court issued a fresh major order to Pastor Jimmy Odukoya amid the deepened church crisis.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-okonkwo-preaches-unity-jimmy-insists-court-order-not-served/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Bishop Mike Okonkwo urged members not to take sides while Jimmy Odukoya stated he has not been served the interim court order.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/leadership-crisis-odukoya-says-fountain-of-life-church-remains-strong-unshakable/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Jimmy Odukoya stated the Fountain of Life Church remains strong and unshakable as the leadership crisis moves to the Lagos High Court.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/leadership-crisis-fountain-of-life-members-express-hope-for-resolution/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Fountain of Life Church members voiced hope for a resolution of the leadership crisis as Pastor Jimmy Odukoya received a rousing welcome at Sunday service.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ive-not-been-served-jimmy-odukoya-speaks-on-court-injunction-amid-church-crisis/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-i-have-not-been-served-court-injunction-legally-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya stated he has not been formally served with a court injunction restraining him from acting as senior pastor.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/dont-take-sides-bishop-okonkwo-warns-fountain-of-life-members/) reported that Bishop Mike Okonkwo made a surprise appearance at The Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/cheers-jubilation-as-jimmy-odukoya-arrives-church-amid-leadership-crisis/) reported that members of the church in Ilupeju, Lagos, gave Pastor Jimmy Odukoya a rousing welcome as he arrived for the Sunday service.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/dont-take-sides-bishop-okonkwo-tells-fountain-of-life-church-members/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Bishop Mike Okonkwo urged church members not to take sides in the leadership crisis.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-heavy-police-presence-at-fountain-of-life-church-amid-leadership-crisis/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported a heavy police presence at the Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos, amid the leadership dispute.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-deepens-as-jimmy-sues-sister-others/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Fountain of Life senior pastor Jimmy Odukoya took his sister Tolu and seven trustees to a Federal High Court in Lagos.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/jimmy-odukoya-sues-sister-fountain-of-life-trustees-over-church-dispute/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-church-odukoya-drags-sister-others-to-court-over-removal-as-senior-pastor/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya instituted a court action against his sister and Fountain of Life Church trustees over his removal as senior pastor.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742636-breaking-jimmy-odukoya-drags-sister-pastors-court-1-demand/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya dragged his sister and pastors to court making one demand.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/jimmy-odukoya-sues-sister-pastors-asks-court-to-declare-removal-illegal/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya approached the Federal High Court in Lagos to challenge his removal from office and ask the court to declare his removal illegal.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/fountain-of-life-church-denies-being-sealed-announces-sunday-service/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-denies-closure-amid-leadership-crisis/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-debunks-closure-rumours-asks-worshippers-to-attend-sunday-service/) reported that The Fountain of Life Church dismissed reports that its premises had been sealed and invited members to attend Sunday service.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-church-dismisses-closure-claims-announces-sunday-service/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that The Fountain of Life Church stated it is not sealed and invited worshippers to a Sunday service.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-church-sealed-by-police-as-leadership-crisis-deepens/) reported that police officers sealed The Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos, as the leadership crisis deepened.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/fountain-of-life-succession-crisis-court-restrains-jimmy-odukoya-as-leadership-dispute-deepens/) reported that the Lagos State High Court restrained Jimmy Odukoya from parading himself as the Senior Pastor and Spiritual Head of the Fountain of Life Church.

reports.text: [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189118-russia-loses-2262-more-soldiers-in-war-against-ukraine.html) reported that between 24 February 2022 and 27 November 2026, Russian forces lost approximately 1,648,161 personnel, with 2,262 lost in the last 24 hours.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/25/kremlin-dismisses-leaked-data-on-russian-troop-losses-a812368) reported that the Kremlin dismissed leaked data on Russian troop losses and has not released an official military death toll since September 2022.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/25/kremlin-dismisses-meduza-s-estimate-of-720-000-russian-war-dead-tells-public-to-trust-defense-ministry-numbers), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91188) reported that Kremlin press secretary Dmitry Peskov called for disregarding estimates that more than 700,000 Russian troops have died in the war with Ukraine.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/25/more-than-700-000-russian-soldiers-have-died-in-ukraine-more-than-the-u-s-lost-in-world-war-ii-or-the-number-of-boys-born-in-russia-in-a-single-year) reported that journalists at Meduza and Mediazona estimate that at least 700,000 Russian troops have died over nearly five years of the war.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/one-every-four-minutes-720000-russian-soldiers-killed-since-start-of-ukraine-war-new-data-suggests/), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/25/estimates-of-russians-killed-in-ukraine-surpass-all-combined-us-war-deaths-since-wwi/), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261125-russian-casualties-in-ukraine-war-new-reports-suggest-death-toll-as-high-as-700-000) reported that new analysis of leaked data suggests approximately 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261125-kremlin-declines-comment-reports-700-000-russian-soldiers-killed-ukraine-war) reported that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov declined to comment on the casualty reports.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/at-least-490000-russian-soldiers-killed-in-ukraine-rosstat-data-leak-reveals) reported that two hacking groups extracted death certificate data from the Russian statistics agency's systems on 1 November.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/24/russian-fighters-killed-in-mali-africa-leaked-data), a British state-media outlet, reported that leaked records list 349 deaths in three years in Mali.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/24/a-leak-from-russia-s-federal-statistics-agency-made-it-possible-to-estimate-the-country-s-military-death-toll-in-the-war-against-ukraine-what-else-did-it-reveal) reported that journalists from Meduza and Mediazona reached a figure of at least 700,000 Russian service members who have died in the war.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/24/world/hacked-ukraine-russian-death-toll/), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3375557/hacked-russian-data-suggests-nearly-500000-soldiers-dead-reports-say) reported that data allegedly stolen by hackers from Russia's statistics agency Rosstat shows the recorded Russian military death toll approaching 500,000.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russia-ukraine-war-soldiers-killed-on-battlefield-military-suicide-rates-putin-zelenskyy-latest-news-101795515459237.html) reported that a report indicated Russia lost more than 460,000 people from February 2022 to September 2026, with over 1,000 soldiers dying by suicide.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915962) reported that leaked data showed more than 1,000 Russian soldiers died by suicide since the Ukraine invasion, with experts believing the actual number is higher.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90999) reported that a study of hacked Rosstat records found at least 490,000 Russian military deaths in Ukraine by September 2026.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-ukraine-war-casualty-estimate-killed/33904373.html) reported that a new analysis found that more than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed during the war on Ukraine.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/europe/russia-ukraine-war-deaths.html) reported that hacked government data underscored the casualties in the war of attrition.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/leaked-data-shows-more-than-1000-russian-military-suicides-during-ukraine-war) reported that leaked data showed more than 1,000 Russian military suicides during the Ukraine war.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-war-death-toll-likely-near-700-000-media-reports-after-studying-leaked-government-data/) reported that the Mediazona investigative team reached a figure of nearly 700,000 Russian war deaths after studying leaked government data.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/23/at-least-720-000-russian-soldiers-killed-in-ukraine-by-fall-2026-meduza-and-mediazona-estimate-in-new-analysis-that-includes-missing-troops-for-the-first-time) reported that Meduza and Mediazona estimated at least 720,000 Russian armed forces personnel died in the war in Ukraine by fall 2026.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/18/russia-s-state-duma-approves-law-restricting-library-access-to-books-by-foreign-agents) reported that Russia's State Duma passed a law restricting access to books by foreign agents in libraries in its second and third readings.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/eu-foreign-policy-chief-kaja-kallas-says-russian-soldiers-data-would-be-quite-easy-to-obtain-for-an-entry-ban-russia-s-state-duma-speaker-threatens-her-with-20-years-in-prison), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648945-kallas-wants-steal-russia-data/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas proposed using intelligence services to obtain personal data of Russian soldiers for an entry ban, prompting a 20-year prison threat from Russia's State Duma speaker.

reports.text: [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/five-arrested-two-drug-trafficking-operations.1137777) reported that suspected drugs were seized during two drug trafficking operations resulting in five arrests.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/nigeria-seizes-220-million-worth-of-meth-arrests-5-mexican-suspects/) reported that Nigerian authorities seized more than $220 million worth of methamphetamine and arrested five Mexican suspects in the country's southeast.
[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611260124.html) reported that NDLEA Chairman Buba Marwa stated a 63-year-old drug baron was arrested alongside five Mexicans.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOeGtNazRHQnVBRmFRbWIyM0VLWlRyQ1JxZUt6WVhLU2ZZTGlmRk1mcEYxb3pSR29yQllQTHI0ejk4d2JQQ1VXNVFlZzRMQ094RTJTMzJ3amZ0YVdnYnVlRUZZYkZBTHFicnl5S2gtNVFoV2l4Y195ZmhHVGlRYjduakJJZnNPZVhnclU4ZDFkRnR0TS1GZDZkeGswLUNycUdOTmhrU3p1WXI?oc=5) reported that Nigeria seized $220 million worth of methamphetamine and arrested five Mexican suspects in a major drug bust.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/nigeria-detains-5-mexicans-confiscates-over-220-million-of-meth/a-80054606?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Nigeria detained five Mexicans and confiscated over $220 million of methamphetamine after experts were allegedly recruited by a Nigerian national to run a lab in Enugu.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndlea-busts-n303-9bn-meth-laboratory-in-enugu-arrests-alleged-drug-baron-5-mexicans/) reported that the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency dismantled an industrial-scale methamphetamine laboratory in Enugu State and arrested a suspected drug baron and five Mexicans.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/two-nigerians-arrested-in-saudi-arabia-over-drug-trafficking/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Saudi authorities arrested two Nigerians in the Riyadh region for alleged hashish and amphetamine trafficking.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6x20lw8955no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/nigeria-seizes-more-than-200-million-of-meth-arrests-five-mexicans-3014021), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928031-ndlea-busts-%e2%82%a6303-9bn-meth-lab-in-enugu-arrests-five-mexican-meth-specialists.html) reported that the NDLEA seized methamphetamine valued at $227 million and arrested five Mexican nationals in Enugu.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/ndlea-dismantles-n303-9bn-meth-lab-in-enugu-arrests-drug-baron-five-mexicans/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1743294-ndlea-busts-2268m-meth-lab-enugu-arrests-63-year-drug-baron-mexicans/) reported that the operation followed a seven-month intelligence effort that dismantled an industrial methamphetamine laboratory and led to the arrest of a 63-year-old drug baron.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/nigeria-seizes-meth-worth-usd-227-million-arrests-5-mexicans-101795624898627.html) reported that agency chief Mohamed Buba Marwa stated a Nigerian recruited the five Mexicans to manufacture the drugs.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndlea-arrests-safrican-golfer-kenyan-chef-at-lagos-airport-over-50kg-cannabis-shipment/) reported that the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency arrested a South African golfer and a Kenyan chef at the Lagos airport over a 50kg cannabis shipment.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ndlea-arrests-south-african-professional-golfer-kenyan-over-illicit-drug-shipment/) reported that during a preliminary interview, a South African professional golfer arrested by the NDLEA said he was recruited by another individual.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742712-ndlea-arrests-south-african-golfer-kenyan-chef-504kg-cannabis-smuggling-lagos/) reported that NDLEA operatives arrested a South African professional golfer and a Kenyan chef over an alleged attempt to smuggle 50.40kg of Loud into Nigeria.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/ndlea-arrests-south-african-golfer-kenyan-chef-over-50kg-cannabis/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the NDLEA arrested South African golfer Grobler Henlo and Kenyan chef Abubakar Njambi over the alleged smuggling of 50.40kg of Loud cannabis into Lagos airport.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/ndlea-arrests-south-african-golfer-kenyan-chef-over-50kg-drug-shipment-intercepts-160-explosives-bound-for-zamfara/) reported that the NDLEA also intercepted 160 explosives bound for Zamfara.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndlea-busts-cocaine-syndicate-arrests-8-swallowers-in-lagos-kano/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/ndlea-busts-transnational-cocaine-cartel-arrests-eight-suspects-in-lagos-kano/) reported that the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency seized 634 cocaine pellets weighing 13.8 kilograms and arrested eight suspects bound for Europe through Niger and Libya.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ndlea-busts-sahara-europe-cocaine-syndicate-arrests-eight/) reported that operatives of the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency busted a Sahara-Europe cocaine syndicate and arrested eight suspects who excreted 634 cocaine pellets weighing 13.8kg.

reports.text: [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/tinubu-flats-n100m-air-force-crash-families/) reported that Nigeria promised homes and cash to families of 25 crash victims.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ondo-crash-tinubu-approves-houses-for-25-victims-families-n100m-each-for-19-military-personnels-families/) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved the allocation of three-bedroom flats in Abuja to each of the families of 25 military personnel and civilians who died in an Ondo crash, alongside N100 million each for 19 military personnel's families.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/26/tinubu-approves-n100m-three-bedroom-flats-for-families-of-naf-931-crash-victims/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu approved 100 million naira and three-bedroom flats for immediate families of military personnel and civilian victims of the NAF 931 crash.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/26/tinubu-announces-financial-compensation-house-for-each-family-of-igbokoda-air-mishap-victims/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu announced financial compensation and a house for each family of the 25 victims of the Nigerian Air Force crash.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/tinubu-approves-three-bedroom-flats-%e2%82%a6100m-for-families-of-atr-42-crash-victims/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/igbokoda-air-crash-tinubu-allocates-houses-to-victims-families/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1743486-breaking-tinubu-announces-n100m-houses-ondo-aircraft-victims-video-trends/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928242-fg-gifts-houses-%e2%82%a6100-million-to-naf-crash-victims-families.html) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved three-bedroom flats and a N100 million donation for the families of victims of the ATR-42 / NAF aircraft crash.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/over-26000-units-525100-jobs-created-by-tinubus-housing-projects-apc-pcc/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council showcased the achievements of the present administration regarding housing projects delivering over 26,000 units and 525,100 jobs.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubus-housing-projects-created-525100-jobs-apc-pcc/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743450-tinubu-government-lists-26000-housing-units-nigeria-targets-affordable-homeownership/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-housing-projects-deliver-over-26000-units-525100-jobs-apc-pcc-says/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council stated that President Bola Tinubu's housing projects delivered over 26,000 units and created 525,100 jobs.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/business-economy/economy/1742409-n100m-housing-loan-9-categories-nigerians-eligible-apply/) reported that the federal government listed nine categories of Nigerians eligible for its N100 million housing loan, including workers, entrepreneurs, and self-employed individuals.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/mreif-mortgage-what-you-need-for-the-%e2%82%a6100m-fg-backed-housing-loan/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that applicants for the MREIF mortgage of up to ₦100m must be between 21 and 60 years old, have a good credit score, and pay 20 percent equity.

[The Chronicle (Ghana)](https://thechronicle.com.gh/tinubu-announces-housing-loan-scheme-for-nigerians-spreads-repayment-over-20-years/) reported that Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu introduced an affordable housing scheme with a fixed interest rate of 9.75 per cent and 20-year repayment terms.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/tinubus-education-reset-n372-62bn-student-loans-technical-skills-and-wider-school-access/) reported on the implementation of student loans, technical skills development, and educational access initiatives in Nigeria.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/how-to-apply-for-fgs-n100m-housing-loans/) reported that Nigerians can apply for mortgage loans of up to 100 million naira under the Federal Government's housing finance programme.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-offers-nigerians-n100m-housing-loans/) reported that Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu announced eligible Nigerians can obtain housing loans of up to ₦100m at a fixed interest rate of 9.75 per cent.
