reports.text: [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91463) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that nine more Ukrainian children returned home through the mediation of US First Lady Melania Trump.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91462) reported that Hungary lifted a three-year entry and residence ban on Ukrainian drone commander Robert Madyar Brovdi.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4189431-hungary-lifts-entry-ban-on-ukrainian-commander-robert-magyar-brovdi.html) reported that Hungary lifted the entry and residence ban on Robert Brovdi, Commander of the Unmanned Systems Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/ukrainian-children-reunited-with-families/33907182.html) reported that nine more Ukrainian children were reunited with family members after being evacuated from Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/9-ukrainian-children-returned-from-russian-occupied-territories-russia-through-melania-trumps-mediation-zelensky-says/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated nine Ukrainian children were returned from Russian-occupied Crimea and parts of Zaporizhzhia and Kherson oblasts through Melania Trump's mediation.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/zelensky-agradece-a-melania-trump-su-mediacion-para-reunir-a-ninos-ucranianos-con-sus-familias-regresan-9-menores-y-2-adultos/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky thanked Melania Trump for her mediation in reuniting nine Ukrainian minors and two adults with their families.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91330) reported that Foreign Minister Anita Orbán announced that Hungary joined the International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children, making all 27 European Union member states part of it.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064742/) reported that Hungarian Foreign Minister Anita Orbán announced that Hungary is joining the International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188832-hungary-to-join-international-coalition-for-the-return-of-ukrainian-children.html) reported that Hungary's decision to join the coalition means all 27 European Union member states are now part of it.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/hungary-joins-coalition-for-return-of-abducted-ukrainian-children-following-magyar-visit-zelensky-says/) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban joined the coalition for the return of abducted Ukrainian children following his visit, according to Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/2026/11/26/viktor-orban-may-be-gone-but-europes-ukraine-funding-headache-remains/) reported that an awkward squad of populist prime ministers want to opt out of joining a 45 billion euro EU loan for Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064672/) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar stated Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy gifted him a 1942 newspaper mentioning his great-grandfather during his visit to Zakarpattia.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/peter-magyar-meets-volodymyr-zelenskyy-hungary-and-ukraine-make-a-fresh-start-after-the-icy-relations-of-the-viktor-orban-era/a-80054175?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91166) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar visited Ukraine to discuss minority rights, historical grievances, energy cooperation, and EU accession with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/ukraine-and-hungary-agree-to-deepen-energy-cooperation-zelenskyy-says-3725972) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced an agreement covering gas and diesel supplies to Kyiv and Hungarian access to Ukrainian gas storage.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188290-zelensky-magyar-meet-with-representatives-of-hungarian-community-in-zakarpattia.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar met with representatives of the Hungarian community in the Zakarpattia region.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/25/ukraine-war-briefing-zelenskyy-and-hungary-pm-hail-new-era-of-cooperation-after-orban) reported that Hungary's new Prime Minister, Péter Magyar, called for efforts to build trust with Kyiv.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064474/) reported that during his visit to Uzhhorod, Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar announced a new social support fund for ethnic Hungarians living abroad.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064480/) reported that Magyar stated Hungary has provided refuge to tens of thousands of Ukrainians, including ethnic Hungarians, since Russia's full-scale invasion.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-zelenskyy-and-hungary-s-magyar-meet-amid-thaw-in-ties/a-80036546?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Hungary's Prime Minister Peter Magyar arrived in Ukraine for meetings with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and ethnic Hungarians to signal a thaw in ties.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064433/) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar arrived in Zakarpattia for the first time since 2015 and plans to meet President Zelenskyy.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188112-hungarian-prime-minister-arrives-in-zakarpattia.html) reported that Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar arrived in Ukraine's Zakarpattia region to meet with representatives of the local Hungarian community.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188130-zelensky-and-magyar-pay-tribute-to-fallen-ukrainian-defenders-in-uzhhorod.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064457/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar paid tribute to fallen Ukrainian defenders in Uzhhorod.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188149-zelensky-makes-first-statement-after-meeting-with-magyar-in-uzhhorod.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy made a statement to the press after meeting with Péter Magyar in Uzhhorod.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/hungarys-magyar-meets-zelenskyy-in-ukraine-in-sharp-break-with-orban-era), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-hungary-leader-magyar-to-hold-first-formal-meeting-in-zakarpattia/) reported that Hungarian opposition leader Peter Magyar and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy are holding their first formal bilateral meeting in Zakarpattia.

reports.text: [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189356-spox-pletenchuk-russia-seeks-alternative-supply-routes-for-troops-after-partial-collapse-of-kerch-bridge.html) reported that Dmytro Pletenchuk stated the Russian Federation is unable to fully supply Crimea with everything required by occupying forces following damage to the Kerch Bridge.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNdDhjR3Rhcm4tZDBldjFGZV9PMm1aV0pWZF9RdFhwdVA0anhFWHdkN212SFBUZTN6V2RxbGhzMHI0cFdXa3VMY3hVb3BXcEZVWEVydzQyYnkwN2t0WjRnZmpFbXhYVHMyWHpRUFRlNTVyOGZSSWFKd21qcng5QTNRZUgyb294a3NJWUNQaUhWMDVYT0E2bGlsYXJjTU9IZzd0Vm8w?oc=5), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91341) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Russia is preparing another massive strike targeting energy infrastructure and logistics in the coming days.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4189052-zelensky-warns-russia-is-preparing-new-largescale-attack.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky called on Ukrainians to pay close attention to air-raid sirens following reports that Russia is preparing a new large-scale attack.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/a770581489b9), a state-run outlet, reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that Russia is preparing a new mass strike.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/26/8064781/) reported that Ukrainian intelligence stated Russia is preparing to target energy, logistics, and critical facilities.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91302) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russia is finalizing preparations for another massive strike on Ukraine's critical infrastructure.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-prepares-new-mass-attack-on-ukraines-energy-infrastructure-zelensky-says/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188863-zelensky-russia-preparing-for-another-massive-attack-on-ukraine.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russia is completing preparations for a massive attack targeting energy infrastructure, logistics, and electronics.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/91069494) reported that an exiled Russian businessman who renounced his citizenship manufactures the Ruta missiles used by the Ukrainian military, including in the destruction of the Crimean Bridge.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187567-russia-lacks-capability-to-recover-kerch-bridge-spans-from-seabed-ukrainian-navy-spokesperson.html) reported that Russia lacks the capability to raise Kerch Bridge spans from the seabed and foreign companies are unlikely to participate.
[TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2223293) reported that expert Dmitry Barov stated Kiev could not have attacked the Crimean Bridge without NATO intelligence and long-range systems.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/after-relentless-ukraine-strikes-russia-to-take-at-least-a-few-months-to-clear-crimea-bridge/articleshow/136069125.cms) reported that Ukraine's defense minister stated clearing debris from the Kerch Strait Bridge will span several months following damage from Ukrainian drone attacks.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/22/world/ukraine-russia-logistics-crimean-bridge-strikes/) reported that Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean bridge piled pressure on an already strained Russian logistics network.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6wy0qj7w5zqo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.
[TASS](https://tass.com/society/2222879), a state-media outlet, reported that Russian Deputy Prime Minister Andrey Nikitin stated train traffic across the Crimean Bridge has been fully restored.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90789) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky warned during an NBC News interview that the Crimean Bridge will not stay.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187063-crimean-bridge-which-putin-uses-to-transport-weapons-to-not-remain-standing-zelensky-says.html) reported that Russian leader Vladimir Putin uses the Kerch Bridge to transport large quantities of military equipment.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187033-russia-unlikely-to-increase-traffic-on-kerch-bridge-even-after-repairs-pletenchuk.html) reported that Dmytro Pletenchuk stated Russia is unlikely to risk increasing traffic on the Kerch Bridge even after repairs.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2222801), a state-media outlet, reported that a military expert stated the UK and France helped coordinate the Ukrainian army's strike on the Crimean Bridge, calling it a purely terrorist act.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/russia-has-no-timeline-for-crimean-bridge-repairs-deputy-pm-says-a94332) reported that Russian Deputy Prime Minister Marat Khusnullin stated both the steel arch and main beam supporting the roadway were damaged in the Ukrainian strikes.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186858-russia-lacks-technical-capacity-to-repair-crimean-bridge-pletenchuk.html) reported that Pletenchuk stated Russia currently lacks the technical capacity needed to repair the Kerch Strait Bridge.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-says-putin-must-understand-crimean-bridge-will-not-stay-warns-russia-increasing-double-tap-strikes/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Russia is increasing double-tap and triple-tap strikes to kill as many people as possible, while stating Russian President Vladimir Putin must understand the Crimean Bridge will not stay.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/ukraines-crimean-bridge-blasts-put-russian-logistics-under-pressure) reported that Ukraine's partial destruction of the Crimean bridge put Russian logistics under pressure and strengthened Kyiv's supply route disruption campaign.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063984/) reported that Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara stated it will take Russia several months to lift and tow away the damaged section of the Crimean Bridge.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063973/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russia attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times before the strike on the Crimean Bridge.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187204-strikes-on-kerch-bridge-can-force-kremlin-to-reconsider-its-position-on-negotiations-ukraine-at-osce.html) reported that Ukraine stated at the OSCE that damage to the Kerch Bridge could force the Kremlin to reconsider its position on negotiations.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187121-dm-khmara-says-russia-will-need-several-months-to-raise-damaged-section-of-kerch-bridge.html) reported that Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara stated Russia will need several months to raise the damaged section of the Kerch Bridge.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-could-take-a-year-to-clear-collapsed-crimean-bridge-section-ukraines-defense-minister-says/) reported that the president rejected Vladimir Putin's claims that the Crimean Bridge was not used for military logistics.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063937/) reported that Ukraine's defence forces struck an ammunition depot in Russian-occupied Crimea and two Russian command posts in Zaporizhzhia and Donetsk oblasts.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/russian-projectiles-hit-poland-as-nato-tensions-rise) reported that three Russian projectiles landed in Poland, prompting NATO to condemn a violation of Polish airspace.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/20/we-do-whatever-we-want-with-what-s-ours-a-look-back-at-ukraine-s-attacks-on-the-crimean-bridge) reported that the Crimean Bridge links the Russian-annexed peninsula to Russia’s Krasnodar region.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063896/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy defended strikes on the bridge, saying Moscow uses it to transport weapons and that Kyiv will continue targeting it.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/troops-from-europe-s-coalition-for-ukraine-train-in-war-s-shadow-101795204897221.html) reported that troops from Europe's coalition for Ukraine trained in the shadow of the war.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186930-crimean-bridge-attack-dutch-journalist-says-russia24-distorted-his-words.html) reported that Dutch journalist Geert Jan Hahn stated Russia-24 distorted his words from a BNR broadcast.

reports.text: [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-i-wont-govern-bauchi-by-proxy-bala-mohammed-assures-yakubu/) reported that Bauchi State Governor Bala Mohammed assured Allied Peoples Movement governorship hopeful Dr Adamu Yakubu that he would not govern Bauchi by proxy.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/female-soldiers-critical-to-army-operations-coas-2/) reported that Chief of Army Staff Lt.-Gen. Waidi Shaibu stated that developing the professional capabilities of female personnel is essential to strengthening army operations.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611240341.html) reported that Bauchi State Governor Bala Mohammed affirmed his administration will prioritize completing ongoing projects and outstanding gratuities in the 2027 budget.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/24/bala-mohammed-bauchi-2027-budget-to-prioritise-completion-of-ongoing-projects/) reported that Bauchi State Governor Bala Mohammed affirmed his administration will prioritize the completion of ongoing projects.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/20/coass-visit-bala-mohammed-approves-land-for-army-training-center-in-bauchi/) reported that Bauchi State Governor Senator Bala Mohammed approved the allocation of land for the establishment of a permanent Nigerian Army Armoured Corps training center.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/coas-in-bauchi-reaffirms-armys-commitment-to-citizens-security/) reported that Chief of Army Staff Lieutenant General Waidi Shaibu reaffirmed the Nigerian Army's commitment to strengthening peace and security in Bauchi State and across the country.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/army-seeks-bauchi-land-for-armour-training-as-coas-leads-combat-exercise/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Army asked Bauchi for land for an Armour Corps training ground as Chief of Army Staff Waidi Shaibu led Exercise MUGUN BUGU 2026 in Alkaleri, Bauchi State.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611180379.html) reported that Nigerian Chief of Army Staff Lieutenant General Waidi Shaibu charged the Armoured Corps to accelerate modernization and adopt combat readiness.
[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/army-seeks-land-for-armoured-corps-training-in-bauchi/) reported that the army is seeking land for armored corps training in Bauchi.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/coas-gen-shaibu-intensifies-combat-training-to-strengthen-army-operations/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/banditry-army-intensifies-training-of-personnel-to-fortify-newly-created-formations/) reported that Chief of Army Staff Lieutenant General Waidi Shaibu reaffirmed the Nigerian Army's commitment to intensified and mission-oriented combat training.

reports.text: [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/26/russia-launches-ballistic-missile-and-drone-barrage-on-ukraine-killing-at-least-three) reported that Ukrainian air defences downed 87 Russian missiles and drones overnight in a barrage that killed at least three people, while Ukrainian drones struck a chemical plant.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064675/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russian forces target power lines and substations to disrupt electricity transmission.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188681-kyiv-under-ballistic-missile-attack-strikes-reported-in-industrial-area.html), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-slams-kyiv-in-ballistic-missile-attack-hits-shopping-center/) reported that Russian forces launched a ballistic missile attack against Kyiv, striking a shopping center and injuring three people.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/russian-triple-tap-attack-in-ukraine-kills-emergency-worker-and-7-year-old-in-zelenskys-home-city/) reported that a seven-year-old boy and a 20-year-old paramedic were killed in a Russian triple-tap strike on Kryvyi Rih.
[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zelensky-reaffirms-ukraines-wish-to-join-nato/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky reaffirmed Ukraine's wish to join NATO.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPdEdyR1RJcnpvbkdBNFFKbHQ3bWh2SzBfVnBfdklPRGlubDVuZjVOYUVrTUtaVGNQc2ZtM042TmpvWFNUZU1vNlRDeUhWbS0xUU5IWndHdlNZa3JIYm1OQm55YVNvbVpxaUhBNExXbS1NOU91ODdGa2d4elRXOWhIUXZCRHR5T3ZTei1fRWRyOVJvOXJRSXNIM25QT1JIOXFPa2VTcg?oc=5), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/russia-launches-ballistic-missile-attack-on-zelensky-s-hometown-in-central-ukraine), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/ballistic-missile-attack-on-zelenskys-hometown-in-central-ukraine-kills-2-and-wounds-scores-3013401) reported that a Russian ballistic missile attack on President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's hometown of Kryvyi Rih killed two people and wounded 60 others.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/921ddd08eb0c) reported that Moscow stated its forces struck energy facilities and a ship near Odessa.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/ballistic-missile-attack-on-zelenskyys-hometown-kills-two-people) reported that a ballistic missile strike targeted civilian infrastructure in Zelenskyy's hometown and killed two people.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/russia-strikes-zelenskyy-s-hometown-killing-2/a-80009458?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the attacks followed Russian President Vladimir Putin's vow of a painful response to Ukraine's attacks on the Kerch Bridge.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ballistic-russian-missile-attack-on-zelenskys-hometown-in-central-ukraine-kills-2-101795265428031.html) reported that a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman were killed in a ballistic missile attack on Zelenskyy's hometown in central Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063344/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185790-zelensky-calls-on-us-to-enable-satellite-communications-to-target-ballistic-missile-launchers.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated the United States could help Ukraine destroy Russian and North Korean ballistic missile launchers by enabling satellite communications.

reports.text: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/27/ukraine-war-briefing-kyiv-launched-more-long-range-strikes-in-2026-than-rest-of-war-combined-data-shows) reported that data shows Kyiv launched more long-range strikes in 2026 than the rest of the war combined, with targets more than 500km away increased and locations hit including Siberia and Libya.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188486-hur-deepstrike-destroys-russias-unique-aerospace-reconnaissance-system.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91175) reported that Ukraine's Defense Intelligence destroyed a Russian MRIK-VKO aerospace reconnaissance and information system in the Smolensk region during a deep-strike operation.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187144-streeting-urges-allies-to-go-further-in-supporting-ukraine-through-winter.html) reported that the UK is ready to discuss additional support with Ukraine and urged allies to provide more winter assistance.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/pistorius-apologizes-for-calling-us-criticism-of-ukraine-strikes-stupid/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius walked back his choice of words but stood by his support for Ukrainian strikes inside Russia.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/germany-uk-push-back-after-us-criticizes-ukraines-deep-strikes-into-russia/) reported that German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius strongly rejected Colby's assessment, calling criticism of Ukrainian strikes against strategic military targets inside Russia stupid.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185713-uk-urges-allies-at-ramstein-to-commit-to-military-support-for-ukraine-through-2027.html) reported that the UK urged international partners at Ramstein to provide military support to Ukraine through 2027, and Germany's Defense Minister highlighted Russian monthly losses and Ukrainian territorial gains.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPRmdnNC1aejdXR1ZzZFEzSGVBNEJ5T2VRZTdHTU1mVGlrcnJkZTlacmJ2V3UteWNQZkNKTUpQa1gtRGxNaGV6ejVaM1JQZkszX2FZeWs0RXlQM09aYnBvdllESnktVEZMclBBcnZDNVdremViZjZmSlZHcGRLeHpCLWc3VnQ3M0psWXBReEg2SEZzSmQ0dkVBbU1ZOTVaVGI1Yld6cWNiaXBGeFB5OFZCTA?oc=5) reported that a German minister rejected US criticism of Kyiv's deep strikes as 'stupid'.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/us-criticises-ukraines-deep-strike-campaign-against-russia) reported that German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius called the US warning a quite a stupid thing, while British counterpart Wes Streeting stated there was no doubt.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/ukraine-deep-strikes-us-germany-britain-b3086767.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-tells-ukraine-s-backers-deep-strikes-don-t-work-urges-focus-on-front-line-equipment-101794943025135.html) reported that the Pentagon urged Ukraine's Western allies to focus military support on front-line combat equipment rather than deep strikes.

narratives.label: French housing energy performance regulations amendment

reports.text: [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/27/fin-de-l-interdiction-des-passoires-thermiques-a-la-location-aux-assises-de-la-renovation-energetique-la-consternation-des-professionnels-du-secteur_6815833_3224.html) reported that professionals in the energy renovation sector expressed dismay over the National Rally amendment adopted by the National Assembly during the housing bill vote.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/conjoncture/l-assemblee-nationale-adopte-en-premiere-lecture-le-projet-de-loi-logement-20261124) reported that the National Assembly adopted the housing bill in the first reading.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/24/l-assemblee-nationale-adopte-le-projet-de-loi-sur-le-logement-avec-les-voix-du-rassemblement-national_6814849_3224.html) reported that Housing Minister Vincent Jeanbrun relies on the removal during December's joint committee of the National Rally amendment that ends the rental ban on energy-inefficient properties.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/20/projet-de-loi-logement-les-deputes-n-ont-pas-revote-sur-le-droit-de-louer-les-passoires-thermiques_6813700_3224.html) reported that deputies did not revote on the right to rent out energy-inefficient properties during the finalization of the housing bill.

[Le Figaro](https://immobilier.lefigaro.fr/article/edouard-philippe-veut-geler-l-interdiction-des-passoires-thermiques-pendant-5-ans-20261119) reported that Horizons presidential candidate Edouard Philippe promised a normative moratorium on housing and to freeze the rental ban on energy-inefficient properties for five years.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/18/suppression-de-l-interdiction-de-louer-les-passoires-thermiques-a-l-assemblee-fortes-tensions-sur-la-crise-du-logement_6813194_3224.html) reported that right-wing deputies added their voices to the National Rally and enabled the adoption of an amendment to the housing bill to end obligations regarding energy-inefficient properties.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/17/logement-l-assemblee-vote-un-amendement-du-rn-supprimant-toutes-les-interdictions-de-location-liees-au-dpe_6813044_823448.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/logement-l-assemblee-adopte-un-amendement-rn-supprimant-les-interdictions-de-louer-des-passoires-thermiques-20261117) reported that the French National Assembly adopted an amendment proposed by the National Rally removing rental bans on energy-inefficient properties.

reports.text: [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/ataque-drones-explosivos-bolivar-policia-muerto-identificaron-victima-OJ44182914) reported that a National Police sub-inspector died in an explosive drone attack against officers in Arenal del Sur, Bolívar.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/ataque-con-drones-en-bolivar-dejo-un-policia-muerto-en-estacion-de-arenal) reported that a drone attack in Bolivar killed a police officer at the Arenal station.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/ataque-dron-explosivo-condoto-choco-mato-un-policia-de-la-espriella-pronunciamiento-OD44125821) reported that an explosive drone attack against a police station in Condoto, Chocó, killed a police officer.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/atentado-terrorista-dron-iglesia-dagua-abelardo-espriella-declaracion-acto-barbarie-MB44103168) reported that President Abelardo de la Espriella labeled the terrorist attack that caused material damage to a church in Dagua as an act of barbarism.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/dron-con-explosivos-cae-techo-iglesia-valle-del-cauca-MI44088105) reported that an explosives-laden drone intended for a police station fell on the roof of a church in Valle del Cauca.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/un-ataque-con-drones-deja-un-policia-muerto-en-condoto-colombia-es-el-segundo-en-menos-de-un-mes-33325415) reported that a drone attack left one policeman dead in Condoto, Colombia.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/video-ataque-drones-explosivos-contra-ejercito-peaje-mondomo-cierre-via-panamericana-LB44015842) reported that an explosive drone attack against army troops at the Mondomo toll booth forced the closure of the Pan-American Highway.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/un-militar-muerto-y-23-heridos-dejo-atentado-contra-batallon-en-cesar) reported that an attack against a military battalion in La Jagua de Ibirico left one soldier dead and 23 wounded.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/colombia-cifra-ataques-terroristas-con-dron-uno-por-dia-IN43934927) reported that Colombia recorded 358 attacks with explosive-loaded drones between January and November, representing a 140% increase.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/ataque-contra-batallon-del-ejercito-colombiano-deja-un-militar-muerto-y-mas-de-12-heridos-33260852) reported that a military man was killed and more than 12 wounded in an attack against a Colombian army battalion.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/defensoria-reporta-22-militares-y-un-civil-heridos-en-ataque-en-cesar) reported that the Ombudsman's Office stated 22 military personnel and one civilian were wounded in the attack in Cesar.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/video-botellon-agua-pintado-eln-panico-alerta-via-yumbo-cali-explosivo-MJ43793834) reported that a security alert caused by an abandoned water jug painted with an ELN flag on a Valle del Cauca road was dispelled after authorities determined it did not contain explosives.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/taxi-abandonado-en-peaje-el-espinal-provoco-cierre-de-la-hacia-flandes) reported that an abandoned taxi at the El Espinal toll booth caused the closure of the road toward Flandes.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/vehiculo-explosivo-taxi-panico-via-espinal-flandes-abandonado-peaje-GJ43682163) reported that anti-explosive authorities inspected a public service taxi abandoned near the Espinal-Flandes toll booth.

reports.text: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/27/newly-released-documents-cia-waterboarding-9-11) reported that newly released declassified documents support the belief that post-9/11 CIA waterboarding was more common and may have occurred beyond two acknowledged sites.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/report-cia-tortured-more-people-with-waterboarding-than-us-agency-admitted?traffic_source=rss), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/cia-waterboarded-more-9-11-terror-suspects-than-it-admitted-newly-released-fbi-files-suggest-report-101795760130993.html) reported that a New York Times report and newly released FBI files suggest the CIA waterboarded more 9/11 terror suspects than admitted.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-22/fbi-database-hacked-according-to-media-outlets/107413682) reported that the FBI and U.S. Agriculture Department were targeted in apparent cyberattacks.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/probe-underway-as-hackers-breach-fbis-crime-database/) reported that hackers breached the U.S. Department of Agriculture system used to process payments alongside the FBI database.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxOX3JOVy03eEI4NG1USFRxZkwtd0FLc0tfWk1zMWJSX0xDeHR1Rmwwd0hoQ2RXMG15ejRzWEJJZFh5WU5la2tvWE9kNjJQOG9rVEh4MUlUQl9Cam5KR1FKNnl4UWhLRmVBMGVfT3Q1dXlsZ2lfUHlXLUV3a0ZjaE16ZzJTMFBSbW9RRHc?oc=5) reported that the FBI is investigating an apparent hack of a key criminal justice information database according to an AP source.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-says-suspected-fbi-database-hack-is-not-good-revives-russia-hoax-claims-maybe-we-ll-learn-things-101795277817214.html) reported that Donald Trump called the suspected cyberattack on the FBI’s National Crime Information Center troubling.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/21/usda-fbi-outages-cyber-attack) reported that hackers breached the US Department of Agriculture farmer payment system and the FBI National Crime Information Center.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fbi-probes-suspected-hack-of-us-crime-database/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the FBI is investigating a suspected cyberattack on its National Crime Information Centre database used by US police.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261121-us-agriculture-department-fbi-hit-by-cyberattacks-media-report) reported that hackers breached systems at the US Agriculture Department and the FBI.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/ef34d53c5e48) reported that the cyber intrusions reportedly target a farmer payment system and a nationwide law enforcement database.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010305/fbi-s-criminal-information-database-hacked-report/story/) reported that the FBI is investigating a suspected breach of a nationwide database used by federal, state and local law enforcement agencies to share criminal justice information.
[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/fbi-breach-criminal-information-database/) reported that the National Crime Information Center holds sensitive law enforcement records nationwide.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/fbi-database-hacked-for-second-time-in-months-breach-targets-us-crime-records-101795228753873.html) reported that the FBI database was hacked for the second time in months, following a September targeting of an FBI recruitment website by ShinyHunters.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/fbis-criminal-information-database-hacked-reports-say/article71727198.ece) reported that the apparent compromise involved the National Crime Information Center database.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fbi-investiga-nuevo-ciberataque-contra-base-de-datos-nacional-segun-cnn-en-septiembre-indago-otro-caso/) reported that the FBI is investigating a new cyberattack against a national database according to CNN.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7324490-fbi-e-departamento-de-agricultura-dos-eua-sao-alvos-de-ataques-hackers.html) reported that the FBI and the US Department of Agriculture were targets of hacker attacks that also affected a payment system.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/hackers-atacan-el-departamento-de-agricultura-de-eeuu-y-el-fbi-segun-medios_0_nZL5j9nd2U.html) reported that hackers breached the United States Department of Agriculture and the FBI.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/hackers-vulneran-al-departamento-de-agricultura-y-al-fbi-en-estados-unidos-en-medio-de-crecientes-alertas-por-la-seguridad-informatica-3602960) reported that recent weeks of disruptions also affected transport, communications, and electronic commerce across United States territory.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/pais/giovanni-ortuno-propuesta-rodrigo-paz-embajada-bolivia-estados-unidos_1794962780) reported that businessman and former CEPB president Giovanni Ortuño was proposed by Rodrigo Paz's government to represent Bolivia as ambassador to the United States.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/embajada-ee-uu-colombia-alerta-marchas-19-noviembre-recomendaciones-EA43702644) reported that the US Embassy in Colombia issued a security alert for mobilized marches.

reports.text: [Al Wihda (Chad)](https://www.alwihdainfo.com/conseil-des-ministres-cap-sur-la-lfr-2026-et-le-developpement-du-senegal-oriental/) reported that Senegal's Council of Ministers met under the presidency of Bassirou Diomaye Diakhar Faye to frame the execution of the 2026 amending finance bill and welcomed a TAS decision on the Africa Cup of Nations.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxNSXB4M0Z3YmVRY00wSW9jUGpyU0hzT2h0a0tFel9wcXFIZFVpYWphTTI5Qm1nSDYxOW5ueVU2OHdLUGx2OFlDOWV2YTg5Wjl4Z0I5VmtWWFZkS0lDdU9IUWZnTjlicHMwMkpURXZaVC1RYzJrRFg5TjJrM3VTdFJ6S29FcFhwSTNpOEluWWJTZlZsdi01amwyZWNja0ptZkJnMGRiWnFJNkE3T3FwOHZyWEhfRVpKTTkyd0pmdU4wM0hFZw?oc=5), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261126-s%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal-la-majorit%C3%A9-parlementaire-adopte-une-r%C3%A9solution-contre-le-passage-par-d%C3%A9cret-du-budget-rectificatif-2026), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/senegal-parliament-denounces-president-over-budget-decree/) reported that Senegal's parliament adopted a resolution criticizing President Bassirou Diomaye Faye's decision to implement the 2026 budget bill by decree.

[Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/actualites/politique/lfr-2026-senegal-oriental-diaspora-bassirou-diomaye-faye-fixe-ses-priorites-et-presse-le-gouvernement/) reported that President Bassirou Diomaye Faye gave new orientations to the government regarding the execution of the 2026 amending finance bill during a council of ministers.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261124-s%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal-les-boulangers-en-gr%C3%A8ve-pour-r%C3%A9clamer-une-hausse-du-prix-du-pain) reported that bakers in Senegal went on strike to demand higher bread prices.

[Aujourd'hui au Faso](https://aujourd8.net/greve-des-boulangers-au-senegal-rejet-du-budget-2027-questions-migratoires-diomaye-faye-a-lepreuve-du-pouvoir-solitaire/) reported that Senegal faced a three-day bakers' strike over flour and electricity prices alongside the rejection of the 2027 budget.

[Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/actualites/budget-rectificatif-2026-la-presidence-met-la-lfr-en-vigueur-par-decret-apres-le-rejet-des-deputes/), [Al Wihda (Chad)](https://www.alwihdainfo.com/senegal-diomaye-faye-passe-outre-le-rejet-des-deputes-et-met-en-vigueur-le-budget-rectificatif-2026-par-decret/) reported that Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye put the 2026 amending finance bill into force by decree after the National Assembly rejected it.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/pastef-drops-president-faye-membership/), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/senegals-ruling-party-pastef-expels-countrys-president-and-31-others/) reported that PASTEF, Senegal's ruling party, struck President Bassirou Diomaye Faye and 31 others from its list.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/senegals-ruling-party-pastef-expels-countrys-president-and-31-others/) reported that the move marks a new stage in the rift between President Faye and Pastef leader Ousmane Sonko.

[Burkina 24](https://burkina24.com/2026/11/18/senegal-bassirou-diomaye-faye-et-31-autres-personnalites-radies-des-rangs-du-pastef/) reported that Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye and 31 other figures were expelled from the ranks of the PASTEF party.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261118-s%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal-le-pastef-officialise-le-d%C3%A9part-de-ses-rangs-du-pr%C3%A9sident-bassirou-diomaye-faye) reported that Senegal's Pastef party announced the departure of President Bassirou Diomaye Faye from its ranks because he chose to join another political formation.

reports.text: [Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/patrones-y-trabajadores-aportan-14760-pesos-al-ano-al-imss-pero-casi-seis-de-cada-10-se-atienden-fuera/) reported that the INEGI household income and expenditure survey showed nearly six of ten individuals seek care outside the IMSS despite contributions.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/familia-de-sofia-muerta-tras-cesarea-en-el-imss-acusa-a-presuntos-trabajadores-del-instituto-de-ofrecerles-600-mil-pesos-buscan-frenar-denuncia/) reported that the family of Sofía, who died after a C-section at the IMSS, accused institute workers of offering 600,000 pesos to halt a complaint.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/alistan-segob-y-embajador-johnson-reuniones-bilaterales-con-autoridades-migratorias-hay-buena-coordinacion-dice-rosa-icela/) reported that Rosa Icela Rodríguez provided details regarding her work table and bilateral meetings with U.S. migration authorities and Ambassador Ken Johnson.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/trabajadores-del-imss-levantan-planton-en-segob-sostendran-reunion-con-autoridades-en-menos-de-10-dias-33185568) reported that IMSS workers lifted their protest encampment at Segob and will hold a meeting with authorities in less than 10 days.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/trabajadores-del-imss-levantan-planton-en-segob-exigen-a-rosa-icela-frenar-represion-del-instituto-y-sindicato/) reported that workers demanded that Rosa Icela halt repression of the institute and union, threatening to close highways if no response is received before December.

reports.text: [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/busca-simples-no-celular-de-vorcaro-mostra-contrato-excluido-de-relatorio-sobre-moraes-e-desmonta-versao-da-pf.ghtml) reported that a simple search of Daniel Vorcaro's cell phone showed a contract excluded from a Federal Police report regarding Alexandre de Moraes.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/relatorio-da-pf-sobre-nunes-marques-e-vorcaro-inclui-desimpedimento-a-favor-do-master.ghtml) reported that the Federal Police report sent to the president regarding Daniel Vorcaro's relation with Supreme Federal Court Minister Kassio Nunes Marques included a disimpediment in favor of Master.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/25/defesa-de-vorcaro-contesta-relatoria-de-nunes-marques-e-pede-que-acao-sobre-caso-master-seja-encaminhada-a-gilmar.ghtml) reported that former banker Daniel Vorcaro's defense contested the distribution of the Master case to Minister Nunes Marques and asked for it to be sent to Gilmar Mendes.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/25/ministros-do-stf-pressionam-por-nova-distribuicao-de-pedido-de-vorcaro-sobre-relatoria-do-master-entregue-a-nunes-marques.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court ministers are pressing for a new distribution of a request presented by former banker Daniel Vorcaro's defense team.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/master-relatorio-sobre-moraes-rejeitado-pela-pf-detalhava-mensagens-de-vorcaro-e-contrato.ghtml) reported that a Federal Police report detailed messages involving Daniel Vorcaro and a contract regarding Supreme Federal Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/23/pgr-analisa-relatorios-de-ministros-em-meio-a-tensao-entre-alas-do-stf-e-pressao-sobre-procuradores.ghtml) reported that the Prosecutor General's Office is set to begin analyzing Federal Police reports regarding citations of Supreme Federal Court ministers.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/lauro-jardim/post/2026/11/delegados-afastados-querem-falar-da-polemica-dos-relatorios-sobre-ministros-do-stf.ghtml) reported that removed Federal Police delegates Daniel Cola and Wedson Cajé intend to speak about the controversy surrounding reports on Supreme Federal Court ministers.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/diretor-da-pf-pos-mendonca-entre-ministros-com-indicios-de-crime-mesmo-sem-achar-contato-dele-com-vorcaro.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues ordered reports produced on all ten Supreme Federal Court ministers and divided them into two groups.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324407-relatorio-da-pf-tem-dialogos-de-vorcaro-sobre-mendonca.html) reported that a Federal Police report contained dialogues involving Vorcaro regarding Mendonça and were forwarded to the Prosecutor General's Office.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/inclusao-de-mendonca-em-relatorio-sobre-master-integra-estrategia-da-pf-de-questionar-volta-de-ministro-a-relatoria-avaliam-investigadores.ghtml) reported that allies of Minister André Mendonça in the Supreme Federal Court view his inclusion in the Federal Police report regarding the Master case as an attempt to wear him down.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/post/2026/11/caso-master-galipolo-relata-a-pf-suspeitas-de-vazamentos-no-bc-e-ata-fora-do-padrao-feita-por-servidor.ghtml) reported that Central Bank President Gabriel Galípolo related suspicions of leaks at the BC and an unusual meeting minutes document prepared by a civil servant to the Federal Police.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/relatorios-sobre-ministros-do-stf-rejeitados-por-andrei-nao-foram-enviados-a-fachin.ghtml) reported that Federal Police reports regarding ministers Alexandre de Moraes, Kassio Nunes Marques, and Dias Toffoli, which were rejected by Director-General Andrei Rodrigues, were not sent to Fachin.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/caso-master-fachin-abre-sigilo-de-relatorio-da-pf-sobre-mencoes-a-mendonca-a-pedido-do-ministro.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court President Edson Fachin made public a Federal Police report regarding mentions of Minister André Mendonça in the Master case at the minister's request.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/fachin-deu-nova-orientacao-a-pf-para-avaliar-relevancia-de-citacoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master-diz-documento.ghtml) reported that STF President Edson Fachin gave new guidance to the Federal Police to evaluate the relevance of information regarding Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/relatorio-da-pf-sobre-mendonca-reune-mensagens-de-terceiros-sobre-terno-jantar-e-reuniao-com-vorcaro-e-nao-aponta-beneficio-a-ministro.ghtml) reported that a Federal Police report on Minister André Mendonça gathered third-party messages about clothing, a dinner, and a meeting with Vorcaro, without pointing to any benefit for the minister.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/caso-master-fachin-determina-que-concierge-de-vorcaro-apresenta-despesas-de-banqueiro.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court President Edson Fachin accepted a request from the Federal Police and ordered a concierge company contracted by former banker D. Vorcaro to present the banker's expenses.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/investigacao-novas-diligencias-ou-arquivamento-o-que-a-pgr-pode-fazer-com-os-relatorios-da-pf-sobre-ministros-do-stf.ghtml) reported that the Prosecutor-General's Office will have to individually analyze reports produced by the Federal Police concerning the Master case.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/andrei-stf-fachin-relatorios-da-pf-sobre-mencoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues delivered investigation reports mentioning Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case to STF President Edson Fachin, who then forwarded them to the PGR.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/pf-investiga-vazamento-de-informacoes-sobre-relatorio-com-mencoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues stated in a Senate hearing that an investigation is underway into information leaks concerning a report mentioning Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323452-chefe-da-pf-explica-saida-de-delegados-do-caso-master.html) reported that Federal Police chief Andrei Rodrigues met with Justice Minister Wellington César Lima e Silva regarding the departure of delegates from the Master case.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/oposicao-vai-pedir-esclarecimentos-de-ministro-sobre-delegados-da-pf-afastados-no-caso-master-em-audiencia-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the opposition will ask the minister for clarifications in a Senate hearing following the removal of Federal Police delegates.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4418664) reported that coalition forces supporting legitimacy in Yemen intercepted and destroyed a drone launched by the Houthi group toward the southern region.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204146/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B4-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%AA%D9%87%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%88%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A8%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%81%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%AC/) reported that the Yemeni Armed Forces accused the Houthis of shelling passenger buses and trucks in Lahj province, resulting in casualties among travelers.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7190618) reported that the Arab coalition forces supporting legitimacy in Yemen intercepted and destroyed a drone launched by the Houthis toward the southern region of Saudi Arabia.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203944/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B4-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-816-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B6%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%88%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%AE%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-24-%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%A9/) reported that the Yemeni Armed Forces announced the execution of 816 military operations targeting Houthi positions, reinforcements, and gatherings over 24 hours.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7184981), [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203503/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1-60-%D9%87%D8%AF%D9%81%D8%A7-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%88%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%81%D9%8A-4-%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%B8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9/) reported that the Arab coalition supporting the Yemeni government announced a targeted military operation destroying 60 military targets and missile tunnels across four Yemeni governorates.

reports.text: [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204286/%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%84%D8%A7-%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%A8%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%81%D9%88-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D9%87%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AC-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88%D9%87-%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%82%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D9%88%D9%86%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%B3/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he does not rule out issuing a pardon for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang if needed, and invited him to tell the truth before Congress.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204112/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-nvidia-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%AC%D9%86%D8%B3%D9%86-%D9%87%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AC-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B5%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0%D9%8A/) reported that Nvidia's board reappointed Jensen Huang as company president, CEO, and board member following his resignation over an extramarital affair.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204141/%D8%AC%D9%86%D8%B3%D9%86-%D9%87%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AC-%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%84%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AE-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A/) reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is scheduled to testify publicly before the US Senate Banking Committee on December 3.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/democratas-tem-maior-avanco-no-senado-em-quase-70-anos-apos-vitoria-no-alasca.shtml) reported that Mary Peltola's victory in Alaska gave Democrats their largest advance in the U.S. Senate in nearly 70 years during a midterm election.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/18/quem-e-mary-peltola-ex-congressista-indigena-que-virou-o-senado-no-alasca-para-os-democratas-com-slogan-peixe-familia-liberdade.ghtml), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7323509-democrata-vence-disputa-no-alasca-e-amplia-maioria-no-senado-dos-eua.html) reported that 53-year-old Democrat Mary Peltola won the US Senate race in Alaska, expanding the Democratic majority in the upper house to 56 seats against 44 for Republicans.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/18/4981155_demokratite_oburnaha_aliaska_i_razshiriha_mnozinstvoto/?ref=rss), [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23951052) reported that Mary Peltola won the US Senate race in Alaska against Republican Dan Sullivan.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/senat-americain-les-democrates-remportent-l-alaska-et-etendent-leur-majorite-a-56-sieges-contre-44-20261118), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/18/midterms-2026-malgre-la-polemique-les-democrates-s-imposent-en-alaska-et-parachevent-le-basculement-du-senat-americain_6813069_3210.html) reported that Democratic candidate Mary Peltola won the Senate election in Alaska against Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan, bringing the Democratic majority in the upper house to 56 seats against 44.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/18/resultado-da-eleicao-para-o-senado-dos-eua-no-alasca-deve-sair-nesta-quarta-feira-entenda-demora-na-contagem-de-votos.ghtml), [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/mary-peltola-vence-no-alasca-e-amplia-maioria-democrata-no-senado-dos-eua.shtml), [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203514/%D8%A3%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D9%85%D9%86%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84-56-%D8%A8%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AE-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A/), [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7184993) reported that Democrat Mary Peltola won the United States Senate race in Alaska, expanding the Democratic majority in the Senate to 56 seats against 44 for Republicans.

reports.text: [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/gobierno-firma-dias-elecciones-otro-acuerdo-cataluna-que-politiza-mas-gestion-aeropuertos-aena_202611236afc4eb6a6f8072789ec34b6.html) reported that the government signed an agreement with Catalonia to give the Generalitat a role in the design of airport policies and investments.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/operaciones-militares-conjuntas-estados-unidos-permiso-congreso-colombia-EN43827407) reported that Colombian Foreign Minister Omar Bula stated that the Congress of the Republic is the sole entity authorized to approve joint military operations with other countries on Colombian soil.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/secretario-de-defensa-de-eu-firma-acuerdo-sobre-ciberdefensa-con-el-gobierno-de-honduras-plantea-operaciones-militares-conjuntas/) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth signed a cyberdefense agreement with the government of Honduras and proposed joint military operations.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/on-the-same-page-hegseth-hails-us-ties-with-colombias-de-la-espriella?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth praised security cooperation with Colombia as the country joins the Americas Counter Cartel Coalition.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/el-secretario-de-defensa-de-eeuu-visita-ecuador-y-honduras_0_Hu5jIajuuo.html) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is visiting Ecuador and Honduras after meetings in Colombia and Venezuela to discuss combating drug trafficking.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/19/hegseth-unveils-new-us-venezuela-military-deal?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth unveiled a new military deal with Venezuela.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261118-hegseth-makes-surprise-trip-to-venezuela-renews-military-cooperation) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Caracas and announced a resumption of military cooperation with Venezuela.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/hegseth-in-colombia-to-deepen-anti-drug-ties-after-surprise-venezuela-stopover) reported that Pete Hegseth is in Colombia to deepen anti-drug ties after a surprise Venezuela stopover, with Colombian Defense Minister Jorge Eduardo Mora stating the Pentagon chief would hand over a C-130 Hercules military aircraft.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-venezuela-sign-military-deal-as-trump-administration-seeks-closer-ties/articleshow/135975509.cms) reported that the United States established a new military partnership with Venezuela following the capture of Nicolás Maduro.

[El Estímulo](https://elestimulo.com/venezuela/2026-11-18/pete-hegseth-caracas/) reported that Pete Hegseth defended the operation capturing Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores during his visit to Caracas.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-gobierno-de-trump-refuerza-su-vinculo-con-delcy-rodriguez-con-un-acuerdo-militar-nid18112026/) reported that Pete Hegseth announced a joint training and intelligence exchange agreement in Caracas to counter common threats.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/secretario-de-defensa-de-ee-uu-llega-colombia-tras-visitar-venezuela) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth arrived in Colombia after visiting Venezuela.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/hegseth-alardea-captura-maduro-primera-visita-venezuela-secretario-defensa-ee-uu-decadas_1795043469) reported that Hegseth described the capture of Maduro as the most sophisticated military operation in history during a speech at the U.S. Embassy in Venezuela.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-18/us-defense-secretary-announces-agreement-with-venezuela-against-threats-from-foreign-actors.html), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/us-defence-secretary-announces-military-cooperation-in-surprise-caracas-visit) reported that acting President Delcy Rodríguez welcomed U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in Caracas.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-and-venezuela-agree-to-revive-military-cooperation-as-hegseth-lauds-interim-government-101795027915218.html) reported that Pete Hegseth's visit occurred amid uncertainty regarding Venezuela's political future.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/us-defence-secretary-announces-military-partnership-on-trip-to-venezuela?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth announced a military partnership agreement with Venezuela involving joint training and intelligence sharing.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxONFk1RlZIUXh1dXlFVHVzSlh1YjVibG0wdV81RS1na0Ywc3p5MEhaOXB6YlREV3FFRzJpM1VhMFgzYnNLU3hvaXBXOUh4TkpXa01XYTRzS1o1R0VXcHhzZXc4ZkRZYUIxRVVpRXB6Zm9BRUNMQlE5aGFySVUzR2RpVmpsV1A2UFNSLTRITEZNVG5BdUlZ?oc=5) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is in Venezuela to meet interim leaders in the latest Cabinet visit.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-and-venezuela-sign-a-deal-to-reestablish-military-ties-hegseth-says-on-visit-to-interim-leaders), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3374965/us-and-venezuela-sign-deal-re-establish-military-ties-during-hegseth-visit) reported that the United States and Venezuela signed a deal to re-establish military ties, ranging from training to intelligence sharing, as announced by Pete Hegseth.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/hegseth-vai-a-caracas-e-eua-e-venezuela-anunciam-acordo-militar.shtml) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth visited Caracas and announced a military cooperation agreement with Venezuela.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/18/pete-hegseth-venezuela-nicolas-maduro-military) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth used his visit to Venezuela to assert U.S. dominance and mention Maduro's capture by the U.S. military.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/venezuela-y-estados-unidos-reanudan-la-cooperacion-militar-33194700), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/ee-uu-retoma-la-cooperacion-militar-con-venezuela-para-llevar-a-cabo-reformas-profundas_0_zaXgjUOMzT.html) reported that Venezuelan interim leader Delcy Rodríguez received US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to resume military cooperation and address common threats.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/el-secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-se-reune-con-delcy-rodriguez-en-caracas_0_BPhgudHrUA.html) reported that US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with provisional president Delcy Rodríguez in Caracas.

[El País](https://elpais.com/america/2026-11-18/el-secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-anuncia-un-acuerdo-de-defensa-con-venezuela-contra-amenazas-de-actores-extranjeros.html) reported that Pete Hegseth announced an agreement against threats from foreign actors.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/venezuela/ultima-hora-venezuela-y-estados-unidos-suscriben-acuerdo-de-cooperacion-militar-tras-visita-de-pete-hegseth-al-palacio-de-miraflores-3602058) reported that the military cooperation agreement was signed by Pete Hegseth and Venezuelan Defense Minister Gustavo González López.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/pete-hegseth-visita-colombia-avion-c-130-fuerza-publica-NB43718498) reported that U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth is arriving in Colombia to discuss military and security cooperation.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/que-viene-a-hacer-el-secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-a-colombia-FA43707471) reported that United States Secretary of War Pete Hegseth will arrive in Colombia on Wednesday.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-llega-hoy-colombia) reported that one of the main points on the agenda during the US official's visit is the delivery of a C-130 Hercules aircraft.

reports.text: [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/28/2027-inec-tests-bvas-irev-in-mock-election-vows-no-repeat-of-2023-glitch/) reported that INEC deployed 57,000 new BVAS devices, upgraded IReV, introduced a new eEC8A result sheet to block upload errors and overvoting, and declared that AI-generated names and photos will not pass accreditation.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/inec-tests-result-transmission-network-for-2027-polls-today/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that INEC stated Saturday’s nationwide mock election will test network capacity for uploading results to IReV and the BVAS ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/inec-to-test-bvas-irev-electronic-ec8a-in-17676-polling-units-ahead-of-2027/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission and election observers assessed readiness to test BVAS, IReV, and electronic EC8A in 17,676 polling units.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/inec-holds-stakeholders-meeting-ahead-of-mock-accreditation/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission in Kebbi State held a stakeholders forum ahead of the mock accreditation.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/inec-mobilises-edo-voters-for-mock-accreditation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that INEC urged parties and residents in Edo to mobilise for the mock accreditation exercise across 192 registration areas ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/kebbi-apc-postpones-inaugural-campaign-over-inec-mock-election/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Kebbi APC campaign council postponed its inaugural campaign over INEC's mock election, rescheduling it for December 2, 2026, at Kamba in Dandi LGA.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928463-2027-yiaga-deploys-347-observers-60-data-clerks-for-inecs-mock-election-exercise.html) reported that the election observer group Yiaga will deploy 347 observers and 60 data clerks alongside its PRVT methodology and ERAD 2.0 dashboard to identify technological and operational weaknesses during INEC's mock accreditation exercise.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-nasarawa-mobilises-residents-for-inec-mock-accreditation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Nasarawa State Government urged residents across 13 local government areas to participate in the Independent National Electoral Commission's mock accreditation.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/ondo-cancels-movement-restrictions-for-saturdays-sanitation-exercise/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Ondo State Government stated there will be no restriction on movement during Saturday's sanitation exercise to allow INEC's mock accreditation to proceed.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928408-lagos-cancels-november-environmental-sanitation-exercise-over-inec-mock-accreditation.html), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/inec-takes-priority-as-sanwo-olu-cancels-lagos-november-sanitation/) reported that Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu directed the cancellation of the November environmental sanitation exercise to prioritize the Independent National Electoral Commission's nationwide mock accreditation and result-upload exercise.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/anambra-postpones-saturday-sanitation-for-inec-mock-accreditation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Anambra State postponed its sanitation exercise from November 28 to December 5, 2026, for the INEC mock accreditation.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1743596-lagos-governor-sanwo-olu-cancels-november-sanitation-exercise-inec-mock-accreditation/) reported that Lagos Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu cancelled the November sanitation exercise after INEC scheduled a mock accreditation drill and urged residents to keep clean.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/lagos-sanwo-olu-suspends-november-sanitation-exercise-over-inec-mock-accreditation/) reported that Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu suspended the monthly environmental sanitation exercise scheduled for Saturday, November 28.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-election%e2%81%a0%e2%81%a0%e2%81%a0-inec-procures/) reported that Independent National Electoral Commission Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan stated the commission procured 57,000 new BVAS devices for the 2027 general elections.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-inec-procures-57000-new-bvas-machines-ahead-of-elections/) reported that INEC procured 57,000 new Bimodal Voter Accreditation System devices to strengthen elections.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/sanwo-olu-cancels-november-sanitation-exercise-for-inec-mock-polls/) reported that Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu cancelled the November environmental sanitation exercise to accommodate INEC mock polls.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/lagos-cancels-saturday-sanitation-over-inec-mock-accreditation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Lagos cancelled the Saturday sanitation exercise on Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu's directive to prevent disruptions to INEC's mock accreditation and result-upload exercise.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928300-2027-polls-inec-to-deploy-electronic-checks-to-prevent-result-manipulation.html) reported that INEC stated its new electronic result sheet will prevent discrepancies between polling unit results and figures uploaded to its result viewing portal for the 2027 polls.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-inec-to-test-bvas-in-406-ondo-polling-units-on-november-28/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission in Ondo State will conduct a mock accreditation and result upload exercise in 406 polling units.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/mock-accreditation-with-bvas-pdp-faction-tackles-inec-doubts-credible-outcome/) reported that an interim PDP faction criticized INEC and expressed doubts over a credible outcome for the upcoming BVAS mock accreditation.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/mock-accreditation-ballot-papers-wont-bear-party-names-inec/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that INEC stated no names of registered political parties will appear on ballot papers during the nationwide mock accreditation.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928071-inec-sets-up-ai-unit-to-combat-election-misinformation-ahead-of-2027-polls.html) reported that INEC set up an AI unit to combat election misinformation, deepfakes, and fabricated audio ahead of the 2027 polls.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743029-inec-conduct-nationwide-mock-accreditation-exercise-publishes-polling-units-affected/) reported that INEC announced a nationwide BVAS mock accreditation and result upload exercise for November 28, 2026, and published selected polling units.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/927638-inec-selects-520-polling-units-for-mock-election-in-enugu.html) reported that the INEC Resident Electoral Commissioner in Enugu State disclosed that 520 polling units were selected for the mock election.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/%e2%81%a0%e2%81%a0%e2%81%a0%e2%81%a0%e2%81%a0inec-to-conduct-mock-accreditation-in-490-lagos-polling/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission will conduct a mock accreditation and result upload exercise in 490 polling units across Lagos State.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/mock-accreditation-inec-publishes-17656-selected-pus-across-36-states-fct/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission published the list of polling units selected for its nationwide mock accreditation exercise, naming 17,656 polling units across 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-elections-inec-deploys-bvas-for-mock-test-in-17676-polling-units/) reported that INEC is deploying the BVAS for a mock test in 17,676 polling units to assess the operational readiness of the technology ahead of the 2027 elections.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/21/rec-appeals-for-participation-as-inec-holds-mock-voter-accreditation-in-598-deltas-polling-units/) reported that the Resident Electoral Commissioner in Delta State appealed for participation as INEC holds mock voter accreditation in 598 polling units.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/delta-inec-to-conduct-mock-accreditation-november-28/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/926795-2027-inec-selects-598-delta-polling-units-for-mock-accreditation.html) reported that INEC will conduct a mock accreditation and result upload exercise in Delta State on November 28.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-inec-schedules-mock-election-in-598-delta-polling-units/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-inec-to-test-bvas-in-598-delta-polling-units/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission will hold a mock election in 598 Delta polling units on November 28 to test the BVAS and result upload systems ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-inec-plans-mock-election-in-638-rivers-polling-units/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that INEC plans to hold a mock accreditation and results upload exercise in 638 Rivers polling units on November 28 to test the BVAS device ahead of the 2027 elections.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926084-inec-pledges-not-to-tamper-with-metadata-of-election-results-on-irev.html) reported that INEC pledged not to tamper with the metadata of election results on the IReV portal.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-inec-says-it-lacks-technology-to-upload-election-results-beyond-polling-units-on-irev/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926086-2027-why-we-cant-upload-ward-lg-results-inec.html), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611180281.html) reported that INEC admitted it lacks the technological infrastructure and cannot publish election results at the ward, local government, and state collation levels on the IReV portal during the 2027 general elections.

reports.text: [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/israels-eisenkot-accuses-netanyahus-party-of-stalling-coalition-talks?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/eisenkot-accuses-netanyahus-party-stalling-coalition-talks) reported that Yashar party chief Gadi Eisenkot accused Likud of stalling coalition talks and trying to drag Israel into another election.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-27/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-says-likud-dragged-out-unity-talks-vows-to-form-government-in-8-days/000001a2-1d6d-d0a2-afb7-5f7f5caf0000), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-israels-eisenkot-vows-to-form-government-within-8-days-despite-deadlock-with-likud/) reported that Israel's prime minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot vowed to form a new government within eight days despite deadlock and the signing of two coalition agreements.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/eisenkot-slams-netanyahus-party-for-sabotaging-coalition-talks) reported that Gadi Eisenkot accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party of deliberately sabotaging Israel's efforts to form a new government.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/video/2026/nov/26/can-elon-musk-really-put-ai-datacentres-in-space-the-latest) reported that the Trump administration approved Elon Musk's plan to create datacentres in space and federal regulators authorized the launch of one million Starmind satellites.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916202) reported that officials within the change bloc fear that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu could use remaining days to prevent the formation of a new government and launch a strike on Iran.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-26/musk-spacex-datacentres-fcc/107428024) reported that the Trump administration backed Elon Musk's plan for solar-powered space-based data centers to help power the next generation of AI.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-916023) reported that former air defense chief Haimovich criticized Israel's approach to repeated rounds of fighting with Iran and warned of potential economic, social, and diplomatic consequences.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-23/Iran-reports-downing-US-drones-Netanyahu-weighs-solo-strike-1SiCeMiYYeI/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Iran claimed to have downed a US military drone as tensions escalated.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/trump-maintains-pressure-iran-democrats-eye-war-funding) reported from Washington, Tehran, and Tel Aviv on the US-Iran standoff as Trump maintained pressure on Iran while Democrats eyed war funding.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/middleeast/netanyahu-israel-iran.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915840) reported that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called renewing strikes against Iran a matter of national security, while military analysts and opposition leaders stated he is prioritizing personal political survival.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/netanyahu-urges-trump-to-strike-iran-without-delay-israeli-media-reports/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/netanyahu-urges-trump-to-strike-iran-as-soon-as-possible-report/) reported that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pressured US President Donald Trump to launch fresh military strikes against Iran as soon as possible.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915732) reported that IDF Chief Eyal Zamir is set to testify for the first time before the Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-915529) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu asked the Mossad head about a covert operation against Iran without notifying IDF chief Zamir.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-20/ty-article/.premium/warmongering-netanyahu-is-pushing-to-strike-iran-but-the-idf-remains-skeptical/000001a1-f527-d9ff-a7b5-f5afb06d0000) reported that attention turned to Netanyahu's use of the Iranian threat to stall an Eisenkot-led bloc coalition.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222599) reported that Israeli officials are concerned about how quickly Iran is rebuilding production capacity for its ballistic missile program.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915595) reported that Democrats are seeking to restrict war funding ahead of taking control of Congress.
