[Sabah](https://www.sabah.com.tr/dunya/israil-basinindan-carpici-iddia-netanyahu-kurmaylarina-irana-saldiri-kacinilmaz-dedi-7705238) reported that an Israeli official stated Netanyahu mentioned at a security meeting that an attack on Iran is inevitable.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/donald-trump-admits-to-indications-of-iran-looking-at-using-gas-and-bio-weapons-against-the-us-weighs-new-wave-of-strikes-101795051670506.html) reported that US President Donald Trump stated there were indications Iran was looking at using gas or biological weapons against the US as the conflict continues.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-19/ty-article/report-netanyahu-presses-trump-for-four-to-seven-day-campaign-against-iran/000001a1-f1b2-d9ff-a7b5-f1bec1d70000) reported that Israeli intelligence chiefs have pressed Washington to target Iranian nuclear and energy sites in a four-to-seven-day campaign.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915391) reported that Donald Trump is reportedly weighing major strikes on Iran amid Israeli warnings.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/us/politics/trump-israel-iran-war.html) reported that warnings that Iran is rebuilding its missile stockpile and advancing biological and chemical programs have divided the Trump administration.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/israeli-spy-chief-lobbied-joint-iran-strikes-us-visit-sources-say), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915351) reported that Mossad chief Roman Gofman advocated for joint US-Israeli strikes on Iran during his Washington visit and met with administration officials.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/centcom-chief-visits-israel-netanyahu-pushes-new-iran-strikes-what-know) reported that the CENTCOM chief visited Israel as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pressed Washington to resume major combat operations against Iran.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/u-s-israeli-military-chiefs-meet-as-israel-pushes-for-new-iran-strikes/000001a1-ee98-ddcb-a9b3-febfbe610000) reported that the CENTCOM chief met IDF leaders in Israel as the country seeks US backing for renewed Iran strikes.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/centcom-chief-israel-following-us-iran-strikes-gulf) reported that the CENTCOM chief's visit follows US and Iran strikes in the Gulf, with Bahrain and Kuwait being targeted overnight.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ireland/2026/1118/1599693-sean-rooney-inquest/) reported that a soldier severely injured in the attack in which Private Seán Rooney was killed gave evidence that his vehicle would not drive.

reports.text: [Military.com](https://www.military.com/video/residents-return-home-as-environmental-crews-assess-impact-of-dangerous-chemical-detonation-in-iowa) reported that locals expressed surprise at the low impact after the U.S. Army detonated five tons of degraded lead azide in southeastern Iowa.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/26/us/iowa-lead-ammunition-stockpile-history.html) reported that evidence suggests efforts to get rid of unstable explosives at an Iowa plant began more than a year ago.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/army-iowa-lead-azide-detonation-b3092613.html) reported that the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency stated test results from samples taken after the controlled detonation of lead azide in Iowa could come in Friday.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-26/Detonation-of-degraded-lead-azide-in-US-s-Iowa-raises-public-concern-1So8l39LvY4/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-run outlet, reported that the detonation of degraded lead azide in Iowa raised public concern.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxQMWlYeHdzd0JEX3VIeUo5dlZNN21aV0FsMjBROW5SQzlMenBiS0tkb1lIS294cGZGbjZ6V25pTlhOT0xHZzZ3Um5oQVZEdk9jYXNpdFFweXV3MFktel9IVDhiUDJFajFhcHFIcFRpSWwwWGJCbXFBZ0UzUk1jb2k4QjhsNjBtWE90NmplUGhHdU5Bdw?oc=5) reported that the EPA expects results from the Iowa lead detonation soon.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/vance-obama-iowa-lead-explosion-azide-b3092309.html) reported that Vice President Vance blamed Barack Obama for Iowa's toxic lead following the backlash.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/26/iowa-chemical-lead-bomb-detonation-toxic-dust-fears) reported that the US army destroyed its entire stockpile of lead azide to avoid an uncontrollable explosion.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/25/army-triggers-controlled-detonation-10000-pounds-degraded-explosives/) reported that the Army triggered a pair of controlled detonations of degraded lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/25/us-officials-say-ammo-detonation-iowa-groundbreaking/) reported that U.S. officials called the controlled detonation of almost 10,000 pounds of explosive lead azide an unprecedented event.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-26/us-army-lead-bomb-detonation-iowa-explainer/107430892) reported that the US Army destroyed its entire stockpile of a toxic bomb-making material in a controlled explosion in Iowa.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-iowa-governor-army-detonation-lead-azide-b3091974.html) reported that President Trump issued a warning to the incoming Iowa governor while praising the Army's detonation of the Iowa stockpile.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/iowa-explosives-blast-jd-vance-says-obama-administration-left-no-plan-for-disposal-101795671953361.html) reported that JD Vance said officials feared the stockpile of unstable lead azide could detonate without warning.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649366-iowa-us-army-detonates-stockpile/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that the US Army destroyed nearly 4.5 metric tons of unstable explosives at an ammunition plant in Iowa despite contamination fears.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/el-pueblo-de-estados-unidos-que-detonara-5-toneladas-de-explosivos-en-medio-de-las-calles-3604253) reported that a town in the United States will detonate five tons of explosives in controlled blasts with enough power to damage buildings and break windows in nearby areas.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/white-house-seeks-accountability-after-iowa-lead-azide-detonation-officials-say-army-failed-to-alert-top-leaders-101795661354132.html) reported that the White House is examining why senior officials were not briefed sooner about risks from 68 barrels of deteriorating chemicals at an Iowa munitions plant.

[CGTN](https://newsus.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-26/Iowa-residents-react-to-Army-detonation-of-bomb-making-chemicals-1Sn7Ko9SNi0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported on Iowa residents reacting to the Army detonation of bomb-making chemicals.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/marjorie-taylor-greene-demands-trump-hegseth-be-jailed-over-iowa-lead-azide-blast-calls-it-a-chernobyl-event-101795633933728.html) reported that Marjorie Taylor Greene called the US Army's controlled blast of old lead azide in Iowa a dirty bomb and demanded that Trump and Hegseth be locked up.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-accuses-cnn-of-hoping-iowa-explosives-blast-would-fail-they-want-our-country-to-lose-101795645286229.html) reported that President Trump accused CNN of hoping the Iowa explosives detonation would fail.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/iowa-dirty-bomb-marjorie-taylor-greene-b3091214.html) reported that Marjorie Taylor Greene criticized Trump and Hegseth over the controlled explosion of lead azide in Iowa.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-916042) reported that NASA chief responded to Marjorie Taylor Greene's Moon landing denial.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/americka-vojska-digla-u-zrak-pet-tona-eksploziva-u-iowi-stanovnici-strahuju-od-olovne-prasine/261125165) reported that the U.S. military controlledly detonated nearly five tons of lead azide in Iowa, representing the country's entire stockpile of the explosive, despite resident and environmental concerns.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1091001/americka-vojska-detonirala-gotovo-pet-tona-eksploziva-stanovnici-strahovali-od-sirenja-otrovne-olovne-prasine) reported that the U.S. military detonated nearly five tons of explosive as residents feared the spread of toxic lead dust.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/exercito-dos-eua-detona-toneladas-de-explosivos-com-chumbo-em-iowa.shtml), [El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-25/recreacion-visual-asi-fue-la-detonacion-de-cinco-toneladas-de-material-explosivo-en-iowa.html) reported that the U.S. Army detonated nearly 4.5 tons of lead azide explosives in Iowa.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/3787fbd15d27) reported that environmental authorities detected no airborne lead following the controlled destruction of 68 drums of hazardous explosives at an Iowa military facility.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5BdzZqSHYyeFlYSzJOczVGcmNteUVLbFVhZW8xM3FqRjYzd0lCNXdPOENpdXNhSmh4aWRhaFNzS0NPX1VDRU1td2pkeFFzbUFwcjl0bi16czVVYVNrNlYxNUJyQU43d202QTNROFN2dDJtcXdtZDlnRjRjWmNKeVk?oc=5), [Military.com](https://www.military.com/army-blows-up-bomb-chemicals-in-iowa-despite-fears-a-toxic-plume-could-endanger-residents) reported that the U.S. Army stated the detonation of lead azide bomb chemicals at an ammunition plant in southeastern Iowa was a success despite toxic plume concerns.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/us-army-declares-iowa-lead-azide-detonation-tremendously-successful?traffic_source=rss) reported that the US Army declared the lead azide disposal operation tremendously successful.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/army-company-behind-iowa-lead-azide-plant-operator-detonation-23-billion-deal-to-run-ammo-depot-through-2046) reported that a Day & Zimmermann unit was awarded a $2.3 billion Hawthorne Army Depot contract.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/25/us/army-detonation-emissions-maps-risk-underestimated.html) reported that the emergency emissions scenario calculated by Army officials did not use a worst-case scenario as required by the Environmental Protection Agency.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE81bmIyR0lsLVpmdmxOWV9MU0pueHhBeWZPUjlJeHBRYmFvMUNRbXdBUEt3RFpuNDlXcDlqcUl1VVpoQVRaeno4NHZ2aXVWblRxczQ3ZWpBaFJiX2pKMEg2aVRNWUFVeTJ5SkxR?oc=5), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261125-us-army-to-detonate-stockpile-of-unstable-bomb-making-chemicals-in-iowa) reported that the US military planned to detonate thousands of pounds of unstable and degraded bomb-making chemicals in Iowa.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-army-to-detonate-unstable-lead-based-explosives-in-iowa/a-80043319?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the US Army stated a controlled blast is the safest way to deal with explosive chemicals that began crystallising in storage at a munitions depot in Iowa.

[Military Times](https://www.militarytimes.com/news/2026/11/25/army-conducts-controlled-detonation-of-lead-based-explosives-stockpile-in-iowa/) reported that the U.S. government carried out its planned detonation of an aging stockpile of lead-based explosives.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/us-army-detonates-toxic-lead-stockpile-in-iowa-amid-backlash?traffic_source=rss), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/25/video-shows-massive-explosion-as-us-army-destroys-entire-stockpile-of-lead-azide), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261125-us-army-detonates-lead-explosives-iowa-despite-community-backlash) reported that the US Army detonated nearly 5 tons of lead azide at an ammunition plant in Iowa.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/25/iowa-controlled-blast-lead-azide) reported that residents in the Iowa town were urged to shelter in place as the army prepared for the controlled blast.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cmvg29jkylp1o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the controlled detonation of 68 barrels of the volatile compound was necessary to prevent an unplanned explosion.

[Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/nasa-sends-p-3-orion-to-watch-u-s-armys-iowa-explosives-blast/) reported that NASA sent three research aircraft, including a P-3 Orion, to southeast Iowa as the U.S. Army prepares to detonate nearly 5 tons of unstable explosives.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/middletown-missouri-mississippi-river-ohio-toledo-b3091120.html) reported that the U.S. Army plans to detonate the nation's entire stockpile of unstable lead azide in a small Iowa town.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/iowa-lead-azide-detonation-health-officials-issue-urgent-safety-advisory-ahead-of-army-s-planned-blast-101795572542124.html) reported that the Illinois Department of Public Health urged residents near the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant to stay indoors as the US Army prepares to detonate lead azide.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/iowa-missouri-detonation-maps-b3091075.html) reported that federal officials warned pregnant women and children to evacuate the area amid fears of lead exposure as new maps showed a toxic cloud spreading to a second state.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/us/iowa-ammunition-plant-lead-explosion-middletown.html) reported that residents of Middletown are taping up their doors ahead of an Army facility explosion.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQVjR6dzVHRXVCTmdZYmkyOVRtcmt4TUNqVnZmSk9mNzdjUUNHWHJRWms0a3pvUXZhR1pfVGFDTlFPbHhvbmJuZVFRWUhROGRxczB6UTdoam5jS2ZtY3g5TGRWYV8waGR4UFlRUHN4NWlsVGdMREFfY1E4dzliYmFlV2dveFN5bV9UdkRaMXlJMG5xRXI4MkE?oc=5) reported that the US Army will detonate a 5-ton stockpile of lead azide.

reports.text: [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/28/adeleke-begins-second-term-unveils-industrialisation-job-creation-agenda/) reported that Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke began his second term and unveiled an industrialisation and job creation agenda.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/adeleke-sworn-in-for-second-term-pledges-economic-transformation-industrial-growth/) reported that Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke officially took the oath of office for his second term and pledged economic transformation and industrial growth.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/27/adelekes-second-term-mandate-defining-milestone-for-osuns-devt-says-adigun/) reported that Sammya Nigeria Limited CEO Adigun Sammy Oreoluwa described Governor Ademola Adeleke's second-term mandate as a defining milestone for Osun's development.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/adeleke-takes-oath-for-second-term-as-osun-governor/) reported that Vice-President Kashim Shettima, former Osun Governor Bisi Akande, and former Senate President Bukola Saraki attended Ademola Adeleke's second-term inauguration.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adeleke-takes-oath-for-second-term-unveils-power-industrialisation-blueprint/) reported that Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke was sworn in for a second term in office at the Osogbo Town Stadium and unveiled a power and industrialisation blueprint.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/27/adeleke-sworn-in-for-second-term-promises-economic-transformation/) reported that Governor Ademola Adeleke of Osun and his deputy, Kola Adewusi, were sworn in for a second term in office.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/ssouth-west/928468-adeleke-sworn-in-for-second-term-as-osun-governor.html) reported that Mr Adeleke was sworn in following his re-election victory in the 15 August governorship election where he defeated his closest challenger.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/27/osun-ipac-urges-adeleke-to-appoint-competent-cabinet-reduce-aides-recruit-teachers/) reported that the Osun State Chapter of the Inter-Party Advisory Council congratulated Governor Ademola Adeleke on his inauguration and urged him to appoint a competent cabinet, reduce aides, and recruit teachers.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/police-deploy-2500-officers-for-adelekes-2nd-term-inauguration/) reported that the Police Command in Osun deployed 2,500 personnel for the second-term inauguration of Governor Ademola Adeleke and Deputy Governor Kola Adewusi in Osogbo.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/inauguration-security-adeleke-orders-police-crackdown-as-armed-nurtw-thugs-storm-osogbo/) reported that tension mounted in Osogbo ahead of Governor Ademola Adeleke's second-term inauguration after intelligence reports of armed thugs.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/osun-ossiec-uniosun-four-commissions-spared-in-adelekes-cabinet-shake-up/) reported that the Osun State Government spared the electoral commission, state university, and four other commissions in a cabinet shake-up.

reports.text: [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196219) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he does not know if Russian President Vladimir Putin will participate in the G20 meeting in Florida next month.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7189613) reported that US President Donald Trump published photos with Russian and Chinese leaders and described them as friends and great powers.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203771/%D9%84%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%B4%D9%89-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85-%D9%84-%D9%83%D9%84%D9%81%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A2%D8%AE%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%86/) reported that Europe fears bearing the cost of settlements drafted by others following the trilateral summit in Shenzhen.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203709/%D9%82%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%AE%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%86%D9%88%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A3%D8%B2%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9/) reported that the summit between Trump, Xi, and Putin addresses issues including the New START treaty, nuclear armament, Iran, the Strait of Hormuz, and the trade and technology war between Washington and Beijing.

[Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%aa%d8%b1%d8%a7%d9%85%d8%a8-%d9%88%d8%a8%d9%88%d8%aa%d9%8a%d9%86-%d9%88%d8%b4%d9%8a-%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%89-%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%88%d9%84%d8%a9-%d9%88%d8%a7%d8%ad%d8%af%d8%a9-%d9%87%d9%84-%d9%8a%d8%aa) reported that US President Donald Trump held separate meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC forum.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190553/%D9%82%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%B2%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AB%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%BA-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A7%D8%AE%D8%AA%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A5%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%83) reported that the Shenzhen trilateral summit features US, Russian, and Chinese leaders facing the test of reshaping the international order.

reports.text: [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/mujeres-marchan-en-25n-recriminan-falta-de-seguridad-y-justicia/) reported that hundreds of women marched in CDMX on 25N to recriminate the lack of security and justice regarding rising violence against them.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/marcha-del-25n-en-cdmx-reune-a-500-mujeres-secgob-y-ssc-reportan-saldo-blanco/) reported that capital authorities and the Secgob and SSC reported a peaceful outcome with 500 women at the 25N march in CDMX, noting only an isolated incident at a CNDH building.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/cdmx-asumira-la-dirigencia-de-los-centros-de-justicia-para-las-mujeres-33310496) reported that CDMX will assume leadership of Justice Centers for Women to consolidate integrated care models.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/mujeres-ingresan-al-perimetro-de-un-inmueble-durante-marcha-del-25n-en-el-centro-historico-de-cdmx-33313786) reported that protesters tried to break the door of a building on Republica de Cuba 60 during a March 25 march in CDMX.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/marcha-25n-en-cdmx-mujeres-protestan-contra-violencia-e-impunidad-en-feminicidios-33310108) reported that women protested against violence and impunity in feminicides during the 25N march in CDMX.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/25n-brugada-anuncia-construccion-de-nuevos-centros-de-justicia-para-mujeres-en-cdmx-preve-crear-al-menos-16/) reported that Mayor Clara Brugada announced the planned construction of 16 new justice centers for women in CDMX.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/marcha-25n-en-cdmx-ruta-horario-y-orden-de-contingentes-para-este-miercoles-25-de-noviembre-toma-nota/) reported that a march in CDMX is scheduled with attendee gathering at 15:30 hours and official departure of contingents at 16:00 hours.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/licencia-permanente-desde-cuando-y-en-que-horario-operara-el-nuevo-macromodulo-de-la-magdalena-mixiuhca-toma-nota/) reported that the capital government announced the opening of a new macromodule in Magdalena Mixiuhca due to high demand.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/saturan-modulos-por-licencia-permanente/) reported that hundreds of drivers formed lines for permanent driver license applications without appointments in CDMX, causing tokens to sell out and service to end earlier than scheduled.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/semovi-habilita-tres-modulos-para-tramitar-licencia-permanente-sin-cita-en-cdmx-toma-nota/) reported that Semovi enabled three modules to process permanent driver licenses without appointments in CDMX, operating Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 14:00 and 15:00 to 17:00, and Saturday and Sunday from 9:00 to 14:00.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/licencia-permanente-en-cdmx-abren-tres-modulos-sin-cita-consulta-horarios-y-ubicaciones-33213021) reported that three modules without appointments were opened in CDMX for permanent driver license applications until December 31 according to the Mobility Secretariat.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/tramita-tu-licencia-permanente-en-cdmx-durante-noviembre-de-2026-revisa-requisitos-y-acude-sin-cita/) reported on requirements and walk-in locations for processing the permanent driver license in CDMX during November 2026.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/25/russian-strikes-kill-seven-in-ukraine-as-kyiv-hits-three-refineries), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-kill-9-injure-59-across-ukraine-over-past-day-halt-power-generation-at-thermal-power-plant/) reported that Russian drone attacks killed seven people across six Ukrainian regions, hitting a Naftogaz gas production facility, a DTEK thermal power plant, and power networks.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91160) reported that the Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant lost its external electricity supply after a Russian attack.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064551/) reported that Russian attacks caused new power outages in five Ukrainian oblasts, and the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant lost external power for the 17th time.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064562/) reported that a massive Russian strike severely damaged equipment at a thermal power plant operated by DTEK, forcing a shutdown.

reports.text: [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe-sees-new-protests-over-rising-costs-inequality-and-public-services) reported that Sunday marked the third consecutive day of protests across Europe following demonstrations from Portugal to France.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/thousands-take-to-streets-in-portugal-france-and-spain-over-rising-living-costs) reported that thousands of people demonstrated in Portugal and France calling for higher wages and affordable housing.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/thousands-protest-overs-prices-education-military-spending-in-france-and-europe), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/thousands-protest-across-europe-over-living-costs-and-housing?traffic_source=rss), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-students-and-unions-unite-for-sixth-weekend-of-protests-across-france) reported that thousands of demonstrators took to the streets across France and Europe for protests over the cost of living, housing, and government policies.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNT203dWpPR19PY3FGeGlGWkNqRklXMDA0cEtFTXBoY21LbVhhaEVNNzVXWTJfOUhUOURwUVVtQXBVazBOdjRjNmVnRktLOGxHam9tZ3ZneGp3bXNfQ2lHOU0yY0I2WF9qdnJxSkNrVm1Pc0REblNaMXJxRHZqRnpDcmY5MEhOdkNaeUZMUVFQYUxDUXRKbmhmckRvQnBHZUlXclh6ZEJJSUJQYll3SUNfdGJ5WQ?oc=5) reported that student protests were held across Europe with demands ranging from school funding to climate action.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/21/gen-z-protests-sweep-europe-over-wars-rising-costs-and-climate?traffic_source=rss) reported that thousands of Gen Z protesters rallied across 25 European countries over living costs, military spending, and climate.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/protestas-en-europa-la-militarizacion-y-el-costo-de-la-vida-vuelven-a-sacar-a-las-personas-a-las-calles-este-fin-de-semana-3602870) reported that Spain, Italy, and Austria experienced a new wave of demonstrations over militarization and the cost of living.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/young-demonstrators-take-to-streets-across-europe-in-widespread-protests/) reported that young Europeans poured into the streets from Milan to Berlin and London to protest high living costs, military spending, and climate issues.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/20/pelo-nosso-futuro-jovens-protestam-de-forma-coordenada-na-europa-contra-custo-de-vida-condicoes-de-ensino-e-gastos-militares.ghtml) reported that students and young workers took to the streets in over 20 European countries in coordinated protests.

reports.text: [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/24/fisioterapia-respiratoria-exercicios-motores-e-visitas-de-carlos-e-michelle-a-rotina-de-bolsonaro-na-uti.ghtml) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro follows a routine of respiratory and motor physiotherapy, medical evaluations, and family visits in the ICU.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/expresidente-de-brasil-jair-bolsonaro-es-diagnosticado-con-neumonia-y-seguira-en-cuidados-intensivos-esto-es-lo-que-se-sabe-sobre-su-estado-de-salud-3603546) reported that Bolsonaro was diagnosed with bilateral bronchoaspiration pneumonia and will remain in intensive care after experiencing chills, pain, and vomiting.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/bolsonaro-continua-hospitalizado-prevision-alta-paso-noche-dolores_1795372418) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro remains hospitalized without a discharge date but spent the night without pain.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/22/bolsonaro-segue-na-uti-e-sem-previsao-de-alta-diz-boletim-medico.ghtml) reported that former president Jair Bolsonaro remains in the DF Star hospital ICU in Brasília without a discharge date according to a medical bulletin.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324608-moraes-autoriza-filhos-visitarem-bolsonaro-em-internacao.html) reported that Moraes authorized Carlos, Jair Renan, Laura, and the stepdaughter of former president Jair Bolsonaro to visit him in the hospital without mobile devices or other electronic equipment.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/21/lex-presidente-del-brasile-jair-bolsonaro-ricoverato-in-terapia-intensiva_839ca9c3-f07e-4473-a141-0031f216f432.html) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to the intensive care unit and is clinically stable, conscious, alert, and breathing spontaneously.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/jair-bolsonaro-esta-internado-en-terapia-intensiva-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-y-podria-ser-nid21112026/) reported that a tomography scan detected an almost total small bowel obstruction and doctors are evaluating a possible new surgery.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532512/Iran-has-no-reason-to-reopen-Hormuz-US-congressman), a state-media outlet, reported that US Democratic Congressman Richard Ojeda stated the United States cannot portray itself as the gendarme and condemned attacks on schools and hospitals in Iran.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/iran-orders-tighter-closure-hormuz/), a state-media outlet, reported that Army Commander Major General Amir Hatami ordered the navy chief to intensify the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/iran-rules-out-talks-with-us-until-its-seven-conditions-are-met/article71739875.ece) reported that three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86330981/No-negotiation-before-Iran-s-seven-conditions-are-met-Ghalibaf), [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532510/Qalibaf-rules-out-action-or-negotiations-until-Iran-s-seven-conditions) reported that Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that no negotiations will take place until seven conditions set by Iran are met.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/South-Korea-Asks-Qatar-for-Priority-LNG-Once-Hormuz-Reopens.html) reported that South Korea asked Qatar to prioritize liquefied natural gas supply to the Asian nation when traffic through the Strait of Hormuz normalizes.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-iran-says-reopening-hormuz-not-difficult-if-us-accepts-tehrans-conditions/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said that reopening the Strait of Hormuz was not difficult if the United States accepted Tehran's conditions.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/usiran-talks-araghchi-says-hormuz-reopening-is-not-difficult-as-qatar-steps-up-mediation-efforts-101795301397814.html) reported that Abbas Araghchi stated the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is not difficult while Qatar steps up mediation efforts.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222921), a state-media outlet, reported that the foreign minister stated the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is off the table until Iran's demands are met, and a Qatari delegation held talks in Tehran.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328562/Enemy-spy-drone-downed-off-Iran-s-southern-coast-IRGC), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249585/IRGC-says-downed-yet-another-US-reconnaissance-drone), a state-media outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps announced the interception and destruction of an enemy spy and reconnaissance drone off the coast of Bushehr in the northern Persian Gulf.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328309/Iran-s-seven-conditions-basis-for-reopening-Strait-of-Hormuz), a state-media outlet, reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding is no longer on the table and Iran's 'Seven Conditions' proposal forms the basis for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and negotiations.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/irans-irgc-downs-us-drone-over-hormuz-as-efforts-to-end-war-remain-stalled?traffic_source=rss), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584857/iran-hits-58th-us-drone-sets-seven-hormuz-conditions/) reported that Iran announced seven conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and rejected any transfer of enriched uranium abroad.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249559/Iran-shoots-down-58th-US-MQ-9-drone-over-Hormuz-IRGC) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps announced the destruction of a 58th US-made military MQ-9 drone in the skies of the Strait of Hormuz.

reports.text: [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPV2k5ZE4zX1RNVDhlc3RhSzRLNVEzVF9GSm9WaEd1SzFxZllTMUt4a3VwX3M1eG91b1pyLXVNZFpKZ0VoaUVQYnZCYk8zTHZPSFBsdUFuZnZTU1VxLVp1a2JROVdCNVZ3VTB5eTJRVHV3MzhHckZuY1RvWThqR194VDNhbmhqUjQtaTRRRWxubUpFUFRzOWh4MDhDOA?oc=5) reported that rescuers faced wet and dark conditions in a flooded Indonesian mine where 16 died and 10 are missing.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/at-least-13-dead-in-indonesia-gold-mine-flood-as-rescue-efforts-intensify?traffic_source=rss) reported that rescue workers faced tough conditions with narrow, deep, and slippery excavation pits and minimal lighting.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/indonesia-illegal-gold-mine-flood-kills-13-with-13-miners-missing/CGRCWQTO75A67JBG5B45LS57S4/) reported that the mine was flooded when a nearby river overflowed after a torrential downpour.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmde1zr0nlyro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/indonesia-disaster-13-dead-13-still-trapped-after-rain-floods-illegal-gold-mine/articleshow/136183638.cms) reported that 13 people died and another 13 remain trapped or missing after rain flooded an illegal gold mine in Indonesia.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/16-dead-10-missing-after-floods-hit-illegal-gold-mine-in-indonesia-search-and-rescue-underway-101795677902881.html) reported that 16 people died and 10 are missing after floods hit an illegal gold mine in Indonesia.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/lifestyle-culture/article/3375934/deadly-factory-fire-indonesia-renews-lack-safety-enforcement-fears) reported that labor advocates and building experts warned that inconsistent enforcement of Indonesia's workplace safety regulations creates risks for factory workers.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642434/death-toll-from-indonesia-gold-mine-collapse-rises-to-13) reported that the death toll from the gold mine collapse in West Java rose to 13 as rescue operations continue.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-mine-flooding-death-toll-missing-6583801) reported that the death toll in the Indonesian mine flooding rose to 13, with 13 still missing as authorities cited narrow, slippery, and dark conditions inside the shaft.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/9-dead-17-believed-trapped-after-flood-hits-an-unauthorized-gold-mine-in-indonesia-3014020), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/indonesia-flood-hits-unauthorised-gold-mine-in-deaths-people-trapped-rescue-operations-101795618534786.html) reported that rescue workers in West Java recovered nine bodies after a flood struck an unauthorized gold mine.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/rescuers-search-for-dozens-trapped-in-flooded-indonesia-gold-mine?traffic_source=rss), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/25/world/asia/indonesia-miners-trapped.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/29-miners-feared-trapped-after-heavy-rain-floods-unauthorised-gold-mine-in-indonesia-101795598587466.html) reported that heavy rain caused the Ciseureuh River to overflow into the mine shaft, trapping dozens of workers underground.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/146f151199bf) reported that rescue teams deployed pumps to drain water from the flooded mine.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-25-indonesian-rescuers-recover-3-bodies-in-search-for-26-trapped-miners-agency-says/) reported that Indonesian rescue teams recovered three bodies in their search for 26 workers believed to be trapped in a flooded mine.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-25/miners-trapped-underground-in-west-java-indonesia/107426126), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/indonesian-rescuers-searching-for-possibly-dozens-trapped-in-mine/article71741002.ece), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-search-dozens-trapped-mine-workers-6580561) reported that Indonesian rescuers are searching for miners stuck in a 100-metre-deep mine after heavy rain inundated access.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/death-toll-from-indonesia-factory-fire-rises-to-26/SY2QIK3CAZEI7NGZ3Y4RIBK5E4/) reported that rescuers retrieved two more bodies from the factory on Tuesday.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNeWdTQ2hjc1YtUzVWamFRbmNuR1hWdTZHNGxDTkNuTFludi0tb1pyVk03bnZ5Z0NWS0VjR3JMZzRPeDgtNWZpTU83Y2ZxQ2ZPbE1KMHEtMnc5ajlkNHI2SW1na3N1cU9UNTYyd01QdHNONjdDRHU3N1NSLXQ0cENXcUEwSHlOTExuOEdXVUJjaUdaU1hzZ3dBZkxBNA?oc=5) reported that most victims of the Indonesia factory fire died trying to reach an emergency exit, according to rescuers.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/asia/indonesia-factory-fire-deaths-missing.html) reported that the death toll from the Indonesia factory fire rose to 26 with dozens unaccounted for, and police opened a criminal investigation.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/asia/indonesia-factory-fire.html) reported that dozens are unaccounted for after a fire ripped through a candy factory in Indonesia following a blaze that broke out on Saturday and raged for hours.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/444771/indonesia-probes-factory-fire-that-left-34-people-missing) reported that the Ministry of Manpower has deployed an Occupational Health and Safety team to investigate the factory fire.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/444739/sar-team-recovers-26-body-bags-from-bantenfactory-fire), a state-media outlet, reported that a joint search and rescue team recovered 26 body bags from a candy factory fire in Serang, Banten.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/deadly-fire-at-confectionery-factory-in-indonesia-kills-24-as-rescuers-search-for-dozens-still-missing-13615577) reported that a deadly fire at a confectionery factory in Indonesia killed 24 people with about 30 others still missing.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/23/indonesia-rescuers-recover-24-body-bags-from-burnt-out-factory/) reported that rescue workers recovered 24 body bags from a fire that gutted a confectionery factory near Jakarta.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNeWxmUHVQSmZGb3dYUl9UZzNOXzlEcW1hcUFTNlZzY0xNS3ZySEE5bzhTYW94eFJJTmN1RnVqLWZXeFJtUUVqUmpkaTNoS19vWlcwWHZza3hqanhPX2pGTjc2czRONGswbEJWT1Fjalh2eTNYTWJ0RjlWUnFld3JKbnUtaUpIZ1Q3RWdVQUtvSXdPajQ1cG1IejZZSQ?oc=5) reported that Indonesian rescuers are racing to find 34 missing workers after a deadly candy factory fire.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585581/indonesia-factory-fire-kills-24-as-rescuers-search-for-dozens-missing/), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/indonesia-banten-factory-fire-death-toll-people-missing/article71733448.ece) reported that Indonesian authorities confirmed 24 people died in a weekend factory fire near Jakarta while rescuers search for dozens missing.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/indonesian-police-remove-24-body-bags-from-factory-fire-site?traffic_source=rss) reported that Indonesian police removed 24 body bags from a factory fire site while authorities searched for missing workers.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/05756b835278) reported that an Indonesia factory fire killed 24 people as rescue teams search for 30 missing individuals.

reports.text: [The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/437442/in-kano-tinubu-has-the-machine-but-kwankwaso-has-the-crowd-ahead-of-nigeria-polls/) reported that the political machine that handed Nigeria's second-largest electorate to the opposition in 2023 has split in two ahead of the presidential vote.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/we-didnt-petition-kwankwaso-before-efcc-kano-govt/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743696-kano-government-strong-claim-kwankwaso/) reported that the Kano State Government denied petitioning Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso before the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611270596.html) reported that the Kano State Government dismissed allegations by former Governor Rabiu Kwankwaso accusing Governor Abba Yusuf of instigating the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/public-office-is-transient-kwankwaso-opens-up-on-relationship-with-kano-gov/) reported that Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso spoke out on his strained relationship with Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743582-breaking-how-kano-gov-plots-bring-using-efcc-kwankwaso-cries-out/) reported that Rabiu Kwankwaso raised allegations against Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf involving the EFCC.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/you-betrayed-43-year-trust-kwankwaso-tells-governor-yusuf-alleges-efcc-vendetta/) reported that NDC vice presidential candidate Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso accused Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf of a betrayal of trust and an EFCC vendetta.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-kwankwaso-accuses-kano-governor-of-plot-to-tarnish-his-image/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso accused Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf of orchestrating a plot to tarnish his image.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/kano-gov-determined-to-tarnish-my-image-through-efcc-kwankwaso/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Kano government denied involvement in the claims.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kano-govt-to-kwankwaso-stop-dragging-yusuf-into-efcc-troubles/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-govt-denies-yusufs-involvement-in-efcc-probe-of-kwankwaso/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/928415-kano-govt-dismisses-kwankwasos-efcc-allegations-against-governor-yusuf.html) reported that the Kano State Government asked former Governor Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso to stop linking Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf to his EFCC troubles and dismissed allegations of instigating the probe.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/i-didnt-politicise-it-gov-yusuf-narrates-how-wife-left-kano-govt-house/) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf stated Zainab was previously married before they got together.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/crq8l01l4vx5o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742715-kano-how-wife-governor-yusuf-speaks-out/) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf broke his silence on his marital crisis and the separation from his wife.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-gov-shares-more-details-on-wifes-reported-divorce-proceedings/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/divorce-crisis-how-my-wife-left-government-house-kano-gov/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf provided details regarding the breakdown of his marriage to his wife Zainab.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/divorce-crisis-how-my-wife-left-government-house-kano-gov/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Kano Governor Abba Yusuf stated his wife left Government House and filed for divorce in an Abuja court after about 20 years of marriage.

reports.text: [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/dodik-otkrio-kada-ce-biti-formirana-vlada-republike-srpske/r0bfcdg) reported that SNSD leader Milorad Dodik announced that the Government of Republika Srpska will be elected on December 8.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/igor-dodik-odgovorio-na-kritike-i-najavio-razgovore-s-opozicijom/) reported that Igor Dodik responded to criticism and announced talks with the opposition regarding the formation of the new Republika Srpska government.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/milorad-dodik-cestitao-sinu-igor-je-moj-ponos-moja-pobjeda-i-dijete-snsd-a-tako-je-naucen/261122133) reported that SNSD leader Milorad Dodik congratulated his son Igor Dodik after he was proposed as premier-designate for the new government of Republika Srpska.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vukanovic-srbi-dobili-novu-dinastiju-dodik-ostaje-da-se-vidi-da-li-ce-i-princeza/q2455bd) reported that Justice and Order List leader Nebojša Vukanović commented critically on the nomination of Igor Dodik as premier-designate.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/bih/republika-srpska/1089938/danas-pada-odluka-ko-ce-biti-novi-premijer-republike-srpske) reported that opposition representatives emphasized they will act as a constructive opposition and alternative to the new government.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Igor-Dodik-Zelim-saradnju-sa-svima-i-trazim-odgovornost-za-propuste/993652), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/igor-dodik-ja-sam-svjestan-da-moramo-mijenjati-sebe-narocito-mi-je-vazno-uspostaviti-saradnju-s-vladom-u-srbiji/261122071) reported that Igor Dodik accepted his nomination as premier-designate for the government of Republika Srpska and stated a need to cooperate with Serbia.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Cvijanoviceva-o-mandataru-Igor-Dodik-ce-unijeti-novu-energiju-i-ideje/993656) reported that Serb Member and Chairwoman of the BiH Presidency Željka Cvijanović stated Igor Dodik will bring new energy and ideas.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/vukanovic-smatra-da-je-igor-zelen-rs-je-postala-monarhija-a-srbi-su-dobili-novu-dinastiju-dodik/261122082) reported that opposition figure Nebojša Vukanović criticized the nomination, claiming the entity has become a monarchy.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Igor-Dodik-mandatar-za-sastav-nove-Vlade-Srpske/993650), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/igor-dodik-zvanicno-predlozen-za-mandatara-nove-vlade-republike-srpske/261122059) reported that Republika Srpska President Savo Minic proposed Igor Dodik as the mandate holder to form the new government of Srpska.
[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/oglasio-se-igor-dodik-potvrdio-da-ce-biti-premijer-republike-srpske/kcv6htm) reported that Igor Dodik stated he accepts the mandate with full responsibility.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/oglasio-se-milorad-dodik-nakon-vesti-da-ce-njegov-sin-igor-biti-premijer-republike/frmwt58) reported that Milorad Dodik stated he has never been as proud as he is following the news.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/25/cia-and-us-intelligence-office-suffer-intrusion-exposing-unclassified-information?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that the Central Intelligence Agency and the US Office of the Director of National Intelligence discovered a computer intrusion that exposed unclassified information.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/cia-cyber-attack-dni-breach-fbi-b3090993.html) reported that the CIA system breach comes days after an FBI crime database was hacked.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/472842593948), a state-media outlet, reported that the attack targeted an open-source intelligence network aggregating public material, social media content, satellite imagery, and commercially purchased data.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/us/politics/spy-agencies-computer-network-breaches.html) reported that U.S. spy agencies suffered a breach of some unclassified information, affecting the C.I.A. and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-916018) reported that while compromised unclassified material was unclear, information at other government agencies was also believed to have been exposed.

[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261122002700315), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10945222) reported that the Korea Electric Power Corp. confirmed a data breach exposing personal information of approximately 1.52 million users.

reports.text: [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/27/cairo-mourns-31-victims-of-deadly-fuel-tanker-inferno-as-families-bid-farewell/) reported that grief and shock gripped Cairo's Waraq district as residents gathered to mourn victims of the fuel tanker inferno.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/27/funeral-prayers-held-for-31-victims-of-egypt-tanker-crash?traffic_source=rss) reported that funeral prayers were held at Cairo's Al-Azhar Mosque on Friday for 31 people killed when a vehicle collided with a tanker.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/egypt-calls-accountability-grow-after-fuel-tanker-crash) reported that public anger grew over Egypt's response following the deadly crash and explosion, demanding accountability from the Ministry of Transport.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/27/motorist-accused-of-causing-deadly-cairo-fuel-tanker-crash-arrested/) reported that Egyptian authorities arrested a driver accused of causing a fuel tanker to overturn on a ring road surrounding Cairo.
[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611270216.html) reported that the Rwandan embassy in Egypt extended condolences following a fuel tanker fire in Giza that killed 31 people.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/cairo-fuel-tanker-inferno-driver-suspect-held-after-explosion-left-31-dead/articleshow/136206334.cms) reported that a 21-year-old driver was detained after an overturned fuel tanker in Cairo ignited and resulted in 31 fatalities and 26 injuries.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/driver-of-car-suspected-of-causing-fuel-tanker-to-overturn-in-egypt-detained-13616933), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/egypt-detains-driver-over-cairo-fuel-tanker-fire-that-killed-31?traffic_source=rss) reported that Egyptian authorities detained a 21-year-old driver suspected of causing a fuel tanker to overturn in Egypt resulting in 31 deaths, with prosecutors ordering drug tests for the suspect.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNU2w0bC1tN2k4SU92bG9kc3U2U053dGZvZEh5WEs4U2IzRnVkRk9RdDlYSGZkekNQNy1WYmtKaHhWblI0U1F6SmxmVHJuWmhkRFJQV0xTaXRQRGFxUnd2b0tNMlNNZkszZy00cDNzazdNR1k4WElZTk5lSWNmR1dnQ1l1N2tCa1dtYmNoZmdZS21nd3NDVENDQ01XcDRCQXpocEpIeVhiMA?oc=5) reported that Egypt detained a driver suspected of causing a Cairo tanker crash that killed 31.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/egypt-arrests-man-suspected-of-causing-tanker-crash-fire-that-killed-31-3726032) reported that Egypt's Public Prosecution said a suspect admitted during questioning to causing the collision with a fuel tanker in Giza governorate.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/turkiye-extends-condolences-to-egypt-over-deadly-tanker-fire-3726028) reported that the Turkish Foreign Ministry shared Egypt's grief over a fuel tanker fire in Giza province that killed 31 people and injured 21 others.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/egypt-prosecutors-announce-arrest-man-over-deadly-truck-disaster) reported that Egyptian prosecutors announced the arrest of a man accused of causing a massive fire from an overturned fuel tanker on a highway.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/egypt-says-31-dead-in-cairo-fuel-truck-inferno-one-man-arrested/) reported that 31 people were killed in a Cairo fuel truck inferno and one man was arrested.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261126-31-killed-21-injured-in-fuel-tanker-fire-in-giza-egypt/) reported that at least 31 people were killed and 21 injured when a fuel tanker caught fire on Cairo’s Ring Road in the Al-Warraq area of Giza province.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/26/egypt-relatives-of-highway-fire-victims-wait-for-news-outside-giza-hospital/) reported that dozens of people gathered outside Giza’s Imbaba General Hospital waiting for news of relatives injured in the massive highway fire.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86333195/Iran-offers-condolences-over-deadly-fuel-tanker-fire-in-Egypt), an Iranian state-run outlet, reported that the Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson offered condolences to the Egyptian government and people over a fuel tanker fire.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/cairo-egypt-highway-fire_n_6b07d770e4b084fa2e174a79), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/26/wreckage-and-burnt-vehicles-as-fuel-tanker-fire-kills-31-on-cairo-highway) reported that a fuel tanker crash on Giza's Ring Road in Waraq caused a massive fire that killed at least 31 people and injured 21, leaving more than two dozen cars and motorcycles charred.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/at-least-30-killed-after-fuel-truck-overturns-in-egypt), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611260153.html) reported that at least 30 people were killed and 15 others injured after a vehicle transporting petroleum products overturned and burst into flames on a ring road in Egypt.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPTlNBNDBhWFE4d3h6MUo0cFJEVk84RjhUdGlqUDhVUU9FRTVfVVdCeHZLZ24yNzM0UmxjLWhlQVBDaWY5emxMOXRPYllLOWNHdjd0ODdhLWJOS2tmSGN6cS1kOE5WU0NnVU9jM1hVMWFMWFk5aWJsbzk0UU45STU2WUNnak8?oc=5) reported that at least 31 people died after a fuel tanker fire in Egypt.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/25/at-least-21-killed-after-tanker-explosion-near-cairo/) reported that at least 30 people were killed after a tanker explosion in Cairo.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10950356) reported that a crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a massive fire on a major highway surrounding Cairo, killing at least 31 people according to Egyptian authorities.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/31-killed-21-injured-after-fuel-truck-overturns-on-highway-egypt-news-giza-tunnel-fire-dramatic-visuals-of-cairo-fire-surface-101795657617926.html) reported that initial statements claimed 25 people were injured in the Cairo fuel truck fire, but that figure was later revised to 21.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261126-at-least-31-killed-in-cairo-fire-after-fuel-truck-overturns-on-busy-highway) reported that at least 31 people were killed and 15 injured when a fuel truck overturned and burst into flames on a busy highway in Cairo.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/25/deadly-truck-fire-is-latest-of-egypts-transport-disasters?traffic_source=rss) reported that a truck carrying gas cylinders caught fire near Cairo's Ring Road, killing and injuring dozens.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/1c78d3d25fb3) reported that the Egyptian health ministry stated the death toll from the Giza fuel tanker fire rose to 30 with 15 injured.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/world/1743347-egypt-fuel-tanker-crash-sparks-massive-highway-fire-killing-31-people/), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/africa/2026/11/25/at-least-31-killed-in-egypt-as-fuel-tanker-crash-ignites-huge-fire-near-cairo/) reported that at least 31 people were killed and 21 others injured after the fuel tanker overturned on a ring road in Cairo.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/25/at-least-30-killed-in-highway-fire-in-cairo-district) reported that at least 30 people were killed in a highway fire in a Cairo district after a fuel truck overturned.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/egypt-at-least-31-dead-after-fuel-truck-overturns-on-highway/a-80055175?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the accident on the Ring Road in Giza near Cairo left at least 31 dead.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/africa/dozens-of-people-killed-in-egypt-highway-blaze-after-vehicle-overturns-20261126-p61hdo.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the truck overturned when a high-voltage electricity cable fell in front of it.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/204343/%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%B6%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%88%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A8%D9%88%D9%86-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B2%D8%A9/), [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7194625) reported that civil protection forces in Egypt controlled a fire that broke out after a petroleum tanker collided near the Ring Road in the Warraq area of Giza, causing casualties.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7194609) reported that the Financial Regulatory Authority directed swift disbursement of compensation for the Ring Road accident victims under the Unified Insurance Law.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7194605) reported that TV presenter Ahmed Moussa stated victims died while attempting to rescue the petroleum tanker driver.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/egypt-fire-vehicle-flip-deaths-b3091723.html), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/at-least-30-killed-in-egypt-vehicle-fire-health-ministry-says?traffic_source=rss), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/at-least-30-killed-in-blaze-after-vehicle-overturns-in-egypt-health-ministry-says-3014042) reported that at least 30 people were killed and 15 injured in Egypt when a vehicle carrying petroleum products overturned and caught fire on a highway.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046527/7-killed-2-injured-as-stone-laden-truck-overturns-onto-mini-truck-in-bahawalpur), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585679/stone-laden-truck-overturns-onto-parked-mini-truck-in-bahawalpur-killing-seven/) reported that seven people were killed and two others injured when a stone-laden truck overturned onto a stationary mini-truck in Bahawalpur’s Uch Sharif.

reports.text: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/science/video/2026/nov/27/is-russia-about-to-send-a-nuclear-weapon-into-space-video) reported that Science Editor Ian Sample discussed reports that Russia might be planning to launch a satellite with a nuclear weapon onboard.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/26/what-would-be-the-fallout-from-a-nuclear-armed-satellite-detonated-into-space) reported that reports indicate Russia has assembled a nuclear-enabled satellite named Sputnik-S that could be launched in 60 days.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Geopolitics/Europe/Could-Russias-Secret-Space-Weapon-Knock-Out-Starlink.html) reported that reports emerged that Russia is planning to launch a nuclear-armed satellite named Sputnik-S into space in the coming weeks.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/25/europe-tonight-russia-reportedly-prepares-nuclear-satellite-launch) reported that former NATO spokesperson Jamie Shea discussed reports of Russia preparing a nuclear satellite launch and its potential impact on satellite systems.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxOeFZfcUtRZnRGWmhSQnJhbDNWeE9vNFI2clBnS1NobkVNNTRYeGFlM1d3VzFQZEZoMS1BRHVRUG9kR1RuV1Q3eFZrcTk5QWZvOG00N2YzaVY3eXpHSTBZRUJETEs1YUhuZlVRSGQ4UHMtOHJ4eGV5eXIzNHI0Yng4Mzg1M19MN2N6bUVCQlQ4Q0VyWWpUTVBiSmpPTkZxbGoyRkhWRnd4SzcwOXREQzJZMjMzRE10X1VHSlhFRHZoZTdUTFBL?oc=5), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/24/russia-may-launch-nuke-laden-satellite-by-years-end-german-report-warns/) reported that Western intelligence and a German report warn Russia could launch a nuclear-armed satellite by December or the end of the year.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/what-happens-if-a-nuclear-weapon-explodes-in-space/a-80025827?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-sputnik-s-space-nuclear-weapons-reports-starfish-prime-emp/33905092.html) reported that reports have emerged regarding Russia potentially preparing to launch a nuclear satellite into orbit, prompting analysis of radiation effects on satellites.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/nato-chief-says-defense-pledge-covers-space-as-russia-reportedly-readies-nuclear-satellite-3725924) reported that German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated reports of a possible Russian nuclear-armed satellite deployment are concerning.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064317/) reported that NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte reaffirmed the alliance's commitment to protecting its members against threats in space.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/medvedev-says-russia-has-right-in-some-cases-obligation-to-use-nuclear-weapons-3725901) reported that Russian Security Council Deputy Chairman Dmitry Medvedev stated Moscow has not seen a direct necessity to use nuclear weapons so far in the Ukraine war.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9x2er1ry2mzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/24/world/politics/russia-nuclear-space-weapon/) reported that allies stated Russia may launch a nuclear space weapon next month that could lead to the rapid destruction or degradation of thousands of satellites.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915803) reported that NATO believes Russia is ready to launch a nuclear-armed satellite, according to German media.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/23/kremlin-dismisses-reports-about-alleged-nuclear-armed-satellite-launch-a94349) reported that the Kremlin dismissed reports about an alleged nuclear-armed satellite launch called Sputnik-S planned for as early as December 2026.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3375522/nato-vows-space-defence-after-russia-nuclear-satellite-report) reported that NATO chief Mark Rutte stated the alliance would defend against threats in space when asked about the German media reports.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-preparing-to-put-nuclear-weapons-in-space-german-media-investigation-claims/) reported that a German media investigation claimed the Sputnik-S has been fully assembled and in storage in the Moscow region for several years.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/23/pearl-harbor-in-space-russia-plans-to-launch-nuclear-warhead-say-german-reports/) reported that leaked intelligence regarding Russian plans to launch a nuclear warhead will add to European anxiety over widening threats.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-satellite-nuclear-weapon-space-b3089665.html) reported that the Pentagon warned a nuclear detonation in space could disrupt communications and security on Earth.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90920) reported that western intelligence and military officials believe Russia could launch a nuclear-armed satellite before the end of 2026 according to a joint German investigation.

reports.text: [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kwankwaso-backing-obi-to-build-2031-presidential-support-daniel-bwala/) reported that Daniel Bwala, Special Adviser to President Bola Tinubu on Policy Communication, alleged that Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso is backing Peter Obi to build support for a 2031 presidential run.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-ndc-campaign-council-disowns-ok-movement-faction/) reported that the National Campaign Council of the Nigeria Democratic Congress disowned a faction of the OK Movement led by John Ozyl Ughulu.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndc-dismisses-ok-movements-withdrawal-as-fake-decampment/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-ndc-dismisses-ok-movements-exit-as-sponsored-distraction/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress dismissed the OK Movement's withdrawal of support from Peter Obi's 2027 campaign as a fake decampment and sponsored distraction.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ok-movement-announces-withdrawal-of-support-for-obi-kwankwaso-ndc/) reported that the OK Movement withdrew its political structures, campaign, and mobilization support from the NDC presidential ticket of Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ndc-dismisses-ok-movements-withdrawal-of-support-for-obi/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress dismissed the withdrawal of support for its presidential candidate, Peter Obi, and his running mate, Senator Rabiu Kwankwaso.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/breaking-ok-movement-withdraws-support-for-obi-kwankwaso-ndc/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/27/ok-movement-pulls-nationwide-structures-out-of-obis-ndc/) reported that the OK Movement withdrew its support for NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi and its ward, council, and state mobilisation machinery while beginning talks with other parties ahead of the 2027 elections.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/ndc-obi-disown-ok-movement-faction-after-withdrawal-of-campaign-support/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1743654-obi-kwankwaso-suffer-major-setback-movement-opts-out/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress and Peter Obi's presidential camp rejected the authority of a faction of the OK Movement to withdraw support.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/shot-edo-ndc-supporter-narrates-ordeal/) reported that an NDC supporter, Aimionkhale Michael, narrated how suspected political thugs shot him at close range in Edo State.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/thugs-attack-peter-obis-convoy-in-benin-we-dont-support-violence-apc/) reported that the APC stated it does not support violence following an attack on an NDC convoy and campaign office in Benin where Peter Obi was expected to speak.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/one-injured-as-gunmen-attack-obi-supporters-in-benin/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that one person was shot in the thigh when gunmen attacked Peter Obi supporters near Benin airport in Edo State.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/edo-ndc-rally-shooting-police-launch-manhunt-for-attackers/) reported that police launched a manhunt after a gunman attack during a Nigeria Democratic Congress rally in Benin left a victim injured.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/five-bullets-ndc-supporter-recounts-attack-on-omo-ageges-campaign-team-in-delta/) reported that an NDC supporter recounted being shot five times during an attack on Ovie Omo-Agege's campaign team in Delta.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-we-dont-want-them-to-rig-us-out-peter-obi-tells-edo-voters/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress presidential candidate Peter Obi urged voters in Edo to remain at their polling places to prevent vote rigging.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/gunmen-strike-ndc-again-attack-peter-obis-supporters-at-benin-airport-days-after-delta-killings/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/breaking-gunmen-attack-peter-obis-convoy-in-edo/) reported that gunmen attacked the presidential campaign convoy and supporters of Peter Obi, the Nigeria Democratic Congress candidate, in Benin City.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/south-south-regional/928011-peter-obi-kwankwaso-visit-family-of-slain-ndc-supporter-in-delta.html) reported that Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso visited the family of a supporter killed during earlier campaign violence in Delta State.

reports.text: [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/26/bangladesh-garment-workers-clash-with-police-over-low-wages?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bangladeshi garment workers clashed with police after a 36 percent minimum wage increase fell short of their demands.
[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bangladesh-workers-reject-minimum-wage/), a state-run outlet, reported that at least 320 garment factories remained shut amid labor protests.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1587387/bangladesh-workers-protest-despite-36-wage-increase/) reported that garment workers clashed with police in Bangladesh despite securing a minimum wage increase a day earlier.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/video/2026/nov/26/bangladeshi-garment-workers-clash-with-police-during-protests-video) reported that Bangladeshi garment workers in Gazipur protested over stagnant minimum wages and rising living costs by blocking roads and setting fires.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxQemRiN3hJQ0RYZkhZSi14QkplRnhIVC1SNHAtS0pYM2dBUlpuMExGTWxVVTFzN3JFX0ZSYXVQeTJEaGNtNl9rRDRDcnFYbExFeFRpWjNmRW9RLXZ6eGppaUZLbFdBVV9VeXBTZ0FqNmhQb21FS0R4a3hxVmFLeXo5a2EwZnZfcC1leFg3aUo3aUIzR0pIZnRSQUc5QjhsbjlKcTJjYnJkRzRtaTJhWW5KTDB4Z2VZRXNTVk85Tjc0NThJMGlCZG9n?oc=5) reported that police used tear gas to disperse fresh Bangladesh garment worker protests.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/police-quell-bangladesh-garment-worker-protests-after-pay-hike) reported that police in Bangladesh fired tear gas and stun grenades to disperse protesting garment workers attempting to block a major highway over wage demands.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642352/bangladesh-raises-minimum-wage-by-36) reported that Bangladesh raised the minimum wage by 36% to 17,000 taka, falling short of worker demands and triggering clashes.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/649348-bangladesh-garment-workers-protest/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/bangladesh-garment-wage-hike-sparks-fresh-clashes-near-dhaka) reported that fresh clashes erupted between police and garment workers on the outskirts of Dhaka following the approval of the new minimum wage structure.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bangladesh-raises-garment-workers-minimum-wage-by-36-to-17-000-taka-after-weeks-of-protests-101795577923884.html), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/bangladesh-raises-garment-workers-minimum-wage-after-protests-6580411), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-garment-workers-win-36-wage-rise/article71741049.ece) reported that Bangladesh raised the minimum monthly wage for garment workers by 36 percent to 17,000 taka following weeks of protests.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxOSk9tZVJkeVE3S3BJa0RXYlBQTWl5b3hndUYzNTUtSHRKUjUwTmI0dGN2clF6MUFRNms5djczY1FYeWhBWk41WW1jZFp1Z214ZlIwb1hzNUg0Tzh1N3ZiTUdnNXdDUWtBeW1sSlI5d2lMMThSb05RNkhUaWUyVWVOVWJDWUI0eUNSZmNPTWNidG8zWVV1bGRBWWZfWEVlRWdrU1dpLTBDTTdscVVkOUdJcmVCNmFtUG9TZHBXYnpxdHFiMmlZeElydmxNMA?oc=5) reported that Bangladesh garment workers clashed with police as pay protests forced factories to shut down.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/protesting-bangladesh-garment-workers-reject-pay-offer?traffic_source=rss) reported that protesting Bangladesh garment workers rejected a pay offer.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/bangladesh-garment-makers-eye-15-wage-hike-far-short-of-workers-demand/article71734242.ece) reported that workers are demanding a raise in the minimum monthly wage to 30,000 taka from 12,500 taka, citing soaring costs.

reports.text: [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE9OWW45UmVnM1hLQVlrNkJWWmhVQkduQmdHRkdoSXBZcS1qTTlrTmlzdjZtVUFpQ3hhSHlLanJMNUFpZDVUNDBYTmFIVkZ4b29jVGVweElPRzVfYnFJa0pvd0ZaRXQ1Q0JXRFZSS0JQYThSd3M?oc=5) reported that Gisèle Pelicot said she was deeply shocked after nude images from her rape case were used in a book promotion.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/gisele-pelicot-denuncia-a-editorial-que-envio-fotos-suyas-desnuda-a-los-medios-para-promocionar-un-libro-me-encuentro-humillada-3603712), [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/gisele-pelicot-diz-que-editora-usou-fotos-intimas-sem-consentimento-para-promover-livro.shtml) reported that 73-year-old Gisèle Pelicot announced legal action against the Tinbad publishing house and the author of an essay after stating she felt deeply shocked and humiliated by the unauthorized use of her intimate nude photographs to promote a book.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261124-gis%C3%A8le-pelicot-to-file-legal-complaint-against-publisher-over-nude-photo-use) reported that Gisèle Pelicot announced she will file a legal complaint against a publisher for using her nude photographs without consent to promote a psychoanalyst's essay.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/23/gisele-pelicot-denuncia-una-casa-editrice-ha-diffuso-mie-foto-intime_81aaf534-1963-41b5-bbdf-1f1a1efac54d.html) reported that Gisele Pelicot accused a publishing house of distributing her intimate photos in a book that implies she was an accomplice.

[El País](https://elpais.com/sociedad/2026-11-24/gisele-pelicot-denuncia-el-uso-de-imagenes-intimas-sin-su-autorizacion-para-promocionar-un-libro-me-siento-profundamente-conmocionada.html) reported that Gisele Pelicot stated she feels profoundly shocked by the unauthorized use of her intimate images to promote an essay.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/gisele-pelicot-shocked-nude-photos-promote-book-b3090415.html) reported that French publisher Tinbad sent intimate images of Gisèle Pelicot to the media to promote an essay by philosopher Sabine Prokhoris.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/french-publisher-accused-of-sending-journalists-intimate-images-of-gisele-pelicot) reported that publishing house Tinbad is accused of using intimate images of Gisèle Pelicot to promote a book three years after the start of her legal fight.

[VG](https://www.vg.no/nyheter/i/vkQJ4j/gisele-pelicot-reagerer-paa-nakenbilder-dypt-sjokkert?utm_medium=rss), [Dagens Nyheter](https://www.dn.se/sverige/gisele-pelicot-chockad-over-nakenbilder-i-bokreklam/) reported that Gisèle Pelicot announced legal action against an author and publisher after nude images of her taken by her convicted ex-husband were used in book marketing.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/gisele-pelicot-shocked-publisher-uses-nude-images-book-campaign.1137564) reported that French author and sexual violence survivor Gisèle Pelicot was shocked after a publisher used nude images in a book campaign.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/gisele-pelicot-to-sue-publisher-over-distribution-of-intimate-images/MPUAVYEJGFEB5NGJPL7BYZULQU/) reported that Gisèle Pelicot's lawyer stated intimate images were sent without consent as commercial publicity.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm3eg502nxw2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the publisher of an essay on coercive control apologized for an inappropriate communication after nude photos of Gisèle Pelicot were sent to the media.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/gisele-pelicot-deeply-shocked-after-nude-photos-used-to-promote-book-13615849) reported that Gisèle Pelicot stated she is deeply shocked and humiliated after nude images of her were sent to the media without consent.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261123-deeply-shocked-gis%C3%A8le-pelicot-sue-publisher-nude-photos-used-book-campaign) reported that Gisèle Pelicot is to sue a publisher after nude photos were used in a book campaign.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/gisele-pelicot-deeply-shocked-nude-images-book-france) reported that Gisèle Pelicot stated she will pursue legal action against the publisher and author over the use of photos taken by her convicted husband.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-24/pelicot-nude-photos-used-to-promote-psychoanalyst-book/107419434) reported that the nude photographs of Gisèle Pelicot had been used without her consent to promote a psychoanalyst's essay on coercive control.
