narratives.label: Varna municipal election commission decision

reports.text: [24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/24011996) reported that Varna businessman Krasimir Uzunov claimed he has been blackmailed by city mayor Blagomir Kotsev for a year and a half and stated he will prove it.

[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/24007488) reported that the Administrative Court in Varna scheduled the hearing for the appeal filed by Mayor Blagomir Kotsev against the Municipal Election Commission's decision for November 30.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/27/4985172_obshtinata_vuv_varna_beshe_evakuirana_sled_signal_za/?ref=rss) reported that the Varna municipal building was evacuated following a bomb threat prior to a hearing for mayor Blagomir Kotsev.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/26/4984960_sudut_vuv_varna_vurna_kmeta_blagomir_kocev_na_posta_do/?ref=rss) reported that the Administrative Court in Varna halted the preliminary execution of the decision to prematurely terminate the powers of mayor Blagomir Kotsev.

[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/23997676), [Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/25/4984635_s_kostjumi_a_ne_s_dunki_nad_1000_varnenci_protestiraha/?ref=rss) reported that hundreds of residents gathered outside the Varna municipal building in support of removed mayor Blagomir Kotsev after the Municipal Election Commission decided to terminate his term early.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/25/4984588_varnenski_praseta_dolu_rucete_ot_kmeta_protest_v/?ref=rss) reported that citizens and politicians gathered in Sofia to support Blagomir Kotsev and blocked traffic on Georgi Rakovski Street.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/25/4984049_zashto_beshe_otstranen_ot_dlujnost_kmetut_na_varna/?ref=rss) reported that Varna Mayor Blagomir Kotsev was removed from office due to more than a month of unjustified absence from work.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/24/4983722_koi_e_daniel_slavov_-_dunkata_chovekut_svurzvan_s/?ref=rss) reported that Blagomir Kotsev identified Daniel Slavov as the main driver behind the premature termination of his mayoral mandate.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/24/4983891_obnovi_evropa_osudi_otstraniavaneto_na_kocev_i_sezira/?ref=rss) reported that the Renew Europe group condemned the removal of Blagomir Kotsev from the mayoral post in Varna and referred the case to the European Commission.

[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/bulgaria/article/23987155) reported that the Renew Europe group in the European Parliament strongly condemned the decision of the Varna Municipal Election Commission to prematurely terminate Blagomir Kotsev's mandate.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2026/nov/25/treasurer-jim-chalmers-myefo-inflation-figures-coalition-one-nation-ntwnfb) reported that the Coalition would look to repeal the digital duty of care legislation.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxQOXozaER4SUdERlZsSGNJYTgzQm5GR1lrZFM5S2tsUWJTV2I1TVo3Yi1RMDJiQ3E3Q0s1T1JGQ0JDdURHTTdJNEJEZENucEVuSHdWT3kwYmpfNmw3OGVkMFVma0RXUkdzTFpyOGhCY3NsNnZJa0tlOGhETU5nS1NJOHF6aTdaVjdEUl9mOVZmRDVVbDB4X3l4YTlkelh5NlBsX2pGSQ?oc=5) reported that Australia is set to pass a digital duty of care law with fines reaching up to 5 percent of tech giants' global revenue.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxORG5QdGdxRm1nOGVuczhoUXJVbnYwakY5NUxEVEVSbzhaRUtYdGx0X25LeGhQbVE0X05XeHI3OUNkZTJDWjA5aTRHN0FSSGRQZllJUjJ1Qm1wWkI4REhSbFhDUnZXRmc3UjBpWng0aExBX1JWSGJlNlNZNUwteFFEY0daYnA5LUJEa1JlakpkcUNBUDlyRTRuSnFpZ3dzU05lMV8xNHQ4YnpUODMxbHFBWXpRLW9jZk9v?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/technology/australia-set-to-adopt-internet-safety-law-fining-tech-giants-billions-3725921) reported that Australia is set to adopt internet safety legislation under a deal between the Labor Party and the Greens, exposing tech giants like Google, TikTok, and Meta to multibillion-dollar fines.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-24/federal-politics-labor-makes-deal-greens-on-digital-duty-of-care/107420982) reported that Australian users will be able to sue social media companies under revised digital duty of care laws after Labor secured a deal to strengthen proposed online safety regulations.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/tech-giants-to-face-billion-dollar-fines-for-breaching-labor-s-digital-duty-of-care-laws-20261124-p61gsi.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that penalties for allowing harmful content on social media platforms will face fines exponentially greater than the original maximum penalties set at $109.2 million.

reports.text: [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/asi-avanza-la-reconstruccion-de-villavicencio-tras-atentado-con-carro-bomba) reported that technical information for six homes was uploaded and assistance resumed as Villavicencio reconstructs following a car bomb attack.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/urban-violence-rises-through-colombia/) reported that November 2026 strikes in Cucuta and Villavicencio reflect urban violence and the human cost of stalled territorial development in Colombia.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/paz-com-as-farc-e-um-fracasso-na-colombia-diz-ex-refem-ingrid-betancourt.shtml) reported that former hostage Ingrid Betancourt stated that peace with the FARC is a failure in Colombia.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10948947) reported that a bomb exploded outside regional government offices in Villavicencio, injuring 23 people.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/atentado-villavicencio-cilindros-bomba-marcados-farc-500-kilos-revolucion-CJ43971762) reported that military intelligence is analyzing whether a video featuring bombs signed by FARC dissident factions is linked to the car bomb attack in Villavicencio.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/no-habra-impunidad-por-el-carro-bomba-contra-la-gobernacion-del-meta-dice-vicepresidente-restrepo-FJ43972304) reported that Vice President José Manuel Restrepo joined voices of rejection regarding the car bomb attack against the headquarters of the Meta government in Villavicencio, stating there will be no impunity.

[El País](https://elpais.com/america-colombia/2026-11-24/el-estallido-de-un-coche-bomba-en-colombia-da-alas-a-los-detractores-del-acuerdo-de-paz-con-las-farc.html) reported that the explosion of a car bomb in Colombia occurred hours before the commemoration of the tenth anniversary of the peace agreement.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/colombia-car-bomb-attack-injures-at-least-23/a-80033956?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a car bomb attack in Villavicencio injured at least 23 people and coincided with the tenth anniversary of a peace accord with FARC guerrillas.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/at-least-24-injured-after-car-bomb-detonates-in-central-colombia) reported that Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella arrived in Villavicencio to hold a security meeting.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/atentado-en-villavicencio-deja-al-menos-23-heridos-y-mas-de-80-viviendas-afectadas) reported that a bomb blast in Villavicencio left at least 25 people injured and more than 80 homes affected.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/presidente-de-la-espriella-atentado-villavicencio-carro-bomba-gobernacion-meta-CI43969795) reported that Abelardo de la Espriella rejected the car bomb attack in a message on X, stating that the attack will not go unpunished.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/atentado-villavicencio-reacciones-iris-marin-gobernadora-meta-ministro-defensa-DJ43971507) reported that authorities and leaders strongly condemned the car bomb parked in front of the Meta Governor's Office.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/longform/2026/11/24/ten-years-after-its-2016-peace-deal-colombia-faces-a-return-to-conflict?traffic_source=rss) reported that critics fear a security crackdown under Abelardo de la Espriella could unravel gains made under the 2016 peace deal.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-24/colombia-marks-10-years-since-farc-peace-deal-as-de-la-espriella-threatens-its-future.html) reported that a decade after the FARC peace deal was signed, victims and former combatants are still waiting for the agreement to be fully implemented.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjqlq2n4np7do?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a car bomb in a Colombian city wounded more than 20 people in a string of attacks on government offices.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/car-bomb-destroys-buildings-in-central-colombian-city) reported that a car bomb detonated in Villavicencio, destroying a local governor's office and surrounding buildings.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/colombian-president-blames-ex-farc-rebels-for-car-bomb-blast?traffic_source=rss) reported that Colombian President De la Espriella blamed the FARC for plotting the bombing and pledged retaliation.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/atentado-centro-colombia-deja-menos-23-heridos-graves-danos-materiales_202611246b053b9aff6fec29219977c3.html) reported that an attack in central Colombia left at least 23 injured and caused severe material damage, with investigators pointing to FARC dissident leader Antonio Medina.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/atentado-en-el-centro-de-colombia-deja-heridos-y-graves-danos-materiales-33283587), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/carro-bomba-estalla-frente-a-la-gobernacion-del-meta-en-colombia-deja-al-menos-12-heridos-y-danos-materiales/) reported that a car bomb exploded in front of the government building of Meta department in Villavicencio, leaving at least twelve people injured and causing material damage.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/atentado-en-el-centro-de-colombia-deja-heridos-y-graves-danos-materiales-33283587) reported that De la Espriella described the incident as a narcoterrorist attack.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/car-bomb-destroys-buildings-in-villavicencio-says-colombian-president-de-la-espriella/article71737324.ece) reported that Colombian President De la Espriella stated a car bomb destroyed buildings in Villavicencio and that no casualties were yet confirmed from the blast, which he blamed on drug traffickers.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/car-bomb-injures-20-in-colombia-ahead-of-10th-anniversary-of-farc-peace-deal/articleshow/136125201.cms) reported that a car bomb injured 20 people in Colombia ahead of the 10th anniversary of the peace deal with FARC rebels.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/carro-bomba-en-villavicencio-explosion-sacude-el-centro-de-la-ciudad) reported that an explosion shook central Villavicencio in a car bomb attack attributed by the president to narcoterrorist groups.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/videos-atentado-explosion-villavicencio-gobernacion-MI43968004), [El País](https://elpais.com/america-colombia/2026-11-24/un-carro-bomba-explota-frente-a-la-gobernacion-del-meta-en-villavicencio.html) reported that an explosion occurred near the Governor's Office of Meta in Villavicencio.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/24/car-bomb-strikes-governors-office-in-meta-colombia?traffic_source=rss) reported that a car bomb exploded in the city of Villavicencio in Colombia's Meta Department.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/car-bomb-hits-meta-government-headquarters-in-colombias-villavicencio-3725923) reported that dozens of people were injured, including five security guards.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3375849/can-australias-pacific-diplomacy-solomon-deal-match-chinas-enduring-influence) reported that Australia's new bilateral treaty with the Solomon Islands is seen as a significant victory for Canberra's strategy of banking on development aid and economic sweeteners.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/australia-solomon-islands-sign-sweeping-pact-seen-as-countering-china/a-80043646?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/solomon-islands-signs-security-deal-with-australia?traffic_source=rss), [Military.com](https://www.military.com/video/australia-and-the-solomon-islands-sign-bilateral-security-pact-in-canberra) reported that Australia and the Solomon Islands signed a sweeping bilateral security pact in Canberra making Australia the primary security partner and requiring the archipelago to consult Canberra before making new security or infrastructure deals.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/australia-records-big-foreign-policy-win-in-deal-with-solomon-islands-20261125-p61haz.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Australia signed a treaty with the Solomon Islands as the Pacific nation scrapped its security pact with China.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOSG1oWFgtQ2pTYWVManFSTHhtZmk2UFl6VllsZFBkTWpHWUF0WGZ6LTNZaTZqTXJpeEhBWHVUallaaXhORWxVbmlaRUk0NkhPdEJXQ3puZHA4RFNIS01rdUVNS2MzdlcyalFTU0NNN2dUSFBuMy1rUmVDdWVFWlhTdGNpYVU2ZUc0bzRiZ0FWR3NiSG5hMEhF?oc=5), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/25/australia-solomon-islands-treaty-blow-to-china-pacific-influence), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/asia/solomon-islands-security-treaty-australia-china.html) reported that Australia and the Solomon Islands signed a new security treaty designating Australia as the primary security partner and excluding foreign military bases.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-25/australia-signs-pact-with-solomon-islands-in-blow-to-china/107424550), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/hard-to-overstate-australia-celebrates-diplomatic-coup-locks-out-china-in-solomons-pact-20261125-p61h20.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Australia and the Solomon Islands signed a pact banning foreign military bases and ensuring critical infrastructure is free from militarisation.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-24/china-solomon-islands-security-pact-australia/107421976), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/solomon-islands-scraps-security-agreement-with-china-in-triumph-for-australia-20261124-p61gp4.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the Solomon Islands told China it is terminating its 2022 security agreement as it moves closer to Australia.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191079/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D8%BA%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%B9%D9%82%D9%88%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7) reported that the National Gathering for Palestinian Tribes and Clans mourned the killing of Deputy Education Minister Khaled Abu Nda and his wife.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191082/%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%B8%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81%D8%A9-%D8%B5%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%BA%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84) reported that female students in Gaza City organized a silent protest denouncing the killing of the deputy minister of education.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204448/%D8%BA%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%84-9-%D9%81%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%87%D9%85-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3/) reported that Israeli airstrikes killed nine Palestinians, including the deputy minister of education in the Gaza Strip.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191022/5-%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%87%D9%85-%D9%88%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%85-%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%88%D8%AC%D8%AA%D9%87-%D8%A8%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%81%D9%8A) reported that 5 citizens were killed and others injured in Israeli bombardments and gunfire across various areas of the Gaza Strip.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204310/%D8%BA%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7-%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D9%88%D8%A3%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%AA%D9%87/) reported that an Israeli airstrike targeted a residential apartment in the al-Shati refugee camp in western Gaza city, killing Hamas leader Muhammad Abu al-Awf and his family.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190904/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D8%BA%D8%AA%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the director-general of internal security, Brigadier General Naeem Muhammad Abu Nahal, was killed in an Israeli airstrike in western Gaza.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204209/%D8%BA%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%84-%D9%81%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Israeli airstrikes killed Palestinians in Gaza, including internal security director Naeem Muhammad Abu Nahal.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/houthis-wont-seize-aden-yemeni-government-forces-say) reported that Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis have pushed as close as 60 km to Aden according to government forces.

reports.text: [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/trending/man-accused-of-breaking-into-prince-william-and-kate-middleton-s-home-entered-uk-illegally-at-least-3-times-report-101795787416164.html) reported that a man accused of burgling the home of Prince William and Kate Middleton entered the UK illegally at least three times.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642439/two-in-court-charged-with-breaking-into-prince-williams-country-home-and-stealing-cufflinks) reported that two Albanian men appeared in court charged with breaking into the country home of Prince William and Kate and stealing royal valuables.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375831/pair-stole-cufflinks-and-clock-break-home-british-royals) reported that two homeless Albanian men climbed a drainpipe to break into the country home of Prince William and Princess Catherine, stealing cufflinks and a clock.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxQd044NFM0eE0ySVNBWWpVYjRxTDVhSGM4TFBIR3dpYTVSeldfYUJLT0JJdVlmbDlSc3ZodEZjS3JmcnQ2MFlpRGo4dmd6N3haUFpYZG9NR1c5MHBEX2JYQ25uRG8zZkgzT25aUEREVGlRX3lFZ0dSUWFtWFYzcWJodzJXNA?oc=5), [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/albanians-scaled-drainpipe-to-steal-cufflinks-at-waleses-home/OZ3HDMYXKFF3ZOPTVLLDZCGCYA/) reported that two men charged in the burglary at the home of the Prince and Princess of Wales scaled a drainpipe to steal cufflinks and a clock.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-26/sandringham-estate-breakin-court-appearance/107427840), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/25/two-men-charged-over-burglary-at-william-and-catherines-home), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010795/2-charged-with-stealing-cufflinks-clock-from-prince-william-and-kate-s-home/story/) reported that the suspects allegedly stole six pairs of cufflinks and a clock.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1586859/prince-william-and-kate-review-security-after-anmer-hall-break-in/) reported that Prince William and Princess Kate are reconsidering visits to the property following the security breach.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046918/uk-police-arrest-two-men-after-break-in-at-williams-home) reported that UK police arrested two men on suspicion of burglary following a reported break-in at the countryside retreat of Prince William.

reports.text: [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/empresa-carro-valores-iban-robar-secuestradores-exito-cartagena-abren-investigacion-interna-FH44165880) reported that Brinks Colombia opened an internal investigation to determine how a criminal gang obtained privileged information before an attempted armored car robbery in Cartagena.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/secuestro-exito-cartagena-testigo-revelo-pelea-delincuentes-implicado-DH44165897) reported that a hostage at the Éxito store in Cartagena recounted that the criminals argued among themselves over stolen money and mentioned a potential fourth accomplice.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/secuestro-rehenes-exito-videos-comandos-policia-rescate-HE44159284) reported that the case file regarding the 17-hour hostage-taking at the Éxito store in Cartagena included high-precision sniper videos from one kilometer away and a spy camera used during the rescue.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/que-objetos-tenia-hombre-abatido-exito-cartagena-jailer-muneton-AF44140257) reported that the Prosecutor's Office revealed items found on Jailer Humberto Muñetón Zapata, who was killed at the Éxito store in Cartagena.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/video-jailer-muneton-abatido-exito-cartagena-toma-de-rehenes-IF44144480) reported that a video emerged showing the final moments of the man killed during the hostage-taking in Cartagena.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/chats-de-secuestradores-con-negociadores-exito-cartagena-DF44147370) reported that the Prosecutor's Office revealed chats between the alleged kidnappers and negotiators during a hearing.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/secuestradores-dieron-pollo-frisby-rehenes-exito-cartagena-antes-liberacion-DA44111893) reported that kidnappers allegedly provided chicken to the hostages held at the Éxito store in Cartagena prior to their release.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/presuntos-secuestradores-de-87-personas-en-cartagena-no-aceptaron-cargos) reported that the suspects in the mass kidnapping of 87 people in Cartagena did not accept the charges against them.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/historial-criminal-presuntos-secuestradores-exito-cartagena-lista-antecedentes-KA44117049) reported that the attempted armored car robbery leading to the mass hostage-taking involved two men with judicial backgrounds.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/alcalde-cartagena-detalles-secuestro-exito-jailer-muneton-HB44101226) reported that Cartagena Mayor Dumek Turbay gave details about the mass kidnapping that lasted approximately 17 hours at the Éxito de La Castellana.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/falso-que-2-rehenes-liberados-sean-secuestradores-de-supermercado-en-cartagena-policia-de-colombia-imagenes-se-viralizan-en-redes/) reported that Colombian police stated it is false that two liberated hostages were the kidnappers in the Cartagena supermarket incident.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/jailer-muneton-zapata-abatido-toma-rehenes-exito-cartagena-KB44101487) reported that the hostage-taking at the Éxito store in La Castellana ended with the death of a man during a police-led operation.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/daniel-acevedo-rehen-confundido-con-secuestrador-exito-cartagena-encara-presidente-que-dijo-HJ44099097) reported details following the rescue of over 67 people who remained kidnapped for more than 17 hours at the Éxito de La Castellana in Cartagena.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/mindefensa-toma-rehenes-exito-cartagena-muerte-presunto-secuestrador-rescate-EJ44097175) reported that the Ministry of Defense explained the armed forces had to act to control the threat and killed a suspected kidnapper during the hostage rescue at the Éxito store in Cartagena.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/exito-cartagena-rescate-rehenes-secuestradores-la-terraza-PJ44092638) reported that after more than 17 hours of tension, President Abelardo De la Espriella announced the conclusion of the supermarket hostage crisis in Cartagena.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/esposa-buscaba-marido-presunto-lider-secuestradores-exito-cartagena-OE44048547) reported that an investigation into a woman searching for her husband among the hostages during the Éxito de La Castellana takeover in Cartagena took an unexpected turn regarding an individual killed during the robbery attempt.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/de-rehen-a-sospechoso-historia-daniel-diaz-exito-cartagena-acusado-secuestrador-EI44087517) reported on the account of Daniel Díaz Acevedo, a man mistakenly confused with a kidnapper during the Éxito de Cartagena takeover.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/por-que-confundieron-carlos-tapia-con-secuestrador-exito-cartagena-KH44075690) reported that around 76 people were rescued after 17 hours by special forces at the Éxito de La Castellana in Cartagena.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/cartagena-supermarket-hostage-siege-ends-with-all-hostages-rescued/O6BOYD3CZBATPLWXZNSSBDPF54/) reported that Colombian police and soldiers entered a supermarket building shortly after midnight, killing one hostage-taker and rescuing 76 hostages.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/lista-nombres-personas-rescatadas-exito-cartagena-FD44039837) reported that special military and police commando units released the hostages after approximately 16 hours of detention at the Éxito supermarket in Cartagena and published their names.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/rehenes-cartagena-cuales-armas-tenian-secuestradores-JH44070494) reported that the Attorney General's Office revealed the weapons used by the suspects during the supermarket hostage situation.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/rehenes-rescate-cartagena-palabras-agradecimiento-alcalde-cartagena-operativo-HD44030531) reported that Cartagena mayor Dumek Turbay expressed gratitude following the rescue operation at the Éxito supermarket.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/cuantos-secuestradores-participaron-toma-rehenes-exito-cartagena-PF44051871) reported that military Gaulas commander Colonel Styk Amaral Reyes confirmed 46 people were rescued after 17 hours of detention.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/rescatan-los-rehenes-del-exito-en-cartagena-tras-18-horas-de-secuestro) reported that Abelardo De La Espriella confirmed the result of the joint police and security operation following an 18-hour hostage situation at an Éxito supermarket in Cartagena.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/rehenes-exito-cartagena-secuestro-testigos-noticias-colombia-AD44030716) reported that a freed hostage stated the kidnappers were drinking alcohol and listening to music.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/15-horas-tension-termino-toma-rehenes-supermercado-colombia-delincuente-abatido_0_jxV41lwHpN.html), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/25/refens-sao-resgatados-apos-17-horas-de-sequestro-em-supermercado-na-colombia.ghtml) reported that the hostage-taking incident at a supermarket in Cartagena ended after more than 15 hours with the rescue of all hostages and one hostage-taker killed.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/rescatan-a-rehenes-de-un-supermercado-de-colombia-mas-de-16-horas-despues-de-ser-tomado-por-hombres-armados-33302186) reported that President Abelardo de la Espriella stated that one of the kidnappers died during the operation after refusing to surrender.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/25/hostages-freed-colombia-security-forces-storm-cartagena-supermarket), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261125-colombian-authorities-rescue-all-hostages-held-at-cartagena-supermarket), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/25/colombian-forces-rescue-all-hostages-after-supermarket-siege?traffic_source=rss) reported that Colombian security forces rescued all hostages held during a day-long siege at a supermarket in Cartagena.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/24/huawei-china-convicted-deceiving-banks-stealing-us-trade-secrets) reported that the tech giant was found guilty on 10 of 12 criminal counts in a case that began in 2018.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/huawei-es-declarado-culpable-de-robar-secretos-comerciales-y-fraude-bancario-en-eu-evita-cargos-mas-graves/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/jurado-de-nueva-york-declara-culpable-a-huawei-de-robo-de-secretos-industriales_0_KaAaTqHwke.html) reported that a New York federal jury found Huawei guilty of bank fraud and stealing trade secrets from competitors.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-oil-gas-prices-fall-as-brent-trims-weekly-gains-ahead-of-opec-meeting/) reported that Brent crude and European natural gas prices fell on Friday as traders weighed threats to Middle Eastern energy supplies against recovering conditions.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/iraq-seeks-higher-oil-production-limit-from-opec-ahead-of-sunday-meeting-101795811868796.html) reported that Iraq's oil minister stated the country is asking OPEC to raise its oil production limit ahead of Sunday's meeting.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/OPEC-Faces-Growing-Pressure-As-Iraq-Pushes-for-Higher-Quota.html) reported that Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair said Iraq is negotiating with OPEC for permission to produce more oil because the country needs a higher quota.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/us-pushed-venezuela-iraq-consider-leaving-opec-2026/) reported that a report based on ten sources stated Washington urged Venezuela and Iraq to consider leaving OPEC, while the State Department stated the matter was not raised at the top level.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/US-Pushed-Iraq-and-Venezuela-to-Consider-Quitting-OPEC-Sources-Say.html) reported that the U.S. Administration earlier this year encouraged Iraq and Venezuela, two of OPEC's five founding members, to leave the cartel.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iraq-Boosts-Oil-Exports-to-36-Million-Barrels-per-Day.html) reported that Iraq raised its oil exports to 3.6 million barrels per day as it seeks a higher production cap.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iraq-Delays-Up-to-30-Million-Barrels-of-Crude-Oil-Shipments.html) reported that Iraq's SOMO delayed loadings of crude oil cargoes ranging between 20 and 30 million barrels.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/us-reportedly-pushed-venezuela-iraq-to-consider-leaving-opec) reported that the Trump administration earlier this year quietly encouraged Venezuela and Iraq to consider breaking away from OPEC.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-27-us-pushed-venezuela-iraq-to-consider-leaving-opec-sources-say/) reported that sources stated the Trump administration encouraged Venezuela and Iraq to consider leaving OPEC and prevented Venezuela from paying its annual membership dues.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/exclusive-us-pushed-venezuela-iraq-consider-leaving-opec-sources-say) reported that the Trump administration encouraged Venezuela and Iraq to consider leaving OPEC.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/26/iraqs-oil-revenues-hit-88bn-as-it-prepares-to-ask-for-higher-opec-quota/) reported that Iraq's oil revenues hit $8.8 billion as it prepares to ask for a higher Opec quota.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Kazakhstan-Joins-Iraq-in-Pushing-OPEC-for-a-Higher-Capacity-Rating.html) reported that Kazakhstan joined Iraq in asking OPEC+ to raise its estimate of the country's crude production capacity.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iraq-Refuses-to-Accept-OPEC-Assessment-of-its-Production-Capacity.html) reported that Iraq is refusing to accept an OPEC+ assessment stating the country can sustainably produce less than 5 million barrels of oil per day.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/iraq-rejects-opec-review-that-puts-oil-production-capacity-below-5-million-barrels-a-day-101795568526957.html) reported that Iraq's oil minister wrote to OPEC insisting the country can reach a production capacity of 5.2 million barrels a day.

narratives.label: Egypt road traffic accident condolences

reports.text: [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7197262) reported that writer Kamal Rayan stated all state institutions, the private sector, and businessmen moved to support the families of the victims and injured in the Warraq ring road accident.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4422452) reported that Health and Population Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar extended condolences to the families of the ring road accident victims.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4422459) reported that thousands of residents in the Warraq area of Giza attended the funeral of nine victims of the petroleum tanker accident on the ring road.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7197069) reported that citizens turned out in large numbers for Egyptian Red Crescent blood donation campaigns at Rehab City and Zamalek Club following the Warraq accident.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7197096) reported that talk show host Amr Adib demanded a restructuring of the traffic system following the Warraq ring road accident.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196941) reported that residents of Dakahlia buried the body of Alaa Khairy, a victim of the ring road traffic accident, at the Jedila cemeteries.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/204530/%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%87%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-27-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%B6%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82/) reported that the Egyptian Ministry of Health announced the identification of 27 victims of the petroleum tanker accident on the ring road in the Warraq area of Giza governorate.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196943) reported that the Sharqia Endowments Directorate participated in funeral prayers for four victims of the Warraq accident.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196786) reported that artists Mahmoud Abdel Moghny and Tawfik Abdel Hamid offered condolences and expressed a desire to donate to the victims of the Warraq ring road fire accident.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196622) reported that the Ministry of Health announced the completion of the identification of 27 victims of the Warraq ring road fire accident.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4421975) reported that maestro Nader Abbassi announced the cancellation of La Boheme opera performances at the Cairo Opera House to mourn the victims of the Warraq accident.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4421976) reported that Cabinet spokesman Mohamed Adel discussed the destination of donation funds collected for victims and injured individuals of the Ring Road accident.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4421977) reported that thousands of residents in North Sinai governorate performed the absentee funeral prayer for the victims of the Ring Road fire in Warraq in various mosques.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196608) reported that members of Al Ahly Club donated blood for the injured victims of the Warraq accident.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4421991) reported that Egypt's Mufti, Dr. Nazir Ayyad, led worshippers in performing the absentee funeral prayer at Al-Azhar Mosque for the martyrs of the Warraq accident.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196320) reported that preacher Al-Habib Ali Al-Jifri offered condolences regarding the victims of the Ring Road fire in the Warraq area.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196406) reported that the body of engineer Kyrollos Adib was found following his disappearance after the Warraq accident.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196268) reported that Grand Imam of Al-Azhar Ahmed the Tayeb directed the performance of the absentee funeral prayer following Friday prayers for the victims of the Warraq accident.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195506) reported that Endowments Minister Osama Al-Azhari directed mosques to perform the absentee funeral prayer for the victims of the Warraq accident following Friday prayers.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196010) reported that Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly reviewed a report from the unified government complaints system regarding inquiries and reports received concerning the Warraq Ring Road accident.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7196146) reported that Professional Footballers Association head Magdy Abdel Gany announced a financial donation for the families of victims and injured of the Warraq accident.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195960) reported that the Egyptian cabinet announced receiving contributions totaling hundreds of millions of pounds to support the families of victims of the Ring Road and Warraq accidents.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4421118) reported that Awqaf Minister Osama Al-Azhari directed mosques across Egypt to hold absent funeral prayers for the victims of the Ring Road accident.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195522) reported that the African Football Confederation approved Zamalek's request for a minute of silence for the victims of the Ring Road accident.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4420530) reported that Islam Azzam, head of the Financial Regulatory Authority, instructed the Egyptian Motor Insurance Pool to quickly disburse compensation to the families of victims and the injured from the Ring Road fire in Warraq.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195279) reported that the government complaints system announced it is receiving inquiries from families of victims and the injured via the hotline 16528.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4420752) reported that the Secretary General of the Gulf Cooperation Council expressed condolences to Egypt over the Ring Road fire victims.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195699) reported that actress Asmaa Galal mourned the victims of the Warraq fire.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195712) reported that Saudi King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud sent cables of condolence to Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi over the victims of the Warraq accident.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4421114) reported that the management of the Arab Excellence and Creativity Forum postponed its fifth-edition ceremony, which was scheduled for today, to mourn the souls of the victims of the Warraq Ring Road accident.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195524) reported that television programme presenters wore black to express grief over the Ring Road accident in the Warraq area and sent messages of solidarity to the victims' families.

[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4420755) reported that the North Giza Prosecution identified the body of the heavy transport fuel tanker driver who died in the Warraq fire accident and ordered blood tests to check for drug use.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/204418/%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D9%88%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%88-%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%A7%D9%87%D8%AF-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1/) reported on footage and scenes from the massive fuel truck fire on the Giza Ring Road in Egypt after a tanker collided with a concrete barrier, killing 31 people and injuring 26.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/204414/%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%AA%D8%B6%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B3%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B6%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7/) reported that Arab countries expressed solidarity with Egypt following the petroleum tanker truck accident on the Warraq Ring Road in Giza, which resulted in 31 deaths and 21 injuries.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195064) reported that eyewitness Yusuf Ahmed gave an account of the initial moments of the fuel truck overturning and catching fire on the Warraq Ring Road.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195276) reported that singer Sherine Abdel Wahab expressed grief and sympathy for the victims of the Warraq accident.
[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7195021) reported that actress Yasmine Sabri offered condolences to the families of the victims of the Warraq Ring Road fire.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191025/%D9%82%D9%88%D9%89-%D9%88%D9%81%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%84-%D9%81%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%B6%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B2%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%B6%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that Palestinian factions and Hamas expressed solidarity with Egypt and offered condolences over the victims of the Ring Road fire in Giza's Warraq district.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/204423/%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D9%87%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A8-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82/) reported that the Egyptian Public Prosecution announced the arrest of the suspect accused of causing the petroleum tanker collision and fire in Giza's Waraq district.
[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4420740) reported that Turki Al Sheikh offered condolences to Egyptians over the fatal accident victims.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91403) reported that EU leaders left Brussels without agreement on a €45 billion loan for Ukraine or the bloc’s seven-year budget.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261127-eu-leaders-split-over-budget-spending-and-a-49-billion-loan-to-ukraine) reported that French President Emmanuel Macron set an end-of-year deadline for an agreement on the European Union's next seven-year budget after leaders ruled out an immediate deal.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxNd3JOOEtUbWY4Z3hoM0cxZU40cDlZRmRiQjdPaU14LVhuYzBzUWhSSWl3SHprS1N4VmxxMV91Z0FuZWYxbXFTV2doOTIweUpPMUpjWlhFMXJndkVIVF9veUlkUDhTMDhpWGFmVk1sSVl6X016d19xRGtPVDg0a1loUE1MYV9VdlB3d0h2dm5rVVdFbGlQdVJkNnBVeTlqXzY1?oc=5) reported that a Ukraine loan is in limbo after EU budget talks stalled and leaders scheduled another attempt in three weeks.

reports.text: [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1588301/seven-killed-in-israeli-airstrikes-across-gaza-as-hamas-reports-attack-on-chiefs-son/) reported that Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed seven Palestinians across the Gaza Strip while Hamas accused Israel of attempting to assassinate the chief's youngest son.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642722/hamas-chiefs-family-survives-israeli-strike) reported that several people were wounded in an air attack on a residential apartment but no deaths were reported.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/hamas-chief-khalil-al-hayyas-son-survives-israeli-drone-strike-in-gaza-city-101795817960514.html) reported that seven Palestinians were reportedly killed in separate Israeli strikes.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/28/world/son-hamas-chief-survives-israeli-strike/) reported that the strike wounded several individuals, including al-Hayya's daughter-in-law.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/israel-kills-four-in-gaza-as-hamas-chief-al-hayyas-son-survives-strike?traffic_source=rss) reported that Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya's last surviving son, Izzeldeen, survived an Israeli strike in Gaza.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/hamas-israel-military-strike-khalil-al-hayya-b3093052.html) reported that Hamas official Basem Naim stated that Khalil al-Hayya survived a dawn airstrike.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/02d6e60e5fc7), a state-media outlet, reported that Hamas stated Israel is using ridiculous claims to justify attacks on Gaza hospitals.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-hamas-says-israel-attempted-to-assassinate-leaders-son-in-gaza/) reported that Hamas stated the Israeli army attempted to assassinate a son of its leader Khalil al-Hayya by targeting a residential apartment in the Gaza Strip.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261127-hamas-says-israeli-claim-that-it-used-al-ahli-hospital-as-interrogation-center-is-ridiculous/) reported that Hamas called the Israeli army's claim that it used one of the buildings at Al-Ahli Baptist Hospital in Gaza City as an interrogation center ridiculous.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-916319) reported that Israel struck a residential apartment in Gaza City targeting Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya's last surviving son, with his fate remaining unknown and six Palestinians wounded.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/hamas-reports-israeli-assassination-attempt-on-al-hayyas-son), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/090ee92fce94) reported that the Palestinian resistance group stated the Israeli military attempted to assassinate a son of Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya following threats made against its leader by Israeli caretaker Defence Minister Israel Katz.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/462891/) reported that an Israeli airstrike targeted an apartment in the Rimal neighborhood of Gaza with the objective of targeting the son of Khalil al-Hayya.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/191106/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%86%D8%AC%D9%84-%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9) reported that Hamas political bureau member Basem Naim stated that the Israeli military's attempt to target the youngest son of the movement's political bureau chief is an extension of criminal Israeli policy.
